store_data.about_the_game:
You are an airport security officer.

Your job is to screen passengers' luggage, search for contraband, and make decisions that

help maintain order and security.

🔍 YOUR TOOLS:

Use modern baggage screening equipment:

a magnifying glass for detailed inspection, a UV flashlight to detect hidden tags,

a hammer for checking hidden compartments, a torch for thermal testing,

chemical analyzers, and X-ray scanners. Each tool unlocks as you progress

and helps you find increasingly sophisticated contraband.

💻 YOUR COMPUTER:

At your workstation, a computer with useful applications awaits you:

• Database – a directory of all items with detailed descriptions and a search function

• Black Market – a secret marketplace for selling found contraband (but be careful!)

• Manuals – useful information about different types of bombs and dangerous items

• Access Panel – control access to secret areas

👮 YOUR GUARD:

A police officer patrols the area to maintain order.

If he discovers contraband in your possession, be prepared to pay a fine.

Work carefully and don't get caught!

📈 YOUR PROGRESSION:

Earn money for successful inspections, level up,

purchase new tools and mechanics. With each level, new opportunities open up:

more advanced equipment, challenging missions, and interesting discoveries.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering English transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.

WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.

More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!

WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.

                                                               

British English available now, American English will be added for free mid-April 2026

Key Features

  • Immersive English Learning

    • Learn practical English through every conversation, quest, and puzzle.

    • More than 40 hours of combined learning and gameplay.

    • 3 Modes to adapt the difficulty for beginners, A1 and A2 level learners.

                                                               

  • Engaging Storyline

    • Follow the journey of a young hero who must learn English to lift a magical curse from their brother.

    • Explore vibrant villages, uncover secrets, and build friendships interracting with over 60 unique NPCs.

  • Learning as a Gameplay Mechanic

    • Solve puzzles, and complete quests by forming sentences and understanding dialogues.

    • Practice building sentences and pronunciation thanks to speech recognition challenges (On Windows only for the moment).

    • Utilize in-game tools like a dictionary and contextual help to aid your learning.

                                                             

  • Spaced Repetition Combat Challenges

    • Engage in language-based combat to reinforce language retention.

    • Combat challenges are designed using the spaced repetition principle

  • Real-World Context Practice

    • Apply your English skills in everyday scenarios such as buying groceries or making an appointment at the doctor.

    • Experience practical vocabulary and grammar in real-world contexts to enhance your language proficiency.

                                                       

  • Customizable Learning Experience

    • Customize your learning journey with various difficulty settings to make the experience more or less challenging based on your preference.

    • Set daily goals and earn rewards for reaching them, helping you build a consistent learning routine.

  • Rich Interactive World

    • Explore exotic locations, each introducing specific English vocabulary and grammar rules.

    • Participate in mini-games like crosswords, memory games, and charades to diversify your learning experience.

      WonderLang can be played with a mouse and keyboard, mouse only, or keyboard only.

      It also plays great on the Steam Deck with an official control layout.

      Other languages available to learn (separate versions of WonderLang): French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean.

store_data.about_the_game:
Project: Latticeborn is a fast-paced 3D action roguelite where you control an expendable warrior known as a Shardborn—a crystal-forged humanoid created in the heart of The Bastion, your upgradeable base. Every run sends you into the chaotic wilds of The Frontier, a shifting combat zone filled with shard-corrupted enemies and elemental hazards.

Fight through waves of foes, collect resources, unlock new weapons, and expand your Bastion to forge stronger successors. Death isn’t an end—it’s part of the cycle.

🔥 SURVIVE THE FRONTIER

Dash, weave, and unleash automatic shard-powered attacks while swarms of enemies close in. The Frontier is procedurally generated, ensuring every run is fresh.

🏗️ UPGRADE YOUR BASTION

Between runs, return to your base to unlock:

  • New weapons

  • Meta-upgrades

  • Run modifiers

  • Class unlocks

  • Building levels

Your Bastion grows visibly as you progress.

⚔️ MASTER 10+ UNIQUE WEAPON TYPES

Each weapon type has fully different mechanics:

  • Orbiting shard blades

  • Homing projectiles

  • Cone shockwaves

  • Nova bursts

  • Elemental bombs

  • Soul-stealing scythes

  • Chain-smash maces

Upgrade general stats or weapon-specific traits for crazy synergies.

🌩️ ELEMENTAL STATUS SYSTEM

Inflict burning, freezing, lightning chains, lifesteal void slashes, healing verdant blooms, and aether fields.
Combine elements for explosive reactions.

🧬 BECOME THE PERFECT SHARDBORN

Each run shapes your build. Mix:

  • Count upgrades

  • Cooldown reductions

  • Element potency

  • Range & projectile speed

  • Unique weapon effects

Every death is a chance to rebuild your next Shardborn stronger.

⚡ KEY FEATURES

  • Fast-paced 3D survival combat

  • Procedural arenas

  • Multiple weapon types & elemental builds

  • Upgradeable home base (The Bastion)

  • Persistent progression

  • Chunky, rewarding hit feedback

  • Stylized arcane-crystal visuals

  • Dozens of upgrade choices per run

  • Low system requirements

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into a relaxing and enchanting puzzle adventure where every completed level reveals a stunning portrait of a beautiful girl. Enjoy a calm, atmospheric experience as you slide, swap, and arrange tiles to uncover each image piece by piece. With difficulty scaling smoothly across stages, your focus and puzzle-solving skills will be gently put to the test.

Play entirely at your own pace—no timers, no pressure, just pure stress-free gameplay. Whether you're a casual player or a puzzle enthusiast, this title offers captivating visuals and a soothing flow you can return to anytime.

Features :

Unlock charming artwork: Reveal new illustrations of lovely girls as you progress.

Relaxing soundtrack: Soft background music creates a peaceful, immersive atmosphere.

Full-image viewer: Enjoy each completed picture in full once the puzzle is finished.

Endless progression: Experience countless levels with gradually increasing challenge.

No time limits: Play freely without rush or stress.

store_data.about_the_game:
PROJECT AROMA is a VR experience focused on recreating the subtle, tactile details of everyday interactions in a calm and atmospheric environment.

The goal of the simulation is to translate familiar activities into VR with a high level of physics feedback, creating a space where users can slow down, explore, and engage with objects at their own pace.

This is not a game, there are no objectives nor progression, Is designed as an open sandbox for relaxation and interaction.

The current version expands on the demo with an additional environment and interactive activities. The experience will continue to grow over time with new interactions, improvements, and content updates.

I'd love to read your feedback!

Key Features:

  • High-fidelity, physics-based object interaction

  • Detailed object mechanics and gestures

  • Cozy, atmospheric environments

  • Interactive activities and minigames

  • Open sandbox design

Planned Features:

  • Expanded interactions and objects

  • Preparing drinks such as tea and coffee

  • Advanced liquid simulation and pouring mechanics

  • Destructible and reactive objects

  • New environments and interactive scenarios

store_data.about_the_game:
Grandma’s Little Store is a cozy store management game set in a forgotten Japanese ghost town.

You play as a kind-hearted grandma running the last surviving general store, a quiet place where stories are exchanged as often as goods.

By day, town residents stop by with their daily needs. Chat with them at the counter, listen to their struggles, and slowly become part of their lives.

But when night falls… things change.

Spirits begin to visit your shop. Some are harmless. Some are not. Serve them well, learn their stories… or risk becoming one of them. 

Welcome each customer into your store and witness their small, meaningful moments.

Handle checkouts, listen to their stories, and respond to their needs. Your choices shape both their lives and your shop.

Keep your store running smoothly.

Arrange shelves, restock items, manage prices and expiry dates, and maintain a clean, cozy space your customers will love.

Every customer has a story.

Pay attention, connect the clues, and help solve the hidden problems within the town.

Your actions may change their fate and uncover the truth behind the spirits.

  • Day & Night Gameplay
    Experience two sides of the shop—serve human customers by day, and mysterious spirits by night.

  • Cozy Store Management
    Organize shelves, restock goods, manage prices, and keep your store clean and welcoming.

  • Meaningful Customer Stories
    Build relationships through small conversations. Learn about your customers’ lives, struggles, and secrets.

  • Supernatural Encounters
    Meet yokai and spirits, each with unique personalities, needs, and hidden intentions.

  • Mystery & Choice
    Pay attention to details, connect clues, and help solve the town’s hidden problems.

  • Customize Your Store
    Improve and decorate your shop to attract more customers and create a warm atmosphere.

  • A Quiet, Emotional Narrative
    A slow-paced, story-rich experience about connection, loneliness, and the unseen world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Decide the fate of Orcania

Years ago, a huge meteorite struck our planet in the state of Orcania. The government covered up the event and militarized the impact zone, prohibiting access. A year later, tycoon Hugh Powell staged a coup and unleashed a war in Grinjil. His forces, superior in numbers and technology, won after a devastating battle: the city was left in ruins, thousands were killed, and the royal family was captured and publicly executed. Powell proclaimed himself president and imposed a dictatorship that, although many accept with resignation, is still resisted by numerous rebel groups, such as the protagonists of this story.

Key Features

  • Explore Orcania by land, sea, and air

  • Brand new scenes

  • New original soundtrack

  • New radio stations

  • Skill tree and talent points

  • Character improvement through cybernetic implants system

  • Crafting (Cooking, Weapons, and Chemistry)

  • Car races

  • New arcade mini-games

  • Achievements

  • Dozens of side quests

  • Autosave

store_data.about_the_game:
RESTORE THE RHYTHM OF THE UNIVERSE In a world that has fallen into absolute silence, you are the spark. Echo Factory is a minimalist, audio-visual incremental game where your goal is to rebuild the audio spectrum from scratch.

Start by generating simple waves. (Accessibility Update: No mouse clicking required—press ANY key on your keyboard to produce Echoes!) As your resources accumulate, you will construct a massive factory of sound, turning a quiet void into a symphony of neon lights and frequencies.

AUTOMATE & MAINTAIN THE SYMPHONY Why click when you can engineer? Unlock and build advanced machines like Resonators, Amplifiers, and Harmonizers. But beware: machines degrade.

Introducing the System Diagnostics layer:

  • Active Maintenance: Corrupted sectors will drop your efficiency. Extract them into your buffer and patch the system.

  • High Risk, High Reward: Fill your buffer and trigger OVERCLOCK to double your production—but prepare for a massive wave of system errors!

  • Hire Engineers: Automate the repair process with dedicated engineers and upgrade your Firewalls and Shields to protect your factory.

DEEP STRATEGIC PROGRESSION This isn't just about watching numbers go up. Strategy matters.

  • Frequency Tree: Customize your playstyle in a massive, branching skill tree. Will you focus on active power, passive automation, or offline efficiency?

  • Synergy Upgrades: Don't just upgrade everything blindly. Combine specific machines to unlock powerful synergy multipliers.

  • Rebuild The Core (Prestige): When progress slows down, trigger a cosmic reset. You will lose your machines but gain Frequency Memory—a permanent currency that allows you to push further and faster in the next cycle.

KEY FEATURES

  • Satisfying Gameplay: Experience the dopamine rush with rhythmic visual feedback, floating texts, and screen-shaking particle bursts.

  • Neon Synthwave Aesthetic: A vibrant visual style accompanied by a soundtrack that builds up layer by layer as you unlock new technologies.

  • Offline Progress: Your factory never sleeps. Earn Echoes even when you are away.

  • Infinite Scalability: From thousands to quintillions—push the limits of mathematics.

Can you break the silence?

store_data.about_the_game:
For ages, the dwarves have defended their mountain and its sacred heart. But fallen clans, now cursed, seek to drag all others into the realm of the forgotten. These dwarves lack all emotion, have abandoned all bonds of fellowship, and will do anything to claim your mountain. Build your base and stand against them—your mountain must not fall.

The lands are rich with resources—wood, stone, food, and more. Gather them by hand early on, then automate production as your settlement grows. Once your economy is running, turn your focus to hunting down enemy encampments, strengthening your defenses, and preparing for the harsh days ahead.

The farther you venture from your mountain, the more dangerous the lands become—but the rewards grow just as steeply. Decide whether the risk is worth the riches, or stay closer to home for safer, smaller gains. Rare resources lie in the outer regions, enabling stronger units, new buildings, and powerful upgrades.

With each passing day, enemy forces grow stronger in the shadows, ready to strike in larger and more frequent waves. Only by training brave dwarves and building solid defenses can you withstand the assault and survive the coming onslaught.

Your primary goal is to defend the mountain—its heart is sacred to the dwarves of your settlement. But survival isn’t just about defense; maintaining a good relationship with the mountain itself is crucial. If your people go hungry or fail to honor the heart, consequences will follow. Keep it pleased, however, and you may be rewarded.

store_data.about_the_game:
StimDock is a collection of tiny games and simulations you can keep open on your desktop.

You start in the Hub, a simple screen where you can browse, preview, and launch each micro-game. From here, you can switch games at any time, read quick instructions, and adjust settings both globally and per game.

Each game runs inside a small, transparent game window.

It floats above your other applications and is easy to move around, so you can keep it open while working, browsing, or playing something else.

At its core, StimDock is a collection of small games and visual simulations that live on your desktop.

From spinners and sliders to click-based games and purely visual systems, each experience can be actively engaged with, simply observed as it runs in the background, or anything in between.

You can customize how the window behaves, switch between games at any time, and use StimDock as a light, always-available companion on your desktop.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore, Parkour, Save the world!

Skybound is a game about exploration with an Exhilarating movement system. Using Bells abilities to bring the world back together!

Skybound is a 3D exploration platformer focused on fun, fluid movement mechanics, parkour and environmental puzzle solving. You play as Bell, a young archaeologist exploring mystical floating islands in search of ancient artifacts. Use Bell's specialized equipment - including a Grappling Anchor, agility boots, and mastery over the magical "Flow" - to investigate ruins untouched by explorers for ages.

Swing through the sky, traverse the islands and meet its curious and whacky inhabitants. You've got a contract to fulfill and mysteries to unearth!

Please note that this is only ACT 1, more acts will be made if the game is positively received!

FEATURES

In Skybound you can EXPLORE three different islands.

By using Bell's GRAPPELING HOOK.

And once you've mastered the MOMENTUM and FLOW of the game you'll be FLYING like this:

And Most importantly, you can destroy oh so many POTS! Some even contain collectibles!

And if your good enough you might make it to the global Steam Leaderboards!

The Story of Skybound

Bell wasn't exactly what Professor A. N. Curia - who studies anicent human civilization - expected to receive. Shipped to the Professor  archaeologist as "Human Remains", the package contained something far more alive: a baby. Turns out, raising a human is excellent for research (and admittedly, pretty adorable).

Growing up, Bell took to her mentor/parent's work in a big way. She spent countless nights under the blanket reading about lost civilizations, and even more time tagging along on excavation trips. Eager as ever, she learned fast by studying artifacts, documenting ruins and decoding ancient texts. By seventeen, she'd shaped into a fine archaeologist in her own right.

Now she's got her very first solo job! The client came through Professor A. N. Curia, so they must be reputable. The mission is straightforward: retrieve an artifact from the ancient and mysterious sky islands and prove she's a real archaeologist. This is the beginning of something great!

But as Bell explores the floating ruins, something feels... off. Questions keep surfacing that don't quite add up. What exactly does the client want with this artifact? And why all the secrecy?

Please note: This is a student demo

Skybound is a demo created over 6 weeks by a multidisciplinary team of students from many different universities together for a semester at DADIU (Danish Academy of Digital, Interactive Entertainment). This project brought together aspiring developers, artists, designers and composers, all of whom have never worked on a game of this scale before, and with this tight of a schedule.

While we're incredibly proud of what we've accomplished in such a short timeframe, you may encounter bugs or rough edges along the way. We appreciate your understanding and hope you enjoy exploring the sky islands with Bell despite any hiccups!

Thank you for playing our game!

store_data.about_the_game:
OUTBREAK

🧑‍👦 A Father and His 14-Year-Old Son Developing a Game from Cuba

Before anything else, we want to be completely transparent.

Outbreak is being developed in Cuba by only two people: a father and his 14-year-old son.

We are not a studio.
We do not have investors.
We do not have a development team.

This project is built using pre-made and marketplace assets acquired from various platforms, which are then integrated, customized, adjusted, and combined into our own survival experience.

Everything you see in this game is the result of learning, testing, failing, improving, and continuing forward — together.

When you support Outbreak, you are not just buying a game.
You are directly supporting a young developer who is learning game development at 14 years old, building his first major project alongside his father in Cuba, with limited resources but strong commitment.

⚠️ Development Status & Transparency

Outbreak is in active development.

Because it is built by an extremely small team:

  • You may encounter bugs.

  • Some systems may still be evolving.

  • Optimization may vary depending on hardware.

  • Features will continue expanding over time.

However:

  • The game is fully playable.

  • Updates are planned consistently.

  • New mechanics, weapons, vehicles, locations, and improvements will be added.

  • All future updates are free for owners of the game.

Our commitment is long-term improvement and transparency.

🌍 The Game

Multiplayer • First & Third Person • Post-Apocalyptic Survival

The outbreak didn’t start with explosions.
It started with silence.

Signals failing.
People disappearing.
Confusion spreading.

Within days, civilization collapsed.

Outbreak places you in a multiplayer survival world where trust is fragile, resources are scarce, and every encounter matters.

There is no scripted story.

The story is created by player interaction.

🔥 Core Features (Deeply Detailed)

🎮 Dual Perspective System — First & Third Person

Outbreak allows seamless switching between first-person and third-person perspectives at any time.

First Person Mode:

  • Increased immersion.

  • Higher tension during combat.

  • More precise aiming.

  • Limited field of view for realistic vulnerability.

  • Strong atmospheric immersion during exploration.

Third Person Mode:

store_data.about_the_game:
LIST is a 3D action-RPG inspired by shōnen battles.
Every second of combat matters: slow down time, grab weapons mid-air, and search for the weakness of a relentless boss who never gives you a break. The goal is simple — survive long enough to understand your enemy.

Key Features

  • Time-slow combat – create a moment of clarity in the middle of chaos.

  • A single evolving boss – your opponent changes form and tactics as you progress.

  • Random weapons – adapt to whatever appears on the battlefield.

  • RPG progression – unlock new skills and fighting styles after every defeat.

  • Shōnen-inspired battle design – tension, strategy, and emotion at the heart of every fight.

  • Easy to pick up – smooth controls mean no long tutorials before the action starts.

The Story

You play as a young boy from a peaceful mountain village.
On the day he leaves home to explore the world and discover the mystery of the list in the sky, a creature crashes down from above — destroying everything.

Driven by rage, he chooses to fight the monster alone.
The enemy is not human — it is searching for something called “The Door.”
It doesn’t care about the villagers. It doesn’t even see the boy as an enemy.
But he will make sure it remembers him.

Our Goals

LIST aims to capture what makes a real shōnen battle unforgettable:
tension, strategy, and style — all delivered through gameplay, not long tutorials or endless dialogue. The focus is simple: one fighter, one monster, one chance to win.

About This Game

My Killer Harem

You wake up in an abandoned mansion with no memory of how you got there. Three beautiful women claim to know you—they say they're your classmates, your friends, your lovers. But one of them is lying. One of them is a killer. And all of them are obsessed with you.

Can you survive their love?

Game Overview

My Killer Harem is a NSFW survival horror visual novel that combines the tension of a dating sim with the terror of a horror game. Navigate dangerous relationships where trust can be your greatest weapon—or your undoing.

Features

Three Compelling Characters: Each with their own dark secrets and motivations

- Luna (The Yandere): Sweet, clingy, and violently protective. She believes she's the only one who can save you—even if it means killing anyone who gets in her way.

- Morgana (The Occultist): Cryptic, seductive, and deeply into dark magic. She believes the mansion is a fated place where destinies intertwine.

- Emma (The Innocent): Seemingly scared and vulnerable, she relies on you for protection. But is her innocence just a mask?

Psychological Horror: Experience a story where paranoia and trust collide. Every choice matters, and high affection might be just as dangerous as low affection.

Multiple Endings: Your choices determine who lives, who dies, and whether you escape the mansion alive.

Atmospheric Locations: Explore the dilapidated mansion, dark forest, mysterious basement, and abandoned classroom as you piece together the truth.

Trust & Sanity Systems: Balance relationships carefully—too much trust can be deadly, and witnessing horror events will test your sanity.

Story

Trapped in an abandoned mansion with three women who claim to know you, you must navigate a web of lies, obsession, and murder. Each woman has her own version of your shared past, but their stories don't add up. As the nights grow darker and the danger escalates, you'll discover that in this twisted game of love and death, survival means choosing who to trust—and who to betray.

Content Warning

This game contains mature themes including psychological horror, violence, dark romance, and adult situations. Recommended for mature audiences only.

store_data.about_the_game:
TRAPPED IN THE HOUSE OF A SERIAL KILLER

After a car accident, you and your girlfriend, Mary are held captive by a serial killer. You are trapped in a house that has every door chained and every window boarded up. All that matters is to find Mary and to get far away from this house of horrors.

STAY SILENT AND HIDDEN TO SURVIVE

Every move you make and everything you interact with creates noise. Raising the sound meter too high will lessen your chance of survival. Stay in the shadows and hide in closets, under beds or behind furniture. The killer’s sight is not as keen as his hearing, but he can still see in well lit areas.

EXPLORE AND COLLECT ITEMS TO UNCOVER THE MYSTERY

Uncover the mystery of what happened to the family who lived in the house and on the farm. Learn what caused a nice young family to fall victim to tragic events.  Piece together the story through the many interactive objects that give light to the secrets of the killer’s past.

SAVE THE GIRL AND FIND A WAY TO ESCAPE

The main objective is finding and rescuing Mary. Her life depends on you. Find her before it is too late. To make your escape with Mary, you will need to find tools, equipment and keys that allow you to get through blocked areas. Search everywhere for what might become useful for your escape.

The Adventure Begins!

An unknown flying island arrives and attaches itself to the core of the planet, as well as releasing thousands upon thousands of minions across the globe! Greeny, awakened by this unannounced entrance, must now traverse to the top of the mountains to confront whoever is behind this invasion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Imago Season is a true narrative roleplaying experience. Explore an alien city inhabited by human-insect hybrids. Roll dice, join a revolution, become a mutant yourself. What are you willing to do in order to find your truth? The choices are yours, but so are the consequences.

You wake up naked and soaking in a cold cave. Something has gone wrong. In the place where you expected to find your memories, only a splitting headache is found, as if someone had lodged a brick in the back of your skull. To make matters worse, after escaping you find yourself at the center of a conspiracy, watched by the mutiple, judgmental eyes of insect-people that you do not recognise. Search for your lost memories and elucidate what is your place in all this. If possible, do it before open war breaks out in the City. Good luck.

Narrative-focused roleplaying

Your character's skills are the way you interact with the world and its denizens. Perhaps you are an expert trickster, able to get anyone to share their secrets with you. Or maybe you prefer to threaten with physical violence to get someone to talk. The choice is yours.

Dice rolls are informed by your past choices. Use your skills to impress, coax, haggle, extort and, hopefully, solve this mysterious situation that you have found yourself in.

In a city inhabited by mutants, you have to keep up. Modify your character with ant feelers, dragonfly wings or crab claws to upgrade your skills and achieve your goals.

A rich world to explore

Excentric worldbuilding and a social approach to sci-fi make the world of Imago Season into a living, breathing character in itself. Discover the stories of a planet where people left their humanity behind to become something new.

First person exploration in a small open world. Break into someone's home, be invited to a clandestine meeting, attend a ball at the palace and end up jailed at the police station. Leave no stone unturned in your adventures in the City.

The City's denizens have their own problems. You never know where you will find an unexpected ally or who is hiding a dark past from their own friends. You decide if and how you help (or take advantage of) the characters that you will meet along the search for your own memories.

Imago Season has no bespoke combat mechanics, but that does not mean you are safe. Multiple factions wage a secret war for control of the City, and they will try to win you over if your prove to be useful. Who will you choose to help, when your own past threatens to reveal a deathly trap?

💖 ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST 💖

✦ A destiny bound by time and a vampire's bite. Are you ready to make your choice?

«Vampire’s Kiss: Time Paradox» is a romantic anime-style visual novel where the secrets of ancient vampires collide with the paradoxes of distorted time. This is a story not only about love but also about trust, choice, and consequences. Perfect for those seeking a deep plot, emotional engagement, and the chance to experience their own unique version of an anime drama.

✦ 🧛‍♀️ Meet the Characters:

  • Ayane: She seems like an ordinary schoolgirl with a troubled past... but her destiny is already intertwined with the night world.

  • Akira: A brash vampire whose one and only secret can turn everything upside down.

  • Kaito: A doctor with a kind heart. But why does his care feel so much like a mask?

  • Ren: A vampire hunter for whom law and duty have always come above all else. Until now.

  • Hikaru: The mysterious Keeper of Time. He observes the conflict from the sidelines, but his neutrality is the greatest mystery of all.

✦ 💞 Immerse Yourself in the Story:

Ayane's ordinary life shatters after a mysterious bite. Now, her fate and the fate of the entire world depend on the choice she must make. Build a relationship with the one who has touched your heart and uncover all the secrets held by the port town of Port Harumi.

  • 3 unique romantic routes with deeply developed characters.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is an innovative game that deeply integrates "Stealth" with "Exploiting Bugs" as its core mechanics.

In the virtual world of MoMoLand, Bugs are not glitches—they are the tools you rely on to survive and break the rules. Your objective is to navigate through limited, sandbox-style maps, using various Bugs to evade patrolling security robots and reach the exit.

Game Content

The Virtual World: MoMoLand: countless strange and unpredictable bugs—real or illusory—lurk in every corner, forming this unique stage of unstable rules. Parkour, teleportation, spiral flight? Of course—that's just how this world works！

Primary Goal: Your main objective is to navigate through 7 distinctively designed arena-style levels, using Bugs in each scene to evade or outsmart the patrol bots, find the exit, and advance the journey to find your friend.

Varied Challenges: Beyond completion, each level hides extra challenges, such as:

  • Flawless Stealth Runs

  • Speedrun Trials

  • Bug Collection Quests

  • Creative Completion (combining bugs in the most unexpected ways to progress).

Core Gameplay

Bug-Driven Stealth: Here, you can "clip into obstacles" to avoid detection, "fall through the ground" to teleport, or "tread on air bridges" to traverse buildings. Players rely on creativity to forge new stealth routes.

Open-Ended Puzzle Solving: No map has a single fixed solution. Countless possible bug combinations and applications make every challenge unique!

Fast-Paced "Hide and Seek": With streamlined controls and rapid pacing, players interact with various objects in the environment to engage in thrilling chases and evasion. Don’t overthink—just run!

Game Details

Genre: Fast-Paced / Sandbox Stealth / Puzzle
Duration: The focused linear experience lasts approximately 7–8 hours, spanning 7 meticulously designed levels. Completionists seeking all challenges will enjoy significantly extended playtime.
Soundtrack: Electronic music fused with digital glitch effects, meticulously enhancing the virtual world’s unstable ambiance and the tension of stealth sequences.

This is an adventure about "glitches" and "rules."

Here, deviation isn't just acceptable—it's the only way forward.

Who says there's only one route to the goal? Get ready to defy conventions and carve your own unique route through the cracks in the code!

store_data.about_the_game:
Sip Or Die is a psychological horror death game built for 4‑player online multiplayer. Four kidnapped strangers awaken in a sealed ritual chamber, abducted by a sadistic antagonist known only as The Pigman. With no memory of how they arrived and no knowledge of each other, they are forced to compete in a lethal drinking game where survival depends on chance, strategy, and cruelty. 

The chamber itself is possessed, bathed in red light, and ruled by a demonic entity known as The Overseer. Emerging from the wall with shifting facial animations, The Overseer reacts in real time to the unfolding ritual. The Pigman enforces its will, filling vials and triggering the wheel as commanded. 

Sip Or Die is a high‑tension psychological party horror. On each round, you will gamble with life itself. As the ritual progresses, pressure escalates as players betray, manipulate, and watch alliances collapse. Constant psychological tension defines the experience. 

The Pigman is always present, obeying The Overseer and enforcing the ritual. He fills the vials, spins the wheel, and ensures the rules are followed. The danger comes from both the environment and the other players: poisoned drinks, revolvers, electric chairs, and Pigman‑controlled roulette events ensure no one is safe. 

At the heart of the ritual are the vials. Some contain water, others poison, and others trigger brutal outcomes. Players interact with the vial wheel and the Wheel of Fortune, both operated by the Pigman under the Overseer’s gaze. These items dictate the flow of the game, shifting power and forcing unpredictable results. 

Each player begins with two hearts, representing their lives. Survival means protecting those hearts while targeting others. Strategic betrayals, shifting alliances, and direct player targeting are all part of the cycle. Every decision carries weight, and the psychological pressure never lets up. 

The game takes place in a possessed, red‑lit ritual chamber. The Overseer’s demonic face is embedded in the wall, animated and alive, feeding on fear and choice. 

• Multiplayer (4 Players): Online death game where real players compete simultaneously. Dynamic alliances, betrayals, and unpredictable targeting define the experience. Only one survivor escapes.

• Singleplayer (1v1 vs The Pigman): A head‑to‑head duel against the Pigman himself. Adapted balancing creates a tense solo survival experience.

You are always on your own. Difficulty is shaped by the mode: multiplayer pits you against other players, while singleplayer focuses on direct psychological combat with the Pigman.

store_data.about_the_game:
It's 1995. Verity Bridges is back in her hometown after a year of unsuccessfully discovering herself. No money and no responsibilities: a perfect chance to throw her cares away at Eastbriar Mall.

In a retro shopping paradise filtered through thick, playful nostalgia goggles, find faces both old and new, master laser tag, and forge friendships and romances—all while running from the impending doom that is getting a job.

• A 50,000+ word story. Four romanceable characters, and five full story routes.

• Five quarter-life crises among sensitive Gen X slackers.

• Highly polygonal computer graphics mixed with amazingly adorable 2D sprites.

• Immersive brands and ads from the 1990s of your dreams. Collect them all!

• Verity: Go-getter and ray of sunshine. Loves games of all kinds (doesn’t mean she’s good at them).

• Zamira: Failing artist brooding over her next career move. She sees this mall as a pointless stopgap. Another round of Skee-Ball will change her mind.

• Maya: She does NOT do children’s birthday parties. Stop asking.

• Deb: A B-tier mean girl with C-tier conformist dreams. Melt this softie’s icy heart.

• Marshall: A lot has changed about your ex. He transitioned, and he seems to live at the mall. But even though he said you shouldn’t get back together…

Yuri Kissaten is a new game studio dedicated to making games about girls who love girls.

The main minds behind this game are:

  • Joi Massat, director, story, design, and art. Wow!

  • Along with writing and additional art by Beatrice Baker and Fruz.

We hope you enjoy all our very gay games!

store_data.about_the_game:
Overview

Bag of Dreams is a cozy, card-based roguelite where you draw dream fragments from your bag and place them on your Dream Space; a quiet sanctuary you're building to facilitate your win condition each run. It’s push-your-luck deckbuilding with a dreamy twist: every draw could bring you closer to the perfect night's sleep, or push you closer to endless nightmares. 😱

How it works

Every bag comes with its own win condition, these can be based on specific cards or groups of cards. Cards have effects (granting currently like dust or dream essence, or retriggering other cards) and some cards are nightmares, which forcibly place themselves down and increase your nightmare fuel… collect too much nightmare fuel and your night will end prematurely! 

Every game has two phases; Rounds alternate between drawing and placing fragments, and a shop phase where you spend resources to grow your collection. Dream essence helps you grow your dream space, and dust lets your purchase new fragments for your dream bag. Visit the Lucid Exchange between rounds and spend wisely! ✨

Push your luck too far and nightmare fuel starts to accumulate. Terrors and Nightmares begin creeping into your bag, threatening to unravel the dream you've worked so hard to build.

Hundreds of fragment synergies, multiple Dream Spaces with unique mechanics, and a risk-based core that rewards bold play and punishes recklessness. No two nights play the same. 🌙

Sweet dreams aren't guaranteed but they're always worth chasing.💜

8 Unique Playable Characters

Unlock 8 dreamers, each with their own distinct playstyle and strategy.

Every character changes how you approach your runs, encouraging new deck builds and creative combinations.

4 Distinct Deck Archetypes

Experiment with 4 unique card decks, each offering different mechanics and synergies.

  • Pets deck

  • Swift deck

  • Isolation deck

  • Sacrifice deck

Mix strategy, planning, and a little luck to create the dream that works best for your playstyle.

10 Lucidity Levels (Progressive Difficulty)

Think you’ve mastered your dream? Think again.

Lucidities introduce progressive difficulty modifiers that reshape every run:

  • New constraints

  • New strategic challenges

  • New ways to play

Each Lucidity level pushes you to rethink your strategy and adapt your dream-building approach.

The Lucid Exchange

Visit the Lucid Exchange, your in-game dream shop. Spend Dust and Essence to:

  • Buy new cards to strengthen your deck

  • Purchase powerful Dream Enhancements

  • Unlock new Dreamspaces to expand your dreamboard

💭 Craft the perfect dream. Adapt your strategy. Discover your playstyle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Down We Go is a little roguelite horror game about taking an elevator way deeper than anyone should.

Every time you go down, the place rearranges itself. Sometimes you’ll run into things that want you gone, sometimes things that don’t care, and sometimes things that are… weirdly helpful? It’s a toss-up.

You can fight stuff, sneak around it, or just book it to the next floor if things get messy. Upgrades come from leveling, exploring, or dealing with some questionable entities that definitely aren’t doing it out of kindness.

The world’s pretty grim, and getting “free” usually means diving even deeper.
Just remember: going down is easy.

Figuring out how to go back up is the hard part.

store_data.about_the_game:
Starlit Bottle is a cozy and relaxing casual game designed to relieve stress. Its core gameplay is simple yet incredibly soothing: your goal is to pour water of different colors from bottles into separate cups until each bottle contains only one color of water to complete a level.

The game features three difficulty modes—Easy, Medium, and Hard—catering to players with different paces. As you progress through the challenges, the number of bottles you need to sort will gradually increase. Whether you want to unwind after a long day or enjoy low-stress puzzles during short breaks, this game is perfect for you.

Dungeon Bomber is a chain-reaction bomb-placing roguelite where you plant explosives, trigger massive blasts, and blow your way through the dungeon.Gameplay videos and streaming are welcome, for both commercial and non-commercial use.

🔥 Place bombs, detonate, and unleash explosive combos!

The rules are simple: each turn, place a bomb from your hand and set it off.
Blast coin blocks to earn money, defeat enemies, and dig deeper into the dungeon.

💣 Build a strategic bomb deck with a variety of explosives!

Each bomb has different power, blast range, and special traits, so choosing the right one is key.
Collect coins to level up and obtain powerful new bombs!

⚙️ Fuse bombs to create the ultimate explosive!

Combine bombs to increase their blast radius or inherit special effects.
Keep fusing and craft your very own ultimate bomb to obliterate the dungeon!

🐉 Defeat the monsters guarding the dungeon and aim for total destruction!

Monsters lie buried within the dungeon! They gradually advance, and if they reach the bottom, you’ll take damage.
Destroy the required number of blocks before your HP hits zero.
Your bomb placement skills and explosive strategy will determine your victory!

You rejected the ordinary life of a racehorse and decide to become a legendary art museum thief. You will control the horse’s four legs and head using Q E O P W A S D ↑ ↓. With your trained hacking and painting skills, start by raiding small museums one by one. The day you steal the Mona Lisa at the very end without going bankrupt, you will achieve your dream.

This is the only space where you can stretch out your four legs and sleep. Practice hacking, painting, and running. Only enough practice will keep you alive.

If you are ready, it is time to raid the museum. You must swap the artwork within the time limit and then run to the target point. If you fail to meet the time or get hit by a police car, an enormous fine awaits you.

If you became rich with the stolen artworks, carry out reinvestment in yourself. However, excessive investment can speed up bankruptcy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Extinct Forest is a hardcore, physics‑driven FPS set in a vast, abandoned wilderness. There are no crosshairs, no traditional HUD, and no weapon reloading — just you, your limited tools and predators that react to sight and sound. Every encounter is a risk, every shot a decision.

Explore forgotten facilities, solve environmental puzzles, and fight to stay alive in a world where preparation matters more than firepower.

Are you the hunter, or the prey?

CORE FEATURES

Pure immersion
Invisible UI, iron‑sights aiming, no traditional reloading, audio‑based shot awareness, and a visual health system. Weapons are limited‑use tools — when they’re empty, they’re discarded.

Smart predators
17 dinosaur species with distinct behaviors, including pack hunters, ambushers, and territorial giants. Featuring iconic species such as T. rex, Spinosaurus, and Giganotosaurus.

Exploration and puzzles
Navigate eerie locations and use physics to create openings, block paths, manipulate objects, or bait ambushes.

Dynamic world
Day/night cycles and dynamic weather that affect visibility, sound propagation, and predator behavior.

Performance options
High‑fidelity visuals with NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR support.

LOCATIONS

Available in Early Access
Diner • Pool • Military Outpost • Canyon • Industrial Area • Military Base

Planned during Early Access
Lake • Village • Hospital • Airport • Secret Area

store_data.about_the_game:
The forest is changing — and it wants you to notice.

A creeping Rot spreads through the trees, warping roots, twisting animals into monstrous forms, and stirring something ancient beneath the soil. As Velimir, a young hunter sent by the Academy, you follow strange signs and relics into a woodland where nothing obeys the rules of nature anymore. Shadows shift, illusions whisper, and the Blight — a forgotten spirit — rises again after centuries of silence.

Investigate the home of a hermit witch, walk through shrines carved from bone, descend into fungal caverns glowing with poisonous light, and uncover ritual sites abandoned long ago. Each area reflects the forest’s fractured memory, revealing pieces of a truth it has tried to bury.

Restore protective symbols. Decipher lore etched into bark and roots. Confront ancient magic that thinks, remembers… and resists. Step by step, the forest will show you what woke the Blight — and what still lies waiting beneath it.

Features

🔹 Explore eerie, richly detailed locations shaped by forgotten rituals.

🔹 Solve Hidden Object scenes intertwined with illusions, old magic, and the living forest.

🔹 Use enchanted artifacts and puzzle mechanisms created by the woodland’s ancient protectors.

🔹 Collect lore fragments to uncover the origins of the Blight and the spreading Rot.

🔹 Unlock the Bonus Chapter and discover the final truth behind the awakening power beneath the forest.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Time is repeating itself. Every day, the same moments. The same encounters. The same choices. But this time... something's different.

Can you break the cycle?

TimeLoop is a time-bending visual novel that combines romance, mystery, and the supernatural. Navigate an endless cycle of repeating days where your choices matter more than ever, and where breaking free might mean understanding the connections between four extraordinary women.

FEATURES

• Four Compelling Characters

Each with their own memories of the loop:

- The Freshman: Innocent and curious, she's beginning to remember things she shouldn't. Her memories might hold the key to breaking free.

- The Teacher: Analytical and mysterious, she sees patterns where others see chaos. She believes the answers lie in understanding the loop itself.

- The MILF: Experienced and intuitive, she feels the weight of countless repeated days. Her perspective might be what you need to escape.

- The Cheerleader: Energetic and determined, she refuses to accept being trapped. Together, you might finally break free.

• Time Loop Mechanics

Experience a story where every choice echoes through time, and memories from future loops bleed into the present.

• Multiple Endings

Your choices determine whether you break free, remain trapped, or discover something even more profound about the nature of time itself.

• Atmospheric Locations

Explore the college campus, dorm rooms, library, cafeteria, gym, and more as you piece together the mystery of the time loop.

• Memory & Connection Systems

Build relationships that transcend the loop, where trust and understanding might be the key to freedom.

STORY

Stuck in an endless time loop, you find yourself reliving the same day over and over again. But as the cycles repeat, you begin to notice that four women are also aware of the loop. Each remembers fragments of previous iterations, and together, you might be able to piece together what's causing this temporal anomaly—and how to escape it.

As memories from future loops bleed into the present, relationships deepen in ways that shouldn't be possible. But time itself is fracturing, and the answers lie in understanding not just the loop, but the connections between you and these four extraordinary women.

CONTENT WARNING

This game contains mature themes including romance, adult situations, and supernatural elements. Recommended for mature audiences only.

store_data.about_the_game:
Giri Jump Star Rush is a classic-style 2D action game refined for a modern feel.

Our top priority is "tactile satisfaction." The character moves exactly as you imagine, following your intended path with precision. Experience a light, responsive playfeel designed to be "fun just to move."

Choose between two difficulty levels: Normal and Hard.

Master the mechanics in Normal mode first to unlock the true challenge of Hard Mode. This higher tier is built to provide a supreme challenge that will test the skills of even the most seasoned action game veterans.

-Story-

The protagonist is Giriko, an ordinary high school girl living on a quiet island.

One day after school, she picks up a strange, star-shaped stone. Little does she know, this small object holds the fate of the entire universe.

The end of the world? Giriko couldn't care less!

But trouble doesn't care about her plans, and she soon finds herself dragged into one cosmic mess after another. Can Giriko make it through this chaos safely?

-Simple yet Exhilarating! Giriko's Diverse Move Set-

The core of the game is just one button: Jump.
Experience the classic joy of jumping on enemies to defeat them as you progress.

Beyond that, you can unleash a variety of situational moves to carve your path, including the Spin Attack to smash through blocks and the high-powered Charge Attack for devastating impact.

-Control Time with "Miracle Time"-

Obtain special items to trigger your ace in the hole: Miracle Time!
By slowing down enemies and stage hazards, you can turn a desperate situation into a brilliant opportunity.

-Zero Stress, Premium Control-

Giriko's movements are perfectly synced with your fingertips. Experience "Top-Tier Maneuverability" as she follows your intended path with zero delay. Feel the thrill of truly light and responsive action!

-Deep Exploration: Pushing the "Giri-Giri" Limit-

Every stage hides a single, elusive "Special Key."

To claim it, your skills and creativity will be put to the test. You'll need to master the "Giri-Jump"—leaping from the very edge of a platform—and strategically utilize your skills.

What awaits those who collect every single key? You'll have to see the truth with your own eyes.

-Massive Content: 60 Stages + Alpha!-

The game features a total of 60 stages: 30 Normal Stages and 30 Hard Stages that serve as the ultimate trial. Each stage is brimming with unique gimmicks and distinct characteristics. Conquer every challenge and fully experience everything the "+ Alpha" secrets have to offer!

-Controller Button Layout-

store_data.about_the_game:
Cook Together

Cook Together is a chaotic co-op drug-creating game where you and your friend run a basement lab. You earn money by completing requested products. With that money, you can buy new equipment, expand your laboratory, and much more.

You can play in single-player or multiplayer, it's up to you. To play multiplayer, simply create a new game, open your friend list with Tab, and invite your friends. It's much funnier and more chaotic when played with a friend.

You can save the game by sleeping; in multiplayer, both players must be sleeping to save.

Cooking

The first rule is to always put on your suit before you start working—unless you want to die.
You can buy all your equipment from the laptop, and the items will be delivered through the tube.

To create Miguel’s Special:

  • Put the pills into the crushing bowl and crush them.

  • Pour the powder into a beaker, add a little water, then pour the mixture into the filter and start filtering.

  • While the filter is working, pour some ammonia into the petri dish. You can use the scale to find the best ratio.

  • Pour the mixture into the boiling flask.

  • Add the filtered solution to the flask, place the flask over the fire, and start cooking.

  • After cooking, pour the mixture into a tray and place the tray in the freezer. Wait a little.

  • Take out the frozen product, smash it into small pieces, pack them, seal the packs, put them in boxes, tape the boxes, and place them into the elevator.

  • Close the elevator.

That’s all you need to do.

Story

You are the chemist or chemists working for the big boss, Miguel. Create your product step by step, carefully. Don’t blow yourself up.

Finish the product in time, package it, and send it through the elevator.

If you fail to finish on time or ruin the purity, the boss won’t be happy.

He is extremely strict about time and purity.

Create high-quality products in a short amount of time.

Flies

Be careful with the flies. They can sneak in through the air vents and destroy your product’s purity. When you hear the fly alarm, find the fly and kill it immediately.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tetra Rise is an action-platformer roguelite where your goal is to escape a deep abyss filled with enemies and terrifying creatures.

BUILD YOUR WAY UP

Every defeated enemy turns into a fixed block you can use to climb closer to the surface.

  • Collect block colors to gain experience

  • Break blocks to earn coins

  • Defeat enemies in strategic spots to obstruct paths

  • Stack pieces to forge your escape route

Each run creates a unique block formation, and your path upward will always be different.

ROGUELITE: EVERY ASCENT IS UNIQUE

As you gain experience, unlock and upgrade equipment that will help you take down bigger, stronger enemies. Combine items to create even more powerful synergies.

The roguelite loop throws you back to the bottom, but you can break the cycle! With each new attempt:

  • Review your stats from the previous run

  • Improve the base attributes of each piece of equipment

  • Try out new weapons and tools

  • Find your playstyle and rise to the top!

store_data.about_the_game:
The gentle rhythm of a summer in Scotland sets the stage for a journey filled with color, music, and discovery. While a light backstory brings the adventure to life, the true charm lies in the abundance of puzzles and hidden-object challenges waiting at every turn. This isn’t a tale to follow—it’s a world to explore, one delightful scene at a time.

From royal halls to hidden closes, from fireworks over the castle to songs echoing down the Royal Mile—join the Brook family as they uncover the heart of Edinburgh during its most vibrant season. For Mimi, it’s a photographer’s paradise; for Bradley, a musical adventure; for Stephanie, a sketchbook of inspiration; and for Eric, a dream come true among legends and lore. Together, they capture the spirit of the Fringe Festival—where every corner holds a story, and every moment becomes a cherished memory.

Take a break from the bustle and enjoy a varied collection of puzzles—classic hidden-object scenes, clever mini-games, and fresh challenges that test your observation and creativity. Each level offers something new to uncover and enjoy.

🔎 Join the Brooks on a heartfelt journey through Edinburgh’s most iconic landmarks.

🔎 Collect unique souvenirs, learn fascinating facts, and capture special family moments along the way.

🔎 Unlock in-game achievements as you progress through your Scottish adventure.

  • Use found ingredients to upgrade your skills like stamina, perception and unlock new abilities

Game Name: As Sweetberry Falls

Tagline: Your every click brings this world closer to its end.

【About This Game】

As Sweetberry Fallsis a unique blend of town-building, card-based strategy, and philosophical thriller narrative. You are a back-end game developer, testing a virtual world called "Battisteri," only to find yourself becoming the "Masked Lord" of its idyllic town, Sweetberry. However, your very existence is the deadliest virus—every plan you make, every building you construct, irreversibly accelerates the world's collapse.

Your goal is no longer salvation, but to witness, make choices, and seek the last glimmer of civilization's endurance within an inevitable tragedy.

【Features】

■ Observer as Polluter: A Subversive Town-Building Experience

  • Experience the unique core mechanic of the "Observer Effect": all your construction efforts boost the town's prosperity, but they also accumulate Corruption Points, unleashing supernatural disasters and distorting the laws of reality. You must navigate this delicate balance with strategic planning.

■ Deep Strategic Card Play

  • Use a variety of cards with different functions for constructing, upgrading, purifying, or exploring. Manage your hand wisely to face increasingly severe challenge

  • The core mechanic, "observe to corrupt," is deeply integrated into every aspect of the design. Every click, every action to build brings prosperity, but it also secretly accumulates Corruption Points, triggering supernatural disasters and reality distortions. This sense of fate—where construction leads to destruction—imbues every decision with emotional weight and strategic depth.

  • Breaking away from traditional simulation management, we introduce a core "anti-growth" system. You must manage Corruption Points, walking a fine line between "development" and "restraint." Every building upgrade carries the risk of "mutation," forcing you to seek survival in a perilous balance, delivering a deeply challenging and strategic experience.

■ A Slowly Unfolding Sci-Fi Tragedy

  • Immerse yourself in a profound story inspired by the works of Philip K. Dick and H.P. Lovecraft. The world is not doomed by malice, but by an unintentional act of "observation."

  • Gradually uncover the truth of the world of Batistelli, as the story confronts philosophical themes like the "Observer Effect," existentialism, and the "Creator's Paradox." You will meet the tragic guardian, the "Old God," and ultimately face your own role in the fate of this world. Multiple thought-provoking endings will leave you reflecting long after the game is over

■ Victorian Era Poetry and the Bizarre

  • Explore a beautiful world that blends Victorian aesthetics, steampunk, and Ghibli-inspired artistry. Yet beneath this cozy surface, the eerie "Black Blight" silently spreads, whispering the secrets of the world. In ordinary times, you'll participate in the town's folk activities, experiencing its last bursts of vitality and energy before the end draws near.

  • On the surface, it's a cozy animal town simulation with hand-drawn illustrations, but at its core lies a hard-hitting sci-fi tragedy about the survival of a world. Experience unprecedented narrative tension in the extreme contrast between the "sweet" and the "corrupt."

【Key Systems】

  • • Dynamic World: Building "Pollution Level" affects exploration and event success rates, adding depth to your decisions.

  • • Rich Questlines: A main story drives the grand narrative, while long chain NPC quests delve into the world's lore and characters.

• High Replayability: Multiple endings ensure your strategic choices impact not only survival time but also the final outcome of the story.

【AI-Generated Content Disclosure】

As a solo developer facing budget and time constraints,

this game utilizes AI-generated assets for certain elements (including character illustrations, background scenes, and UI icons) as well as musical compositions.

All AI-generated content has undergone manual refinement:

•Frame-by-frame detail adjustments for consistency

•Redrawing elements that conflicted with the game's aesthetic

Yuzu guarantees full compliance with Steam's policies, with 100% original core gameplay and storyline.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

WARNING: This game contains flashing images. If you are sensitive to flashing lights, please proceed with caution.

A Bad Christmas Story is a short, horror interactive fiction experience set in the same universe as Bad Summer. Whether you’re already familiar with Bad Summer or stepping into this world for the first time, A Bad Christmas Story is a standalone, tightly focused horror story you can finish in one sitting.

Welcome to New Empress City

Another dead body, another day in New Empress. For the crowd, it’s just another story for the evening news in a city that’s long since gone numb. Death is commonplace on these streets, and the police is stretched thin. Experience a gritty, dark setting where every fresh corpse is just another file stamped, shelved, and quietly forgotten.

Play as Detective Oliver Smith

Step into the shoes of New Empress’s youngest detective. Oliver is intelligent, stubborn, and far too used to spending his holidays staring at corpses. Your choices and investigations shape his drive to find the truth, and how high a price he pays for it. 

Cinematic Storybook

Experience a Christmas horror tale told through dark, storybook-style imagery and film-inspired angles. Slow pans and stylized hand-drawn animations turn each moment into a dark, eerie moving picture that sticks with you long after the credits roll.

Choices Matter

Details come back to haunt you. Information picked up early in the night can unlock smarter choices, sharper questions, and safer outcomes later on. Miss those details, and you’ll be left guessing when it matters most. A Bad Christmas Story is built to be finished in a single evening, with meaningful choices worth revisiting to see how else this night could have gone.

Fully Voiced Experience

With over 10+ talented voice actors, every character in Bad Christmas has a distinct voice to bring the gritty streets of New Empress to life.

Meyow is a fast-paced survival arena game where you play as a spinning, gun-wielding cat fighting off endless waves of zombies. Dodge, rotate, shoot, and stay alive as long as you can while chaos unfolds around you.

Features

• Spinning Cat Combat
Control Meyow, a constantly rotating cat armed with a rifle. Position yourself, time your shots, and keep moving to survive the swarming undead.

• Endless Zombie Waves
Different types of zombies approach from every direction. Some are fast, some are tough, and some are just unsettlingly well-dressed.

• Disco Ultimate Ability
Fill your ultimate bar to unleash a full-screen disco blast that lights up the battlefield and wipes out everything around you. Bright colors, flashing lights, total destruction.

• Score-Based Survival
Every second matters. Every zombie defeated increases your score. Compete with yourself to beat your best runs.

• Simple, Addictive Gameplay
No complex menus or long tutorials. Jump in, spin, shoot, and enjoy short, intense play sessions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Wheels Echo 

Is a story-driven winter survival game where your own thoughts shape the journey. You play as Fred Walker, a man who left society decades ago to live alone in a frozen forest. But one winter morning, as he drives toward town for supplies, he finds shattered windows, abandoned roads, strange dates carved into objects… and a world that feels wrong.

What follows is a mystery-driven experience where the main mechanic is not combat or looting — but thinking.

Sit by a campfire, enter Fred’s “thinking state,” listen to his inner voice, and write down his thoughts manually into a physical notebook. What you choose to write — and how you interpret it — determines which quests, clues, jokes, negative tasks, or meaningless scribbles become part of Fred’s story.

Your notebook is the quest system. Your thoughts are the progression.

Out here, no one is coming to save you.

Fred doesn’t meet enemies or allies — he encounters situations.

Some can be avoided. Some must be endured. Some will test his limits.

In a world without people, even animals behave unpredictably.

Survival is not about winning fights, but understanding when — and why — they happen.

The notebook is not a menu. It’s the game.

Fred doesn’t receive quests automatically.
Instead, he reflects on what he sees and hears — and you decide what matters.

When you open the notebook, you’re not checking objectives.
You are shaping Fred’s understanding of the world.

What you choose to write becomes part of the story:

  • quests may appear or never exist

  • clues can gain meaning — or stay meaningless

  • thoughts can turn into jokes, doubts, or negative tasks

The notebook is your interface to the narrative.

The road doesn’t end where the map does.

Fred is not guided by markers or scripted paths.
The world opens gradually — through movement, observation, and curiosity.

Forests stretch far beyond the road.
Abandoned places hide off the beaten path.
Some locations reveal themselves only if you choose to explore — or notice them.

Exploration is not mandatory.
But every step away from safety carries meaning.

About This Game

Dead Exposure is a short-form analog horror experience (1–1.5 hours) set inside a foreclosed home that won’t stay still.

You are sent to document the property after a family tragedy.  Armed with a Polaroid camera and a child’s toy modified to detect anomalies, you begin to notice things that shouldn’t exist.

Some only appear in photographs.
Others emerge when captured on film.
The act of observing changes what is there.

This is a slow-burn, liminal horror experience focused on tension, atmosphere, and uncovering what hides beneath the surface.

The Experience

  • See beyond reality
    Your camera reveals objects and entities invisible to the naked eye.

  • A world altered by observation
    What appears on film doesn’t always match what is right in front of you.

  • Liminal, slow-burn horror
    Tension builds through subtle changes, absence, and unease.

  • Best experienced in one sitting
    A focused 1–1.5 hour experience designed to be played in the dark with headphones.

Features

  • Reveal hidden realities using your camera

  • Entities visible only through photographs

  • Environmental storytelling through fragmented clues

  • EMF toy (“Clever Mouse”) for detecting nearby anomalies

store_data.about_the_game:
Dive into unforgettable adventures! Your choices lead to multiple possible endings, shaped entirely by the decisions you make. From the very beginning, you can choose your hero’s gender, give them a name, and adjust the game’s resolution.

Story in Brief

Depending on your chosen path, the game unfolds in different ways:

  • Male protagonist — you receive a mysterious book. Will you try to uncover its meaning, or ignore it and experience the three acts differently?

  • Female protagonist — you receive an enigmatic letter. Will you solve the mystery of who wrote it, or set it aside and shape the three acts in your own way?

 Playtime:

   It depends on your reading speed, but a single playthrough will not reveal all characters or possible consequences.

Achievements:

The game will feature 21 Steam achievements, including meta‑achievements.

 Options and Accessibility

The game offers both basic settings and advanced accessibility features.

  • Press A to open a special menu where you can:

    • change text size,

    • select a font (DejaVu Sans or OpenDyslexic),

    • enable high‑contrast mode,

    • adjust line spacing.

  • Press G to access energy‑saving options and set the frame rate:

    • Match your screen,

    • 60 FPS,

    • 30 FPS.

 Story and Choices

In this game, your character can even die, leaving the truth you seek undiscovered. The storylines of the woman and the man differ greatly, and a single playthrough will not reveal all characters or the full consequences of your choices. This makes it a unique visual novel that rewards replayability.

 A Word from the Creator

Thank you to everyone who plays and leaves feedback — whether positive or critical. If you notice any mistakes, don’t hesitate to report them.

This journey may turn out to be truly special for you. Wishing you a great time — Karol, the creator of the game.

This is just a small fragment — the full game has much more to offer.

store_data.about_the_game:
Launch Window is a physics-based automation game. Establish supply chains across a procedurally generated star system. Build infrastructure. Construct ships. Open new routes.

Your first launch may carry a handful of colonists to a barren moon. Years later, you command thousands of ships, each following a trajectory you planned, bound for a colony you designed. This is how the colony grows.

  • Start with a lone planetary outpost, and develop into a full star system-wide colony

  • Coordinate fleets of 1,000+ physics-based spaceships

  • Automate orbital shipping lanes, plotting routes rather than individual burns

  • Build across entire spherical worlds, placing structures anywhere on a planet's surface

  • Craft logistical networks on-surface and between different planetary bodies

  • Research and unlock more advanced technology, manoeuvres, and buildings to improve your colony and extend your reach

You command 1,000+ ships simultaneously, not calculating every burn yourself. Plot and automate orbital shipping lanes, setting up the routes and letting the physics do the work.

As there are only certain times efficiently reaching planetary bodies is possible (the Launch Window), you will have to plan carefully what resources are needed at which colonies, how long they will take to get there, how long they will take to be resupplied. This logistical puzzle is the basis of the game.

You can build across the entire surface on each planet you inhabit. Build solar panels to extract sunlight, build drills to extract resources, and build factory networks to construct your fleet. The reach of the colony depends on the infrastructure that feeds it.

Each planetary body offers different resources and challenges. Ice-rich moons provide water for fuel production. Metal-rich rocky bodies feed your factories. Outer planets offer rare resources but longer transit times. Where you expand, and in what order, shapes the logistics of everything that follows.

Once the trajectory is planned, the ships are built, and the cargo is loaded, it's time to light the candle. Launch when the windows align. 

Timing is everything.

Use flagships to lead your convoys across the system rather than managing every vessel individually. Built for scale, so even at very high time warp your fleet's physics run reliably and at full performance.

Your colony isn’t the only presence in this system, and the same physics you'll harness to expand your reach can be used against you. Defend your infrastructure and fleet with physics-based projectiles, and prepare for what’s lurking in the outer reaches…

EARLY ACCESS

Launch Window is in active development. The core game mechanics - orbital physics, automation systems, and planetary production will be playable on early access release. Your feedback will directly shape what comes next as the star system expands.

Major planned features include:

  • Terraforming (atmosphere/water/temperature)

  • Asteroid/comet redirection and mining

  • Celestial dangers (e.g., solar flares)

  • Megastructures, both orbital and terrestrial 

Also expect regular updates adding new technology, buildings, ships, and more.

ABOUT THE STUDIO

gumptiongames consists of 1 dev, Fred (that's me, hello). Motivated through a love of sci-fi, physics sims, and space in general, I want to create games that capture the vastness of space, have satisfying orbital mechanics, and give the joy of expanding logistics networks. My hope is to bring this ideal to life through Launch Window, and I am eager for thoughts and feedback. Please do get in touch!

store_data.about_the_game:
Just as the MCF agency is beginning to lose hope of ever seeing close friend and agency director Evelyn Ravenhearst, the intrepid Master Detective receives a surprise call from Evelyn herself, with a dire warning. Angelica Morgan’s spirit is still sharing Evelyn’s body, and what’s worse, she’s after something buried deep beneath Ravenhearst Manor!

It’s time once again to don the Master Detective’s iconic coat and hat for a case that promises to unearth unknown secrets of Charles Dalimar’s forgotten past. What really became of him after he was sent to the asylum in this new timeline? What new information did Angelica discover, and what does she intend to do with it? Can you capture Angelica, rescue Evelyn, and maybe even claim Charles Dalimar’s long lost prize? Journey into the hidden labyrinth deep beneath the home of the MCF Agency itself in this eerily exciting Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

● Emma's great-great-grandmother keeps a tragic secret you must uncover in the bonus chapter!

● Play and re-play Mini-Games and HOPs, earn Achievements, and collect all the hidden Observers!

● Unlock the bonus Jigsaw Puzzle and a playable Hidden Chapter of crucial Ravenhearst lore!

● Enjoy unique wallpapers, concept art, music, movies, and more!

● The Strategy Guide will keep you on track and several steps ahead of Charles Dalimar's machinations!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game - a sub genre of point & click adventure. Follow protagonists on a story-driven quest, find cleverly hidden objects, and solve challenging puzzles to advance the plot.

store_data.about_the_game:
Challenge your piloting skills in a seaplane focused flight simulator that takes place in a persistent world where you are responsible for the care and maintenance of your plane. Parts wear out and must be replaced. Otherwise, you risk in-flight failures. At its heart, Lakehopper is a flight simulator, with a physics-based flight model that aims to be realistic and challenging. 

Fly between isolated communities in a flooded, rugged landscape that only seaplanes can serve. Deliver cargo and help connect towns separated by huge distances of nothing but mountains and open stretches of water. Use your skills as a pilot, and the navigational tools at your disposal, to hop between far-flung destinations. Keep your deliveries safe in unforgiving terrain and treacherous waters. Learn intricately simulated plane systems that are a mix of the familiar and the near-future.

A detailed simulation of a workhorse flying boat

  • Assemble your twin engine flying boat seaplane from 100+ parts. 

  • Walk around inside your plane! Being in a vehicle doesn't simply lock you into the pilot's seat, even while flying. Roam around the plane, do in-flight repairs, and reconfigure systems. Just watch your step and keep the door closed! 

  • Refuel your plane and deliver cargo to isolated communities around the region. 

  • Detailed plane subsystems with start-up sequences that require attention to detail.

  • Complex water physics for seaplanes that float, take off, and land like real seaplanes!

A vast map to explore

  • Fly across and explore a mountainous, flooded 360,000 square km (140,000 square mi) map. 

  • Realistic terrain based on real world landscapes.

A challenging, persistent world

  • The game doesn't end just because your flight does. Each flight informs the next!

  • Check the condition of individual plane parts and replace them before they cause in-flight failures... or don't! 

  • Track jobs, run checklists, look up navigational info, and reference assembly instructions with the in-game reference binder.

Fly your way

  • Support for gamepads, joysticks, yokes, throttle quadrants, and many common flight sim peripherals with detailed control rebinding options.

store_data.about_the_game:
After losing everything, you accept an unrefusable offer from a casino you swore you'd never return to, only to find yourself in a sealed room on a shaky deepweb livestream, masked players breathing through broken voice modulators as an unseen audience watches every hit, stand, and split, because winning isn't about reaching 21, it's about outlasting the table, the pressure, and whatever's waiting just beyond the camera.

Think you know how to play Blackjack?

Dead Hand is a Blackjack game focused on quick matches, smart decisions, and duels that can flip in an instant. The rules are simple, but every round hits hard, one card can make you a legend or wipe you out instantly.

Climb through a gritty underground circuit, facing opponents who get faster, sharper, and meaner. Each table has its own rhythm, and every victory pushes you deeper into a world where winning is all that matters.

Face 3 Unique Opponents:

1. Mason A street gambler with poker chips that can shift the rhythm of the game. He reads every hesitation, every tell. His chips aren't just currency, they're weapons.

2. DDT A former casino hitter caught red-handed stealing. Blind but deadly. This isn't just about cards, it's about who can lie better. He listens for the slightest crack in your voice.

3. High Roller No tricks, no games. Just a grandious Blackjack player blessed with fortune itself. Luck follows his every move.

Multiplayer PvP Challenge other players in real-time competitive matches. Test your skills against human opponents and dominate the underground circuit.

Place your bet.
