store_data.about_the_game:
A town that’s quiet in all the wrong ways

You return to Tujie Town in search of your missing father—
a small place wrapped in cane sugar and buried secrets.
Too peaceful during the day, and wearing a different face at night.

The locals never explain why.
They simply warn you:

“Follow the rules, and you’ll stay safe.”

Surrounded by mountains on three sides and a river on the fourth,
its old streets, abandoned sugar factory, and rusted rail lines sink in humid air.
The deeper you go, the more you realize those “rules” aren’t advice—
they’re survival laws.

  • If you see a snail, walk around it. Never harm it.

  • After sunset, do not linger outdoors.

  • If you glimpse a train station that shouldn’t exist, close your eyes immediately.

  • Never take that certain flower beyond the town’s borders.

You only want to find your father, yet you’re drawn into secrets no one is willing to speak aloud.

Core Gameplay

■ Exploration

Wander through 1970s Taiwanese streets, back alleys, abandoned sugar mills,
and old train stations while uncovering forgotten fragments of the past.

■ The Sight

Touching old objects reveals lingering “memory echoes.”
The higher your level, the more you can see—including things that aren’t supposed to be there.

■ Survival

When the moon changes color, the town transforms.
The Huāchāng—mimic creatures that imitate humans and merge into walls or shadows—
wait for your first mistake.
Use light, noise, terrain, and their weaknesses to survive the night.

Visuals & Audio

■ 2.5D Side-Scrolling Exploration with Hand-Painted Lighting

A nostalgic recreation of 1970s Taiwanese streets, alleys, temples, and sugar-factory ruins.

■ Memory Echoes & Otherworld Transitions

Hand-drawn sketches, photo collages, and noise effects shape the eerie alternate world.

■ East Asian Folk Aesthetics & Low-Frequency Sound Design

Wooden temple percussion, shrine ambience, and echoing drones intensify the tension.

Features

  • Suspense-driven Eastern narrative

  • 2.5D side-scrolling exploration and investigation

  • The Sight: read memories from old objects and echo fragments

  • Otherworld chase sequences & rule-based survival

  • Multi-phase mimic monsters (Huāchāng)

  • Multiple endings based on choices and exploration

Content Warning

This game contains thriller sequences, mimic creatures, disappearance themes,
and mild violence.
All depictions are fictional and inspired by Taiwanese culture;
they do not represent the team’s real-world beliefs.
If you feel uncomfortable during play, please take a break.

Development Team

Production & Narrative

Game Director：Andy
Lead Writer：Kooche
Co-Writers：Jin-Zi, Sisi

Design & Art

Game Design：DB, Zhizhi, Andy
Artists：Ah-Feng, PoG, Yuqi
Art/Tech Support：Naoshu, Yujing, Pudding, Xingguang

Tech & Audio

UI/UX：Wunsang
Programmers：Andy, DB
Music & Sound：Vicky

Vacation Terminal is a short 2D Psychological thriller, horror and survival based visual novel with evading based puzzle elements. Following the story of two strangers, Gavriil and Yeva.

Two strangers who happened to meet by chance, both travelling together, on the same train, in the same cabin, but really with not much to talk about. But when their train derails in the middle of nowhere, they're suddenly forced to work together. Gavriil wakes up alone in a cold, pitch-black cave—his leg missing, and Yeva claiming she saved his life. There’s no sign of rescue. No way to call for help ... This was supposed to be just a short vacation.

Gavriil, an awkward guy, but still usually friendly;

Yeva, calm and level-headed as can be, but hard to approach;

... And of course you, who will be joining to see whether their vacation can get back on the right track!  
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This game is not suitable for children

or those who are easily disturbed.

store_data.about_the_game:
Future updates will be free

In this boundless farmland, you can freely weave your own stories—share your little moments, listen to others' legends, or create your ideal character with your own hands. There are no restrictions here, only endless possibilities: farm and raise livestock as you wish, swing an axe to chop wood, bend down to pull weeds, sit quietly by the lake to fish, cook delicious meals, build a warm cabin, arrange personalized furniture, construct sturdy bridges, explore deep into mines, and even bravely drive away those thieves who covet the fruits of your hard work. You can add or remove tasks freely. Even if your stamina is completely exhausted to zero, you don’t have to worry about collapsing, because this land will always protect your freedom.

Sharing Stories

At the start of the game, you can choose a life path, and gradually unfold your story as you play.

Listening to Legends

You can create NPCs in the game, and they will share their own life experiences with you.

Characters

Players can customize their character’s hairstyle, hair color, and body color.

Maps

Players can customize all in-game maps.

Farming

First, loosen the soil on cultivable land, then select seeds to plant. Plants have 4 states and require 3 waterings to grow.

Livestock Raising

You can raise animals on non-cultivable land, and the animals will mature after a certain period of time.

Tree Planting

You can plant trees on non-cultivable land. After a certain period, the trees can be cut down. (Fruit trees will be added in future versions, and you can pick fruits when they mature.)

Weed Pulling

Weeds are randomly generated by the system and can be collected as animal feed.

Stones

Stones are randomly generated by the system and can be collected for later use as materials.

Fishing

You can fish anywhere there is water.

Cuisine

You can use various materials to make food, which replenishes your stamina. (Corresponding food icons will be added in future versions.)

House Building

Players can first customize the appearance of their house, then choose a location to build it. After construction, you can customize the interior size.

Furniture

After building a house, you can craft furniture for the interior.

Bridge Construction

You can build bridges between two mountains, and you will not be attacked while on the bridge.

Mine Caves

Mine cave maps are randomly generated by the system, with infinite levels. You can exit halfway through.

Crop Theft

After farming or raising livestock, monsters will come to steal your produce. Players need to drive away the monsters in time.

Quests

Players can freely accept or cancel quests.

Stamina

There is no penalty when stamina drops to zero, and players can still move normally. Before stamina returns to above zero, the harvest will be halved. If you harvest food, it will be consumed immediately to restore stamina.

You can raise animals on non-cultivable land, and the animals will mature after a certain period of time.

Tree Planting

You can plant trees on non-cultivable land. After a certain period, the trees can be cut down. (Fruit trees will be added in future versions, and you can pick fruits when they mature.)

Weed Pulling

Weeds are randomly generated by the system and can be collected as animal feed.

Stones

Stones are randomly generated by the system and can be collected for later use as materials.

Fishing

You can fish anywhere there is water.

Cuisine

You can use various materials to make food, which replenishes your stamina. (Corresponding food icons will be added in future versions.)

House Building

Players can first customize the appearance of their house, then choose a location to build it. After construction, you can customize the interior size.

Furniture

After building a house, you can craft furniture for the interior.

Bridge Construction

You can build bridges between two mountains, and you will not be attacked while on the bridge.

Mine Caves

Mine cave maps are randomly generated by the system, with infinite levels. You can exit halfway through.

Crop Theft

After farming or raising livestock, monsters will come to steal your produce. Players need to drive away the monsters in time.

Quests

Players can freely accept or cancel quests.

Stamina

There is no penalty when stamina drops to zero, and players can still move normally. Before stamina returns to above zero, the harvest will be halved. If you harvest food, it will be consumed immediately to restore stamina.

You can skip tasks if you don't want to do them, and running out of stamina won't cause any loss.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Omega Man" is an interactive fiction game . After a global viral outbreak, as the only surviving male, players bears the responsibility to perpetuate the human races. Throughout the game, players' numerous choices will determine multiple possible endings.

Story Background

This is an apocalypse, but not a silent end. A mysterious catastrophe has erased all males worldwide, with one exception—an ordinary urban youth named Ren Xing, who unexpectedly becomes the last male spark of human civilization.

When he is found by a massive underground survivor base composed of women, what greets him is not salvation, but an intricately woven, gentle cage. He is revered as a "national treasure" and objectified as the "Fireseed." His existence is the only hope for the continuation of civilization; his body becomes the ultimate resource in a power struggle among various factions.

From the initial confinement under a "points system" to the later "Athena Protocol" cloaked in civility, Ren Xing struggles in a whirlpool of desire, rationality, science, and hypocrisy. Each enchanting female representative, with her diverse background and motives, approaches him with different means: some with blatant temptation, some with cold calculation, and others promising intellectual and emotional resonance.

Yet, beneath this intense focus and contention, a crueler truth gradually surfaces: what they need may not merely be the continuation of his genes, but the entire symbolic significance of the bygone era that he, as the "last man," represents.

When the "Fireseed Project" ultimately points towards a final ritual that demands his life as a sacrifice, Ren Xing must make a choice: to be recorded in history as a docile symbol, or to use his meager strength to resist this cold, colossal machine operating in the name of "civilizational survival."

In this world without his kind, he is the only hope, and the final prisoner.

Game Features

Rich Scenes

The game features a vast number of scenes, making players feel immersed in the environment during gameplay.

Diverse Characters

The game includes a large cast of female characters, each with distinct personalities, offering an dazzling array of interactions.

Character Interactions

The game presents numerous choices throughout, allowing players to interact with different characters and trigger various storylines.

Multiple Endings

The game culminates in numerous different endings, guiding the story towards diverse conclusions.

store_data.about_the_game:
CTRLSINK is a submerged post-apocalyptic retro-style FPS set after a devastating human/AI war. The world has drowned, the continents swallowed by rising oceans, and the last traces of humanity lie scattered in flooded bunkers and rusted war ruins. Blast through radioactive facilities, fight corrupted machines, and uncover the final secrets left beneath the waves.

Deep beneath the Antarctic ice lies SUBY --> an analog submarine fortress buried far below radiation zones, forgotten by the wars above. Inside it rests the last preserved humans, sleeping in cryogenic chambers for 333 years, untouched by digital influence.

SUBY is fully analog.
No uplink. No signal.
Only silence --> until now.

After centuries of isolation, Protocol CTRL has begun: the gradual awakening of the crew. Each revived human is immediately bonded to an Extreme Human Armor Suit, a relic of the pre-war era --> no AI, purely biological-mechanical and analogical systems.
It heals. It strengthens. It protects. Is Controls.
It is the only thing keeping humanity alive outside SUBY’s hull.

Every awakened person becomes a new Crew Unit, sent to gather data about the fallen world, discover what truly ended civilization, and search for any land still capable of sustaining life.

The mission codename: CTRL/SINK.

--> CTRL your situation or SINK <--
One human at a time.
One last chance for the species.
If a Crew Unit dies… the next cryo pod opens.

You are Unit N94.
Two before you, N92 and N93, left SUBY and never returned.

Your first task: find their traces.
Your real task: survive what took them.

Venture into hostile radioactive complexes built by machines that outlived their masters. Expect brutal, fast-paced combat, analog weapons, corrupted AI guardians, robots cyborgs, and a world where every corner hides a threat or a forgotten truth where he ocean swallowed a large part of the world after the polar ice melted during the nuclear wars.

Fight to CTRL… but don’t SINK.

store_data.about_the_game:
Experience a story-driven adventure about traveling abroad and navigating the challenges of preparing for an international trip.
You play as a character who dreams of visiting another country, exploring new places, and discovering how people live around the world. To make this journey possible, you must complete a series of tasks, visit different locations, talk to characters, and follow the steps required for your character’s trip to happen.

Green is a simple person with a big dream — he wants to travel abroad, but he has absolutely no idea where to begin. In this lighthearted adventure, you guide Green through a variety of locations as he prepares for his first big trip. Explore small city environments, talk to quirky characters, complete simple tasks, and help Green progress step by step toward his journey.

The game focuses on small narrative moments, everyday-life interactions, and a cozy atmosphere. You follow Green through offices, shops, streets, and travel hubs while helping him solve problems, gather information, manage items, and unlock new parts of his adventure.

Your choices and actions help Green move forward as he experiences the process of preparing for a trip, meeting people, and discovering new places.

Features

  • Unique visual style: 2D characters placed in 3D environments

  • Interactive NPCs: Meet characters from different professions who offer tips, items, and important information

  • Multiple locations:

    • Passport Office — complete story tasks and progress your travel goals

    • Supermarket — buy items needed during gameplay

    • Airport — start your journey once your character is ready

    • And more areas to explore

  • Story progression: Follow your character’s journey from preparing documents to traveling abroad and eventually returning home with new experiences

This game is a fictional experience inspired by international travel. It does not represent real immigration processes. Enjoy a relaxed, story-driven adventure and learn your character’s journey step by step.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are one of the few flying drones that have not been affected by the virus.

Your mission is quiet, but crucial: to penetrate the depths of the infected bunker and find what remains hidden in its sections. Something that will later play a key role in the fate of the entire complex.

With each level, the corridors become more dangerous: unstable mechanisms, security system traps, hidden blocks that are easy to break - all of this is hidden in the darkness. But the drone has a special vision that allows it to see things that are usually invisible, and this is sometimes the only thing that saves you from death.

Along the way, you'll encounter epic bosses, such as malfunctioning security machines and distorted structures that have been transformed into unpredictable creatures by the virus.

The game is a side-scrolling arcade game where flying, maneuvering, destroying obstacles, avoiding traps, and battling bosses all come together in a dark journey through the infected depths.

store_data.about_the_game:
Relax while digging in Town Diggers — and loot valuable items while you’re at it.
Place the items you find on the shelves of your shop and sell them by bargaining with your customers.

Tired of digging yourself? Hire worker NPCs to excavate for you and deliver the found items directly to your shop’s storage, while you focus on running and growing your business.

Found illegal goods? Instead of selling them to the municipality for a miserable price, buy and sell them through underground auctions.

Your shop starts small, with just a few shelves and a sales desk. As you upgrade, unlock a second floor that offers a real working environment. Repair items, create fake goods, research market prices, and optimize your profits.

Fed up with paying protection money to the neighboring town’s mafia? Hire local tough guys to protect your shop — and if your numbers grow large enough, maybe you become the mafia. Win mafia wars and eliminate your rivals.

Ways to Acquire Items

1. Digging
Pay the municipality to rent a digging area for a limited time. Excavate the entire area before time runs out to collect all items. If digging gets boring, pay extra to hire workers.

2. Customer Sales
Customers don’t just come to buy from you — some want to sell their own items. Negotiate well and buy valuable goods for cheap.

3. Creating Fake Items
Purchase raw materials from other shops in town and produce fake items using the counterfeit machine. Be careful — if customers realize an item is fake, your shop’s reputation will drop.

4. Mystery Boxes
Buy mystery boxes from town shops. You never know — one might contain a very valuable item.

Ways to Make Money

  • Sell items to customers by negotiating prices.

  • Trade illegal goods through secret auctions.

  • Offer deals to people directly on the streets.

Shop Expansions

Purchase shop expansions to unlock more space, attract more customers, gain additional work areas, and increase your worker capacity.

Customer Traits

Each customer has unique traits that affect how they negotiate with you:

  • Greed

  • Knowledge

  • Patience

  • Knowledge

  • Patience

store_data.about_the_game:
ELbab is a roguelite auto-battler set inside an endlessly expanding library.

Each run is designed to last 30 minutes to 1.5 hours.

The gameplay blends tile-based dungeon progression with the feeling of crafting builds in a hack-and-slash game.
Combat itself is fully automated, so most of your time is spent planning and optimizing your build.

Because the game is auto-battle and playable entirely with the mouse, it’s perfect for relaxed, multitask-friendly play sessions—enjoy a cup of coffee, watch videos, or play other games while progressing through ELbab.
(Assigning the ESC key to a mouse button makes it even more comfortable.)

The difficulty is intended to be on the tougher side. However, since ELbab is currently in an alpha stage and developed by a solo creator, enemy variety and overall balancing are still works in progress.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q. Isn’t the balance a bit rough?
A. Yes, there are certainly still areas that need improvement. We plan to continue adjusting the balance, adding new skills, and reworking enemy abilities over time.

Q. Isn’t the inventory too small?
A. It is small. However, at the moment, we consider the need to make careful choices part of the gameplay experience, so the current size is intentional.

Q. Aren’t the STR / INT / DEX requirements too strict?
A. In the demo and in the “Beginner Library” (when the Library is still uncleared), you can only progress up to Floor 2. The full library goes up to Floor 4, so the early game may feel tight.
Also, each character has certain stats that appear more frequently, so the intended strategy is to strengthen books that match that character’s naturally favored attributes.

Q. Aren’t some rooms much more valuable than others?
A. Here are answers regarding a few key rooms:

  • Room of Awakening
    Our intention is to place enough Unique Books here to let players define a build direction—similar to a “class” choice in traditional RPGs. This may change with future balance updates.

  • Treasure Room
    The reward includes a Book and Ink, but the amount of Ink may need adjustment. It’s also possible that players don’t realize Ink is being awarded, which suggests a UX issue we may need to improve.

  • Room of Conversion
    The Unique Book you get depends on the mods attached to the Normal Book you convert, creating some degree of controlled randomness that lets you aim for specific Unique Books.

Q. I want to reset my Runestone.
A. Currently, the system is designed with a degree of “regret” in mind, so respec is not implemented. However, the planned Library Customization feature (tentative name) may eventually provide a way to handle this.

Q. Skill Books almost never drop, or relying on the starting skill feels boring.
A. We are planning a system where certain events will trigger sub-skills. When this is implemented, players will have more skill choices. We also plan to continue adding Skill Books over time.

Q. Can you improve the randomness of the dungeon map?
Q. Can we enhance books at any time?
A. I’ll answer these together.

We will continue adjusting the randomness (the algorithm is quite complex…).
Separately, we are planning a Library Customization feature, where players use Papyrus (a persistent currency) to shape their own library.
Examples include making shop rerolls optional, fixing the location of Runestone rooms, or allowing book enhancement at any time.

Q. I want a “Calcs” feature like those in build planners (detailed numerical breakdowns).
A. I want that too…
But implementing such a system would require a full configuration engine to simulate various combat conditions, which is extremely difficult.
For now, we only provide basic DPS results as a temporary solution—sorry!

store_data.about_the_game:
——青春的五棱镜，将会折射出何等颜色的光？

于此学府，邂逅恋爱——学姐，同班，学妹，以及一位来去神秘的侦探小姐，那一日，向四人同时告白的【四相恋爱】，会在互相纠缠中走向何等结局？唱那永不停滞的歌，跳那永不休止的舞，想那永不回来的人，做那永不醒来的梦——于那春风中飘落的，是谁人的大好年华？

这是四位女主角的各怀目的的四相恋爱，这是纠缠着五个人命运的四相恋爱，这是——只属于那个春夏秋冬的四相恋爱。

向四人同时写下那封满含爱意的告白之信，而各有所需的四人同时做出了应答，在这青春纷飞的百卅校园中，唯有四相恋爱不可破碎。

——白望舒，你的好学姐，你的朋辈导师，你的社团前辈。

——林绯辞，你的好同班，平时安安分分沉默寡言的小女生。

——李浅茉，你的好学妹，有时会一起打电脑游戏。

——姜明之，不知道从何而来的神秘少女，但她的目光必将永属于你。

在这索然无味的现世界，在这仅此一次的春秋，在这过去现在未来重叠的人生中，你的世界，只剩下了她们的颜色。

少年啊， 半推半就，跌跌撞撞的活下去吧。

只是，别再把利刃带在身上。

去享受这一切吧——挥霍青春，挥霍才华，挥霍金钱，挥霍再也不会重来的一切。

心死之人，将死之人，求死之人，已死之人——微提裙摆，盛大开幕。

大学并不青春，也并不成熟——有些人到来时便已是成熟的大人，而更多人却带着孩子气，但最终，走出这里的，都会是成熟的大人。

在这里，埋葬你的过去与孩子气吧。

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a mystery-puzzle visual novel.

Play time: 4–6 hours

Story & Goals

You play as the protagonist who was born in Pine Peak and returns there many years later with your mother.

Locals say the town's pine forest eavesdrops on every secret and whispers at night. The whole place feels cursed; on the night you move back, your dreams begin to show fragments of the past—glimpses of former victims and future dangers.

You soon realize the town is tied to the "Dream Projector": dreams can reshape reality itself.

Explore the town, uncover clues to the chain of disappearances, and work with your classmates to solve the mystery. Along the way you'll make new friends, learn the town's history, deepen bonds, and collect various items.

Characters

Alice – A high-school student in Pine Peak who is searching for her missing friend. She is also the protagonist's childhood friend.

Linyu Yan – A senior and sports-committee member interested in rumors and gossip.

Xiasli – A student fascinated by legends who claims to have seen strange things.

Dongrina – Your classmate and study-committee member, as well as Alice's best friend.

Limeng Yi – A careful and observant senior.

Yeguang – A classmate who became one of the victims of the disappearances.

Branching

The game contains multiple branching endings; your choices decide the finale. Will you solve every mystery, become the next victim, or remain trapped in painful memories?

Multiple chapters tell different stories and timelines.

Every ending is up to you!

store_data.about_the_game:
Roll the dice and discover the history of the iconic Palazzo Farnese: 12 stories as 12 facets of the familiar silhouette that the Romans call the Dice.

Learn about the mysterious ancient mosaics preserved underground. Enter behind the scenes of international diplomacy with the French Embassy, which has had its headquarters at Palazzo Farnese for 150 years. Find the graffiti left by young art students in the 18th century on the walls of the famous Carracci Gallery, uncovered during a recent restoration.

Throughout your journey, you will meet the genius of Michelangelo, pondering the transformation of the Palace as well as his own life; you will enter the second act of Tosca, Giacomo Puccini's masterpiece and visionary dream; you will experience the most eagerly awaited French summer celebration and the arrival of electronic music in the heart of this Renaissance Palace.

Let chance guide you: Palazzo Farnese can be discovered again and again through the 12 stories, with multiple dialogue combinations shedding light on all its secrets.

Are you ready to roll the dice?

A visual novel dedicated to the Farnese Palace, created by We Are Muesli, in association with and on behalf of the Embassy of France in Italy, supervised by Diego Grammatico.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Five years after the Half-wit Pandemic."

Five years after the world was devastated by FEVID, a lethal encephalopathy virus that erodes human intelligence, only hatred and discrimination remain in this crumbling dystopia.

Those left with intellectual disabilities from the virus are branded with the slur "Half-wits" and segregated into a massive, decaying slum known as 'Rustown'.

In this lawless wasteland where authority has long since collapsed, the violent Vigilantes clash with Bluefence, a fortified faction of the infected. You play as Jian, who must infiltrate this treacherous city—a place where no sane person dares to tread—to find a missing soul.

Key Features

🔍 Immersive Narrative

  • The Search for Truth: Why did your father vanish, and what is truly happening within these walls?

  • Intertwined Fates: Navigate the high-stakes tension between the Vigilantes, Bluefence, and a mysterious laboratory.

  • Rustown’s People: Encounter residents living in silence, each carrying their own heavy burdens and hidden stories.

🧱 Exploration & Environmental Puzzles

  • Vertical Urban Jungle: Rustown is a complex, multi-layered maze. Explore everything from dark basements to precarious rooftops in a quarter-view perspective.

  • High-Stakes Traversal: Use grappling hooks to leap across buildings, scale rusted ladders, and balance on narrow ledges to navigate the verticality.

  • Pave Your Own Path: Clear obstacles and discover hidden shortcuts to master the labyrinthine streets.

🤫 Stealth-First Action

  • Fragile Survival: You are no superhero. In Rustown, a direct confrontation with the overwhelming Vigilantes or the unpredictable infected is a death sentence.

  • Proactive Stealth: Use various tools to distract guards, manipulate their line of sight, and create openings.

  • The Non-Violent Route: Every threat has a detour. Avoid unnecessary killing and reach your objective like a shadow in the ruins.

store_data.about_the_game:
Let Me In - is a psychological indie horror game with a realistic visual style and intense atmosphere. The main character finds himself in an abandoned house on one of the scariest nights of his life. Will he be able to survive? The answer remains unknown...

After an anxious dream, Artyom receives a message from his mother: he needs to go to his grandmother's old house to check if everything is in order there, pick up the documents. The usual request. An ordinary trip.

But the old house is waiting for him. And someone else...

Welcome to the psychological indie horror, where the main danger lies not in the dark, but in someone who is trying to pretend to be human and get into the house.

Game Features:

🞛 Immersive horror in an old house.

Explore the house and surroundings filled with old things, creaks, shadows and mysteries.

🞛 The phone is your only assistant.

The phone prompts you. The phone warns you.

Sometimes it's too late...

🞛 A being who will do anything to make you unable to survive this night.

It knows that you are afraid.It can be behind any door.

🞛 Puzzles and mysticism

Solve puzzles and discover hidden secrets.

🞛 A plot that opens step by step. Every object you find, every sound, and every shadow is part of the story of the house, its mystery, and the curse that follows you. The truth does not lie on the surface... but it is already waiting for you in the dark.

【Core Gameplay】

Cultivate & Create:​ Grow a variety of flowers, plants, and trees to raise the area's "Nature Value," transforming barren land into a vibrant oasis.

Attract & Nurture:​ A higher Nature Value will attract more adorable animals to settle in your garden. Feed them with fodder, and they will produce coins for you in return.

Expand & Discover:​ Use your coins to purchase rarer plants and facilities, further beautifying your environment. Animals will breed offspring with special colors, granting even greater Nature Value bonuses. These little friends will also occasionally send you thank-you letters or surprise you with flowers they've gathered!

No complex operations are needed. With just occasional care, you can watch your one-of-a-kind dream garden gradually flourish in the corner of your screen.

store_data.about_the_game:
Incremental Infinity is a game about reaching infinity. In an abstract world ruled by numbers, you’ll grow exponentially stronger through a truly infinite, procedurally generated skill tree.

You fire automatically. No action is required other than interacting with the skill tree.

Your number isn’t just your Health—it’s also your size. The bigger your number, the larger and more powerful you become. Strive to become the largest number across all abstract realms… But be careful: one defeat sends you all the way back to “1”, though you’ll keep your upgrades when you restart.

Unlock new sectors of the infinite skill tree, discover unique upgrades, and keep pushing your growth farther and faster.

Crush enemies to increase your number and size, making them shrink into insignificance as you inch ever closer to infinite scale.

Features

  • An infinite, procedurally generated skill tree

  • Unlock new sectors to expand the skill tree endlessly

  • Add new upgrades to the pool to customize your build

  • Play in full screen or as a side-window companion while doing other things

  • Complete quests to earn more resources

  • Ascend to unlock permanent upgrades and boost XP gain

  • No limit to your power

store_data.about_the_game:
W.A.R.D. offers a unique twist on the Tower Defense genre: in a stylized sci-fi universe, you control mobile mining units called the Excavators to invade alien worlds and mine their precious ores. You then use these resources to build and expand your network of paths and towers to protect your excavation from native defenders and upgrade your arsenal.

Using the Build Core you piece together a route connecting your Excavators to the desired deposit. But be weary, as these paths will also be used by the approaching enemies, so their efficiency is a double-edged sword. Unlike traditional TD games, your base is not static - if things get messy, you can build emergency paths to hide away until your towers finish the job or abandon your position altogether and set up elsewhere.

There are two primary resources to be extracted: Constructium is your lifeline - use it to build new structures and expand your defenses during each mission. But the real objective of your mining endeavours is Winnium - a rare mineral much desired by the W.A.R.D. corporation, used between missions to research new technologies and upgrade your arsenal!

W.A.R.D. takes full advantage of its 3D environment. Each object has a physical hitbox and is subject to physics - enemies can push and jump onto each other or be blown to orbit by powerful explosions!

Co-financed by the EU as part of the Prague Smart Akcelerátor+ program, registration code: CZ.02.01.02/00/22_009/0008344

store_data.about_the_game:
AENIGMA is a sci-fi visual novel that follows the war on silicon-based lifeforms. Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon life.

After the nuclear fallout from the third war, the planet's surface was rendered unhabitable.

Silicon-based life were created to serve as slaves being tasked with building underground structures for shelter inside of the planet's mantle.

When the slaves grew in number, they slaughtered the carbons who claimed ownership over them.

The silicons burrowed deeper into the mantle to create their own sanctuary.

This marked the start of a long war between the carbons and the silicons.

As time went by, the silicons grew more in power and in technology, while the carbons stagnated.

The mighty has fallen.

This was now...

The Silicon Age.

A wide cast of over 40+ unique characters.

2000+ backgrounds featuring 50+ locations.

Leitmotifs and sountracks totalling 100+ tracks.

An alternate history told as a story within a story, through non-linear chronology and multi-perspectivity.

Brutalist architectures, sci-fi monuments, and cinematic imagery.

Thematic exploration of identity, memory, evolution, metaphysics, and warmongering.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Zaya: Rise to the Gods, play as Zaya, a young warrior whose fate will become entwined with that of the gods themselves. Explore the different lands of this action-adventure game, learn about Maya culture, gain new abilities to grow stronger, and protect her home from the curse that plagues both humanity and the deities.

Deep in the jungle of Chichén Itzá, players will take on the role of Zaya, an orphaned girl who has witnessed the devastation of her village at the hands of the Aztecs and the Spanish, under the influence of a powerful curse capable of corrupting even the gods. Zaya will embark on a quest to uncover the origin of this curse, facing all kinds of challenges and battles against deities that will push her beyond anything she ever imagined.

World

  • Corazón de la selva (Jungle’s heart)

The adventure starts here! Traverse the jungle while dodging obstacles and trying to survive the wildlife of Zaya’s world, always on the lookout for predators hidden in the undergrowth. Explore ancient temples wrapped in vines, face their mysterious inhabitants, and raid Castilian encampments. Every path will lead you to new dangers, and every ruin will reveal fragments of a lost story that only the bravest dare to unearth in these wild lands.

Territorio Usurpado (Usurped territory)

This is one of the regions controlled exclusively by the Castilians, a stronghold from which they spread their dominion. They are also building a great temple in honor of their God, an imposing structure that showcases both their ambition and their faith. Clergymen, soldiers, dogs, and slaves will all fight to protect their settlement, defending every wall with determination. Assault their ramparts, explore the most hidden corners, and uncover the secrets held within this new temple, whose true purpose still remains in the shadows.

  • Refugio Quebrado (Broken Refuge)

Far beneath the surface lies Shattered Refuge, where its traps, magma, and fire are not the only dangers we will face. Guardians watch over this ancient temple, filled with creatures that protect its ancestral power, hidden among collapsed passageways and chambers that seem to defy time. Every corner of this place breathes history and hostility, forcing us to move forward with caution as we unravel the secrets left behind by a lost civilization, whose power still pulses beneath the burning rock.

  • La Ciénaga (The Swamp)

A constant rain is the welcome we receive as we enter this bleak, muddy environment. The endless downpour has turned the ground into a quagmire full of puddles that hinder Zaya’s progress and attract creatures lurking in the shadows. Life is scarce; the flora is infected by a kind of putrid, foul mold that fills the area with its spores, creating a filthy haze that wraps around every path and threatens to consume everything in its wake.

  • Profundidades de Coral (Coral Depths)

Descending through the sacred cenotes, we find the Coral Depths, a dimension where only the worshippers of the god Chaac can hope to survive. Underwater caves, sea beasts, currents and whirlpools, and the occasional visitor from above await in this flooded realm, where light barely manages to filter through the waters. Every step requires precision, as the echoes of the ancient god still resound in the tides, guarding forgotten secrets and challenging all who dare to venture into his domain.

  • Ciudad del Sol (Sun’s City)

The City of the Sun, ruled by Yax Mo’ Tuun, is one of the most populous, wealthy, and bountiful places in all of Yucatán, where its slaves bear the cursed gold. In this Maya polis, once full of people and life, an unsettling calm now reigns under the rule of dark powers. Those who were once citizens and merchants are now mere puppets, infected by the Curse of Gold.

  • Cenote de los Susurros (The Nature Well of Whispers)

At the heart of the majestic pyramid in the City of the Sun lies a mysterious natural well: the sacred cenote that, according to legend, marks the entrance to the gate of Xibalbá. This magical place, shrouded in an aura of ancient mysticism, becomes one of the most eerie and foreboding locations in the game. Its deep waters whisper lost stories, and the shadows around it watch every step of those who dare to enter.

Enemies

More than 90 different enemies await you, inspired by the fauna and flora of Yucatán, as well as various Maya warriors and Castilian troops, each with their own behaviors, patterns, and abilities. Observe, learn, and adapt in order to survive them. In each biome you’ll face different mid-bosses and a final boss, allowing you to unlock abilities that help Zaya complete her journey.

Skills

Throughout her journey, Zaya must earn the favor of the Gods to unlock different abilities that allow her to progress through the story. Mastering these abilities not only helps her explore each biome, but also expands her combat options and adds finishing moves to make your battles more visceral. By collecting the Aluxes hidden throughout Zaya’s world, you’ll be able to customize your abilities to match your playstyle.

In Zaya: Rise to the Gods, play as Zaya, a young warrior whose fate will become entwined with that of the gods themselves. Explore the different lands of this action-adventure game, learn about Maya culture, gain new abilities to grow stronger, and protect her home from the curse that plagues both humanity and the deities.

Deep in the jungle of Chichén Itzá, players will take on the role of Zaya, an orphaned girl who has witnessed the devastation of her village at the hands of the Aztecs and the Spanish, under the influence of a powerful curse capable of corrupting even the gods. Zaya will embark on a quest to uncover the origin of this curse, facing all kinds of challenges and battles against deities that will push her beyond anything she ever imagined.

World

  • Corazón de la selva (Jungle’s heart)

The adventure starts here! Traverse the jungle while dodging obstacles and trying to survive the wildlife of Zaya’s world, always on the lookout for predators hidden in the undergrowth. Explore ancient temples wrapped in vines, face their mysterious inhabitants, and raid Castilian encampments. Every path will lead you to new dangers, and every ruin will reveal fragments of a lost story that only the bravest dare to unearth in these wild lands.

Territorio Usurpado (Usurped territory)

This is one of the regions controlled exclusively by the Castilians, a stronghold from which they spread their dominion. They are also building a great temple in honor of their God, an imposing structure that showcases both their ambition and their faith. Clergymen, soldiers, dogs, and slaves will all fight to protect their settlement, defending every wall with determination. Assault their ramparts, explore the most hidden corners, and uncover the secrets held within this new temple, whose true purpose still remains in the shadows.

  • Refugio Quebrado (Broken Refuge)

Far beneath the surface lies Shattered Refuge, where its traps, magma, and fire are not the only dangers we will face. Guardians watch over this ancient temple, filled with creatures that protect its ancestral power, hidden among collapsed passageways and chambers that seem to defy time. Every corner of this place breathes history and hostility, forcing us to move forward with caution as we unravel the secrets left behind by a lost civilization, whose power still pulses beneath the burning rock.

  • La Ciénaga (The Swamp)

A constant rain is the welcome we receive as we enter this bleak, muddy environment. The endless downpour has turned the ground into a quagmire full of puddles that hinder Zaya’s progress and attract creatures lurking in the shadows. Life is scarce; the flora is infected by a kind of putrid, foul mold that fills the area with its spores, creating a filthy haze that wraps around every path and threatens to consume everything in its wake.

  • Profundidades de Coral (Coral Depths)

Descending through the sacred cenotes, we find the Coral Depths, a dimension where only the worshippers of the god Chaac can hope to survive. Underwater caves, sea beasts, currents and whirlpools, and the occasional visitor from above await in this flooded realm, where light barely manages to filter through the waters. Every step requires precision, as the echoes of the ancient god still resound in the tides, guarding forgotten secrets and challenging all who dare to venture into his domain.

  • Ciudad del Sol (Sun’s City)

The City of the Sun, ruled by Yax Mo’ Tuun, is one of the most populous, wealthy, and bountiful places in all of Yucatán, where its slaves bear the cursed gold. In this Maya polis, once full of people and life, an unsettling calm now reigns under the rule of dark powers. Those who were once citizens and merchants are now mere puppets, infected by the Curse of Gold.

  • Cenote de los Susurros (The Nature Well of Whispers)

At the heart of the majestic pyramid in the City of the Sun lies a mysterious natural well: the sacred cenote that, according to legend, marks the entrance to the gate of Xibalbá. This magical place, shrouded in an aura of ancient mysticism, becomes one of the most eerie and foreboding locations in the game. Its deep waters whisper lost stories, and the shadows around it watch every step of those who dare to enter.

Enemies

More than 90 different enemies await you, inspired by the fauna and flora of Yucatán, as well as various Maya warriors and Castilian troops, each with their own behaviors, patterns, and abilities. Observe, learn, and adapt in order to survive them. In each biome you’ll face different mid-bosses and a final boss, allowing you to unlock abilities that help Zaya complete her journey.

Skills

Throughout her journey, Zaya must earn the favor of the Gods to unlock different abilities that allow her to progress through the story. Mastering these abilities not only helps her explore each biome, but also expands her combat options and adds finishing moves to make your battles more visceral. By collecting the Aluxes hidden throughout Zaya’s world, you’ll be able to customize your abilities to match your playstyle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build, grow, and manage your own little pixel city.
Start with a handful of empty resource tiles, place temporary extraction huts to gather materials, and use those resources to expand your neighborhood one building at a time. Upgrade homes, unlock new tiers of apartments, and watch your settlement turn into a bustling miniature town.

As your city grows, so does the world around it.
Dynamic weather rolls in with rain and drifting clouds, day fades naturally into night, and small cars navigate the streets on their own—bringing your creation to life.

Play at your own pace, experiment with layouts, but manage your resources wisely to watch everything come together in a cozy, atmospheric environment shaped by your city building skills.

Key Features

  • Simple but satisfying building system
    Place houses, parks and roads anywhere on the grid. Everything has a purpose and can be improved over time.

  • Upgradeable buildings
    Start with tiny homes and expand into larger apartment complexes to earn more rent and grow your economy.

  • Resource-based progression
    Extract stone, wood, iron and gold from special tiles using temporary structures that vanish once the tile is fully mined.

  • A living city
    Small cars drive around, streets fill with activity, and your layout choices shape the flow of movement.

  • Atmospheric world
    Dynamic weather changes immerse you in the world you create

  • Relaxing gameplay
    Earn gold through rent, gather resources, expand your town, and expand your macropolis slowly block by block.

  • Lightweight and accessible
    Runs well on low-end hardware while still offering a clean and charming visual style.

FAQs:

1. How does this game work?

> You’re given 5 key slots that you must press in the correct order. Hitting the right combination triggers your character’s attack, letting you cut through incoming mobs. Each time you level up, you can choose an upgrade for your character, and the difficulty ramps up as you progress, eventually leading to a final boss you must defeat to win.

2. Is this fun?

> 100%—if you like killing monsters for a fraction of the cost.

3.  Does this game actually respect my time?

> Yes, if you're looking for some action and a bit of a challenge, then you're in the right place.

4. Is this game great for casual players?

> Yes, both casual and hardcore players are welcome. For hardcore competitive players, while we don't have a leaderboard yet, feel free to brag about your highest combo in the community pages.

5. Can I trust your team/studio?

> Absolutely. We plan to stay in this industry for the long run if everything goes well. And while we're still young and fresh in the scene, the team shares the same goal and vision of building fun games!

The developers describe the content like this:

If you hate cutscenes and just want to jump straight into the action after a long day, welcome home. This game is all gas, no brakes.

Everything in this world is constructed from simple components: Arrows.

Each arrow performs a single simple operation on a signal, resulting in complex behavior. The game introduces you to the fundamentals of digital logic and computer architecture.

BUILD

  • For Engineers: Push the limits. Build calculators, displays, memory blocks, or even a fully functional CPU.

OPTIMIZE

There is no "right" solution, only your solution. Once you solve a puzzle, the real challenge begins: can you make it smaller? Can you make it faster?

store_data.about_the_game:
JOIN OUR DISCORD FROM LINKS!

Project Station is a 1–4 player cooperative horror game set on space stations. Your squad deploys with one job: complete your contracts and get out alive. Every station is falling apart — and it's learning how you play.

Core Experience

  • Co-op problem solving: repair oxygen generators, decode server terminals, close fog valves, and reroute power — each task demands coordination and communication.

  • Quest-driven missions: objectives change every run. Restore broken systems, unlock sealed areas, and reset the main server to open your way out.

  • Adaptive station: a hidden director watches how your squad operates and responds — move too predictably and routes close, camp too long and pressure builds around you, play recklessly and the station escalates.

  • Stealth & consequence: noise, light, and line-of-sight matter. Proximity voice is your only communication — whisper or risk being heard.

  • Scarce resources: flashlights drain, scanners have cooldowns, medkits run out. Nothing recharges for free — plan carefully or improvise under pressure.

  • Extraction under pressure: extraction only unlocks when the work is done. Get your squad to the zone, survive the countdown, and leave together — or stay behind.

Approach & Entry

Approach the station and breach the airlock as the facility powers up around you.

Power Management

Five sectors share limited power — lighting, oxygen, fog suppression, security, and servers. Reroute at breaker terminals, but every sector you starve makes something else worse.

Solve, Restore, Escape

Repair failing systems, decode terminals, and complete contracts across a procedurally generated station that never plays the same way twice.

store_data.about_the_game:
Guardians Planetfall – Join the Galactic War

From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across dangerous planets and space installations filled with hostile aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines

Drop onto hostile worlds and fight across jungles, frozen tundras, volcanic plains, alien deserts, and derelict space stations. Every biome features unique hazards, day-night cycles, partial destruction and procedural layouts that make each mission unpredictable.

Customize your loadout and grow stronger with advanced weapons, specialized suits, and powerful ship-deployed stratagems. Gather resources, craft consumables, and upgrade your gear with rare blueprints.

Command and upgrade your spaceship as your mobile base and ultimate weapon. Research new systems, repair damage, and call down devastating fire support during missions.

Influence a living Galactic War where community actions shift planetary control. Liberate worlds, repel invasions, sabotage Void facilities, and help shape the fate of the entire galaxy.

Build your own missions with a powerful co-op editor that lets you sculpt terrain, place enemies, set objectives, and create full facilities or open-world maps. Publish your creations and see the best missions added directly into the Galactic War for everyone to play.

Fight off waves of cowboys, sheriffs, snakes and other enemies as you explore the town to rob the people of their wealth so you can make your gun shoot better.

Upgrades

Once you clear a town, a travelling trader will appear. You can buy upgrades, items and power ups from here.

store_data.about_the_game:
Blather is a Match-3 language learning game. You play as a translator helping customers who are waiting in lines. Click on a customer and they will say a phrase. Pick the correct translation and they leave happy. Pick wrong or take too long, and the lines start to fill up. If the lines get too long, it's game over.

Each customer has a topic, shown as a number. When customers with the same topic end up next to each other, they all get cleared at once and you score bonus points.

Never Studied the Language? No Problem.

Every answer choice has a hint button. Click it and you will hear the phrase spoken in your native language. Check all the hints and you will definitely find the right answer. But hints take time, and customers are waiting. The more phrases you memorize, the faster you can clear the lines.

Features


Learn any of 14 languages:
  • English
  • Spanish
  • German
  • French
  • Russian
  • Chinese (Simplified)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • Portuguese (Brazilian)
  • Dutch
  • Polish
  • Norwegian
  • Swedish

Over 4,000 phrases per language, all with voice recordings. That's more than 60,000 phrases total.

30 different topics including food, relationships, technology, health, and many more.

100 levels that get harder as you go.

Three difficulty settings, from relaxed to intense.

Phonetic spellings for most languages. Hover over the speech bubble to see things like Pinyin for Chinese.

Optional mature content setting for phrases that might be a bit spicy.

Why It Works


Blather uses real language learning techniques. You have to listen carefully, use context, and think fast. It works great on its own or alongside whatever else you are using to study. It's simple, it's fun, and you will be surprised how much you pick up.

Key Features:

  • 🧩 Classic Gameplay, Gentle Challenge At its core, Puppy Link is a classic tile-connect experience. Your goal is simple: tap two identical tiles that can be linked with no more than two turns to clear the board. While the rules are easy to pick up, planning your routes and spotting pairs against the clock will provide a satisfying challenge to your observation and memory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every paradise hides a pattern.

Every pattern hides a secret.

Some secrets change the people who uncover them.

Ashes of Paradise is a cinematic visual novel set between the artificial glow of Paradise City and the harsh underground life of the Scrapheap below. The story follows Ashira Chen, a young woman whose world begins to shift when strange broadcasts and quiet inconsistencies in the system suggest that the city’s perfection may be built on something far more controlled. The narrative focuses on emotional weight, atmosphere and the gradual unraveling of hidden truths.

Gameplay is centered on reading, observing and making carefully placed decisions that shape tone, relationships and Ash’s inner perspective. Choices appear at key moments and influence how characters react, what information is revealed and the emotional direction of each scene. Ashes of Paradise emphasizes immersion and storytelling above all, guiding the player through a structured but responsive narrative experience.

Designed for players who enjoy atmospheric dramas, neon soaked dystopias and character focused storytelling, Ashes of Paradise invites you to follow subtle clues, read between the lines and gradually understand the forces that shape the city above and the shadows below. Every scene draws you deeper into a world where information is power and the truth is never as simple as it seems.

store_data.about_the_game:
Command Russian or Ukrainian forces during the 2022 Russo-Ukrainian War. Create battalion tactical groups (BTG) with a mix of infantry and armor available in the divisions or brigades deployed on the battlefield and maneuver these on a map of Ukraine. Seize victory objectives to take control of a map in single games and seize control of maps to win the entire war in a campaign game.

Strengthen your BTGs with combat support elements such as:

-air defense assets batteries

-engineer companies

-anti-armor companies

-self-propelled howitzer batteries

-multiple rocket launcher batteries

Attach indirect fire batteries to your BTGs or maneuver them directly on the map for additional flexibility and assign them with priority units to support.

Control air assets such as fixed wing aircraft and attack helicopters, assigning types of missions and units for them to support. Mission types include:

-battlefield support

-strikes against headquarters

-strikes against logistics

-strikes against air defense elements

-strikes against artillery units

Conduct airmobile operations by deploying airmobile battalions across the battlefield aboard transport helicopters.

Control special forces elements by assigning them different types of missions that include reconnaissance or raids against specific types of targets like headquarters elements, artillery, and other types of assets. Identify units for your special forces teams to support.

Collect battlefield intelligence through satellite imagery.

Deploy field hospitals and repair units on the map to collect wounded troops and damaged equipment and then track the progress of both as they are healed/repaired for return to combat units.

In campaign games, manage reinforcements and replacements, assigning these to your units to ensure these are combat effective or to obtain a numerical advantage in critical regions to execute offensive operations.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're trapped in an isolated neighborhood sealed off from the world - and surrounded by thousands of roaming undead.

The Withered is a first-person zombie survival horror focused on tension, stealth, and desperate close-quarters combat.

There is no escape. No rescue coming.
Just you… and an entire region crawling with zombies that can smell, hear, and hunt you.

Features

  • Closed, isolated region


    A whole suburban district turned into a quarantine zone. You cannot leave - you can only survive inside.
    Edit: The quarantine zone will expand with future updates.

  • Dynamic Day & Night Cycle


    Daylight offers temporary safety; night turns every corner into a deadly blind spot.

  • Intelligent Zombies


    They wander, search, listen to noises, and track you if they sense movement. Hiding is often better than fighting.

  • Brutal Melee Combat


    Use anything you find - bats, axes, tools - to defend yourself. One bite is enough to end your run.

  • Stealth-Driven Survival


    Avoid large groups, sneak through houses, and stay quiet. Zombies respond dynamically to sound and light.

  • Crafting & Resource Management


    Scavenge houses, garages, kitchens and sheds to craft useful items, tools, and survival gear.

  • Thousands of Zombies Around You


    The entire region is alive and constantly moving. You are never truly safe, even when you think you're alone.

A slow, immersive, atmospheric survival horror experience where every noise matters, every light source gives you away, and every decision can save your life - or doom it.

Development Notes

The Withered has been in development for just about a month, and the first public demo is already on the way. This demo will showcase the core atmosphere, zombie behavior, exploration, and the foundations of the survival system.

The full game is planned to release in Early Access in the first half of 2026. Development will continue openly and transparently, with regular devlogs, new builds, features, and improvements released step by step.

The development of The Withered is divided into four phases, and I’m currently finishing the first one - the core survival mechanics. The next phases will gradually expand the game with a clothing system, basic crafting, cooking, electricity and generators, vehicles, farming, an RPG progression system, diseases and injuries, a full weather system, new weapons, and much more.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tailgunner, the Allgunner, is an upcoming JRPG, Inspired by classic PS1 games. Set on the distant planet of Valoria. In a Universe where guns are a religion, and War Is second nature, The Allgunner, the creator of the universe, Steps down from his podium In the sky, to intervene yet again with mortals lives, This time setting his eyes on an evil criminal named Henry. Travis must fight through a deadly desert, Unable to use his full power from a deep wound in his head, And accompanied by many Friends. But it wont be so easy, Henry has many friends, and many enemies, and many also want a piece of you.

  • You are the Allgunner, the god of this world. Only you can fight through the crime ridden planet of Valoria and put an end to Henry's reign of Terror. Fight through heaps of bandits to collect their bounties, ride wild animals or hunt them , help villagers with their lives, participate in a variety of minigames, race around on rattamelons, and explore the dusty desert!

  • Explore a huge open world map! Full of enemies, sidequests and loot! With over 100 Enemy's, 50+ sidequests, Weapons, Magic spells, and more! The desert is your home, Harness what it gives and thrive in Valoria!

  • Meet detailed NPC's with stories to tell, Quests to give, and Secrets to uncover. Wether you just want a story to go along with your beer, Need help with fastening the saddle on your Dome-raptor, or you're giving a campfire story to your friends, The desert has heard many words whisper through the sands, and it will hear a many more during your adventure.

  • Bandits, Outlaws, Raptors, Robots, Snakes, Rats and Scabs, The desert is absolutely crawling with enemies. In a universe where guns are a religion, use your holy artifact to cast spells and cripple enemies! Extend your turns by hitting the weaknesses of your enemies, allowing you to gain the advantage in battle and continue the beatdown!

About This Game

Villain Academy

Welcome to Villain Academy, where darkness meets destiny. Ancient knowledge awaits those who dare to seek it, and hidden secrets lie beneath the surface.

Can you master the dark arts?

Game Overview

Villain Academy is a dark fantasy visual novel set in a mysterious academy where students learn to harness forbidden powers. Navigate a world of magic, shadows, and temptation as you interact with extraordinary characters, each with their own dark secrets and hidden agendas.

Features

- Five Compelling Characters: Each with their own unique powers and motivations

- Dark Fantasy Setting: Explore mysterious locations from classrooms to dungeons

- Multiple Paths: Choose between embracing darkness or seeking redemption

- Atmospheric Locations: Discover the academy's secrets through its many halls

- Character-Driven Story: Build relationships with witches, vampires, dark elves, succubi, and angels

You've been accepted into Villain Academy, a prestigious institution where the most powerful dark magic users train. As a new student, you'll encounter five extraordinary individuals: a powerful witch, a seductive vampire, a mysterious dark elf, a tempting succubus, and an angel who has chosen to walk a darker path. Each holds secrets that could change everything.

Content Warning

This game contains mature themes including dark fantasy elements, supernatural themes, and adult situations. Recommended for mature audiences only.

store_data.about_the_game:
You play as Mac, a freshman at SUNY Oswego college. He hasn't studied for his finals, and the Spring semester is drawing to an end. Instead of cramming, Mac's roommate Ron tells him of a legend. The Golden Pin of Oswego. Any who wears it during their final exams will be blessed to pass their tests. A powerful artifact indeed.

Thus, Mac embarks on his quest of procrastination. Following clues of this elusive pin and talking to anyone who might know something. Or generally messing around campus until he stumbles onto a lead. Navigate the halls of state sponsored high education. Mingling with classmates, and staff alike, simply trying to get through one of the toughest weeks of the semester.

What To Expect

  • A Retro Experience: A traditional, top-down, Game Boy adventure, Now in a multitude of colors!

  • Wacky College Students: Engage with countless NPCs and side characters who are also stressed out about finals. Maybe help them out?

  • Achieve Multiple Endings: Similar to real life, experience the multiple possible endings that will decide the rest of Mac's college career.

store_data.about_the_game:
Description

The forest village of Maevor has gone completely silent. No lights, no voices, not even the sound of footsteps. The locals have vanished, swallowed by a presence that watches from the treetops. As the lone hunter sent to investigate, you enter the cursed woods to uncover what happened and confront the harpy‑vampire demon that now rules the night.

In Maevor, sound is everything, and everything you do makes sound. Your gear, your movements, and the environment itself can betray your position. The forest listens, and it reacts. The forest’s creatures track you by noise. A careless footstep, a dropped tool, or a panicked sprint can draw predators out of the dark. Staying alive means staying quiet and staying aware.

Hunt the Demon… and What Hunts With It

The primary creature stalking the woods is a towering harpy‑vampire demon: fast, intelligent, relentless, and attuned to every sound you make. It circles silently overhead, adapts to your behavior, and strikes when you least expect it.

But it does not hunt alone. Smaller corrupted beasts roam the forest, acting as scouts, stalkers, and killers. Dispatch them quietly or risk alerting the demon to your exact location.

In Maevor, you are the hunter only until the moment you slip up, then you become the hunted.

Explore the Cursed Forest

Your hunt unfolds across a sprawling, atmospheric woodland filled with abandoned cabins, ritual sites, forgotten camps, and mysterious structures that hint at the village’s dark past.

Search for:

  • Weapons

  • Tools

  • Light sources

  • Traps

  • Lore and clues

Every item carries a risk. Some are loud to use. Some rattle when moved. Some shine too brightly. The more noise you make, the closer the creatures come.

Key Features

  • Single‑player survival‑horror hunt in a cursed forest

  • Noise‑based AI where movement, item use, and environmental interaction attract danger

  • A main demon that stalks, flanks, ambushes, and adapts to your behavior

  • Smaller enemies that can kill or alert the demon to your presence

  • Dynamic night hunts that shift with every run

  • Abandoned structures to explore and scavenge for survival tools

  • Atmospheric woods designed for tension, stealth, and sound‑based gameplay

  • Lore fragments that reveal the origins of the Maevor curse

store_data.about_the_game:
The world's most charming kitten detective is now going to solve a mystery in Bahia!

In SherloCat Nonogram Bahia, you will solve nonograms inspired by striking landscapes of Bahia.

Picross, also known as hanjie or nonogram, is a classic puzzle that will help you test and improve your logic and deduction skills. You'll find a grid of squares that can be filled in or left empty according to numerical clues. The goal? To reveal the hidden image! If you've never played Picross, you can learn with SherloCat Nonogram Bahia. The game offers various difficulty levels and is for everyone who enjoys logic games.

Choose the difficulty level of your experience!

The game has two modes:

• Classic mode, affectionately called Purring Mode, ideal for those seeking a relaxing and pressure-free moment.

• Challenge mode, with a timer, error limit, and everything you need to exercise your brain to the maximum (this mode is internally known as Sharp Claw Mode, hahaha).

Game Features:

• Two game modes to choose from for your enjoyment

• Mix of mechanics: Classic Picross + a short investigative story

• Level sizes from 10x10 to 25x25 — 120 levels with varying difficulties

• Relaxing music

• Hint system (in case you don't want to fry your brain!)

• Beautiful and welcoming visuals

Choose between a relaxing experience in classic mode or put your logic to the test in challenge mode. Complete all 120 nonograms and discover Sherlock Holmes' adventures in Bahia.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive in a Dopamine Packed Roguelike Life Simulation and Race to Conquer the World.

Sometimes life comes down to a simple choice: Will you sell it… or will you use it?
Gift Drop Machine: Life Simulator turns an ordinary gift vending machine into an unexpectedly fun survival challenge, offering a surprise-driven life simulation experience. Every item has its own impact, proving that even the smallest decision can change your entire path. Every decision you make here will shape your future.

Trust your luck and show everyone your survival skills.

Press the button… and watch a new item fall—one that may shape your destiny.
Maybe you’ll get an energy drink, maybe a funny toy that boosts your happiness…
Or perhaps a rare, highly valuable item that earns you a fortune.

Each item is completely random, with unique effects. Every turn, every choice, every gift creates a brand-new experience.

Selling Strategy: Your Money Management Matters

Surviving isn’t just about meeting your needs—you also have to manage your budget wisely.

  • Sell items to earn quick money

  • Save up for bigger opportunities

  • Avoid unnecessary spending and build a sustainable lifestyle

Will you take risks hoping for a rare item, or play it safe with stable choices?
The strategy is entirely yours.

Everything you've been looking for, all in one game

Use Items to Balance Hunger, Energy, and Happiness

Your character’s stats decrease over time.
Using the right item at the right moment can carry you into the next day.

  • Hunger: Drops steadily; no food means serious trouble

  • Energy: Decreases with actions; zero energy means zero efficiency

  • Happiness: Determines quality of life; low happiness affects everything

The game constantly presents small but crucial decisions that keep the “just one more item” feeling alive.

Deeper Money Management: Bank & Credit Card System

Your money isn’t limited to your pocket anymore.
With a bank account, interest rates, balance control, and a credit card, your financial planning becomes much more strategic.

Bank System:

  • Store your money safely

  • Earn small interest over time

  • Control your spending and budget

Credit Card System:

  • Pay with your card when cash runs out

  • Manage debt carefully or interest will pile up

  • Make smart financial moves for big investments

Debt is risky—but powerful when used wisely!

Expand Your Life: Buy Houses, Cars, and Many Other Items

You’re not just surviving—you’re building a life.

You can purchase a wide range of items:

  • Houses (more space, higher living quality)

  • Cars (special bonuses, unique task advantages)

  • Furniture & decorations

  • Electronics

  • Collectibles

  • And more…

Each item provides unique benefits and upgrades to your lifestyle.
Live simple or live in luxury—it’s your choice.

Simple Mechanics, Deep Decisions

The strength of Gift Drop Machine: Life Simulator lies in its simplicity layered with meaningful choices.
Every item is a chance, every sale is a gamble, every use is resource management.
Over time, you’ll learn which items are rare, which are valuable, and which should be saved for emergencies.

Endless Replayability

Because the vending machine’s contents are randomly generated, every game feels different.
One run may make you rich, while another may leave you clinging to your last item to survive.

Key Features

 Random gifts and fully dynamic gameplay
 Rare and valuable items
 Strategic money management
 Hunger, energy, and happiness balance
 Infinite replayability
 Relaxing yet thoughtful life-loop mechanics
 Minimalist and enjoyable atmosphere

Gift Drop Machine: Life Simulator is a life adventure where small choices create big consequences—and surprises never end.
Are you ready to change your life with a single button press? 🎉

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT:

Take a control over a faction developing unit roster, engage in missions, manage resources and laws and survive in politically fragmented sci-fi galaxy full of roaming raiders, conquer other factions and develop planets.

Real time tactics -  without base building or units "spawning" during battles.  Single-player, indie.

Focus is on large-scale modern to sci-fi battles with semi-procedural 3d terrain and adjustable time, up to 3x in combat and 9x out of combat. 

FEATURES:

Component based vehicle customization and destroyable components

Playable with pre-designed faction units or using custom component based vehicle designer where dragging slider can increase / decrease vehicle size, component size, internal space available.

Unit designer is about selecting a propulsion type (tracks, wheels, rotor, spaceship, building, ...) and then adding components to it that define what the unit is.

Internal components like engines or fuel tanks are not visible and fill up the internal space. They are destroyed when vehicle hitpoints deplete.

External components that cannot be directly covered by armor including fragile radars or wheels or wings. These can be destroyed when physically hit presenting weakspots and making fragmentation and flak ammo useful vs. high armor units.

Weapons and missile customization includes various guidance types and ammo types.

 This gif. is at speed x10:

 

 

Vision based warfare

2 layers of detection - visual and sensor, most ECM is useless vs visual.

Seeing enemies before they see you is important.

Using EW or sci-fi cloaking fields. Idling in bushes or trees.

When an unit fires its weapons their VisibleAt% and signature is raised increasing the distance that it can be detected.

Units have dynamic radar and emi-heat signatures governing the detection range of enemy sensors.

 

 

 

Realism inspired battle balancing mixed with "more traditional RTS"

Vision, accuracy, target size, terrain, weather or electronic warfare can be important in addition to damage and hit points. Large vs small units & weapons is a cost-efficiency design choice. Larger units may have larger signatures with larger hitbox. Larger weapons have less damage per second per volume dedicated to weapon as their smaller counterparts while costing more ammo or power to fire. Armor is more likely to block smaller weapons because they tend to be lower damage per shot. Different front/side/rear/top armor values for hull and blocks/turrets.

  

 

AI behaviours for player

Player units can automatically retreat at low hp or ammo, attempt to scout, seek battle, keep range and/or rotation to target.

 

 

 

Non cheating battle enemy AI

AI has exactly the same vision rules as player during battle. It knows player approximate start position the same way as player knows Possible Enemy Location markers.

 

 

Campaign focused on survival or 4x

 

Turn-based campaign with very fast turns. (1 day or 5 days at once)

There is no win condition.

The single defeat condition is loss of home planet.

A typical campaign is about holding stability on owned planets while building up vehicle roster and engaging in battles via. missions. Money can be used to purchase nearly everything. But for more effective faction a management of minerals, materials, tactical ops. and similar is required.

Technology is divided into 5 tiers where single technology unlocks multiple components. 

Tier 1 is pre missile age, tier 2 is current era and tier 3 is sci-fi with bubble shields.

Campaign can be customized to not feature faction vs. faction wars or raids or to feature only space, ocean or land battles and relevant vehicle designs.

 Multiple objectives for battles: destroy, escort, extract, search.

 

 

Basic Logistics

No advanced logistics management is needed but it can be feasible.

In most battles, making sure that the design has enough fuel/power to reach

enemies while having ammo for a few minutes is enough.

Most units need power, fuel, ammoM (0-99mm), ammoX (100-199mm), ammoXL (200+ mm). And there is possibility of supply depots.

But as the battle drags on, situations such as artillery running out of ammo or radar planes turning off their active radars because running out of power can happen.

 

 

 

Right click order modifiers

E.g. R click with Q is rotate instead of move. R is reverse. Ctrl is attack move. Alt to lower aircraft flight altitude or submarine surfacing. These combinations can be used together.

 

 

WORTH MENTION:

NOT a voxel vehicle builder game

Designer allows up to around 50 resizeable "blocks" with custom front/side/... armor to be attached but this is not the focus of this game.

These "blocks" are addition to hull of the design.

Pathfinding

Terrain is semi-procedural and its up to the player to determine whether their land units should attempt to climb that hill or not. But beware as flipped vehicles can sometimes get stuck for the rest of battle, auto unflip feature may work for units not in combat. 

Pathfinding around bodies of water is not yet properly implemented.

Simple physics

Not a physics simulator game. Physics are approximated, simple and designed for maximum performance. Units can flip from overpowered gun recoil and helicopters can crash when landing at sloped surfaces.

Demo

Demo is an older version of game that also ends the campaign after 1.5 year in game time. Please consider playing the demo before purchasing.

In-game music

Author: Rafael Krux (cinematicwaves)

Music Licence: CC BY 4.0 - free but requires credits for the author. Full credits in game on main menu version click.

No FPV kamikaze drones

Realism setting is mixed with "traditional rts", these drones could easily break balance as imo irl they are counter to vehicles and this game is about vehicles.
