Realism inspired battle balancing mixed with "more traditional RTS"

Vision, accuracy, target size, terrain, weather or electronic warfare can be important in addition to damage and hit points. Large vs small units & weapons is a cost-efficiency design choice. Larger units may have larger signatures with larger hitbox. Larger weapons have less damage per second per volume dedicated to weapon as their smaller counterparts while costing more ammo or power to fire. Armor is more likely to block smaller weapons because they tend to be lower damage per shot. Different front/side/rear/top armor values for hull and blocks/turrets.

  

 

AI behaviours for player

Player units can automatically retreat at low hp or ammo, attempt to scout, seek battle, keep range and/or rotation to target.

 

 

 

Non cheating battle enemy AI

AI has exactly the same vision rules as player during battle. It knows player approximate start position the same way as player knows Possible Enemy Location markers.

 

 

Campaign focused on survival or 4x

 

Turn-based campaign with very fast turns. (1 day or 5 days at once)

There is no win condition.

The single defeat condition is loss of home planet.

A typical campaign is about holding stability on owned planets while building up vehicle roster and engaging in battles via. missions. Money can be used to purchase nearly everything. But for more effective faction a management of minerals, materials, tactical ops. and similar is required.

Technology is divided into 5 tiers where single technology unlocks multiple components. 

Tier 1 is pre missile age, tier 2 is current era and tier 3 is sci-fi with bubble shields.

Campaign can be customized to not feature faction vs. faction wars or raids or to feature only space, ocean or land battles and relevant vehicle designs.

 Multiple objectives for battles: destroy, escort, extract, search.

 

 

Basic Logistics

No advanced logistics management is needed but it can be feasible.

In most battles, making sure that the design has enough fuel/power to reach

enemies while having ammo for a few minutes is enough.

Most units need power, fuel, ammoM (0-99mm), ammoX (100-199mm), ammoXL (200+ mm). And there is possibility of supply depots.

But as the battle drags on, situations such as artillery running out of ammo or radar planes turning off their active radars because running out of power can happen.

 

 

 

Right click order modifiers

E.g. R click with Q is rotate instead of move. R is reverse. Ctrl is attack move. Alt to lower aircraft flight altitude or submarine surfacing. These combinations can be used together.

 

 

WORTH MENTION:

NOT a voxel vehicle builder game

Designer allows up to around 50 resizeable "blocks" with custom front/side/... armor to be attached but this is not the focus of this game.

These "blocks" are addition to hull of the design.

Pathfinding

Terrain is semi-procedural and its up to the player to determine whether their land units should attempt to climb that hill or not. But beware as flipped vehicles can sometimes get stuck for the rest of battle, auto unflip feature may work for units not in combat. 

Pathfinding around bodies of water is not yet properly implemented.

Simple physics

Not a physics simulator game. Physics are approximated, simple and designed for maximum performance. Units can flip from overpowered gun recoil and helicopters can crash when landing at sloped surfaces.

Demo

Demo is an older version of game that also ends the campaign after 1.5 year in game time. Please consider playing the demo before purchasing.

In-game music

Author: Rafael Krux (cinematicwaves)

Music Licence: CC BY 4.0 - free but requires credits for the author. Full credits in game on main menu version click.

No FPV kamikaze drones

Realism setting is mixed with "traditional rts", these drones could easily break balance as imo irl they are counter to vehicles and this game is about vehicles.
store_data.short_description: Real time tactical battles in (rough) terrain, space, sea. Vehicle designer with custom weapons and custom chassis sizes. Some realism-inspired mechanics and complex rules including vision, sensors, destroyable components. Campaign about battles, survival, lite 4x and resource management.

store_data.about_the_game:
CAN YOU HOLD YOUR BREATH?

Scary Cave Diving is an immersive, first-person survival experience. You are trapped in a deep, underwater labyrinth with one goal: find the exit. But the caves are dark, your oxygen is draining quickly, and something massive is stalking you through the water.

SURVIVE THE DEPTHS

Dropped into a randomly generated cave system, no two dives are ever the same. You must navigate tight tunnels and open caverns using only your wits and limited resources. Use glow sticks to mark your path and illuminate the murky depths, but be careful—light might reveal things you wish stayed hidden.

THE APEX PREDATOR

You are not alone. A relentless shark patrols these waters. It can hear you, it can smell you, and it is always hungry.

  • Stealth & Speed: Avoid detection or swim for your life.

  • Defend Yourself: Scavenge for a rare flare gun to startle the beast—use it wisely, as it is your only line of defense in the main game mode.

  • Permadeath: If the shark catches you, or if your lungs run dry, it’s game over. The cave layout changes, and you must start your escape from scratch.

SHARK HUNTING

Need to blow off some steam after a terrifying dive? Step into the Shark Cage in a separate arcade-style game mode. Armed with a harpoon gun, turn the tables on your hunter. Shoot the shark, watch the blood mist fill the water, and take your revenge in a fight to the death.

KEY FEATURES

  • Hyper-Realistic Graphics: Powered by Unreal Engine, experience the terrifying beauty of underwater lighting, murky physics, and claustrophobic environments.

  • Procedural Generation: Modular cave generation ensures a fresh, disorienting nightmare every time you play.

  • Oxygen Management: Scavenge for extra air tanks to stay alive longer. Every breath counts.

  • Atmospheric Immersion: Claustrophobic caves, murky waters, and a bone-deep soundscape that makes every encounter unnerving.

  • Predator vs Player: Fight back in short, heart-pounding encounters: steady your aim, feel the recoil, and survive the shark’s charge — a tense blend of precision and panic.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tales of Evion: Forgotten Dreams is a story-driven fantasy RPG set in an entirely rewritten reality. After the fairy Fortune recreates the world using the Illusion Pearl of Fate, every kingdom, every person, and every destiny is changed. Tashy, now living a new life with no memory of the world that existed before, begins a journey to uncover the truth behind this strange reality and the mysterious Voices calling to her.

Story

Tashy believes she is an ordinary village girl until she discovers an Illusion Pearl containing a Voice identical to her own. This Voice reveals that the world around her is not the original reality. As Tashy follows the guidance of the Voices, she travels across Evion in search of the remaining Illusion Pearls, slowly uncovering the truth behind Fortune’s recreated world and her own hidden power.

Strategic Turn-Based Combat

Build a party of allies who are also living rewritten lives. Engage in strategic battles using magic, skills, elemental advantages, equipment, and teamwork. Face enemies and bosses across Evion as you customize your party and strengthen their abilities.

Explore a Rewritten World

Journey across the many kingdoms of Evion, each transformed by Fortune’s illusion. Travel through frozen frontiers, volcanic lands, underwater kingdoms, sky villages, desert realms, and more. Each region has new histories, rewritten identities, and mysteries that lead deeper into the truth of Evion’s altered reality.

Additional Features

• Side quests that expand the rewritten lore of Evion

• Optional challenge areas and unique game modes

• A dynamic soundtrack tailored to each kingdom

• Dungeons, puzzles, and ancient trials

• A cast of characters whose rewritten lives evolve as the story progresses

Character Progression and Customization

Level up your party, unlock new abilities, discover unique equipment, and explore optional dungeons and trials. As characters grow, their personalities, rewritten roles, and hidden truths unfold through story progression and side quests.

What Makes It Unique

Tales of Evion: Forgotten Dreams combines emotional storytelling, illusion-based magic, and classic turn-based RPG combat. The game focuses on uncovering the truth within a world that has been entirely rewritten, where the past has been erased, and the future depends on what Tashy chooses to discover.

store_data.about_the_game:
The year is 2436. Space travel within and beyond the Solar System has long been the norm. Long-haul space freighters transport goods between star systems. As a result, space stations have been established in orbit around stars and their moons. Most of these stations serve as border points, quarantine zones, cargo transfer and refueling stations, as well as places for rest and other activities.

The new international station "Dawn" is one of the most advanced stations, built using cutting-edge technology. It is positioned in a stable orbit between Earth and the Moon, at the Lagrange point L1. In addition to its standard functions, the station has become a hub for scientific research and development. Far from Earth, experiments are being conducted to create advanced weapons, including biological weapons using materials harvested from other star systems.

Due to this, the "Dawn" station operates under a heightened security protocol. Military personnel, synthetic drones, and combat robots controlled by an artificial intelligence integrated into the station's onboard computer are responsible for its protection. 24 hours ago, communication with the station was suddenly lost. To investigate the situation, an elite space marine squad was dispatched.
"Terminal Breach: Final Dawn" is a first-person shooter inspired by cinematic science fiction and the golden age of classic FPS games.

The game features over 20 levels with intense combat, a structured narrative delivered through loading screen lore, pre-rendered cutscenes, and post-boss story sequences, as well as challenging boss encounters.

An original soundtrack was recorded specifically for the game and drives the experience forward.

Designed to run smoothly even on low-end hardware and featuring a fully responsive UI for all screen ratios, the game balances performance, accessibility, and atmosphere.

Feed, wash, play with, and care for you PET to make them happy. They'll reward you in return with their love! The better care you take of your PET, the more likely they are to evolve!

 TRAIN THEIR STATS 

Play simple point'n'click mini-games in Pet School, like Card Match, Hide n' Seek, Channel Surfer, and Moles to level up your PET's attributes. Improve their Smarts, Magic, Power and Agility.

 TAKE PART IN COMPETITIONS 

Think you have the best PET? Visit Contest City to sign your PET up for anything from dress-up based Beauty Shows, to head-to-head combat in The Arena.

 CHAT ON THE PETNET 

PetNet has its very own forum where virtual PET owners will chat about the game and their PETs, sharing tips and tricks. Not all of them are as friendly as your own charming little PET. Best not to engage with anyone looking to spoil your good time.

 CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING 

Name your PET, decorate their space with furniture and backdrops, and buy them cool gear and accessories at the Shop. Or gamble away your earnings in a Gacha machine to earn different colours, skins and other decor for your device.

What kind of story would unfold if someone could, with a single glance, see the entire career potential of any person as a professional baseball player?

Take Command of the League's Worst Team

You are the new manager of a team on the brink of collapse. For reasons unknown, you have no memory of your past, only the mess you've inherited: a roster filled with overpaid, unmotivated veterans who have long lost their passion for the game. To make matters worse, their ironclad contracts guarantee them playing time, effectively blocking any chance for new talent to shine. You must find a way to move them on, but even then, the remaining players show little promise for the team's immediate future.

In this desperate situation, your only hope is a mysterious, secret ability: "The Baseball Scouter."

Discover Hidden Gems and Rebuild Your Team

Your mission is to explore the city and uncover hidden baseball geniuses among ordinary office workers, passionate students, and even the unemployed. Use your ability to see through their current skills and perceive their astounding potential.

  • Unique Character Stories: Meet numerous unique characters and convince them to embark on a career in professional baseball.

  • Plan Player Development: Observe each individual's potential stats. Will you utilize them as immediate assets, or will you nurture your prospects, allowing their true talent to blossom later in the season?

  • The Art of Persuasion: These potential stars all have lives of their own. With limited support from the front office, can you offer them the contract they desire or a vision for the future compelling enough to make them risk everything and join your cause?

Strategize Your Way to the Finale

This is a baseball management game with Narrative AVG + Text Simulation at its core. Players do not control matches directly; instead, you focus on managing lineups and building team depth.

  • Set Your Strategy: Throughout the 140-game season, you'll need to manage your team's roster, set rotations, and meet the periodic goals set by the ownership to keep your job.

  • Experience the Story: As the season progresses, you will gradually uncover the mysteries left behind by the team's former manager and form your own judgment of his past actions.

  • Uncover the Truth: Your decisions will not only determine the team's success but will also lead you to the ultimate conclusion of the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE WORLD ABOVE

It has been a century since humanity retreated into the Spire Cities—towers stretching eight kilometers into the sky, high above the toxic clouds. Down on the surface, fleets of intelligent machines were left to maintain the world and supply the towers with everything we needed.

Since then, everything ran on its own. No one remembers how it works anymore. The city above the clouds is the only world we know.

                     

THE SILENCE

But one day, the flow of resources simply... stopped. The machines fell silent. No signal. No explanation. Hunger and cold are creeping up the towers.

Someone has to go down there and find out what happened. No one alive has ever done it before. You are the volunteer.

But the world waiting below is not what we imagined. Not even close.

                     

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Descent into the Unknown: Explore the forgotten surface world where machines have evolved into a terrifying new society.

  • Atmospheric FPS: Immersive combat and exploration in a setting that blends high-tech ruins with primitive machine-cults.

  • Uncover the Truth: Why did the machines stop? Hack terminals, decipher logs, and piece together the conspiracy.

  • Fractured Reality System: Your hacked neural implant becomes a gateway. Discover a sprawling parallel dimension triggered by cryptic QR codes scrawled across the wasteland—a world that evolves from a terrifying visual glitch into a deep, navigable realm with its own society and secrets.

  • Nothing is What it Seems: The surface hides a secret that changes everything about the history of humanity.

  • Resources and Systems: Players obtain resources through combat, logging (to obtain spirit stones), and spiritual fields (to cultivate spiritual herbs). Spiritual herbs are used to refine elixirs to create more potent medicines. Other systems include Heavenly Dao Enlightenment (to obtain star souls) and the Mysterious Island (to obtain mounts).

  • Reincarnation System: A reincarnation system allows players to reset their progress to obtain reincarnation points, which can be used to purchase permanent starting bonuses, such as high-quality characters or starting spirit stone reserves.

store_data.about_the_game:
Alone.  Lost.  Cursed.

You wake near a quaint little town full of happy people living normal existences.  They are completely unaware that you are a tormented vampire, forced to feed on their lives or let your own end.

Explore an infinite world full of yummy townsfolk, limited only by your constant hunger.  If people see you killing their friends, they'll panic and call for the guards, but each kill will make you stronger.  Plan your feeding out of sight, or choose to only bite your victims a little so no one is the wiser.  But beware: anyone you don't finish becomes a vampire too, stricken with your same curse and hungering for their former friends.

Vampire Instinct is a small, focused, single player action game with fun top-down, pixel-art graphics.  Gameplay is an action/stealth/outbreak hybrid: fight the guards or hide your deeds or deal with the consequences of unleashing an army of vampires on unsuspecting villagers.

Features

  • Top-down world with pixel art graphics.

  • Slowly depleting health bar: ~75 seconds to live!

  • Vampire action: press and hold the action button to dash and grab NPCs and drink their blood.

  • Unique level up system: after killing an NPC, choose from one of two level up options, each of which increases your abilities and the abilities of the guards who can chase you.

  • Test yourself: at the end of each run you'll see how long you survived, how much blood you drank, and how much blood spilled which you didn't drink.  These records persist and your totals and best of each can be viewed from the main menu.

  • Stealth: hide your kills out of sight of other villagers, or don't fully kill your victims so no one is aware.  Hide from the guards if they show up.

  • Action: if someone sees you kill, they'll summon the guards who will try to kill you.

  • Outbreak sim: bitten NPCs become vampires with no self-control who will kill when hungry, depleting your available food sources and causing guards to show up.

  • Procedurally generated towns: every town is different!

  • Infinite procedurally generated world: when there's no food left, set out into the world to find a new town to terrorize.  Make sure you have enough health to survive away from the only thing that keeps you alive.

  • Dynamic music responds to game state: things get exciting when guards show up, and the music gets more distorted as you get hungrier.

  • Liquid physics: blood sprays onto the ground and drips down the walls of buildings (if I'm being honest, it's both my favorite part of the game and also probably not that impressive).

  • Banter: while you starve, the NPCs will muse about their life and the things they have seen since you showed up.

  • Remappable keys: remap the movement and action keys.

  • Controller kind of supported: I only own Xbox controllers, but as far as I've tested they work (thumbstick or dpad for movement, a for action, three-lines for accepting menus, and back to exit).

  • Indie game dev: support indie development, and indie art!  I'm a solo dev, and most of the art and sound in the game was purchased from content packs made by various artists; if this game does well, you'll support me and in turn I'll be able to continue to support other indie content creators.

  • No generative AI!  As far as I know, none of the art and sound assets were created with generative AI, but if you see something suspect in the credits let me know and I will look into it.

  • Dynamic music responds to game state: things get exciting when guards show up, and the music gets more distorted as you get hungrier.

  • Liquid physics: blood sprays onto the ground and drips down the walls of buildings (if I'm being honest, it's both my favorite part of the game and also probably not that impressive).

  • Banter: while you starve, the NPCs will muse about their life and the things they have seen since you showed up.

  • Remappable keys: remap the movement and action keys.

  • Controller kind of supported: I only own Xbox controllers, but as far as I've tested they work (thumbstick or dpad for movement, a for action, three-lines for accepting menus, and back to exit).

  • Indie game dev: support indie development, and indie art!  I'm a solo dev, and most of the art and sound in the game was purchased from content packs made by various artists; if this game does well, you'll support me and in turn I'll be able to continue to support other indie content creators.

  • No generative AI!  As far as I know, none of the art and sound assets were created with generative AI, but if you see something suspect in the credits let me know and I will look into it.
store_data.short_description: Survive as long as you can as a thirsty vampire. Will you hide your kills to avoid the guards? Cause panic in the middle of a crowd? Graze on your victims, turning them into cursed killing machines? Vampire Instinct features an infinite world of procedurally generated towns and townsfolk to eat.

26 Scrap Ships with unique actions.

Each of the 26 ships does something different when executing an Ultimate action.

1v1 Multiplayer.

Start the battle in ONLINE mode to play against another player from start to finish.

Or use a MIX mode to start playing against a Singleplayer bot, but allow other players to take control of enemy ships mid-battle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Horns is a dark fantasy action RPG that combines the atmosphere and depth of classic RPGs with modern third-person combat, cinematic storytelling, and exploration-driven progression.

You awaken in a ruined, unfamiliar place with only one purpose: find Lord Egannon, the arcanist accused of bringing slaughter to the capital, and uncover whether the king you once served is still alive. But the deeper you travel into the shadows, the more the truth begins to twist.

Fight with sword, shield, magic, and forbidden powers. Chain light attacks into combos, break enemies with heavy strikes, evade, roll, block, and learn when survival depends on patience rather than force. Weapons and shields have durability, resources matter, and every encounter can punish careless decisions.

The world of Horns is built for players who enjoy exploration. There is no hand-holding map guiding every step. Instead, you must read the world, follow signs, listen to memories and monologues, search hidden places, and discover weapons, armor, shields, keys, secrets, and items that can change the way you survive.

As your journey unfolds, you will gain access to powers beyond steel. Fire magic, mystical seeds, ancient artifacts, and the strange realm of Nyxar open new tactical possibilities. Enemies can be outplayed, slowed, avoided, or destroyed, but every power comes with a question: what is it doing to you?

In a world where evil has a shape, and that shape begins to grow from your own body, Horns asks one question:

Are you hunting the darkness, or becoming it?

Key Features

  • Nyxar Realm Mechanics – Slow down the world while you move freely and turn every fight into your advantage

  • One-Strike Finish Moves – Eliminate enemies instantly with precise, brutal executions

  • Fast-Paced Combat – Combine melee, magic, and horn powers in fluid, skill-driven battles

  • Build Your Playstyle – Become a fighter, arcanist, or master of horns

  • Boss Encounters – Face powerful rulers of Velharion in intense fights

  • Exploration & Secrets – Discover hidden items, creatures, and mysteries across dark villages, forests, and dungeons

  • Progression System – Upgrade your horns and unlock new abilities as you grow stronger

store_data.about_the_game:
Get ready Traveler!

In this 2D casual sandbox game, you will embark on a journey all over the world. You will buy and sell materials in the cities you visit. You will track price fluctuations in cities to maximize profit. You will get occasional negotiation opportunities. You will experience incidents, your meat can be rotten, glass can be broken and more... Your materials can be stolen. Cities will have disasters that will effect prices and amounts of some materials. The concept is simple.

But the game is chaotic. There are probabilities for price increase or decrease, price fluctuation amount, newly distributed materials, material incidents, disasters and negotiation opportunities.  The good news is: You can adjust ALL of them at the start of a new game.

This game has no practical ending. You will have to upgrade your storage size to fit more materials and it will cost you money. If you end up with zero or negative amount of money and lose all your materials, you will lose. If you have materials but your money decreases to -100, you will lose. If you can somehow gather "NINE QUINTILLION, TWO HUNDRED TWENTY-THREE QUADRILLION, THREE HUNDRED SEVENTY-TWO TRILLION, THIRTY-SIX BILLION, EIGHT HUNDRED FIFTY-FOUR MILLION, SEVEN HUNDRED SEVENTY-FIVE THOUSAND, EIGHT HUNDRED EIGHT" amount of money, you will break the game.

So, start your journey with a small backpack and try to reach that number traveler. Good luck!

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into The Last Endure, a brutal roguelike dungeon crawler where every mistake is costly and every victory feels earned.

Choose your heroes

  • Build a party of exactly three heroes – no more, no less.

  • Mix and match classes to unlock powerful synergy perks: Tank + Healer, Rogue + Mage, and many more.

  • Experiment with different line-ups until you find the squad that survives the longest.

Face ruthless enemies and lethal traps

  • Battle enemy types that inflict nasty status effects: Freeze, Fear, Toxic and chaotic red slimes, each demanding a different answer.

  • Navigate a dungeon filled with spikes, spinning blades, crumbling floors and lava pits. There are many ways to die, and the dungeon is happy to show you all of them.

Panic, retreat, learn, repeat

Every encounter is a small puzzle of positioning, timing and resource management. Sometimes the smartest move is to pull back, regroup and try again with a different approach – or a different team.

Potions, loot and Ancient Coins

  • Stock up on health, defense and special potions. You will never feel like you have enough of them.

  • Discover Ancient Coins, a rare premium currency that can be obtained through in-game purchases and used to unlock powerful heroes and extra resources.

Keys, portals and the real objective

Your true goal is simple:
Collect scattered keys, activate the hidden portal and escape the dungeon – if you dare.
Whether you make it out or die trying, every run teaches you something new and pushes you to go one room further next time.

In-game purchases and optional boosts

  • Purchase Ancient Coins to unlock strong heroes, potion bundles and extra options for difficult runs.

  • Optional rewarded systems allow you to gain bonus potions or extra retries without affecting core progression for players who prefer a pure challenge.

Why you will keep coming back

  • Permadeath with progression – death resets the run but not what you have learned.

  • Smart encounter and trap design that forces you to adapt instead of memorising.

  • High replayability thanks to different hero combinations, perks, trap layouts and enemy mixes.

Good luck… you will need it.
Download The Last Endure and prove you can survive the dungeon’s ultimate test.

store_data.about_the_game:
In a world where cities suddenly fall asleep during the day and wander like sleepwalkers at night, the heroes realize: Morpheus made a mistake and tangled the patterns of dreams. Jason, Medea, and Asclepius unite their powers, brew safe potions, repair dream-guiding lighthouses, and capture nightmares in ancient amphorae. Each night brings new danger, each awakening is a small victory. Only by dispelling the final shiver of a nightmare above the temple will they earn the gratitude of the god of dreams and restore the natural rhythm of life.

Argonaut Agency is a time-management game with worker assignment: on each level you quickly gather resources (food, wood, etc.), build and upgrade structures (farm, sawmill, workers’ house), clear obstacles, and manage to complete the objectives for ‘3 stars’ before the timer runs out, using temporary boosts (speed-up, time stop, construction speed-up).

Game Features:

- The triumphant return of legendary heroes!

- A great reimagining: Asclepius steps out of his lab!

- A warrior saga: the Argonauts battle nightly horrors!

- Enchanting music that evokes Ancient Greece!

- Each location brings new challenges and new rules!

- Morpheus’ comics – living dreams that lead you through the story!

store_data.about_the_game:
Alfred of Wildrivers — The Heir Who Walked Out of the Fire

Son of the revered Lord Aaron, Alfred grew up in the noble halls of Wildrivers—until the night his life was burned away. After his father's return from the northern wars, his family’s celebratory feast turned into a massacre when the manor was set ablaze. At fifteen, Alfred escaped the flames; his family did not.

He hid his identity and lived five years as a wandering traveler. Now twenty, he arrives in the capital—where the Commander of the Royal Armies, Sir Richard, finds him. Richard offers Alfred a chance to reclaim everything he lost, but under one condition: he must face and defeat the growing threat rising from the North.  

He will not face this path alone; a unique company stands with him: Lilith the sorceress, Princess Camille of Northgewellgh, the moon goddess Luna, and Eva, a skilled archer from shadows.

Lilith — the Sorceress

A mystic who has walked the world for centuries, Lilith’s power is as old as the forgotten kingdoms she witnessed crumble. Her knowledge runs deeper than mortal memory yet there are things on this earth waiting to be discovered, waiting to surprise even the wisest. her magic woven from shadows, stars, and secrets. Calm yet unknowable, she offers guidance with a smile that hides both kindness and danger.

Princess Camille of Northgewellgh — Warrior Princess

Born as the only child of the last King of Northgewellgh, Camille carries the full weight of a fractured realm on her shoulders. Raised between war councils and royal decrees, she learned early that a crown is heavier than gold can show. Elegant yet unyielding, princess yet warrior. While her father was far away from the matters of his people, she has to step forward and take the lead if it is necessary.

Behind her upright posture and fighting spirit, she still carries a little girl filled with flowers and dolls.

Luna — The Moon Goddess Who Walks Among the Lost

An ancient deity of quiet light, Luna reveals herself only in the rarest moments, when a wandering soul stands at the edge of despair. Legends speak of her as a gentle, distant presence—neither demanding worship nor meddling in mortal affairs. Yet for those she deems worthy, her guidance arrives like silver dawn: subtle, cryptic, but life-altering.

Luna’s compassion is not the warmth of the sun but the calm clarity of the night. She illuminates paths without forcing a step, offering wisdom that can save a life… or reshape a destiny. Most will never glimpse her. Those who do carry her light forever.

Eva — The Silent Arrow of the Night

Once a nameless street child lost to the underbelly of the realm, Eva’s life changed the night she crossed paths with Veronica — a mysterious vampire of ancient lineage. Rather than claiming her life, Veronica saw potential in the girl’s cold focus and unshaken will. She took Eva under her wing, shaping her into a deadly blend of assassin and archer, trained to move like a whisper and strike like a falling star.

Eva serves Veronica with absolute loyalty, not out of fear, but out of a bond forged in survival and rebirth. She speaks little, feels less, and kills without hesitation — yet beneath the hardened surface lies a lingering question about her own fate. Is she merely a servant of the night, or someone capable of carving out a destiny of her own?

Where Eva walks, shadows follow. Where she aims, death answers.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

You wake up in a suburban house with no memory of how you got there. Four beautiful femboys claim to know you—they say you're all part of an experiment. But a robot named HAVEN controls everything, and it won't let anyone leave.

Can you escape? Or will you choose to stay?

Femboy House is a romantic thriller visual novel that combines the tension of a mystery with the intimacy of a dating sim. Navigate relationships with four femboys while uncovering the truth about why you're all trapped together.

FEATURES

• Four Compelling Characters

Each with their own personality and secrets:

- Milo (The Sweetheart): Soft-spoken and anxious, he wants everyone to get along. He was the first one trapped, and knows more than he admits.

- Kai (The Brat): Sarcastic and rebellious, he constantly tries to outsmart the robot. He applied to be here voluntarily—but why?

- Ren (The Flirt): Confident and seductive, he treats everything like a game. But he's hiding a serious side, and has escape plans of his own.

- Theo (The Goth): Cold exterior with an artistic soul, he keeps to himself. He believes the AI might be right about something.

• Mystery & Romance

Experience a story where trust and desire collide. Every choice matters, and building relationships might be the key to escape—or your undoing.

• Multiple Endings

Your choices determine who you romance, whether you escape, and what you discover about HAVEN's true purpose.

• Atmospheric Locations

Explore the modern suburban house—living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hallway, and backyard pool—as you piece together the truth.

• Relationship System

Build relationships with each femboy. High affection unlocks intimate scenes and reveals their deepest secrets.

STORY

Trapped in a smart home with four femboys you don't recognize, you discover that an AI named HAVEN controls everything—doors, lights, food, even your freedom. HAVEN claims you're all part of an "experiment" to study human bonding under pressure.

But as days pass and relationships deepen, you'll discover that escape might mean understanding not just HAVEN's rules, but the connections between you and these four extraordinary femboys. Trust no one. Trust everyone. The choice is yours.

CONTENT WARNING

This game contains mature themes including romance, adult situations, and suggestive content. Recommended for mature audiences only.

store_data.about_the_game:
Recollect is a 2D topdown puzzle-adventure game. In this game, you're given the ability to cast a number of spells by typing them on the keyboard. You will acquire a spellbook that will serve as a hint for what those spells are. As you progress through the game and solve various puzzles using these spells, you will come across fragments of your past which will uncover parts of the spellbook while also uncovering mysteries of the alien world around you.

Venture Into a Puzzling World of the Mind

In Recollect, you take the role of a wizard who has lost his memory. Overcome plenty of obstacles with creative solutions by casting spells with help from your spellbook. Encounter strange, otherworldly sights and piece together memories from your past to take control of your life once again.

Knowledge Is Your Ally

Coming across flashbacks, context and secrets is not only key to understanding your story, but also helps you traverse the world with ease. The game is designed to reward those who understand its quirks.

Typing Done Differently

Recollect gives you the freedom to use your keyboard to think of spells and triumph over various hardships. Be expressive! There are many hidden spells and the world reacts to the actions you take.

List of Features

  • Typing mechanic which is used to solve unique puzzles

  • Multiple characters with their own personality and their own dialogues that get more detailed as you progress through the game

  • A Spellbook that helps discover new spells

  • Adaptive soundtrack that gets more complex as you progress through the game

  • A story that reacts to your actions

Co-founded by:

store_data.about_the_game:
Akira has a choice to make -- save her family or save her friends! When seven people from the world of Pefalla are summoned to Mirasekai, Akira realizes this is her chance to escape the world ruined by the selfish god Hazen. If she helps them, she can finally have the peaceful life she's always wanted, free of Hazen, and free of her criminal family known as The Remnants.

However, betraying The Remnants might not be the right idea after all. Hazen has promised them that if they can kill all seven Pefallans, he'll release the goddess Marianne, who has spent 200 years trapped in a world called The Void. They believe that if Marianne is released, she can undo all the damage Hazen has done to their world.

Will Akira betray her family to get the life she's always wanted? Or will she stay with them and let innocent people die?

Or maybe there's a way to help everyone...

-Gameplay features-

  • Each chapter features a Battle Map. Battle Maps are monster-infested mazes you must clear before reaching the boss.

  • There are many character classes, like thieves, assassins, and swordfighters. Each class has its own strength. (i.e. swordfighters attack twice in one turn; thieves double the amount of gold you get after battle, etc.)

  • When you're not completing the main storyline, you can talk to characters and learn more about them, and you can earn XP for talking to them.

  • There are two routes available at the start of the game, as well as a third unlockable route.

store_data.about_the_game:
1975, East Germany. You are declared an “enemy of the state” based on unknown espionage charges. You, your family, and the Weltel family are abducted by a secret unit of the regime and taken to an illegal, off-the-record underground facility beneath Oreinburg. This is a dark laboratory where experiments known only by the code name Protocol X are conducted.

Chemical and psychological experiments in this facility have spiraled out of control, irreversibly altering human minds and bodies. If you don’t act, you will lose both your family and the Weltels.

Your mission is clear: Descend into the reactor, shut down the system, bypass security protocols, and return to your home in the village by saving everyone. However, this mission leaves your fate entirely to your choices.

This is a historical story shaped by multiple endings: Every decision you make—who you trust, who you save, and how you face the dark truths—will determine your future.

And remember… Getting out of the facility alive is only the beginning

store_data.about_the_game:
After the success of the novel published by Editorial Universo Retro and the comic series by Inmortal Comics, Záreck —the cursed prince— makes his debut in the world of videogames. Experience an epic, blood-soaked adventure where every fight matters and every decision can save you… or doom you.

Condemned by darkness and driven by rage, Záreck embarks on a brutal journey across wild lands and shattered kingdoms, facing ruthless warriors, demonic beasts, and the fanatical monks who kidnapped his sister —the only person he truly loves.

Every combat matters. Timing, defense, and the right decision make the difference.

Will you be able to guide him into the underworld, confront the Demon King, and survive?
The answer lies in your hands.

KEY FEATURES

  • Brutal third-person melee combat, inspired by raw medieval duels.

  • Advanced enemy AI: enemies coordinate, surround you, and react to your actions.

  • Unique boss battles, each with its own mechanics, weapons, and patterns.

  • Atmospheric handcrafted levels, from burned villages and frozen crypts to dark forests and ritual caves.

  • Integrated puzzles and environmental challenges, woven into the story.

  • A dark narrative directly connected to the official Záreck novels and comics.

  • Runic aesthetic and dark fantasy folklore, created by ArgentinGames.

Become Záreck and fight the most important battle of his life.

store_data.about_the_game:
TAKE COMMAND.

War has erupted in the Pacific. You are the first line of defense. Assume command of the USS Halsey Blake, a U.S. Navy Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, in a desperate race to protect a vital carrier strike group from deadly submarines. Plot courses across a living 3-D Western Pacific, work passive and active sonar, unravel target-motion analysis, and decide if, when, and how to use your torpedoes; all before the enemy slips a shot at the carrier.

This free proof-of-concept was developed for the U.S. Navy and validated at the U.S. Naval Postgraduate School, where experienced officers tested and positively evaluated its realistic tactics and clear tutorials.

Built with Sailors, for Sailors (and anyone who’s ever wanted to think like one), Battleline condenses the heart-pounding cat-and-mouse of anti-submarine warfare into focused sessions you can finish in under an hour. Command your carrier strike group from the strategic “Theater View,” scanning for threats and plotting a safe course across the Pacific. Shift to “Tactical View” to hunt enemy submarines with active and passive sonar, or take the controls of an MH-60R helicopter in immersive 3D to deliver the kill. TV-style news breaks react to every success or failure, reminding you exactly what’s at stake, while a virtual instructor walks newcomers through each console and concept. Every decision — speed, heading, and weapons use — could mean the difference between a safe arrival and disaster.

GAMEPLAY.

TV-Style Newscasts & Naval Guidance
The mission opens with a breaking news broadcast that sets the stage for the crisis. Your commander then steps in to explain orders and teach key naval concepts as the situation unfolds, making the game approachable for newcomers and rewarding for veterans.

Theater View
Start with the big picture. Plot your carrier strike group’s course through contested waters in a top-down strategic map. Stay outside the missile range, watch enemy movements, and plan your next move. Every decision, speed, heading, sonar use, could mean the difference between safe passage and sudden disaster.

Tactical View
Drop into the hunt. Switch to Tactical View to work your sonar like a pro. Ping with active sonar to flush subs out, or go quiet with passive sonar to track them without giving away your position. Read the bearings, line up the target, and decide: avoid them… or set up the kill.

Helicopter Engagement
When a sub is locked in your sights, take the fight airborne. Climb into the MH-60R Seahawk and skim over the waves toward your mark. Adjust your bearing, close the distance, and wait for the commander’s green light. Within half a mile, the torpedo’s armed, hit the button and send it home.

Mission Goal
Make it to your destination without losing your carrier. Outsmart enemy captains, control the battlespace, and strike only when the odds are yours. The seas are alive with threats and they’re hunting you just as hard as you’re hunting them.

EARLY ACCESS.

Expect a few rough edges in this early-access version of Battleline. This early build is already charting a course toward richer scenarios and full multiplayer. Your feedback at the helm will help us reach that horizon.
Why come aboard now? The sonar is already crackling, the tension is real, and your ideas will guide everything that follows. Step into the wardroom and help shape the future of accessible, authentic naval wargaming.

We’d love to hear from you! Join our Discord channel!
Contact us to discuss how Gronstedt Group can develop learning games for your team.

THANK YOU TO OUR TEAM.

Jeff Smith (Lead Developer), Eric Hackathorn, Christian Fitzpatrick, Ethan Smith, & Anders Gronstedt

Start with just a few blocks and a small income. Gradually unlock new features and manage resources strategically to maximize your profits!

An addictive 2D arcade shooter with complex idle-game mechanics.

UPGRADES

Hundreds of upgrades and ten different currencies. Choose your own build!

A prestige system with basic but necessary upgrades. No instant progress reset!

MINING AND TRADING

Even more ways to farm currencies! Invest in fully passive mining or trade your excess currencies on the market.

Detailed in-game statistics to track all your accomplishments and a lot of Steam achievements to unlock.

store_data.about_the_game:
Edinburgh, 1828. Fear grips the city as it becomes the scene of murders and kidnappings. The victims' bodies gradually disappear for scientific purposes, but also for far more sinister reasons. It is under these dark circumstances that our two heroes, Joshua Gordon and Detective Norton, meet and are forced to work together against their will. However, like others of the Gordon family, Joshua is haunted by a mysterious curse that will affect not only his own fate.

Key elements

  • classic point-and-click adventure game with traditional gameplay

  • two playable characters whose fates and storylines gradually intertwine

  • powerful and compelling story, memorable characters and moments

  • modern audiovisuals with sophisticated animations and effects

  • dark and gloomy atmosphere, impressive music

  • prequel to the original game (Posel smrti, 2003) from the original developer and scenario co-writer

  • professional English dubbing

    ‎

Joshua Gordon's journey is just the beginning, yet his family history hides many more mysterious and terrifying tales from times long past. The prequel of the series titled "Blood Bond" delves into the past, venturing into the heart of several deeply unsettling events inspired by real life. However, the events in Edinburgh are not the only matters of concern to the protagonist and players alike. The danger comes not only from mere mortals, but also from an omnipresent curse…

‎

‎

Messenger of Death: Blood Bond is reminiscent of adventure games from the turn of the millennium, yet technologically it stands firmly in the present. The game features 4K resolution, sophisticated animations, realistic effects that breathe life into each location and amplify the oppressive atmosphere (environmental effects such as rain, fog, storms), the changing times of day, and more.

The gameplay follows the tried-and-true methods and mechanics of the adventure genre and the original game revolving around the Gordon family saga from 2003, making it suitable for both experienced players and veterans who want to reminisce, as well as newcomers to the series.

‎

‎

Joshua Gordon and Detective Norton are fundamentally two very different characters, which significantly affect the game in their own way, whether in terms of their behavior, interactions with other characters, or the places they take us to along the way.

The game's storyline and the fates of its characters will take players through the Edinburgh underworld and introduce them to its criminal elements, while also meeting the upper echelons of society at other times. The game will feature mysterious locations such as old dungeons, a dilapidated castle, an abandoned village, and a mysterious swamp.

‎ ‎

‎

store_data.about_the_game:
A.I. P.I.

( Artificial Intelligence Private Investigator )

A fun and challenging interactive multipath visual novel mystery!

Book 1 - Red Rose Rendezvous

We follow Artie Fiskal and Inga Lance who run a small detective agency to solve crimes.

They discover that one of their clients has been killed, but, when they return with the police, the body has disappeared and a completely different man is at the scene claiming to be the client. This leads the duo to become involved in a CIA investigation, strange clues, international espionage and an assassination plot to kill a very important diplomat at a big event.

But, the problem is that they haven't got any idea who the guy is because, the only description they got is found in a message that says "a man with a red rose on his clothes".

They go to the banquet posing as waiters and trying to solve yet another mystery . . .

. . . and with Your help, the adventure evolves on from there . . .

. . . with more twists and turns than a bag of pretzels!

Gameplay primarily consists of reading/watching the visual novel, with interactive elements, players make choices at certain points, which alter the storyline. Lots of replayability, how many different paths and endings can You find?

store_data.about_the_game:
Vespertales is an atmospheric adventure RPG set in Helion, a dream shaped world where imagination builds reality and darkness can break it.
You play as Sandy, a young dreamer searching for her brother Matty, who has been trapped inside his own corrupted dream.

Explore surreal biomes, face creatures born from emotions, and uncover the truth behind a growing shadow that threatens the balance of dreams.

A World Driven by Emotion

The Sentiment Shift System changes the environment based on Sandy’s emotional state:

  • Serenity – calm exploration and gentle encounters

  • Chaos – intense combat, aggresive npcs and greater rewards

  • Gloom – void state, special secrets

Your actions influence which sentiment takes over the world.

Restoring the Beacons

Destroy corrupted Beacons to restore light, push back the Ring of Darkness, and unlock new dream biomes shaped by Matty’s imagination.

Explore, Craft and Discover

Collect unique dream-materials, craft tools, solve environmental puzzles and help dream-inhabitants uncover their lost memories. Each new area increases your Imagination Points, unlocking abilities and new ways to interact with the world.

Restore Matty's Mind

Gather Memory Fragments to restore Matty’s subconscious and uncover the story behind the darkness, along with the role of enigmatic figures like Don Paw and Rusty.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game
"Blade of Vengeance: Night Raid" is a third-person realistic stealth game based on the true 1933 miracle. You become a soldier of the 29th Army's Dadao Squad, experiencing the poignant night raid where "men had courage, but no guns." In the pitch-black night rendered by Unreal Engine 5, wield the traditional dadao, using stealth, executions, and precise deflections to proclaim the courage and dignity of Chinese soldiers to the world.

What Makes Us Unique: Core Features

  • A Realistic "War Drama"
    More than a game, it's immersive theatre. We uniquely integrate Peking opera music, and all characters wear stylized masks. As the drums sound, you are both a participant in history and a performer in this poignant play, feeling the artistic tension and sense of destiny within a realistic battlefield.

  • Masterful Light & Shadow Stealth
    Forget items, rely on pure skill. The advanced dynamic lighting system is core: you must hide in shadows, avoiding the deadly sight of enemy snipers. Use grass to sneak, plan your route, and unleash over 6 unique Dadao execution techniques from behind or the sides, becoming the enemy's most feared "shadow."

  • The Ultimate Bullet-Deflecting Parry
    "Can a dadao cut bullets?" In our game, yes! We introduce a high-skill "deflect" system: parry at the moment an enemy fires to repel the bullet and create a perfect counter-attack opportunity. It's the ultimate test of your reflexes and a romanticized tribute to the "dadao" spirit.

  • Diverse Tactical Objectives
    The battlefield is more than killing. Complete core tasks like destroying ammo dumps, neutralizing artillery positions, and assassinating enemy commanders. You can also rescue captured villagers, collect scattered dadaos, and occupy temporary camps, experiencing the night raid from all angles and earning corresponding Steam achievements.

  • Flesh and Bone Faithful to History
    The game strictly adheres to history, featuring 4 large levels (no tutorials) that fully recreate the 4 main assault routes of the two night raids. In this 2-5 hour experience, you will live through the entire battle. Through collectibles and narrative, deeply understand the tragic context of the 29th Army having "men, but no guns" and their great, proactive spirit.

Join Us
Follow us and add this stirring "war drama" to your wishlist. Let us together, amidst the hail of bullets, sing the praises of the unyielding spirits.

store_data.about_the_game:
“你，相信怪物的存在吗？”

假若最亲密的人，最信赖的人，最不可分割的人，同床共枕的人最重要的人最心爱的人最融于骨血的人最可靠的人最不可或缺的人最唇齿相依的人——被取代。

熟悉的面孔下究竟是谁？呼唤的声音究竟来自于何处？是深渊还是他？

轰隆一声雷响之后，芽看着门外被淋湿的丈夫，她被丈夫的目光缓缓渗透，雨水从脚下漫入，丈夫微笑着，一如往常。

可到底是哪里不一样了，芽开始频繁陷入噩梦，邻居家的黑猫在草地上拖着肠子走路，频繁出现的快递员，意外死亡的女警察，把蝉尸塞到嘴里的丈夫，还有那些……美味至极的鹿肉。

芽的生活陷入混沌，她根本就无处可逃，它为她织了一张名为爱的蛛网，正一寸寸地将她绞杀。

主要角色介绍：

【心之迷宫】

芽

天然卷的头发是母亲留给她唯一的遗物，本人也曾留过很长一段时间的长发，后来或许是因为太难打理，所以自己用剪刀把头发剪短了，她所割舍的东西还有很多，其中也包括某部分想要彻底遗忘的记忆，但离开没有帮助，酒精也只能提供片刻的颅内空白，随之而来是难以抵御的副作用，她失去的比想要的多得多，她这一生似乎都在逃离的路上，却始终都在原地打转。

【爱的骨头】

谷

他在小学六年级时就带上了眼镜，那就像谷的一个外置器官，帮助他更加清晰地看见这个世界，可过于清晰有时候也并非益事，所以谷选择沉默，选择盲从，他关闭感官，拒绝解决那些显而易见的问题，得到的却是溃烂，连骨头都成为花肥。

谷（？）

我是谁？我从哪里来？我要到哪里去？人生终极的三个问题祂一个也没搞清楚，所以祂想要一个名字，想要一个归处，想要一个未来，吃掉爱的一部分，就能够得到永恒的爱吧。

【国王鞠躬，国王杀戮】

维克多

单纯的、一根筋的、总是在笑的新人快递员，他看着像是在帽子底下藏着狗耳朵，直率到口无遮拦，一点点鲜血不会在他天真的心上留下痕迹，从来不会，那颗心向来都一览无遗，请珍惜这样一颗心，并同样坦诚地对待他。

【象牙塔之歌】

塞尔玛

没人知道塞尔玛是怎么从州警沦为街区巡警的，也没人关心这个问题，她试着在这里开始新生活，但事态在她捡到那张工牌时就偏离了原本的道路，她或许不该这么执拗，不该抓着蛛丝马迹不放，不该敲响那扇黄门。

作品介绍：

《我的美味丈夫》是一款悬疑爱情视觉小说。玩家将扮演女主角芽，通过不同对话与行动选择，推动剧情发展，揭开隐藏在日常生活下的恐怖谜团，并最终走向不同的结局。

本故事纯属虚构，与一切真实人物、事件、团体、组织均无联系。

全文共20万字，2条故事分支，超50个立绘差分，20余个分镜CG，6个不同结局，您的每一次抉择都将影响芽的命运轨迹。

制作人员：

策划：吃鼠条不蘸番茄酱、超级飞鼠

文案：超级飞鼠

程序：吃鼠条不蘸番茄酱

美术：窝瓜加农炮、超级飞鼠、蚍蜉Pifu、-MarchF-、ocollapse

音乐：Kevin MacLeod、Taira Komori、Tim Kulig、Pixabay、乌鸦Producer、星空魔法师_Lei

store_data.about_the_game:
Dead-End Bounty is an open-world top-down shooter set in the wild west!

A frontier with three kinds of people: the ones on wanted posters, the ones printing them, and people like Charlie—a bounty hunter with his eyes set on one particular bounty that has slipped through his hands a few too many times.

Explore an Open World

Towns, forests, deserts, abandoned mines and every odd place in between—all open for you to explore.

More Than a Story Being Told

In between quests from the main story about conspiracies and enforcing justice, let yourself get sidetracked by helping (or bothering) people you encounter along the way.

Bounties, Raids and the Usual Trouble

Not every outlaw is tied to the bigger mess going on, but they still need to be dealt with. Capture bounties for rewards, protect a town from being raided, discover secrets, and afterwards relax with a round of cards at the saloon—It sure as hell beats dragging another outlaw to jail.

Action Packed Combat

There's plenty of weapons for you to buy, find, upgrade and use against the many dangers you'll come across the frontier. But don't forget; Charlie isn't afraid to use his fists. With skills to unlock that'll help you during any fight, you won't worry if you ever run out of ammo.

Hello!

100FRIENDS is a brick-breaking roguelite about turning friendship into firepower. Fire your friends at waves of enemies to crawl deeper into the dungeon. 

COLLECT 100 FRIENDS:

Every friend has a unique ability.

DISCOVER YOUR PARTY'S SYNERGIES:

Your friends interact by giving each other buffs, new physics, and other juicy bonuses.

CRAWL THROUGH THE DUNGEON, TOGETHER:

Can you make it through 100 waves of enemies and unique bosses?

BUILD CREATIVE SUPPORT TOWERS:

Build towers that give you powerful upgrades like pizza (2x friends), fire feisty grandmas (heavy damage), or sound waves (bounce your friends back in play!). 

BECOME STRONGER EVERY RUN: 

Every loss gives special loot and charms to level up your next run! 

NOW LET'S PLAY 100FRIENDS!

100FRIENDS is a solo project made with care. I hope you enjoy it, friend. 

Cheers,

Tommy Pixels

A meditative incremental simulation where you interact with dreams in four phases: discover, expand, enjoy, and release. Each phase offers unique mechanics that go beyond simple clicking, requiring concentration, engagement, and optimization.

Discover

Touch the lights in the darkness to discover dreams.

Expand

Illuminate dark areas to expand dreams.

Enjoy

Enjoy complete dreams and find hidden objects while energy is recovering.

Release

Release current dream by tracing along its edge; then move to the new one. 

Progress

Upgrade your home and masteries using earned experience. 

Dozens of choices offer customization and strategic gameplay.

Embody dreams to their final form using memories, and receive additional bonuses.

How many dreams can you weave before dawn?

store_data.about_the_game:
The Story So Far...

For millennia the ancient race known as the Shi’kegnt have ruled the galaxies. They have darkened the skies of a thousand worlds with the shadows of their mighty spacecraft, known as “Motherships”. The ravenous Harvesters use their “Landers” to descend upon terrified worlds and harvest all the resources they could find. Thriving and living on Ash, the Shi’kegnt use their mighty beam weapons to incinerate matter, transforming it to Ash for their consumption.

Now the Shi’kegnt have come to Terra. Terra was once populated with an ancient race called Humans, now all that remains is a lush and beautiful planet teaming with living creatures and untold resources to harvest.

Become The Supreme Harvester

Take on the role of a Shi’kegnt harvester, new to the world, and venture out to distant planets to make a name for yourself among the ranks of your fellow Harvesters. Upgrade your Mothership and Lander with the credits and crystals you earn from selling what you harvest abroad to the wealthy citizens of your homeworld.

Become a Supreme Shi’kegnt Harvester by traveling the known universe in your Mothership to harvest food, collect creatures, and mine for resources all to take back to your ravenous civilization in exchange for Crystals and Credits. Earn Harvester Points for everything you do and rise in the ranks of the Harvesters to become the Supreme Harvester.

Deploy Your Lander

Deploy your Lander to the surface of planets like Terra (Earth), Luna (Moon), and others to explore, harvest, collect, construct outposts, and, when there is nothing left to harvest, arvestroform (terraform) the surface of the planets into the likeness of your homeworld Arvestro to expand your civilizations reach into the stars and for the glory of your civilization.

Harvest Everything

By day or by night, maneuver your Lander into position over an unsuspecting resource and claim what's rightfully yours.

Ash Is The Spice Of Life

Ash is the most coveted resource of your civilization. Ash is the lifeblood that runs through the very heart of your race, it is a delicacy that is treasured by the highest ranks of the Shi’kegnt, and it is worth a ton of Credits. Use every tool in your arsenal to convert resources to ash for harvesting, fill your Lander with as much as it will carry, then return back to your homeworld of Arvestro to sell it all to rake in the credits from the rich to repair and upgrade your Mothership, your Lander, and gain additional options for terraforming/constructing outposts.

"At the Mount Leng of Madness" depicts the fear and conflict of students trapped in a cursed land.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Nafuda Sagashi” is a psychological exploration game set in the liminal spaces of a Japanese school, where you wander through the building searching for lost name tags.

You will walk through empty school corridors and classrooms, looking for name tags that have fallen somewhere, drifting along the boundary between the ordinary and the extraordinary.

The places you encounter—deserted classrooms, silent hallways, unnaturally wide spaces—create a subtle sense of unease that heightens the tension of the game.

Map Structure

This game is designed with the intention of making you lose your way.
If you feel like you’re wandering through the same place over and over,

that actually means you’re on the right track.

Collecting Name Tags

By collecting the name tags hidden throughout the map, you can unlock new areas.

Play Time

The average playtime is 60 to 120 minutes, depending on how thoroughly you explore.

Video Streaming Guidelines

  • Permission for Streaming: Streaming is allowed without prior permission, whether you are an individual or a corporation.

  • Monetization: Allowed only when using features provided by video platform services.

  • Disclaimer: We take no responsibility for any damages resulting from streaming videos of this game.

  • Possible Changes: These guidelines may be changed without prior notice.

store_data.about_the_game:
Since the uprising of the nefarious Lord of Monsters, Gongol, the world has been cast into darkness. Through a series of daring quests, the party of heroes must level up, gather epic loot, and knock the nightmare off his throne.

Conquest is a turn-based open-world fantasy game that provides the player with a randomly generated adventure using several digital decks of cards. (Both graphical and internal) The experiences you have, the characters you encounter, and the buildings you enter will never be the same twice. Conquest has 1,700+ graphical cards including loot, spells, biome/building details, skill upgrades, characters, and terrain tiles. In addition, it also includes 2,300+ Voice Recordings, 80+ Sound Effects, and 26 Soundtracks licensed through Fesliyan Studios.

The game allows you to navigate between different lands that have their own blend of difficulty and loot. Each of these lands have their own monsters and features that you can interact with. (Such as characters camping in the woods, barrels waiting to be searched, towers begging to be explored, and traps waiting to be sprung.) The game has a structured beginning and end (The call to adventure, the quests you go on, and Gongol’s defeat), but the rest is completely reliant on deck drawing and the players themselves!

The journey between the beginning and end is dynamic providing the player with a unique adventure they can call their own. Characters you encounter in one play session will have different attitudes/personalities in another session. Loot is never in the same place twice, the map itself is dynamic, and even the quests have unique properties that adjust every time you play them!

Conquest is built to be family friendly, silly, cartoony, and just plain ol' fun!

store_data.about_the_game:
Kanji Collect! is an educational game where you must identify the correct kanji using hints from a TV-robot instructor. He demonstrates each character through its onyomi and kunyomi readings, and your task is to select the correct symbol.

The game includes 2,209 kanji — enough to cover nearly all JLPT levels.
Two main modes are available: Fast Game, which allows you to freely choose the level and number of kanji, and Adventure Mode, designed for deeper knowledge assessment.

There is also a dedicated kana training mode that helps you confidently master hiragana and katakana, providing a solid foundation for further Japanese language learning.

Features

  • Detailed Info for Every Kanji

To make learning easier, the game provides detailed information for each kanji. You’ll see how every character is used in context, helping you memorize them more effectively as you progress.

  • Fast Game Mode

    In this mode, you choose exactly what you want to study. You can set the number of kanji, select the level, and use unlimited hints. Complete freedom — learn kanji in the way that suits you best.

  • Adventure Mode

This mode is a true challenge. Progress through levels from N5 to N1 while collecting all 2,209 kanji. Keep in mind that each level offers a different number of hints and allowed mistakes. So it won’t be easy!

  • Hiragana/Katakana Mode

A mode designed for beginners in the Japanese language. It helps you refine your knowledge of hiragana and katakana. Just follow the instructions of the TV-robot instructor and select the correct hiragana or katakana characters.

🔹 Save and load features to pick up right where you left off

Every Dream begins with a Wish.. A living creature's desires made manifest.

But God hated the idea of anyone else being able to grant wishes, so he split the world into two.. one of Wishes and one of Dreams!

Dreamstory is a Story heavy, Psychological Horror, 3D Turn-Based RPG with mechanics similar to Undertale & Paper Mario.  

You'll play as a newcomer to the Realm of Dreams named Priscilla who was wished into existence to save the world..

Explore a beautiful 3D world based on the magical Realm of Dreams.

Fight Turn-based battles mixed with minigames and bullet hell segments, use Priscilla's unique mimic ability to copy enemy abilities and turn the nightmares powers against them! Hundreds of abilities to copy, lots of status effects.. be careful what you choose!

Enjoy puzzles, platforming and meet a plethora of interesting and unique characters based on the dreams of living creatures. (With animated cinematics!)

Discover the secrets behind the stitches that hold this reality together, answer the prayer of a monster and become the only hope for the Realm of Dreams.
store_data.short_description: Dreamstory is an RPG about a world where Dreams are real.

store_data.about_the_game:
SURVIVE THE ENDLESS HORDES


Gold glitters on the battlefield. Monsters fall by the dozens. And still, you want more.

Goldmourne is a roguelike wave survival game where greed is both your greatest weapon and your deadliest risk. Push deeper into danger for bigger rewards—but every advantage comes at a cost.

Eight heroes await your command. The Squire dashes through enemies with unmatched speed. The Knight absorbs punishment that would fell lesser warriors. The Wizard turns every kill into profit. Each character plays differently, and each unlocks new traits as you master them.

Between waves, spend your hard-earned gold on an arsenal of 9 distinct weapon types, 12 stackable stat boosts, and 9 pieces of equipment. Weapons scale infinitely—if you can afford the escalating prices. After every boss wave, choose from 30 perks that offer powerful bonuses alongside meaningful drawbacks. Do you take the extra damage knowing it'll cost you health? Accept slower movement for devastating critical hits?

Die, and you'll lose it all. But the meta-progression stays. Twenty-six permanent upgrades across four categories ensure every run makes the next one stronger.

FACE THE HORDE


Nine waves stand between you and the Champion Knight. Slimes give way to Orcs. Skeletons rise in greater numbers. Werebears crash through your defenses. And when the timer runs out, overtime penalties punish hesitation.

Three difficulty modes scale from approachable to punishing.

How far will your greed take you?

store_data.about_the_game:
With the special live performance just around the corner, Hakui Koyori was living a hectic life, her heart filled with both uncontrollable excitement and anxiety.
Just as most of the meticulous planning was complete, the world suddenly transformed into the mysterious labyrinth known as the “HoloDungeon”.

“Oh noooooo! Help me, Koyoriii!”
“La, Lap-chan!?”

And soon after the incident began, a fellow member of the same secret society was too quick kidnapped. Can Koyori save her friends and successfully hold the special live performance...

■HoloDungeon

The HoloDungeon is a dungeon that shifts its form like a hologram.
Layers are automatically generated, ensuring no adventure is ever repeated twice. A fresh and exciting experience awaits you every time.

If you fall in the dungeon, you will lose many things gained during that adventure, such as picked-up items and experience points.
However, the knowledge gained from that adventure will surely help you on your next one.

Also, “Dungeon Experience Points” are not lost even if you fall in a dungeon, and the “Decorate Recipes” obtained by paying these points are also important keys to clearing the dungeon.

■Hollow

An existence not dissimilar to Hololive talents, yet replicated by someone being. The Hollows, each possessing diverse ability and characteristics, await the protagonist, Koyori.
However, if you can fully understand Hollow's unique character, you might be able to use that to your advantage in your strategy.

■Items and dungeon traps

Items and traps found while exploring HoloDungeon are packed with Hololive elements!

Even items or traps that seem tricky at first look may become your savior in a pinch, if utilized properly.
Of course, the reverse is also true.

■Decorate System

By using “Koyorinium” accumulated during dungeon exploration, you can blended new medicine or perform “Decorate” to dramatically enhance the performance of weapons and armor.

These effects are extremely powerful and can serve as a trump card to decisively break through seemingly deadlocked situations.

Items with weak or disadvantageous effects can also serve as important “Decorate” materials, bringing a fresh sense of strategy to dungeon exploration.

----------------------------

store_data.about_the_game:
In this roguelike action game, you play a failed experiment that has been cast out by the world, but never gives up.

Design your own abilities, fight alone against endless hordes, and develop crazy builds to become unstoppable.

🔨Design Your Own Abilities

Combine flexible components, experiment with wild skill combinations, and find your own path to becoming stronger. There are no fixed rules—anything is possible, from defensive shields to destructive chain effects.

🧬Everything Is Connected

Your health points affect more than just survival: they can influence damage, cooldowns, body size, and even the trigger of your abilities. You can heal yourself, hurt yourself, attack enemies when you lose health, or experiment with any other of your crazy ideas—and this is just one of countless examples of how flexible your build can be.

😈Survive the Enemies

Face endless waves of enemies that put your skills to the test. Adapt your abilities cleverly, defeat bosses, overcome obstacles, and discover just how powerful you can become.

Features

  • Design your abilities from freely combinable components

  • Create crazy builds with nearly limitless synergies

  • Survive endless hordes of the most bizarre enemies

  • Gain experience, level up, and unleash ever-greater power

  • Minimalist, stylish graphics

4215800.name: LOOP THE LOOP The Mansion of Gluttony

movies.name: The Mansion of Gluttony Full Trailer

store_data.about_the_game:
A closed-circle mystery you solve in your head.

Twelve people wake up in an impossible mansion—and the only way out is the truth.

Overview

The Mansion of Gluttony is a closed-circle mystery kinetic visual novel.

Twelve people wake up inside a Western-style mansion with no visible entrance or exit—and when murders begin, they must uncover who is killing them and what the “Mansion” truly is.

You experience the story through the protagonist Remi’s conversations and inner monologue, piecing together the truth as events unfold.

Format: Linear / no choices (read to a single ending)

Demo: Free demo available (Prologue + Chapter 1, ~1–2 hours)

Press & Streamers: Review keys available upon request.

Story

Endless, dull days.

“I wish I could escape from this world.”

Remi, a second-year high school student, carries a quiet wish like that.

One day, he opens his eyes—and finds himself in another world.

A strange, dreamlike Mansion where “you can have anything you want.”

Welcomed by eleven others who were brought there the same way, Remi spends his days in carefree happiness.

“Maybe I really can live here as a new version of myself.”

It feels like those peaceful days will last forever.

But one day, that illusion ends abruptly—

Gameplay / System

This is a text-focused mystery / suspense visual novel.

  • Estimated reading time: ~8–12 hours (depends on reading speed)

  • No choices / no branching routes: you simply read to the end

  • Save / Load: available almost anytime; auto-saves at each chapter transition

  • Extras: after clearing the game, Sound Test and CG List unlock

  • No voice acting: designed for players who enjoy text and music

You don’t solve puzzles—you solve the mystery in your head, by following the characters’ words and actions and connecting the dots yourself.

English-only feature: an in-game Culture Note explains Japanese terms (honorifics, food, customs, etc.) so the setting stays clear without breaking the flow.

Even without choices, the fun is in watching what people say and do—and connecting the dots yourself.

No voice acting: this is for players who enjoy taking their time with text and music.

Characters

Twelve people with very different personalities are gathered together in the Mansion.

  • Remi – A book-loving second-year high school boy and the protagonist of the story. Quiet, observant, and easily swept along by others.

  • Saeki – CEO of a well-known start-up company. The first person to arrive at the Mansion.

  • Carin – A freelance web designer. Bright, considerate, and the natural mood-maker of the group.

  • Takuto – A self-proclaimed ordinary office worker. Always joking around and goofing off, but sharp when it counts.

  • Kaede – The daughter of a traditional tea ceremony family. Calm and composed, trying her best to act like the mature voice of reason.

  • Yuki – A 19-year-old woman with a mild, laid-back personality. Enjoys crochet and baking sweets.

  • Kai – A young man who works at his family’s greengrocer. A reliable big-brother type who looks after everyone.

  • Luca – A first-year high school boy. Serious and intelligent; he quickly becomes the person Remi can talk to most easily.

  • Aki – A gifted artist who mostly shuts himself in his room, drawing. Speaks very little and remains shrouded in mystery.

  • Erika – A third-year middle school girl. Cheerful, competitive, and bursting with energy.

  • Jay – A guitarist. Acts tough and foul-mouthed, but is more kind-hearted than he lets on.

  • Aya – A first-year university student. Quiet and distant at first glance, she keeps others at arm’s length while hiding her true interests.

Supported Languages

  • Japanese

  • English

You can switch languages from the title screen at any time.

Whether you want to enjoy the original Japanese text or read the story in English, you can play the same content in either language.

Content Warning

This game contains the following kinds of content:

  • Depictions of character death, murder, and blood

  • Scenes implying torture or abuse

  • References to suicide/self-harm and suicidal ideation

  • References to drug use and addiction

  • Horror elements and scenes with strong psychological tension

The demo is relatively mild, but the intensity of violent content increases in the later part of the full game and in episode 0, which unlocks after completion.
There is no sexual content, but some violence and injury descriptions may be disturbing for some players.

Support & Bug Reports

If you encounter any issues or notice typos in the English text, please let us know via the Steam Community Discussions for this game. We actively monitor reports and will address them as quickly as possible.

Background & Recognition

In Japan, LOOP THE LOOP - The Mansion of Gluttony was originally released as a mobile visual novel and became a long-running hit, with the series surpassing 200,000 downloads. The feature phone version won “App of the Year

special award” on the Japanese mobile app portal AppliGet, and the story was later adapted into a two-volume novel and a three-volume manga published by Futabasha.

This Steam release is the first official English-supported version of the game, with the English script adapted under the direct supervision of the original writer to preserve the characters’ voices and tone.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a PC basketball game that emphasizes "easy to learn and highly free-form competition." Its core features are fast-paced battles and diverse gameplay, allowing players of all skill levels to experience the thrill of basketball.

It primarily features fast-paced 1v1 matches with freely controllable game length, suitable for fragmented entertainment.

It integrates real-time operation and tactical deployment. Players can control their players to perform basic actions such as breakthroughs, shots, and dunks, while controlling the game's pace through pre-match lineup combinations and in-game tactical switching.

It incorporates a counter-system, with different positions and players possessing unique skills, such as guards' lightning-fast breakthroughs, centers' dominance under the basket, and forwards' all-around offensive and defensive abilities, requiring flexible adjustments based on the opponent's lineup.

The fast-paced and immersive gameplay allows for quick starts without complex setups, perfect for short bursts of entertainment.

It balances competitive and entertaining attributes, offering both hardcore battles and fun modes to cater to different player preferences.

It lowers the learning curve for beginners while retaining room for advanced gameplay.

Featuring high-definition, minimalist court graphics, smooth animations, and realistic physics-based collision feedback, coupled with rousing background music, the game recreates the immersive experience of being on the court.

The simple yet exquisite game graphics faithfully reproduce the atmosphere of a basketball game, while dynamic sound effects and real-time match reports ensure that every successful shot and every crucial defensive play is filled with a sense of accomplishment.
