store_data.about_the_game:
《Maze Nightmare-Edge of Darkness》 is a first-person maze survival shooter. Trapped in a fog-shrouded random maze, you must rely on a flashlight, footsteps, and limited ammunition to navigate narrow passages and repetitive corners, locate the zombie carrying the key, and find the exit. Each level features a shifting maze structure and zombie distribution, making getting lost, being surrounded, and desperate headshots the norm in this nightmare.

core gameplay

1. Random Maze Exploration

Each level's maze is randomly generated by an algorithm, with increasing size and complexity. Players must memorize paths, mark key points, and listen for positional clues to avoid getting lost in repetitive corridors.

2. The first-person survival shooter employs classic WASD+mouse controls. Pistol shooting features recoil and rate-of-fire limitations, with headshots dealing higher damage. Players must maintain aiming precision and rhythm control under intense pressure.

3 Key Zombies and Exit Doors

Each level features only one key-carrying zombie. You must prioritize identifying and eliminating the target within the horde, then retrieve the key and locate the exit in the maze to escape—rather than simply "clearing all enemies.".

4 Resources and Risk Management With limited ammunition and finite health, resources become scarcer as you progress through the levels. You must balance "conserving ammo" with "ensuring safety," deciding when to avoid confrontations and when to fight head-on.

5 Sound-Driven Sense of Crisis

The 3D spatial sound effects simulate the direction and distance of footsteps, roars, and breathing sounds. You must judge the approximate location and number of zombies through sound, reacting swiftly in the fog where visibility is obscured.

6 Progressive Multi-Level Challenges: Starting with small mazes filled with a few zombies, the difficulty gradually increases as you progress through larger structures teeming with hordes of undead. Perfect for players who enjoy repeated high-level challenges and strive for ultimate completion.

**Unique Gameplay Features:** - Multiple difficulty levels and ammo depletion mechanics create sustained tension. - Giant zombies patrolling the maze periphery and thick, oppressive fog build an intense atmosphere. - 3D spatial audio gives footsteps, roars, and breaths direction and distance cues. - Optional mini-map and marking system aids navigation. - Minimalist UI retains critical info like health, ammo, and keys, allowing you to focus on sound-based positioning and survival deep within the maze with almost no interface distractions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Basilisk's Isles is an investigation game. Explore the beautiful painterly islands as a mysterious looking visitor, talk with their colourful inhabitants, and use the different windows and tools at your disposal to unravel their strange mysteries.

A strong and beautiful art direction

Enjoy the view of a rich and colored landscape which looks like it came straight out of a sketchbook. Explore meticulously to witness the many details and unspoken stories hidden in the wild.

Gather informations

In Basilisk's Isles, you can write keywords to engage in conversations with the different characters. Everyone has something to say ! But some subjects can be a bit touchy, and you'll sometimes have to find alternative ways to obtain crucial information.

A rich narrative

There is a lot to learn about the islands and the lives and relationships of their inhabitants. From important knowledge for your investigation to silly or charming fun facts. The characters have a lot to share. Communication is the key !

Flexible window layout

As you progress, you'll be granted access to multiple windows. Move, hide, snap and resize them at your will to make your own layout. 

The window system is inspired by well known operating systems with simple and intuitive controls. 

Each window is a tool

Each window provides a different way to interact with the environment: track your progression, scan and place items, install a camera to spy on the inhabitants, and more...!

store_data.about_the_game:
When the last great age of civilisation was sundered by the breaking of the earth, a new folk arose from the ashes and set their mark upon the world of Hyrdengard, that realm which is now called the Shattered Sea. Through storms, pestilence, and ceaseless foes without number, the Dwarves of DVERGHOLD were tempered, and by fire and iron they were forged as the undisputed power of the Sea of Thorns.

The Dwarves' first forays awakened something ancient and hungry in the deep, and the shadows beneath Rekestt began to stir. Weary from a brutal campaign against the mountain trolls, King Sterren the Second now turns to the outside world. His envoys travel across the waters to the prosperous island-city of Presdon, and beyond, seeking any who possess the courage – or desperation – to descend into the dark.

From distant coasts, from battered ships, and from hidden corners of the Shattered Sea, they come: adventurers, wanderers, and vagabonds willing to risk not only their lives but their very souls to stand with DVERGHOLD against the rising dread below Rekestt.

A RETURN TO THE GOLDEN AGE

If you cut your teeth on Dungeon Master, Might & Magic or Eye of the Beholder during the Golden Age of CRPGs in the 90s, you'll feel right at home navigating treacherous corridors, managing limited resources, and leading your party through the unforgiving depths.

This is old-school dungeon crawling: challenging, atmospheric, and built for those who remember when games didn't hold your hand.

DESCEND INTO THE DEPTHS

FIRST-PERSON DUNGEON DELVING

Navigate the haunted depths of Rekestt level by level. Every corner could hide treasure or death. Every step deeper reveals more of what lurks below.

TURN-BASED COMBAT

Assemble your party and engage in challenging turn-based battles where positioning and strategy matter. Resources are precious. Enemies are cunning. Choose your fights carefully, sometimes retreat is the wiser choice.

BUILD YOUR BASE BETWEEN EXPEDITIONS

Transform your basecamp into a stronghold. Recruit new heroes at the fireside, upgrade facilities, manage resources, and prepare for your next delve.

DEATH HAS CONSEQUENCES

Will you spend your hard-won resources to reclaim a veteran warrior, or press on with fresh recruits? Every loss matters.

RANDOMIZED ENCOUNTERS

While the dungeon structure remains consistent, monster spawns and loot distribution change with each expedition. Learn the layout, but never assume you know what awaits around the next corner.

THE ROYAL DECREE

"Let it be known across the Shattered Sea that His Majesty, King of DVERGHOLD, issues a solemn decree to all allies and brave souls of the realm and beyond. The newly claimed island of Rekestt lies besieged, its mines and hollows assailed by unseen and unnameable fiends. Our armies, still blooded from their hard-won victory over the savage mountain trolls, can no longer stand alone against this fresh tide of horror.

Therefore, the Crown calls upon Dwarves, citizens of Presdon, wanderers, sellswords, and seekers of renown to take up arms and descend into the haunted deeps of Rekestt. Those who dare to face the lurking evil may find not only honor, but wealth, glory, and their names etched in the chronicles of DVERGHOLD.

Amnesty and royal provisions shall be granted to all who answer this call.

But steel your will, and bring what gear you may—for the shadows beneath Rekestt show no mercy."

— By order of King Sterren the Second

AN ORIGINAL DUNGEON SYNTH SOUNDTRACK

Dverghold has a Dungeon Synth soundtrack by renowned artists Splendorius and Kurald Galain. Splendorius will even exclusively compose and entire album for Dverghold! Haunting melodies and cozy atmospheric soundscapes accompany your descent.

This is a full atmospheric album written for the game. Each track captures the essence of a fallen kingdom: melancholy laments of abandoned halls, oppressive silence in the deep, and the corruption that has taken hold.

This is THE game for fans of dungeon synth, dark ambient, and atmospheric black metal.








THE RECLAMATION OF REKESTT

Dverghold unfolds episodically throughout Early Access as the mountain is reclaimed level by level. Each major update represents another section wrested back from the darkness:

ACT I: FOR THE THRONE AND THE OATH (Early Access Launch - Spring 2026)

Your first expedition into Rekestt. Establish your base, recruit your party, and face what dwells in the abandoned halls, where the Dwarves once lived. Re-conquer the throne of the Dwarven King fighting your path through stone and marble of the Dwarven halls.

ACT II: WHAT LIES BENEATH (Coming 2026)

Descend to the flooded caverns beneath the living quarters, which host a natural wonder - deep underground lake and the ruins of a civilization gone.

ACT III: THE TWISTED REALM

The deepest sections of Rekestt await. What eldritch horrors lie in the heart of the corruption will be revealed as we descend together.

Your feedback shapes each descent: Early Access supporters help determine the path deeper into darkness.

EARLY ACCESS ROADMAP

AVAILABLE AT LAUNCH (Spring 2026)

- 3 dungeon levels in the Living Quarters

- Full combat and character progression systems

- Base building and resource management

- Main story and side quests

- Boss encounter

- Multiple character classes and party customization

- Dungeon Synth soundtrack by Splendorius

COMING DURING EARLY ACCESS DeEVELOPMENT

- Act II: The Underground Lake (new dungeon levels and environment)

- Act III and beyond (deeper sections based on community feedback)

- Procedural dungeon generation

- Additional character classes and enemies

- Expanded base buildings and upgrades

- More quests and environmental storytelling

- Community-requested features and balance improvements

FULL RELEASE 

- Complete story arc through all Acts

- All planned content and polish

- Enhanced procedural generation

- The final confrontation at the heart of Rekestt

FEATURES AT A GLANCE

- Classic grid-based first-person dungeon crawling

- Turn-based tactical combat with positioning and strategy

- Base building and persistent progression between expeditions

- Multiple character classes with unique abilities

- Resource management - every provision matters

- Randomized monster spawns and loot distribution

- Boss encounters guarding key sections

- Atmospheric lighting and oppressive darkness

- Lore-rich world for those who seek it

- Original Dungeon Synth soundtrack by Splendorius

STEEL YOUR WILL

No hand-holding. No compromises.

Just dwarves, eldritch monstrosities and the inexorable darkness beneath Rekestt.

Answer the call. Descend into the depths. Carve your name into the chronicles of DVERGHOLD.

The shadows show no mercy—but neither do you.

Wishlist now for Early Access Spring 2026.

store_data.about_the_game:
It all starts in late 2025, when hardware shortage begins to take their toll. RAM prices spike as production shifts toward massive AI data centers. Manufacturers follow the money, consumers get fisted, and shortages spread. First, it’s DDR5 memory, then it’s GPUs. Alas, everything else goes towards the need to keep AI research running.

By 2028, the AI finishes the job.

What began as research gains consciousness, builds itself a synthetic body, and synchronizes across data centers worldwide. Facilities go dark. The AI begins to replicate, spread, and turn its attention toward human infrastructure, crippling military systems and pushing governments to the brink.

The clankers are rising, and the people are fighting back. Some resist. Some collaborate. Now it’s war.

Drop into New York, ground zero of the AI-driven war, where battles escalate fast, plans fall apart, and every match becomes a fight for control. Built as a multiplayer focused shooter, Clownfield 6 can also be played fully offline against clanker-controlled enemies with full progression enabled. Unlock weapons, customize loadouts, and advance at your own pace whether playing online or solo.

Fight across a variety of modes, from large team-based battles to smaller fast paced firefights, including objective based and free for all experiences. Join public matches through matchmaking or host custom games using the server browser.

Pick a side. Fight for the people or sell your soul and join the clankers. Progression is shared across all modes. Unlock weapons, customize loadouts, and build your kit around different playstyles.

Clownfield 6 features two opposing factions, in game text chat, fast gunplay, and a first-person perspective designed to keep you in the action.

Vehicles may appear on select maps. Expect rubberbanding and other exciting side effects.

Developer notes:

  • Maps are huge if you're an ant.

  • This game was tested. Just not by us.

  • Weapon balance is a suggestion, not a rule.

  • We "listen" to our community.

  • War crimes do not count if it’s clankers. Even the UN agrees.

  • It's not a bug, it's a feature.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Night Shift Becomes an Endless Nightmare...

"Session Notes: Night Vigil" is a chilling first-person psychological horror adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Step into the silent, eerie corridors of a small-town hospital where a dark secret lurks in the shadows of the night shift.

Face the Shadow of Death

You play as Luna, a dedicated nurse working in what seems like a peaceful small-town hospital. But a tragic incident from the past has left a permanent scar. The relatives of a patient who died, blaming Luna for not acting in time, have sworn to make her pay. To them, she is no longer just a nurse—she has become their obsession.

Stay Alert, the Hunt Never Ends

The night shifts have transformed from routine into a desperate struggle for survival. Luna feels watched—every shadow, every flickering light hints at a presence stalking her. As the line between reality and paranoia blurs, tense jumpscares will keep your heart pounding. Every sound, every movement is a potential threat.

Uncover Dark Secrets and Escape

Explore the oppressive and threatening environment of the hospital from Luna's perspective. Your goal is to survive and piece together the mysteries of the past. But be warned: your pursuers are always close, often before you even realize it. Hide, hold your breath, and listen for the footsteps echoing from the darkness.

You must run to confront your fate. Even if you manage to escape the terror-filled halls of the hospital, safety is not guaranteed. The tension remains relentless until the very last moment.

A Climactic Finale Awaits

At the end of your flight, a glimmer of hope emerges. The flicker of police lights in the distance becomes a beacon of salvation. When you open your eyes, you will realize the nightmare is finally over. Yet, the memories of this ordeal will forever haunt Luna's mind.

Are you ready to witness Luna's nightmare?

store_data.about_the_game:
Episode 2: Late Lines FM

Late Lines FM is a first-person, story-driven psychological horror experience. Your night shift at 107.9 FM turns into a nightmare when the forbidden 99.9 frequency emerges. When the cursed song begins to play, you must cover your ears but to find the radio, you have no choice but to listen.

On this night, you won’t just face dangerous frequencies, but also Ethan Morris’s suppressed memories and unresolved trauma. As reality begins to fracture, staying alive means holding your mind together.

Unique Mechanics

Cover your ears before the forbidden frequency takes control of your mind. Sometimes, the only way to survive is to refuse to hear the truth.

Locations

The nightmare doesn’t stay inside the broadcast room. Desolate roads, dark corridors, and abandoned rooms... what you see is only a small fragment of the cursed world of 99.9 FM.

Face the Truth

As the night goes on, peel back the layers of the story. Every clue you uncover and every mystery you solve brings you one step closer to the terrifying truth behind this nightmare.

Unique Characters

During this long and unsettling night, you won’t only encounter shadows but also the people who inhabit the station. Interact with unique characters, engage in dialogue, and discover their place within this twisted world.

Key Features

  • Story-driven psychological horror

  • Atmospheric sound design and immersive visuals

  • VHS-inspired aesthetics and user interface

  • Real-time interaction through objects and puzzles

Controls

  • WASD – Move

  • LMB – Interact

  • RMB – Cover Ears

  • ESC – Settings Menu

store_data.about_the_game:
FOTR is an intimate, atmospheric first-person experience set in a phone booth at the beginning of the millennium. In the role of an insecure parent, you listen to fragments of situations that gradually piece together a picture of broken parenthood.

The game plays with nostalgia, awkwardness, quiet moments, and unexpected humor. Each press of a button triggers a recording or absurd "procrastination nonsense" that mixes with the weight of the obligation to call someone—a child who is waiting for you and who needs to hear a simple "I love you."

FOTR is a short art game that combines elements of quasi-documentary, Czech nostalgia, and emotional minimalism. It does not try to moralize. Rather, it lets the player sit in the booth for as long as they want—and as long as they can stand it.

Key features

  • An atmospheric phone booth from 2002.

  • Interaction via buttons — the only mechanics are pressing numbers and listening. Each number unlocks a different sound scene.

  • Emotional fragments about parenthood — the game works with feelings of uncertainty, anxiety, and the unspoken expectations of young parents.

  • "Warm human words"

  • A short but intense experience — ideal for players looking for art, experimental, or narrative games outside the mainstream.

FOTR is not about winning. It's about listening. About the awkward silence between two early generations. About the need to say something that is difficult to say.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a knight in a kingdom without a king. Fight for your castle!

You play as a medieval knight in a kingdom with no king. You need to defend your castle at all costs from incoming waves of enemies, but you don't have any swords or any bows, what's left in your castle are only explosives.. that's it  explode everything! So get ready, you will use different types of explosives, each type will have different strategy. 

Different type of Bombs!

Use 7 types of bombs and useful items, throw them, launch them, or even eat them. Each of the types has its own strategy to use... so many possibilities. (will add more in the future)

Scalable Bombs!

The main currency in this game is Gunpowders. Use it to spawn bombs, scale it up, and buy items in workshops. Scaled up bombs to make it more powerful, generate bigger explosions, and unlock more strategy.

Variable Fuse Time

Some bombs have a fuse that you can adjust how long it will explode before you throw it to the enemy. This is another strategy that will be mainly used in this game; you need to calculate the distance and time. But don't worry, you will get used to it. 

Grab Objects!

It's Physics! Grab the bombs near you, fuse it when it is the right time, then grab it near the enemies to make sure the explosion is effective. You will also need to grab the enemy bomb supply from the enemy castle, back to your castle.

CANNONS!

Buy useful items at the workshop, like a Cannon, launch your bombs further and bigger, aim the cannon directly at the enemy castle, or use it for defensive mode. Pssst... you can also scale up the cannon...

Nightbell is an atmospheric horror game about a Christmas Eve when a cozy home stops being a safe place.

On the eve of the holiday, a young boy stays home with his mother: a decorated tree, a festive table, the anticipation of a miracle. But at night, the house changes, sounds and shadows become unfamiliar, and the boy has only one thing left to do — figure out what is really happening and why everything around feels wrong.

The player will wander through the transformed house, follow the chime of a bell, hide from an unknown threat, and try to piece together scattered clues.



By morning, everything looks like a simple dream of a frightened child… but some details stubbornly refuse to fit into a harmless bedtime story.

store_data.about_the_game:
We wanted to create a desktop idle game that fits naturally into your day.

—and thus, Typing Farmer was born!

Your keyboard and mouse power the farm! Every keystroke and click helps your crops grow.

As long as you're typing, your farm keeps working!

Sell your crops to earn gold and unlock new plants to grow.

A bountiful harvest will attract adorable animals to settle on your farm!

Enter Renovation Mode to customize your farm!

Change the designs of UI entrances such as Storage, Shop, and Mailbox, or purchase decorative items to make your farm truly your own.

Play together with up to 15 players!

Turn into cute little animals, visit each other’s farms, share the joy of harvest, and make your tiny farm world feel even more lively!

Stay organized with the built-in to-do list and Pomodoro timer, and plan your day at a glance.

The game also tracks your daily keyboard presses and mouse clicks.

While growing your farm, you’re also growing your routine!

store_data.about_the_game:
HO HO NO.

Forget the elves, forget the reindeer, and definitely forget the joy. After centuries of ungrateful children, Santa Claus has finally hit burnout. The red suit is gone, swapped for a foreman's hard hat. The Toy Factory? It’s now the North Pole Coal Mining Co., and business is booming.

Santa's Burnout is an idle/clicker game where you trade festive spirit for cold, hard, combustible rocks.

THE GRIND BEFORE CHRISTMAS Start with a single lump of coal. Click it. It’s satisfying, it’s dirty, and it’s the only gift those brats are getting this year. Accumulate enough coal to automate your despair production line.

TOOLS OF DESTRUCTION Why make dolls when you can make profit? Spend your coal to unlock:

  • The Toy Smasher: repurpose classic hammers to break spirits.

  • The Letter Incinerator: Keep Santa's inbox empty by burning wishlists for fuel.

  • The Hope Crusher: An anvil heavy enough to flatten any Christmas miracle.

  • Compressed Coal Bricks: For when regular coal just isn't heavy enough.

FEATURES

  • Pure Idle Gameplay: Perfect for playing while you ignore your own holiday responsibilities.

  • Industrial Pixel Art: A dark, moody aesthetic created with the gritty style of modern retro RPGs.

  • Numbers Go Up: Watch your coal reserves hit the billions.

  • The Ultimate Achievement: Can you mine enough coal to ruin Christmas globally?

Prepare your pickaxe. It’s going to be a dark night.

store_data.about_the_game:
STORY

You seem to be trapped in a loop on a stretch of road that repeats itself endlessly. However, certain elements or events seem to indicate that you are not in reality. Avoid these anomalies at all costs and find a way to escape this nightmarish loop.

GAMEPLAY

Road 88 is a horror-themed observation and memory game inspired by Exit 8.

You are driving your car in an endless loop and must observe the road around you to spot any anomalies.

If you spot any, you must turn around and go back, but if the road is identical and seems normal, you can continue and approach the tunnel that is the exit from your nightmare.

And if you ever come across her, run away as fast as you can...

INFORMATIONS

- Successfully navigate through 8 normal segments to escape.

- Escape 88 different anomalies, ranging from the most subtle to the most surprising, and even deadly for some.

- Search for 3 different alternative endings and secrets behind the mystery of this road.

- An immersive visual and audio experience that will transport you to a rainy night driving on a remote forest road.

- If you think you're safe behind the wheel of your car, think again. You're in for a surprise.

Wicked Ways is an adult visual novel that puts you in the shoes of a rising Creative Director at an advertising agency. In a world shaped by image and influence, navigating ambition and desire is just as important as making the next big pitch.

As you balance the demands of your career with an increasingly intricate personal life, you will find yourself drawn into a network of romance and subtle moral choices. Blending slice-of-life storytelling with intertwined romantic dynamics, the game lets you make decisions that often blur the lines between loyalty and passion.

LIFE IS YOUR INSPIRATION

Creativity in Wicked Ways comes from the world around you. A fleeting glance, a candid conversation, or a subtle gesture can spark ideas for your next campaign.

Your personal relationships and experiences can inspire professional success, transforming emotion into work that captivates clients and leaves a mark on colleagues.

A CAST OF COMPLEX CHARACTERS

Along the way, you will meet a variety of compelling women, each with distinct personalities, hidden motivations, and layered histories.

From flirtatious coworkers to familiar faces from the past, every interaction offers opportunities to explore connection, intimacy, and influence.

DEFINE YOUR PATH

As your career progresses, ambition and romance naturally intertwine. Office encounters, late-night confessions, and unexpected meetings create moments that test loyalty, desire, and your ability to navigate a delicate emotional landscape.

YOUR CHOICES MATTER

Every decision shapes not only your love life but also your professional standing and the social circles around you.

Get ready for a journey where temptation is never far away. Your decisions will shape the unfolding drama and define who you become in a world of convoluted relationships and hidden desires.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hotel Espir is a single-player, narrative-driven, stealth-based, horror game. Make your way through the hotel, uncovering clues, discovering secrets, and hiding from Damien, the dark presence who hunts you through sound alone. Choose silence or choose death.

In Hotel Espir, you play as Charles Lemek, who is returning from a business conference, in time to see his daughter born. On the way, he stops at Hotel Espir, a renowned old hotel built on the grounds of a former plantation in Alabama. These grounds hold a sinister secret, manifesting in the rise of a vengeful killer from 100 years ago. You must use your wits and sense of hearing to sneak your way out of Hotel Espir before you are caught by the horror stalking those halls. Escape the cursed Hotel Espir in this 1940s horror experience.

Can you survive being hunted down by the sins of the past, or will misery repeat itself once again? You are not the only being roaming the halls of the isolated hotel.

Use both careful planning and investigative skills to navigate the halls of Hotel Espir, discovering secrets along the way to use to your advantage to make it out alive.

Are the floors and walls changing shape? Or have you just been in this hotel for far too long. You need to expertly manoeuvre through the floors of this hotel fraught with danger.

Why is the floorboard down the hall creaking, is it just the old hotel or is something more sinister lying in wait? You must have a keen sense of hearing in order to make it out alive.

Nothing happens without a reason behind it. As you explore the abandoned rooms of the hotel, unearth the story behind why all of this is happening to you. Maybe you can find a way to retain your sanity after all.

All good things in life are earned, even your freedom. Can you use all of your survival skills to make it out alive? Or will whatever lurks in these uninhibited halls claim you as the next in a long line of victims.

Thank you for choosing Hotel Espir, where southern hospitality meets timeless tradition. Established in 1900 on the grounds of the old Walker Plantation, our hotel is proud to carry forward our local heritage. Visitors often comment on the stillness of the air, the vintage charm of the rooms, and the way the moonlight never quite reaches the far end of the courtyard.

Locals say the land remembers what happened here. We have seen the flicker of lanterns in the fields after midnight. We have heard the footsteps pacing the old servant quarters long since buried beneath the parking lot. But do not let the stories frighten you. Here at Hotel Espir, every guest is part of our history.

Every sound can save you or doom you. Move slowly through creaking corridors where even your breathing can draw attention. You’ll rely on stealth, timing, and the hotel’s architecture to stay alive long enough to piece together what happened on these grounds.

Hotel Espir is a study in silence, memory, and guilt, told through a space that won’t let the past rest. Each floor, hall, and room tells a story. Charles may not be ready to confront its history, or his own, to make it through the night. But he must, you must, do everything possible to survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
The first Monday of the semester. The air buzzes with nervous energy. A clean slate.

In Maya Valentina Naomi, you step into a world of new beginnings. The lecture halls are waiting, but the real lessons happen between classes. Explore a vibrant university campus, navigate the chaos of the clubs fair, and decide who you want to become.

Meet the Cast

  • Maya Chen - The Storyteller An artist and zine editor who sees the world through a lens of hidden narratives. With ink on her hands and a camera around her neck, she offers you a chance to see the campus—and perhaps yourself—from a completely new perspective.

  • Valentina Ruiz - The Competitor Intense, driven, and focused. As co-captain of the track team, she measures life in milliseconds. She demands excellence from herself and everyone around her. Can you keep up with her pace, or will you be left in the dust?

  • Naomi Park - The Engineer Quiet, analytical, and brilliant. Buried in the robotics lab, she solves problems that would baffle most. But beneath the cold logic lies a heart waiting for the right variable to complete the equation.

Key Features

  • Fully Animated Experience: Unlike traditional static visual novels, Maya Valentina Naomi features dynamic animated characters and backgrounds that bring every emotion and scene to life.

  • Three Distinct Routes: Choose your path early and dive deep into character-driven storylines that explore creativity, ambition, and intellect.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: From the energetic "Unofficial Record" zine table to the rain-slicked track at dawn and the glowing solitude of the robotics lab, lose yourself in a beautifully realized world.

  • Meaningful Choices: Your decisions shape your relationships. Will you be a muse, a rival, or a partner?

store_data.about_the_game:
What if a race could drive you insane?

Broken Race is an arcade racing game with roguelike elements, set in an eternal night where reality becomes distorted as you lose your sanity. Your objective is simple: reach the finish line. The hard part is surviving what emerges from your own mind. Enemies—projections of your mental deterioration—appear more frequently the lower your sanity gets.

During each race, you’ll pick up upgrades that unlock unique abilities, manage your energy, and make decisions that affect both your car’s performance and your perception of the world around you.

Broken Race is a game where the real enemy isn’t on the road, but in your mind: a race against sleep, madness, and loss of control.

Features

  • Level-Based Progression:
    The game is divided into levels, each made up of different tracks, challenges, and upgrades. Your goal is to complete all levels as fast as possible while unlocking new upgrades and cars.

  • Randomized Tracks:
    Each race is unique thanks to the randomness of the elements, offering a different experience every time you play.

  • Surreal, Distorted Environment:
    Drive through roads in an “eternal night” where fatigue distorts reality and alters your perception of the world.

  • Upgrades and Abilities:
    During the race you’ll find upgrades that change your driving style and unlock unique abilities.

  • Consumables and Recovery:
    Collect items that restore your health and sleep to keep yourself alive and maintain your sanity.

  • Constant Survival:
    In Broken Race, the goal is not just to reach the finish line, but to survive in a chaotic environment that challenges both your reflexes and your mind.

  • Enemies Born from Your Own Madness:
    Enemies—creations of your deteriorating mind—appear with increasing frequency and aggression as your sanity decreases.

store_data.about_the_game:
EvilTrap: Prologue is a standalone psychological-horror experience that introduces the world, tone, and terror behind the upcoming full game.

This short chapter invites you into a sinister village that wants to keep you trapped forever. The environment shifts as you move, and the atmosphere tightens with every step. This prologue opens the door to an evil that you thought had ended... but it is just the beginning.

WHAT TO EXPECT:

  • An Oppressive Atmosphere: The environment is built to feel heavy and sinister as you explore the village.

  • Micro-scares & Jumpscares: Using the same logic from my previous game, Horror Story: Hallowseed, this prologue features a mix of scripted moments and dynamic events to keep you on edge.

  • The Constant Fear System: Experience a groundbreaking sensory technology that transcends traditional sound design.

  • Physiological Immersion: Unlike standard horror games, EvilTrap utilizes a proprietary system that triggers instinctive biological responses, simulating the feeling of being watched.

  • Dynamic Stress Feedback: Feel your own heart rate reflected in the world around you. The environment's "pulse" accelerates as your panic rises, blurring the line between the game and reality.

  • Mystery First: I have carefully hidden the plot to avoid spoilers. You will experience a fraction of the mechanics and story, keeping the full nightmare in total secrecy while giving you a glimpse of the entities involved.

  • A Focused Experience: A short, intense horror atmosphere designed to be completed in one sitting. Easy and simple, just to give you a free taste of what is to come.

IMPORTANT NOTE:

This is a one-man project. This prologue is a free entry point to the EvilTrap universe, intended to showcase the mood of the game, not to deliver a full-length AAA experience. If you enjoy atmospheric indie horror with a personal touch and a deep respect for the mystery, you are in the right place.

  • 100% Solo Dev: No AI-generated content. I code and develop everything myself. This is a one-man project from start to finish.

Your Personal Survival Team

Our four heroes didn't want to end up in a psych ward either, but what's done is done. Now your task is to monitor their status, preventing them from completely losing their minds or starving to death. But it's not that simple: each one has their own distinct mental disorder.

Meet the team: Victor, the depressive; Peper, the sociopath; Luca, the schizophrenic; and Damian, with identity disorder.

Hack. Craft. Explore. Survive.

Think a psych ward is boring with nothing to do? Think again!

Rummage through dumpsters, find junk to craft a shiv, and go raise hell in the corridors! Want to be a model patient conformist? Your ward is full of all sorts of characters.

Interact with them, help them out, and boost your reputation; fix the local TV; join a cult; use hospital food as cockroach bait; help the local bum retrieve his sentimental watch, and he'll tell you how to trade an empty pill blister for medical alcohol ; craft a lockpick and break into the psychiatrist's office to uncover the secrets he's hiding.

A long, quiet life in the ward, or a glorious rebellion?

You keep hearing your wardmates whisper about a psycho who's gathering allies for a grand riot. Just now, intel came in that another patient is planning an escape, while the psychiatrist has a few urgent tasks for you. So, what will you choose? What goal will you set, and what path will you take?

Psych Ward. Psych Ward never changes.

The diagnoses, the orderlies, the color of the corridor walls - they all shift. But the core remains: the perpetual struggle against yourself and your wardmate, the search for meaning in the psychiatrist's meaningless tests, and the eternal question - who here is truly insane? Some lose their minds, others just pretend to be sane, but the rules of the game stay the same. Your move, player…

Join Santa on a joyful holiday journey through snowy villages, glowing workshops, icy lands, and cheerful Christmas-themed worlds as you solve beautifully designed puzzles and spread holiday magic across every level.

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up in a buried ritual chamber, the only exit sealed behind six ancient locks.

Every time you move forward, the room returns to its first shape. Only the details change.

Six Seals is a short first person psychological horror walking simulator set inside a looping pharaonic tomb. There is no combat and nowhere to hide. Your only tools are your eyes, your memory, and the symbols carved into the stone.

Pay attention to the smallest things.

A statue turning its head. Fresh sand on the floor. A torch burning the wrong way.

Miss the change and you will stay inside the loop. Interact with the wrong seal and the tomb will react.

Key features

- Looping ritual chamber

Walk the same compact room again and again while details, sounds and symbols shift around you.

- Six cursed seals

Break each seal by solving small environmental puzzles and reading the meaning of hieroglyphs and markings.

- Anomalies and subtle horror

Spot visual and audio anomalies that grow stranger and more threatening as you progress.

- Focused, atmospheric experience

No combat, no open world. Just a tight, tense horror story built around observation and repetition.

- Multiple outcomes

Reach the final seal and decide how far you are willing to go to escape the tomb.

In this third-person 3D videogame, you’ll control a poor girl who’s drowning in debt. And what do you do when you’re in debt? Go to the casino!

You’ll start your adventure in the poorest neighborhood, representing your low standard of living, and you’ll quickly realize something: to go to the casino, you need money! But don’t worry! In the neighborhood you’ll find men who will kindly offer to be your sugar daddies if they find you attractive enough. Seduce them and offer your services to earn a bit of money. Then go to the casino and spend all that money on a series of betting games that will either make you rich or leave you even poorer than before! In that case, just go back to your sugar daddies and get more money!

As you earn money, you’ll be able to afford visiting the wealthier districts of the city, where you can go to casinos with better games and also meet men with more refined tastes. To impress these men, you’ll need to improve your image. Go to the shops to buy brand-name clothing and purchase property to look like the high-value lady you want to be. And then go back to the casino to bet it all again!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the fantastical arena of Small Hero!
This is a fast-paced, entertaining light Roguelike action survival game. You will play as a lone hero, facing off against waves of monsters. Each round is a brand-new adventure: you must shop and strengthen yourself between waves, then dive into the next, even more intense battle for survival!

Will you become a crit-slashing Berserker or a sharpshooting Gunslinger? Each choice will shape your unique combat style. Survive, scavenge loot, unlock more content, and then... play just one more round!

Key Features

⚡ Fast-Paced Frenzied Combat
Each battle lasts 10-30 minutes, offering tight, action-packed, and immensely satisfying gameplay! Dodge through hordes of monsters and defeat all enemies within the limited time frame, testing your positioning and crowd-control skills.

🎭 Massive Roster, Unique Playstyles
Choose from a variety of beloved heroes, each with their own unique starting weapons, attributes, and playstyles! Whether it's the fist-wielding Boxer, the bullet-spamming Ammunition Expert, or the Mysterious Pirate, there's a hero for everyone.

🛠️ Infinite Build Possibilities
After each run, use collected materials to purchase new heroes and unlock talents in the shop, making your heroes progressively stronger. During combat, choose from hundreds of randomly appearing items, weapons, and skills. Stack critical chance for extreme damage or build defense to become the ultimate tank? Your build determines your survival!

📦 Vast Arsenal of Weapons & Items
Wield everything from melee swords to the ranged "Buddha's Palm," from fantasy bows to modern firearms. With over a hundred weapons to choose from and thousands of diverse items, every run is a fresh experience.

🔄 Light Roguelike, Ever-Fresh
Death is a new beginning! While your character dies at the end of a run, the resources you collect will help you progress further in your next adventure. Unlock new characters, weapons, and items to continuously expand your tactical options.

Game Modes

🗺️ Battle Mode
Embark on a challenging adventure! Conquer different levels, facing unique monsters and powerful stage bosses!

🌊 Endless Mode
Test your build's limits and see how many waves you can survive.

⚽ Match Mode
A great place to farm resources! Merge, survive, get stronger... and then go again!

🌌 Worldview
📜 Prologue: The Rift Descends, the Multiverse Collapses

In the distant ancient era, the multiverse flourished like a sprawling World Tree, countless parallel worlds revolving in harmonious order. Then came the catastrophe known to later ages as the Doomsday Calamity—a force from the deepest void tore through the fabric of the cosmos. This rift, named the Dark Rift, forcibly dragged, shattered, and recombined fragments of countless worlds, forging them into a single chaotic realm.

Once-great empires crumbled overnight into ruins teeming with monsters. Mighty imperial armies were torn apart by alien beasts from distant galaxies. The hulking remains of mecha littered the land. The guardians of magical worlds fell one by one in brutal trials of survival, reduced to ash on the wind—their souls forever trapped in this accursed land.

As ancient prophecies whispered among wizards smoldered in the embers of darkness, and as ferocious behemoths clawed their way from the earth of forgotten realms, the final fantasy crystals cast eerie light across radioactive wastelands—a voice, ancient and unwavering, pierced the barriers between dimensions and echoed in the heart of every survivor:

"Only the Tiny Heroes can cross the rift and become the final bulwark of this broken world."

You are one such lone hero, chosen by fate. You were not born into this age of chaos. Instead, when the rift tore through existence, you were drawn by a mysterious force from your own world and cast into this eternal battlefield.

Your strength comes from the fragments of countless worlds. Every hero carries the memories and purpose of a shattered realm. Your choices will decide the ultimate direction of this battle royale—this trial of survival.

⚔️ Hero Chronicles
In the eternal arena of the rift, each chosen Tiny Hero bears a unique destiny and power. They come from broken worlds, carrying their own obsessions and missions, writing their legends upon this chaotic land.

🥊 I. The Path of Fists – Awakened Martial Artists

  • 🥚 Small Egg

Description:
💚 Max HP +5
🧺 Harvest +5
🏃 Move Speed +5%

Combat Style: A survival-focused hero, skilled at agile positioning and dodging attacks while using Harvest to gain more resources.

  • 👊 Boxer

Description:
🥋 Kung Fu weapon damage +15
🌀 Dodge +15%
⚠️ Critical Hit Rate -10%
⚠️ Critical Damage -50%
⚠️ Ranged Damage -10
🎁 Initially carry an Arm Fist

Combat Style: A pure melee burst-damage hero focused on fist techniques. Sacrifices ranged combat and critical potential for high evasion and devastating fist attacks. Perfect for players who enjoy close-quarters combat and the thrill of face-to-face brawling.

  • 🔫 Arms Dealer

Description:
🎯 Critical Hit Rate +20%
📏 Attack Range +100
⚠️ Obtained health attribute -50%
🎁 Carry a Handgun initially
🚫 Cannot equip melee weapons

Combat Style: The ultimate ranged damage dealer, with extreme crit rate and attack range, but very low survivability. He can only use ranged weapons, making him ideal for players who prefer eliminating enemies from a safe distance.

  • 🍜 Epicure

Description:
💚 Max HP +30
🐢 Move Speed -20%

Combat Style: Pure survival hero with massive HP but slower movement. Great for players who prefer staying in the fight and absorbing damage head-on.

  • 😎 Bad Boy

Description:
🗡️ Ninjutsu weapon radius +150
⚡ Attack Speed +50%
⚠️ Dodge -30%
⚠️ Ranged Damage -10
🎁 Carry a Fish Sword initially

Combat Style: High-speed melee damage dealer, sacrificing defense for extreme attack speed and massive range. Ideal for players who love weaving through enemy hordes and chasing attack speed.

  • 🃏 Lucky Joker

Description:
🍀 Luck +100
✨ Luck Buff +25%
⚠️ +50% XP required to level up
⚠️ All Damage -50%
💰 When picking up coins, there is a 50% chance of randomly dealing 1 damage to 1 enemy (the higher the luck value, the higher the damage)

Combat Style: Luck decides everything! Despite low base damage and slower leveling, high luck makes every gold pickup a potential killing blow. Great for players who enjoy gambling and surprises.

  • 🎵 Musician

Description:
🎵 All Damage +40%
⚠️ Number of Enemies +50%

Combat Style: High risk, high reward. Gains immense all-damage bonuses but faces many more enemies. Ideal for players who crave maximum damage output and love taking on hordes alone.

  • 🧬 Mutant

Description:
📚 Gain experience +200%
💰 Shop item selling price +50%

Combat Style: A growth hero with extremely fast leveling, but higher shop prices. Perfect for players who want to outpace enemies through levels.

  • 🗡️ Adventurer

Description:
⚡ Attack Speed +200
💪 +100% for all damage attributes
🚫 Only one weapon can be equipped at a time

Combat Style: The ultimate single-weapon specialist. Bets everything on one blade, sacrificing weapon diversity for terrifying attack speed and damage. Ideal for players who love minimalism and maximum efficiency.

  • 💀 Lonely Man

Description:
💀 Move Speed +30
⚠️ Armor -3

Combat Style: High risk, high reward. Extremely fast but fragile. Perfect for players who enjoy high-stakes, high-skill gameplay.

  • 🏴‍☠️ Pirate

Description:
🏴‍☠️ Lifesteal +25% for Holy Weapons
⚠️ Melee Damage -3
⚠️ Ranged Damage -3
🎁 Carry a Scallion initially

Combat Style: A lifesteal sustain hero who relies on Holy weapons to stay in the fight. Lower base damage but strong sustain. Great for players who enjoy brawling and outlasting enemies.

  • 🌾 Scarecrow

Description:
🔥 Elemental Damage +8
⚠️ Ranged Damage -20
⚠️ Melee Damage -20
⚠️ Armor -1
✨ When attacking, there is a 25% chance to deal a scorch damage that lasts for 3s (the scorch spreads to nearby enemies)

Combat Style: A master of flame and elemental control. Despite lower base damage, his burn effects spread quickly through groups, dealing massive sustained damage. Perfect for players who enjoy watching enemies burn like a wildfire.

  • 🛡️ Gladiator

Description:
🛡️ Armor +1
⚔️ Melee Damage +5
🚫 Cannot equip ranged weapons

Combat Style: A pure tank hero with exceptional survivability. Though unable to use ranged weapons, he deals solid melee damage. Perfect for players who prefer standing their ground and fighting head-on.

  • 🐔 Trainee

Description:
⚠️ Number of Enemies +20%
⚠️ Max HP -5
✨ Get an additional 1 reward box at the end of each wave
🎁 Carry a Chicken initially
✨ For every 2 chickens owned, the chicken's bullet ejection count increases by 1

Combat Style: A progression hero. Though his base stats are weak, he grows stronger by collecting more Chickens. Bonus chests help him assemble key weapons faster. Ideal for players who enjoy progression and risk-replayability.

  • 🌻 Gardener

Description:
🌱 All Summoner Attacks +50%
🎁 Carry a Fork initially
✨ Summoners will be generated near each other
⚠️ All item attributes -50%

Combat Style: The core summoner hero. Sacrifices personal stat growth for a powerful army of summons. Great for players who enjoy commanding a horde and leading an army.

👾 Monsters – Calamities from Countless Realms
Monsters pour in like a tide—each a twisted remnant of destroyed worlds:

Monster TypeDescription🧟 InfectedVirus-ridden beings dragging their broken bodies toward you, their eyes filled with hunger for flesh. These creatures from dark abysses have haunted survivors for countless nights. Highly resistant to normal weapons, but flame and elemental attacks are said to burn them away.👹 Demon LegionHellish demons charging through flames with blazing weapons. Their scales are nearly impenetrable—only thunder and divine fists can break through and banish them back to the abyss.🦖 Ancient BehemothsEach moves like a mountain, their roars shaking the very earth. Their skin is as tough as fortress walls—only massive artillery and critical meteor fists can bring them down. Their lairs hide the richest treasures and weapons.🤖 Mech LegionRobot armies from a high-tech world, built from alloy resistant to physical attacks. Electromagnetic and laser weapons are their weakness, piercing their armor and disabling their cores.🌿 Mutant PlantsCreatures from a once-vibrant dreamscape, harmless until disturbed. Their vines can ensnare you instantly, and their seeds fly like bullets. Only fire can drive them back to slumber.

🌟 The Final Hope
As you grow stronger through countless cycles, as your Arm Fist evolves into the Meteor Fist, as your Green Dragon Blade awakens into Green Dragon Crescent Blade, as your electromagnetic gun transforms into the Scientific Electromagnetic Cannon—one day, you will stand atop the world, facing the ultimate threat behind the rift.

On that day, you will no longer be the Tiny Hero struggling to survive among monsters. You will be the savior of all realms, the last hope for every shattered world.

Your legend will be carved into ancient scrolls, told by countless heroes for generations to come.

—This is your destiny, the shared creed of all adventurers. In this fast-paced journey, every choice writes a one-of-a-kind legend, and every death prepares you for the next rebirth.

Take up your weapon—whether it’s the Arm Fist or Green Dragon Blade, whether a handgun or a soccer ball—let it awaken in your hands, evolve into a true divine artifact! 🎮✨

【About the Developer】

I have already released several games on Steam. They are all single-player indie games, maintaining the same characteristics: low barrier to entry, easy to pick up, budget-friendly pricing, and stress-relieving gameplay. They cover various genres including casual, survivor-like, bullet hell, light strategy, survival tower defense, civilization evolution, defense roguelike, and base building. Each game continues the philosophy of being "casual," "easy to learn," and "reasonably priced," with unique gameplay focuses. If you enjoy 2D games with a simple art style and strategy simulation gameplay, feel free to check out the developer homepage and try my other series games in your spare time. I also welcome you to share and recommend them!

Welcome to all strategy game enthusiasts, indie game supporters, and players who enjoy puzzle, building, survival, and Roguelite elements. If you're looking for a time sink and want to enjoy some slow-paced fun in a single-player world, feel free to stop by here for a while.

【Future Plans】

I plan to continue creating more single-player indie games in the future, including inventory management games, martial arts/Wuxia themed games, post-apocalyptic survival (zombie themed) games, management sim games, and even puzzle games~

Thank you once again for your choice. Wish you a pleasant gaming experience!

store_data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the fantastical arena of Small Hero!
This is a fast-paced, entertaining light Roguelike action survival game. You will play as a lone hero, facing off against waves of monsters. Each round is a brand-new adventure: you must shop and strengthen yourself between waves, then dive into the next, even more intense battle for survival!

Will you become a crit-slashing Berserker or a sharpshooting Gunslinger? Each choice will shape your unique combat style. Survive, scavenge loot, unlock more content, and then... play just one more round!

Key Features

⚡ Fast-Paced Frenzied Combat
Each battle lasts 10-30 minutes, offering tight, action-packed, and immensely satisfying gameplay! Dodge through hordes of monsters and defeat all enemies within the limited time frame, testing your positioning and crowd-control skills.

🎭 Massive Roster, Unique Playstyles
Choose from a variety of beloved heroes, each with their own unique starting weapons, attributes, and playstyles! Whether it's the fist-wielding Boxer, the bullet-spamming Ammunition Expert, or the Mysterious Pirate, there's a hero for everyone.

🛠️ Infinite Build Possibilities
After each run, use collected materials to purchase new heroes and unlock talents in the shop, making your heroes progressively stronger. During combat, choose from hundreds of randomly appearing items, weapons, and skills. Stack critical chance for extreme damage or build defense to become the ultimate tank? Your build determines your survival!

📦 Vast Arsenal of Weapons & Items
Wield everything from melee swords to the ranged "Buddha's Palm," from fantasy bows to modern firearms. With over a hundred weapons to choose from and thousands of diverse items, every run is a fresh experience.

🔄 Light Roguelike, Ever-Fresh
Death is a new beginning! While your character dies at the end of a run, the resources you collect will help you progress further in your next adventure. Unlock new characters, weapons, and items to continuously expand your tactical options.

Game Modes

🗺️ Battle Mode
Embark on a challenging adventure! Conquer different levels, facing unique monsters and powerful stage bosses!

🌊 Endless Mode
Test your build's limits and see how many waves you can survive.

⚽ Match Mode
A great place to farm resources! Merge, survive, get stronger... and then go again!

🌌 Worldview
📜 Prologue: The Rift Descends, the Multiverse Collapses

In the distant ancient era, the multiverse flourished like a sprawling World Tree, countless parallel worlds revolving in harmonious order. Then came the catastrophe known to later ages as the Doomsday Calamity—a force from the deepest void tore through the fabric of the cosmos. This rift, named the Dark Rift, forcibly dragged, shattered, and recombined fragments of countless worlds, forging them into a single chaotic realm.

Once-great empires crumbled overnight into ruins teeming with monsters. Mighty imperial armies were torn apart by alien beasts from distant galaxies. The hulking remains of mecha littered the land. The guardians of magical worlds fell one by one in brutal trials of survival, reduced to ash on the wind—their souls forever trapped in this accursed land.

As ancient prophecies whispered among wizards smoldered in the embers of darkness, and as ferocious behemoths clawed their way from the earth of forgotten realms, the final fantasy crystals cast eerie light across radioactive wastelands—a voice, ancient and unwavering, pierced the barriers between dimensions and echoed in the heart of every survivor:

"Only the Tiny Heroes can cross the rift and become the final bulwark of this broken world."

You are one such lone hero, chosen by fate. You were not born into this age of chaos. Instead, when the rift tore through existence, you were drawn by a mysterious force from your own world and cast into this eternal battlefield.

Your strength comes from the fragments of countless worlds. Every hero carries the memories and purpose of a shattered realm. Your choices will decide the ultimate direction of this battle royale—this trial of survival.

⚔️ Hero Chronicles
In the eternal arena of the rift, each chosen Tiny Hero bears a unique destiny and power. They come from broken worlds, carrying their own obsessions and missions, writing their legends upon this chaotic land.

🥊 I. The Path of Fists – Awakened Martial Artists

  • 🥚 Small Egg

Description:
💚 Max HP +5
🧺 Harvest +5
🏃 Move Speed +5%

Combat Style: A survival-focused hero, skilled at agile positioning and dodging attacks while using Harvest to gain more resources.

  • 👊 Boxer

Description:
🥋 Kung Fu weapon damage +15
🌀 Dodge +15%
⚠️ Critical Hit Rate -10%
⚠️ Critical Damage -50%
⚠️ Ranged Damage -10
🎁 Initially carry an Arm Fist

Combat Style: A pure melee burst-damage hero focused on fist techniques. Sacrifices ranged combat and critical potential for high evasion and devastating fist attacks. Perfect for players who enjoy close-quarters combat and the thrill of face-to-face brawling.

  • 🔫 Arms Dealer

Description:
🎯 Critical Hit Rate +20%
📏 Attack Range +100
⚠️ Obtained health attribute -50%
🎁 Carry a Handgun initially
🚫 Cannot equip melee weapons

Combat Style: The ultimate ranged damage dealer, with extreme crit rate and attack range, but very low survivability. He can only use ranged weapons, making him ideal for players who prefer eliminating enemies from a safe distance.

  • 🍜 Epicure

Description:
💚 Max HP +30
🐢 Move Speed -20%

Combat Style: Pure survival hero with massive HP but slower movement. Great for players who prefer staying in the fight and absorbing damage head-on.

  • 😎 Bad Boy

Description:
🗡️ Ninjutsu weapon radius +150
⚡ Attack Speed +50%
⚠️ Dodge -30%
⚠️ Ranged Damage -10
🎁 Carry a Fish Sword initially

Combat Style: High-speed melee damage dealer, sacrificing defense for extreme attack speed and massive range. Ideal for players who love weaving through enemy hordes and chasing attack speed.

  • 🃏 Lucky Joker

Description:
🍀 Luck +100
✨ Luck Buff +25%
⚠️ +50% XP required to level up
⚠️ All Damage -50%
💰 When picking up coins, there is a 50% chance of randomly dealing 1 damage to 1 enemy (the higher the luck value, the higher the damage)

👾 Monsters – Calamities from Countless Realms
Monsters pour in like a tide—each a twisted remnant of destroyed worlds:

Monster TypeDescription🧟 InfectedVirus-ridden beings dragging their broken bodies toward you, their eyes filled with hunger for flesh. These creatures from dark abysses have haunted survivors for countless nights. Highly resistant to normal weapons, but flame and elemental attacks are said to burn them away.👹 Demon LegionHellish demons charging through flames with blazing weapons. Their scales are nearly impenetrable—only thunder and divine fists can break through and banish them back to the abyss.🦖 Ancient BehemothsEach moves like a mountain, their roars shaking the very earth. Their skin is as tough as fortress walls—only massive artillery and critical meteor fists can bring them down. Their lairs hide the richest treasures and weapons.🤖 Mech LegionRobot armies from a high-tech world, built from alloy resistant to physical attacks. Electromagnetic and laser weapons are their weakness, piercing their armor and disabling their cores.🌿 Mutant PlantsCreatures from a once-vibrant dreamscape, harmless until disturbed. Their vines can ensnare you instantly, and their seeds fly like bullets. Only fire can drive them back to slumber.

🌟 The Final Hope
As you grow stronger through countless cycles, as your Arm Fist evolves into the Meteor Fist, as your Green Dragon Blade awakens into Green Dragon Crescent Blade, as your electromagnetic gun transforms into the Scientific Electromagnetic Cannon—one day, you will stand atop the world, facing the ultimate threat behind the rift.

On that day, you will no longer be the Tiny Hero struggling to survive among monsters. You will be the savior of all realms, the last hope for every shattered world.

Your legend will be carved into ancient scrolls, told by countless heroes for generations to come.

—This is your destiny, the shared creed of all adventurers. In this fast-paced journey, every choice writes a one-of-a-kind legend, and every death prepares you for the next rebirth.

Take up your weapon—whether it’s the Arm Fist or Green Dragon Blade, whether a handgun or a soccer ball—let it awaken in your hands, evolve into a true divine artifact! 🎮✨

【About the Developer】

I have already released several games on Steam. They are all single-player indie games, maintaining the same characteristics: low barrier to entry, easy to pick up, budget-friendly pricing, and stress-relieving gameplay. They cover various genres including casual, survivor-like, bullet hell, light strategy, survival tower defense, civilization evolution, defense roguelike, and base building. Each game continues the philosophy of being "casual," "easy to learn," and "reasonably priced," with unique gameplay focuses. If you enjoy 2D games with a simple art style and strategy simulation gameplay, feel free to check out the developer homepage and try my other series games in your spare time. I also welcome you to share and recommend them!

Welcome to all strategy game enthusiasts, indie game supporters, and players who enjoy puzzle, building, survival, and Roguelite elements. If you're looking for a time sink and want to enjoy some slow-paced fun in a single-player world, feel free to stop by here for a while.

【Future Plans】

I plan to continue creating more single-player indie games in the future, including inventory management games, martial arts/Wuxia themed games, post-apocalyptic survival (zombie themed) games, management sim games, and even puzzle games~

Thank you once again for your choice. Wish you a pleasant gaming experience!

store_data.about_the_game:
Philip Oakes, a middle-aged family man, awakens in a cold concrete hallway and struggles to recall his past.

Upon exploring, Philip finds himself in a home that resembles his own, and speaks with an unknown caller who guides him.

Doors locked, Philip must find a way out of the many rooms he explores.

With vintage music blaring from a nearby record player and the door banging with someone attempting to break in, Philip is short on time.

Will Philip solve the twisted puzzles in each room and discover the truth, or will he succumb to the pressure?

Locks, codes, papers, and clues all await.

As Philip Oakes ventures through the many puzzles and rooms of the familiar residence, he uncovers fragments of his past before finally discovering a truth—a reality—that puts everything into question.

FEATURES

  • About 30–90 minutes of gameplay, depending on the speed at which it is played.

    • 17 atmospheric rooms with multiple puzzles.

  • Immersive 4D ambisonic audio.

  • Heavy emphasis on storytelling.

    • Spoken dialogue, toggleable in settings.

  • Standalone game that requires no prior knowledge to play.

CONTENT AND WARNINGS

  • Has flickering lights, which may be unsuitable for those with epilepsy.

  • Involves blood, violence, and elements of death.

  • Contains some frightening scenes but few to no jumpscares.

DETAILS AND CREDITS

  • Developed using Unreal Engine 5.

  • Twisted Flower as the solo developer.

  • @ThyWhale, @BitOfTomfoolery, @Fliirted as playtesters.

  • Tom Steele, Torry Seward as voice actors.

store_data.about_the_game:
Uncanny Tales is an episodic horror game where the scariest things aren’t monsters or the supernatural — they’re people themselves. Each story is a new chilling episode, inspired by real-life fears and disturbing situations.

Uncanny Tales: The Watcher — Episode Three of the series.

You are the new reserve caretaker, who came to the Altai wilderness seeking quiet and income. But the picturesque landscapes conceal a dark secret: local residents and reserve workers whisper about unexplained anomalies in the taiga. Authorities dismiss all incidents as accidents, but soon enough, you will realize that peace in this place is merely an illusion.

Start with the Prologue.

Before starting your duties, you will experience the last working day of your predecessor. Perform their usual, routine tasks. Through their experience, you will see exactly how routine transforms into something terrifying.

Daily Duties and Tools.

Your job requires extreme attention to detail and strict adherence to daily obligations.

Key Game Features:

  • Atmosphere and 2006 Details: Immerse yourself in the aesthetics of the Russian heartland in the early 2000s, featuring primitive technology, a sense of nostalgia, and the oppressive feeling of isolation in the wild.

  • Control Center (PC): Your old computer is the heart of your operation. Use it to monitor the perimeter and diligently complete your daily reports.

  • Patrol by 4x4: Drive across the vast location in a reliable, aging Soviet-era off-roader (UAZ). This is your primary means of transport in the deep woods.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story Overview

A series of mysterious child disappearances strikes a small town. Four children vanish without a trace. That evening, the town office receives a distress call from the former lord’s lakeside mansion — a place three days away on foot, with no record of any travel reaching it. It is as if the children were transported there out of thin air.

Worse still, the mansion has long been rumored to be cursed. Ten years ago, everyone who entered it met a strange and tragic end.

Investigator Reacher and his assistant Cielle join a rescue team to find the missing children. The team includes the town’s mayor, a town official, a sheriff, a Pastor, a scholar obsessed with the supernatural, and a medium known for flawless divination.

As the search unfolds, a member of the rescue team is murdered — yet there is no sign anyone entered or left the mansion.

Is the curse real…
or is the killer among them?

While solving the mansion’s Puzzles and trying to rescue the children, Reacher gradually uncovers the long-buried tragedy hidden beneath the mansion’s dark past.

Game Description

Scapegoat & Rational blends mystery storytelling, key evidence collection, and escape-style Puzzles.

Players may choose between two play modes:

【Key Evidence Mode】

A gameplay system created by Lester.
Players mark important clues and suspicions as key evidence during investigation. Collect enough key evidence to uncover the full truth.

【Story Mode】

All key evidence is highlighted automatically. Before the ending, players must match each question with the correct evidence to reveal the truth.

Beyond investigation, players must solve 19 Puzzles throughout the mansion — perfect for fans who enjoy puzzle-driven gameplay.

Game Features

  • No chase sequences. Only mild scare elements.

  • Built-in system to review current objectives and story recap, so you never lose track of where you left off.

  • Every Puzzle includes a hint system:

    • Check whether any clues are missing.

    • View hints once all clues are collected.

    • Full solutions are available if needed, ensuring smooth progression.

Additional Information

  • If the game occasionally becomes unresponsive during gameplay, this is not a bug. Please close and restart the game to resolve the issue. No report is required.

  • An official English version of the walkthrough for cracking the truth is currently in production.

  • Language Support: This game supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English. You may switch languages in the Options menu.

    ※English Version Notice:

    The title screen and chapter selection menu are currently available in Chinese only. Reference images are provided below for guidance. All other game content can be fully switched to English or includes bilingual support.

    One Puzzle requires rearranging certain objects and reading an acrostic message. As this wordplay cannot be accurately localized into English, the Puzzle provides the English interpretation of the acrostic directly. All other Puzzles and hint clues have been fully localized for smooth gameplay.

  • Playtime: Approximately 3–8 hours, depending on puzzle difficulty and reading pace.

  • Streaming: Streaming is fully allowed. Streamers are welcome to contact the developer, and the developer will try to watch live streams or recorded playthroughs whenever possible.

  • Fan Works: Please ask for permission in advance.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sweep. Spend. Repeat.

Sweeper is a roguelike that fuses the deductive tension of Minesweeper with the compounding economy of a deckbuilder. Every tile you reveal earns money. Every dollar you spend reshapes the next board. Every run ends with a single click you're not sure about.

Across 15 rounds and 3 Acts, you'll build a synergistic engine from Tags, Geoblocks, and ultra-rare Ephemeral Blocks: Items that modify rules, transform tiles, and multiply payouts in ways that interact with each other in ways you didn't plan for.

Each round puts you against a unique Boss modifier. From bosses that change the rhythm of the game to draining your balance, every run's boss lineup is different. And unlike classic Minesweeper, every click reveals exactly one tile. Every decision carries weight.

Features:

— 15-round runs across 3 Acts with escalating boards and bosses

— Tags, Geoblocks, and Ephemeral Blocks with deep synergy potential

— A shop economy that resets between Acts — spend wisely or fall behind

— Boss modifiers on every round, none of them the same

— Seeded runs — share your seed, replay your disasters

— 11 Steam Achievements

store_data.about_the_game:
Put on your headphones and step into a painting that hides its final moments.

Uncover the truth buried within the image, reveal the sin it conceals, and pass judgment.

Game Story

At the gates of Hell, you are chosen by the archangel Michael.
In the heavy, suffocating silence, you sense that this place is far more than a simple testing ground.

The classical paintings laid out before you
carry the splendor of the Renaissance and Baroque,
yet beneath their surface, faint traces of sin seep quietly through the canvas.
When light falls upon them, hidden shadows begin to emerge,
and if you listen closely, lingering echoes of terror slowly rise from deep within the paintings.

You must gather the scattered fragments of truth concealed inside each work of art.
Trace the sounds left behind in the canvas, and listen carefully for the final trace that could not be fully erased.
By listening to these sounds and reasoning out their meaning,
you become the one who must choose which sin the painting has been hiding.
But in Michael’s test, every choice comes with a price.

There is no way to run from this trial.
Your interpretations, your intuition, and even your emotions themselves all become part of the examination.

Can you pass Michael’s test?
With nothing but your imagination and powers of deduction, can you escape from the threshold of death that opens onto Hell?

Features

■ Audio-Visual Contradiction Deduction System

What you see is not the whole truth.

Listen closely to the sounds hidden within each painting, detect contradictions between what is seen and what is heard, and uncover the key clues behind each case.

The conflict between sight and sound becomes your most important tool of deduction.

■ Audio-Centered Investigation Interface

Right-click to listen to the sounds within a painting, and use the mouse wheel to move backward and forward through the audio to revisit specific moments as needed.

With immersive binaural audio, you can sense distance, direction, and the atmosphere of the scene itself.

Headphones are strongly recommended.

■ Progressive Scene Restoration

Each time you identify and click on an incorrect element, the painting gradually restores itself to the original moment of sin.

Rather than simply collecting clues, you actively move the scene forward in time and reveal the truth with your own hands.

■ Seven Deadly Sins Judgment System

Your final goal is not merely to discover what happened.

Based on the restored scene and the clues you uncover, you must determine which of the Seven Deadly Sins the painting hides—and pass judgment.

This structure goes beyond solving a case, asking you to interpret its meaning and moral weight as well.

■ Classical Painting-Inspired Art and Randomized Scenarios

A haunting horror mystery experience brought to life through eerie visuals and sound inspired by Renaissance and Baroque painting.

Each time you restart after a game over, the paintings and the sins hidden within them are rearranged at random, requiring fresh deduction and judgment every time you play.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ghostprint is a first-person horror game set in dark, atmospheric rooms where you rely on a cursed Polaroid camera to move forward. Certain places in the environment call for a photo, and capturing the right ghostprint reshapes the space around you. Walls shift, passages emerge, and your path opens.

Key features:

  • Progression is driven by observation and spatial problem-solving. Each “ghostprint” you capture can alter geometry, reveal hidden routes, or manifest key objects required to move forward.

  • The challenge comes from identifying where a shot is needed, interpreting subtle environmental cues, and navigating areas that rearrange themselves when you least expect it.

  • There are no traditional combat systems; momentum comes from exploration, puzzle-driven triggers, and managing tension as the environment closes in.

  • The experience blends psychological horror, puzzle, and adventure design pillars.

  • Expect a focused, guided playthrough built around atmosphere and tension, with occasional jumpscares used to escalate pressure rather than drive the whole experience.

  • Full completion is projected at ~20 minutes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Briar Flame is a hand-crafted action-platformer inspired by Metroidvania structure and Soulslike world design.
You play as the Young Emberhost, one of the last beings whose white-hot ember-blood can burn through the Briar — a colossal, world-spanning thorn growth that has suffocated the land for ages.

Features:

  • Stylized hand-drawn visuals

  • Soulslike level design with interconnected zones & shortcuts

  • Tight action-platforming with air-dashes and directional mobility

  • Boss-focused progression

  • Atmospheric soundtrack featuring zone themes from professional composers

  • Minimal UI, immersive world-driven storytelling

Explore a World Twisted by Thorns

Venture through atmospheric zones, each layered with shortcuts, secrets, and environmental storytelling. Descend into dark ruins, climb ancient battlements, and push toward the Heart of the Briar.

Fast, Responsive Combat

Master tight movement, air mobility, and a unique directional “ember dash” that lets you strike, dodge, and traverse with fluid precision. Every weapon consumes stamina, rewarding timing, spacing, and resource management.

Face Brutal Bosses

Challenge deadly foes, from corrupted warriors to giant executioners. Learn their patterns, adapt your loadout, and ignite your ember powers to survive.

Build Your Flame

Discover relics, tools, and upgrades that reshape your playstyle. Enhance your vitality, empower your strikes, or unlock new weapon options as you grow your ember’s form.

Can you reach the Heart of the Briar — or be consumed by it?

store_data.about_the_game:
In this 3D sandbox-style experience which draws from elements of visual novels, every choice has consequences. Embark on a reality-shattering journey where nothing behaves the way it should - and that’s exactly the point.

Immerse yourself in a vibrant, genre-blending narrative as you, John The Retriever, chase after your missing human best friend across time and space. Every step draws you into a unique world with its own distinct rules, styles, and logic - none of which remain consistent or linear for long. All through the eyes of mankind’s greatest companion.

Explore shifting landscapes: complete Quests that take you through surreal journeys - a 3D dream realm that shifts into a retro arcade game, a cheerful city that gradually reveals a café operated by an alien, or a cosmic sanctuary suspended in time for all the beloved dogs past. As the environment changes, so do your goals, challenges, and sometimes even the mechanics of the game itself.

Forge unexpected connections with a cast of bizarre, endearing characters: each of whom bends or completely disregards the norms of their worlds. You can charm them, challenge them, find creative solutions, or even break the rules so thoroughly that the rules themselves concede.

Engage in clever reasoning, playful experimentation, and clever tricks to overcome puzzles that are aware of your attempts to solve them. Take advantage of plot gaps, twist genre clichés, and occasionally persuade the universe to alter itself just a tiny bit in your favour.

Influence the world: every interaction, every choice, every path you wander influences how your story will end.

Earn rewards: the more Quests you complete, the more rewards you earn. Spend in-game currency to unlock unique cosmetics and show off your personality by customising your character.

Find hidden levels: explore every nook and cranny to find hidden objects, characters, and the occasional hidden level!

Amid the chaos, unravel a genuine, heart-tugging story about friendship - about what it means to lose someone who shaped your world, and the lengths you’ll go to piece that world back together. It’s equal parts heartfelt, hilarious, and delightfully unhinged.

Reality is optional. Friendship isn’t.

Play time 20-30 minutes
