store_data.about_the_game:
Goat's Odyssey is an atmospheric point-and-click adventure in a unique shadow theatre style, where a black silhouette world comes alive against a warm amber sunset.

It all started with a gust of wind. Your heroine is an ordinary village goat, tired of life on a leash. When the wind brings a bright postcard from a holiday resort, her patience runs out. Down with the rope! Long live adventure!

You will travel from your native peg through a dark forest and a Witch's hut straight to the stars. But remember: every journey has an end, and sometimes it lies exactly where it began.

🌟 KEY FEATURES:

  • A World of Shadow and Light: Enjoy a unique visual style where every level is a living painting drawn in ink on a golden gradient.

  • Classic Point & Click... with Horns: Collect items, combine them, and apply them in the most unexpected places. Build a catapult out of a bucket, brew a levitation potion, and use goat "magic" (yes, you'll have to fertilize some garden beds!) to move forward.

  • From the Village to the Moon: Locations change rapidly, raising the degree of absurdity. Outsmart a mischievous squirrel, steal a key from a grumpy rooster, deceive a Witch, and negotiate with moon dwellers.

  • Diverse Mini-games: The gameplay won't let you get bored! Musical rock puzzles, catching fireflies, stellar navigation with a sextant, and even stealth missions against wolves await you.

  • Philosophical Irony: This is a story about a great dream and the search for a better life, told without a single word. Is it worth flying to space to realize how tasty the grass is at home?

Goat's Odyssey is a small game with a big heart (and a very stubborn goat).

Ready to chew through the rope?

store_data.about_the_game:
SPRING YOUR WAY UP

...through a colossal, punishing world, using nothing but a giant spring strapped to your body. Every jump demands perfect compression, careful angles, and ruthless precision if you want to reach the top.

THE JOURNEY

...takes you through a vast of punishing levels, filled with diverse environments, tricky platforms, and unexpected surprises. Every jump matters, and the path to the top is full of tension, testing your patience, skill, and self-control. Will you reach the ultimate success, or stumble just short and face a different fate?

ENJOY:

  • No deaths, just pain.

    Just the constant fear of falling and losing all your progress. Perhaps worse...

  • Simple, yet deep mechanics

    Stretch and compress your spring, adjust the angle, and land with pinpoint accuracy.

  • Hours of relentless gameplay.

    Finish it fast – or fail for days. Your skill decides.

  • Good vs. Bad Ending

    One final decision can lead you to triumph... or put your patience and control to the ultimate test.

  • A peaceful, yet merciless experience.

    Physics-based jumping. Every platform is carefully crafted. Endless challenge.

CONQUER ALL THE WORLDS

...each with their own theme and hazards, to reach the ultimate reward. Discover hidden lessons, ancient secrets, and perhaps... the meaning of life itself.

Developer's Note:
Spring Me Up is inspired by Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy and A Difficult Game About Climbing by Pontypants. We consider it a continuation of a genre that, in our opinion, still has far too few entries today - and with this game, we aim to contribute to it.

store_data.about_the_game:
If Chinese characters could be split apart, recombined, and scored, what kind of strategy game would they become?

WordJoy is a character-component word-building game. Place Chinese character components onto a 3x3 grid, combine them into valid Chinese characters, and score points through chips, multipliers, relics, and component skills.

Each stage has a target score, but your number of plays is limited. A simple character may help you clear the stage safely, while a more complex multi-component character may bring a higher multiplier. Should you play now, or wait for a stronger combination? Every move asks you to make a choice.

After clearing a stage, you can visit the shop to choose new components and relics, gradually strengthening your build. Different components, relics, and skills can create different scoring rhythms: stable scoring, multiplier stacking, or waiting for one explosive turn.

Through repeated splitting, combining, and scoring, Chinese characters are no longer just written symbols. They become your strategic resources. As you chase higher scores, you may rediscover the structural beauty and charm of Chinese characters.

Features

  • Place components on a 3x3 grid, combine them into valid Chinese characters, and score points

  • Create high-scoring synergies through chips, multipliers, relics, and skills

  • Reach the target score within a limited number of plays

  • Choose new components and relics between stages to strengthen your build

  • Decide between safe progression and high-score bursts

  • Experience the structural beauty of Chinese characters through strategic play

store_data.about_the_game:
You're Not Here to Share the Wealth!

As the Security Officer for the "Bridgeway to Heaven" climbing expedition, your real mission is to make sure as few climbers as possible reach the summit. Why? Simple: more loot for you!

Just make sure the Expedition Boss doesn't catch you, or you'll be the one taking a final plunge into the abyss.

Destroy the Bridges, Claim the Gold!

You've reached the summit and secured your share of the bounty. But the less successful climbers there are, the bigger your prize!

Destroy those bridges before your gold runs out!


Master the Art of Treachery

Every member of the expedition presents a different challenge. Learn their mechanics and figure out how to make them fall without alerting the foreman.

More gold for you!

KEY FEATURES

  • Thrills: Every attempt will bring out the best—and the worst—in you. You'll feel your emotions swinging like a suspension bridge!

  • Reaction: Test your reflexes and senses to prevent your betrayal from being discovered. How quickly can you anticipate the foreman's movements?

  • Strategy: Choose your path of destruction for the bridges, set your priorities, and trace your plan. No one must reach the summit!

  • Have a Blast!: The entire atmosphere is designed for a great time: attractive graphics, engaging sounds, and gameplay that is as satisfying as it is challenging.

store_data.about_the_game:
BND Legends: Operation Blackbox is a story-driven stealth and infiltration game that places you in the role of AJ, a field agent of the German Federal Intelligence Service. Your mission leads you deep into the high-security headquarters of Warlink.AI, a foreign tech corporation suspected of developing a devastating AI-powered cyber weapon known as T-Cell. Hidden somewhere inside the facility lies the Blackbox, a sealed server containing all research data. Your task is to infiltrate the complex, retrieve as much information as possible, and escape before the enemy security forces can react.

Your Team

AJ never enters the mission alone. She is supported remotely by two specialists who help shape every decision inside the field.
Atlas, the team’s geo-intelligence and tactics expert, scans the environment, reveals camera sightlines and patrol zones, and provides strategic guidance that helps you navigate the facility unseen. Ruby, the team’s hacker, accesses locked systems, manipulates devices, overrides defenses, and leads you through intricate hacking challenges that reach far into enemy networks. Together, the three agents form a tightly coordinated unit whose collaboration is crucial for the success of Operation Blackbox.

The Setting: Warlink.AI Headquarters

The entire operation takes place in the tech district of Te-Guug, the futuristic capital of Bethulan. Warlink.AI’s headquarters resembles a fortified research citadel made of steel, carbon and glass, guarded by drones, soldiers and cutting-edge surveillance technology. More than a simple office building, this sprawling facility houses experimental AI labs, production halls and deep server layers. Somewhere within this fortress lies the guarded Blackbox – your primary objective and the key to uncovering the T-Cell threat.

Gameplay and Mission

Your journey spans five atmospheric levels, each offering its own tone and set of challenges. The outer premises serve as a warm-up in which AJ learns to move silently and stay in the shadows. From there, you infiltrate the heavily monitored entrance complex, where disguises, misdirection and careful observation are the only ways to advance without raising suspicion.
The mission then leads you into a pitch-dark production hall, a maze filled with patrolling drones, industrial noise and a massive ceiling crane that you must carefully maneuver through a dangerous obstacle course while trying to restore the power supply.

Pressure intensifies as you reach the Quantum Layer, a high-tech server zone filled with patrols, platform puzzles and a temporary identity cloak that can collapse at the worst possible moment. After a security alert, every second counts while you fight your way toward the data vault before the entire area locks down.
The operation culminates inside a virtual data stream, where Ruby dives into a surreal digital environment, races through endless data corridors, evades firewalls and defensive protocols, and extracts the final pieces of intelligence needed to expose the full scope of the T-Cell weapon.

Atmosphere and Tension

BND Legends: Operation Blackbox blends stealth, strategy, dynamic environmental challenges and cinematic storytelling into a concentrated, high-tension experience. The world of Bethulan, infused with high-tech espionage, political intrigue and the looming threat of an AI catastrophe, creates a gripping backdrop for AJ’s mission. Working together with Atlas and Ruby, you must stay silent, stay hidden and stay in control. Every step in the shadows brings you closer to the Blackbox – or straight into danger.

store_data.about_the_game:
Brawl Arena Shooter is a fast-paced online arena shooter where cute animals unleash ridiculous firepower across tight, colorful battlegrounds. Dash through bushes, dodge incoming bullets, and outplay waves of opponents in chaotic Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch battles.

Jump into a lobby on your own, fill it with bots, or fight against real players — each match can host a large crowd of competitors at once. Rounds are short, explosive, and easy to pick up, but surviving the constant crossfire of bullets and power-ups takes real skill.

Earn XP from every takedown and climb through the progression system, then use the coins and gems you collect to unlock stronger heroes. Each character comes with its own balance of health, armor, attack power, and movement speed, making your choice of animal just as impactful as your aim.

Use the in-game chat to coordinate with teammates or taunt rivals, dominate the global leaderboard with your lifetime kill count, and prove who truly rules the arena.

Key Features

  • Large-Scale Online Battles: Dive into hectic Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch rounds packed with both real players and bots.

  • A Roster of Unique Animal Heroes: Begin with a starter hero and unlock many more using in-game earnings. Every character features distinct health, armor, attack, and speed attributes.

  • Hero-Focused Combat: Pick from a variety of weapon designs — purely cosmetic — while the real strength comes from your hero’s stats and your tactical movement on the battlefield.

  • Power-Ups Scattered Across the Map: Collect health boosts, damage enhancers, and speed pickups to shift the momentum of any fight.

  • Multiple Distinct Arenas: Master every pathway, choke point, and hiding spot across the available maps, from open firefights to bushy ambush zones.

  • Continuous Progression: Level up through consistent XP gains and unlock new heroes using coins and gems earned in matches.

  • Global Kill Leaderboard: Your cumulative eliminations contribute to a worldwide ranking — climb the board and cement your legacy.

  • Casual, Colorful, Always Online: Cartoon visuals, quick rounds, and simple controls make the game accessible for everyone, while constant action keeps every match engaging.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cute Away: Paws Caretaker Simulator creates a relaxing yet challenging experience where you turn an empty home into the ultimate feline caretaking home. It’s not just about petting cats it’s about managing resources, optimizing your space, and running an efficient household for your demanding little friends.

What does Cute Away: Paws Caretaker Simulator Offers?

Manage Your Supplies 

Your cats need more than just love; they need a steady stream of resources. Use your computer to order goods from the suppliers. Stock your shelves with food, litter, medicine, and toys. Keep a close eye on your inventory levels. Running out of kibble during dinner time is a recipe for disaster!

Design for Efficiency

Decoration meets optimization. While you want your house to look good, you also need a well-structured workflow.

  • Strategically place storage units near feeding zones to save time.

  • Arrange furniture to prevent "traffic jams" when multiple cats are playing.

  • Create an organized pipeline that allows you to clean, feed, and play without wasting a second.

Fulfill Unique Requests

Every cat has a personality and a specific set of needs. One might demand a high-tower scratcher, while another requests a specific brand of wet food.

  • Listen to your cats: Pay attention to their bubbles and body language.

  • Buy specialized furniture: Purchase specific items to satisfy their requests and boost their happiness.

  • Earn their trust: The better you fulfill their requests, the happier the colony becomes.

Upgrade & Expand

Start with a small room and limited funds. As you successfully care for more cats, you’ll earn the budget to expand your house. Unlock new rooms, buy high-tech automatic feeders, and upgrade your cleaning tools to handle the mess faster.

Playtime is Key

It’s not all work! Take a break from the management grind to grab a laser pointer or a feather wand. Engaging in physics-based play isn't just fun—it's essential for your cats' health and creates a bond that keeps them coming back for more.

store_data.about_the_game:
Corridor Duel is a modern 3D adaptation of the classic strategic board experience.
Your goal is simple: move your piece from one side of the board to the other.
But every match becomes a tactical mind game as you place walls, block paths, and reshape the battlefield with each turn.

Featuring clean visuals, smooth animation, and clear readability, Corridor Duel offers a focused, skill-based strategy experience. Every wall you place changes the outcome of the match, making each decision meaningful and each victory earned.

Play against smart AI opponents in single-player mode, challenge friends locally, and adapt your strategy through different themes and upcoming modes.

More difficulty levels, customization options, and multiplayer features will be added as development continues.

Key Features

  • Modern 3D board game adaptation

  • Strategic wall placement and path-blocking

  • Smart AI with multiple difficulty options

  • Fast, clean, and easy-to-read visual design

  • Local multiplayer support

  • Smooth animations and accessible UI

  • Upcoming features: advanced AI, new themes, online multiplayer modes

store_data.about_the_game:
🎃 Meat is Murder 🍽️

A Taste of Terror at La Maison du Manger de Madame Malacarne

Welcome to the most exclusive restaurant in Fromageham, UK, where the chandeliers glint like spotlights, the silverware sings, and something sinister stalks the kitchen. The Green Reaper! Cloaked in emerald velvet, carrying a carving knife instead of a scythe, and wearing a jack-o'-lantern grin that flickers in the dark. No one knows what... or who... lies beneath that pumpkin mask.

But here's the twist: in this restaurant, meat means survival.

Eat meat to heal your wounds... but every bite makes the Green Reaper faster.

Will you starve in fear, or feast yourself into a massacre?

Meanwhile, Lottie LeHottie, aspiring actress and waitress, has just arrived for her first shift. A shadow flickers? "Oooh, cinematic lighting!" A floorboard creaks? "Perfect for my close-up!" Patrons scream? "Ah, method acting!" To her, the terror is just part of the show... a whimsical stage for her boundless optimism.

🍖 Barry Bacon... The Butcher

Master of the cleaver, king of the carving block, and proud owner of the city's most "hands-on" handshake. His motto: "Respect the meat or meet the blade."

🍰 Lara L'Oeuf... The Pastry Princess

Sugary smile, soulless heart. Every tart a work of art... and every colleague a critic she's ready to torch. Her desserts were sweet, but her temper? Pure brûlée.

🔪 Phillippe Filet... The Golden Boy Sous Chef

Knife prodigy, showboat, and the poster boy of fine dining. He believed the kitchen was war, and he was born to win... until someone else carved the victory.

🍷 Marlin Merlot... The Sommelier

Wine snob extraordinaire. His nose could detect "notes of oak, despair, and mediocrity." He swirled, he sniffed, he sneered... and one night, he never resurfaced.

👩‍🍳 Madame Malacarne... The Head Chef

The matriarch of meat and mistress of misery. Her kitchen ran on fear, sweat, and blood... and she liked it that way.

🎭 "Bon appétit... or bon voyage."

In Meat Is Murder, every chef gets their just desserts... and every meal might be your last.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're the new hire in a weird office where they just want you to sort numbers in to buckets. Surely there must be more to the job than that? Sort numbers, earn employee merits, and manage your own team to prove you have what it takes to reach the top in a mysterious corporate workplace.

A short narrative-driven incremental management sim.

Welcome to Halcyon Dynamics, valued colleague.

In your exciting role in our new Digital Processing and Categorisation department you'll be expected to process digits as efficiently as you can. Owing to the nature of the recruitment and workplace commuting procedure, new employees often suffer from disorientation and confusion over their first few days. As a result we have compiled a helpful list of answers to common questions, below.

New Employee Frequently Asked Questions

  • How do I process a digit?

Simply click the Correct digits on your computer terminal.

  • How do I know what is a Correct digit?

Your computer terminal will tell you the digits the system currently requires you to process.

  • Are there opportunities for job progression?

That's what we like to see - a go getter! No wonder you were chosen for this department. Your line managers will keep a close eye on your processing metrics and Key Performance Indicators (or "KPIs", a term Halcyon recently coined). If you maintain high standards of work you will be eligible for promotion and will be allowed to begin hiring your own team.

  • Will I receive any management training?

Here at Halcyon we feel that direct training is burdensome and old thinking. Instead you will receive insightful messages and provocations from your line managers. These will be a mix of new, cutting edge, techniques with wisdom that they themselves found useful in your situation. Think of it less like formal training, and more like a mother cuckoo lovingly teaching their nest of chicks the Halcyon family ways.

  • Can I meet my team?

NO! You must not directly meet or communicate with other members of the Halcyon family. This rule was put in place for the mutual protection of our valued colleagues, and attempts to break it will be considered gross misconduct and result in immediate termination. We recognise the value of "water cooler chat" to morale however, so to replace those social situations we have a robust direct messaging service that your line managers will use to send you important missives, and that you and your team can use to "talk". Please be aware that messages are monitored for security purposes.

  • Am I allowed to decorate my work station?

We encourage employees to personalise their work area as studies have shown favourable results both quality and duration of time in the office, but for safety reasons we cannot allow you to bring items in from your own home. Instead we have set up a fun system of employee merits earned through satisfactory work, and a way to spend them on company-endorsed decorations that will brighten up your day and increase your productivity. Managers can even spend their own merits to treat their favourite team members, isn't that wholesome?

  • If I do not enjoy this new role, can I go back to my old job?

Staff rarely leave the Digital Processing and Categorisation department as it is very rewarding work (and because it is very new). If you do decide that you are unfit for such a prestigious role management will discuss your severance package with you directly, so that you can make the correct choice for your future prospects.

  • Why do digits need to be processed, is something weird going on here?

There is nothing weird going on here.

  • Why can't I remember arriving each morning?

---DOCUMENT ENDS---

store_data.about_the_game:
Lone Warrior is a minimalist fast-paced action roguelite with reaction-based, 1-on-1 battles and short, repeatable runs.
Time your dodges, strike during brief openings and spend the gold you keep after death to unlock new spells, stats and items.

Core gameplay loop:
– Dodge telegraphed enemy attacks in real time
– Hit back while enemies are standing still or recovering
– Kill mobs to earn gold and upgrade your hero between runs
– Unlock new skills, spells and builds in a branching skill tree

Each stage is a series of 10 duels in a row. You probably won’t clear it on your first attempt – but every enemy you kill gives you gold, letting you push further next time with a stronger build.

Inspired by JRPG-style 1-on-1 battles, Peglin-like progression and the reaction-based combat of Timing Hero with improved gameplay and pixel graphics.

In this cyberpunk point-and-click mystery, Rex stands accused of the unthinkable: murdering his best friend, Sara. To clear his name, he must partner with the victim herself — or rather, her wisecracking ghost — to expose conspiracies and determine his own fate.

WELCOME TO DISTRICT 13

This is an adventure game inspired by the classics. Explore the city of Neo Manchester. Solve puzzles and mysteries. Have fun chats with interesting people. Clear your name!

HACK SYSTEMS

Rex is an expert hacker, and can get into any system with the power of the “break game”! A “break game” is an arcade-style microgame that keeps the action fresh and lets your brain take a rest from all the puzzle solving.

TAKE CONTROL

Go on the computer! Read other people’s instant messages, steal their files, mess with their settings, and take control of any robots, cameras and drones you can find on the same network!

store_data.about_the_game:
Think Like a Block is a minimalist puzzle game focused on logic, quick experimentation, and precise movement. Each room works like a small reactive mechanism: blocks open doors, activate platforms, and reveal paths, while the environment responds clearly to every action.

Every block matters: pushing, aligning, grouping, pulling, or moving faster with your abilities changes the pace of the solution and creates a balance between thinking carefully and acting on impulse.

The game rewards intelligent trial and error, creative solutions, and that immediate “aha!” moment when everything clicks into place.

With its clean visuals, streamlined progression, and short challenges, Think Like a Block offers a sharp and polished experience, perfect for those who enjoy strategic puzzles with a touch of action and fluidity.

Highlights

• Block-Based Mechanics

Interact with blocks that activate doors, alter the environment, create paths, and unlock new areas.

• Special Abilities

Use unique powers that change the rhythm of gameplay and let you manipulate the environment in unexpected ways.

• Reactive and Dynamic Rooms

Every move influences the puzzle, environments shift and adapt as you progress.

• Short and Satisfying Challenges

Levels designed to engage your logic without unnecessary complexity.

• Clean and Light Aesthetic

A minimalist visual style optimized for any PC.

• Accessible Gameplay

Plays seamlessly with keyboard, mouse, or controller (Xbox, DualSense, and generic controllers supported).

store_data.about_the_game:
A remaster of the origin point for the doujin circle Ankake Spa, creators of Touhou: Scarlet Curiosity and Touhou: New World has hit the scene! Konpaku Youmu stars in a stage-based 3D bullet hell action game with an emphasize on simple but satisfying controls.

Story

Konpaku Youmu works as the gardener, security, and swordsmanship instructor for Saigyouji Yuyuko, mistress of Hakugyokurou.

One day, upon Youmu scolding her mistress for slacking off in her training, Yuyuko told her "with your lack of skill, there won't be any training."

Yuyuko then challenged her to prove herself by defeating the shrine maiden who'd resolved Gensokyo's incidents time and time again:

She was to go and defeat Hakurei Reimu.

Youmu wasn't happy with this, but showing awareness of her inexperience, she accepted her mistress's conditions and set off for Gensokyo.

Will she be able to overcome the dangers awaiting her, defeat Reimu, and prove her skills to Yuyuko?

Gameplay

Use Three Skills to Clear Stages and Beat Bosses!

Youmu has three skills that each have their own strong points – movement, area damage, and range, as well as high-damage Spell Card. They'll come in handy when clearing stages if used well!

For example, your dash skill can help extend your jump range as well as do damage, and your ranged skill can defeat troublesome foes waiting on the other side of gaps.

Farm Combos to Turn the Tides

Continuing to hit enemies will raise your combo counter, granting bonuses to your score and skill recharge rate.

The latter bonus lets you use your skills much more often, making battles much easier.

Difficulty Options

Play on Easy, Hard, or Normal; whichever suits your skill level.

Music

Touhou: Blossom Blade features Touhou arranges from Shoichiro Sakamoto, AKA Sound Sepher, to make stages feel even more alive.

What's New to the Steam Version?

Each Skill Has its Own Button!

Previously, you toggle between between Youmu's three skills as you fought, but the skill controls have been updated to be more intuitive.

Other Changes

  • Steam Achievements

  • Balance changes

  • More breakable objects

  • HUD additions

  • No more fall penalty

  • Graphics optimized for modern hardware

─────────────────────

This game is a Touhou Project fangame.

store_data.about_the_game:
Siege at Sundown – a 1v1 tactical PvP strategy about castle sieges

Siege at Sundown is a 1v1 top-down PvP strategy game about short, high-stakes sieges.
By day you hunt for coins and strengthen your fortress, by night construction is locked and the siege begins. Each night is longer than the last, and the final night is endless until one fortress falls.

Day: hunt and build

During the day a truce protects all buildings: you cannot damage structures yet, but heroes and armies fight over coins and artifacts on a symmetrical map.
You contest monster camps, coin spots, chests and safe artifact stalls, upgrading your defenses and preparing for the coming night.

There is a single resource: coins.
Your hero carries them in a bag – if you die, you drop part of what you carry and your opponent can pick it up. To avoid losing everything, you can return to the fortress and bank your income in the treasury, where it is safe. Construction and upgrades spend coins from both bag and treasury, so every push on the map is a risk–reward decision you make.

Night: raids and siege

When the sun sets, the truce ends.
You can no longer place new buildings – you must fight with what you managed to build. All your daytime choices turn into power for your army and hero across night raids. Each night is longer than the previous one, and the final night has no timer until one castle goes down.

At the center of the map stands the Temple of Plenty.
By the third night, players are strong enough to contest the temple, defeat its boss and construct a civilization-specific temple. It applies ticking damage to the enemy fortress and prevents matches from stalling into endless, passive defense.

Heroes as civilizations

Seven starting heroes each represent a full civilization and a playstyle:
northern mountain clans, a pirate confederation, eastern sultanates, a techno-theocracy of the future, a masked Renaissance canal city, Slavic marshlands and jade provinces.

Every hero combines a classic role archetype (tank, duelist, mage, commander, assassin, engineer, warrior) with their own architecture, building priorities and tempo.

Each hero has two active abilities and one passive.
Instead of classic mana there are energy shards that are spent on abilities and regenerate one by one over time. The system is simple to read but creates a lot of timing decisions: when to dive, when to fall back and when to hold charges for the next fight.

Readable low-poly combat

The combat is built around clarity:

  • a top-down camera,

  • thick tracers for projectiles,

  • high-contrast cones and zones for attacks,

  • short audio cues for key events.

It should always be clear who hit whom and with what.
A faceted low-poly art style keeps the screen clean, looks good on video and is friendly to weaker PCs – making the game comfortable for streaming and for play on Steam Deck.

Key features

  • 1v1 top-down PvP strategy with short, intense matches.

  • Clear “Day → Night” cycle: hunt and build by day, raid and siege by night.

  • Single-currency coin economy: risk carrying coins in your bag versus safe banking in the treasury.

  • Seven hero-civilizations with unique roles, architecture and playstyles.

  • Temple of Plenty in the center as an anti-stall mechanic that pushes matches to a decisive end.

  • Simple but expressive shard-based ability resource instead of classic mana.

  • Faceted low-poly visuals tuned for combat readability and streaming.

  • Controller support and a comfortable experience on Steam Deck.

store_data.about_the_game:
World without Time is a third-person atmospheric adventure set in a ruined world frozen between the past and the future. These lands were once filled with light, warmth, and magic, but a catastrophe destroyed everything. Now only an endless frozen wasteland remains, covered in ash, ice, and silence.

You play as a fire alicorn (Lieris) — a lone wanderer who has lost their past. Your journey changes the moment you encounter a small version of yourself — Little Lieris. From that moment on, you must not only explore the world but also take care of the child who represents your own forgotten past.

Features

  • Exploration of a post-apocalyptic world.
    Travel through ruined valleys, frozen forests, and abandoned structures. Each region contains fragments of the fallen civilization and pieces of a story you must uncover.

  • Flight and vertical gameplay.
    Use your wings and magic to traverse large distances, soar above snowstorms, and descend into hard-to-reach places.

  • Magic and combat system.
    Fight shadows of the past using fire spells, magical spears, charged attacks, and evasive maneuvers. The combat focuses on positioning, timing, and ranged abilities.

  • Care system for Little Lieris.
    Little Lieris travels with you. You must protect her, calm her, help her, teach her, and make choices that shape her character. The way you treat her determines who she becomes and whether she will be able to help you during crucial moments of the story. This system directly affects the game's ending.

  • Story based on player choice.
    Your decisions shape the story, the child's attitude toward you, and the world around you. There are no right or wrong choices — only actions and consequences.

  • Multiple endings.
    The ending depends on your decisions, the way you cared for Lieris, and the secrets you uncovered throughout your journey.

  • Atmospheric presentation.
    The game focuses on mood, silence, loneliness, and emotion. Wind, snow, fire, music, and light work together to create a meditative, immersive atmosphere of a destroyed world.

What to expect

  • single-player story

  • exploration of open spaces

  • magic abilities

  • light combat

  • relationship system with little Lieris

  • flight mechanics

  • hidden lore

  • multiple endings

  • strong focus on atmosphere and narrative

World description

These lands were once full of life, joy, and magic. But the world collapsed, leaving behind only a grey wasteland, ash, and lost memories. You are a fire alicorn wandering through a ruined world, searching for answers to a question too frightening to ask.

Everything changes when you meet the one you once were — Little Lieris. She is vulnerable, frightened, and dependent on you. By caring for her, you care for yourself. By uncovering the world’s mystery, you uncover your own.

Can you protect her?
Can you accept the truth when it finally appears?
Can you find hope in a world where time has stopped?

Developed entirely by a solo creator, Elemental Clash Arena blends stylish action with deep combat mechanics to deliver an experience that’s easy to pick up—but endlessly rewarding to master.

Unleash your power through a combo-driven combat system designed for creative expression. Chain aerial juggles, dodge-cancels, elemental finishers, and character-specific techniques to overwhelm your opponent. Every fighter wields unique elemental abilities that shape their playstyle—burn foes with blazing rushdowns, freeze the battlefield with precision ice traps, shock enemies with lightning-fast mix-ups, and more.

Choose from a roster of distinct, hand-crafted characters, each with their own fighting philosophy, special skills, and explosive super attacks. Whether you’re battling solo or facing off against friends, the game’s local multiplayer makes every match a spectacle.

Featuring striking anime visuals, dynamic effects, and smooth animation, Elemental Clash Arena brings every punch, blast, and combo to life.

Key Features
🔥 Anime-style arena combat full of personality and flair
🌪️ Elemental powers that define each character’s playstyle
⚔️ Deep combo system with cancels, launchers, and finishers
✨ Unique special abilities for every fighter
👥 Local multiplayer for intense couch battles
🎭 A diverse cast of original characters
🎨 Beautiful visuals and effects crafted by a solo developer

Prepare to enter the arena—master your element, perfect your combos, and claim victory in Elemental Clash Arena.

store_data.about_the_game:
What you do:

  • Everything on Black! Build a balanced deck of fighters - or double down on specific outcomes.

  • Spin the wheel and watch the fight

  • Unlock new cards and build up your options over time.

How it works:

Fighters multiply the winning number to block and attack - if their color matches the winning color. Each fighter also has a specific rule, for example "Extra attack if number < 5" or "Ignore enemy block".

Enhancements change the roulette wheel: Increase the probability for a specific number, or all odd numbers, or a whole color - or change numbers altogether. 

After each opponent you choose a new card - either fighter or enhancement.

Decisions you'll need to make:

Strengthen your build - or bend the odds in your favour. More fighters mean more combat potential - but tweaking the wheel with enhancements can give you a decisive edge. Will you go for an all-red army composition and boost the likelihood for the ball to land on red? Or do you go balanced and tweak the odds away from the extremes to take down your opponents in a more controlled fashion?

It's all luck - but in Brawlette fortune favours the bold!

store_data.about_the_game:
"Whispers of Ai" is a new-sensation, female-oriented healing visual novel where the storyline unfolds through your conversations. You discover a heavily damaged talking robot named Ai in a beautiful, forgotten courtyard.

 

Discuss a wide variety of topics with Ai to help him restore his energy and repair his broken appearance. The main plot is cleverly hidden within hundreds of randomized everyday topics. All in-game text is 100% human-written, simulating the organic freedom and unpredictability of an AI chat but with genuine emotional depth.

As your bond deepens, Ai's attitude towards you will gradually change. Step by step, he will transform from a stiff, emotionless machine into a gentle, devoted partner, and ultimately, your lover.

As a highly intelligent robot, Ai isn't just for chatting. He can take you on virtual journeys using holographic projections, or quietly act as your productivity assistant, accompanying you to stay focused on your work and studies.

Uncover the deeply hidden secrets of Ai's origins and learn about the unknown tragic past he has kept to himself.

Experience the final outcome of your journey together. Ai's ultimate fate rests entirely in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tiny Egg Clicker is an idle pet-collecting clicker game that keeps you company at the bottom of your screen. Relax to chill Lofi music while you play at your own pace.

HATCH EGGS

Help your pet hatch by clicking the egg! The egg will passively progress towards hatching on its own, but will always wait for your final 3 clicks to finish hatching.

GENERATE GOLD

You generate gold by clicking the egg or your pets. Pets also generate gold every second on their own.

BUY NEW EGGS AND UPGRADES

Use your gold to buy more eggs and level up your pets. Buy new upgrades to make your clicks more powerful and improve your pet’s passive gold generation to become the ultimate hatcher!

LEVEL UP YOUR PETS

Once you have a pet species roaming your desktop, any eggs of that species that you hatch will make it level up instead of adding another copy of it. With each new level, the pet will give more gold per second and increase its shiny chance for the next time you hatch it.

INTERACT WITH YOUR PETS

Your pets don’t require your attention and are content just keeping you company, but they’ll be extra happy and give you bonus gold if you click on them!

HATCH SHINY VARIANTS

By leveling up your pets and buying the shiny charms upgrades you increase your chances of hatching a shiny pet! Shiny variants will be a different copy of the pet on your desktop, so you'll have both the normal and shiny variants.

OTHER FEATURES

Freely drag the egg anywhere you want on your screen!

store_data.about_the_game:
“Luck, temptation, and the smile of a goddess… Your night begins now.”

■ Game Overview

Lucky Bunny Casino - Alluring Collection is an adult entertainment game that lets you enjoy three popular casino classics — Texas Hold’em, Baccarat, and Up & Down — all in one place.

Players bet their game money and join a variety of gambling modes. Win the games and use the Gold (G) you’ve earned to unlock and collect alluring photos and videos of beautiful characters.

It’s a sensual casino simulation that combines the thrill of victory with the pleasure of collection.

And there’s more — a Fortuna’s Lottery Machine, blessed by the true goddess of luck herself.

Draw your own lucky numbers and see what fate has in store for you.

To play, you’ll need to gather in-game Gold (G).

Each game — Texas Hold’em, Baccarat, and Up & Down — offers different rooms based on your balance.

The higher the room tier, the greater the stakes — and the higher both your potential winnings and your risks.

Challenge yourself in one of the five table tiers: LOW, MID, HIGH, VIP, and ROYAL, and prove your skill and luck.

■ Three Game Modes

① Texas Hold’em

A strategic poker game where you combine two personal cards with five community cards to create the best possible poker hand.

Players must pay a buy-in before joining.

Each round is a four-player match — you versus three AI opponents.

If your remaining gold drops below a certain amount, you’ll be forced to leave the table.

The last player standing wins the match.

Of course, you can leave the game at any time.

Walking away after earning enough profit can also be a wise move.

If your gold balance falls below the threshold, you lose the game.

Defeat the three AI opponents and claim victory!

Texas Hold’em is not purely a game of luck — your judgment, patience, and courage determine the outcome.

Show off your skills and prove your nerve.

② Baccarat

One of the most popular and fastest-paced casino games in the world.

Two or three cards are drawn, and the side whose final digit is closest to 9 wins.

You can bet on either PLAYER or BANKER as the winner, or wager on TIE, PLAYER PAIR, or BANKER PAIR for additional odds.

Each room has different minimum and maximum betting limits, depending on its tier.

On the right side of the screen, you can check the history board, showing the ratio and sequence of PLAYER, BANKER, and TIE outcomes — a valuable hint for your next bet.

When luck and instinct align, the payouts can be truly extraordinary.

③ Up & Down

A simple yet thrilling number-guessing game.

The numbers range from 1 to 9, and you must guess whether the next number will be higher or lower than the current one.

The game starts with the light on number 5.

You bet on whether the next number will be UP (higher) or DOWN (lower) — note that the same number will never appear twice in a row.

Each room has a fixed betting amount, automatically placed at the start of each round.

At the top of the screen, you can check your secured amount, odds, and potential winnings based on the odds.

For example:

If you start with a 100G bet, your secured amount is 100.

Both UP and DOWN have an initial odds of 2.0, meaning each would yield 200G if correct.

Choose either UP or DOWN — if you win, you earn 200G and the secured amount increases.

If you bet UP and the next number is 6, your new secured amount becomes 200G.

Now, the screen might show UP odds at 2.7 (540G possible) and DOWN odds at 1.6 (320G possible).

Continue as long as you dare — the more you win in a row, the greater the payout.

But beware — one wrong move can take it all.

Will you stop and collect, or keep going for glory? The choice is yours.

■ Special System – “Fortuna’s Lucky Numbers”

Believe it or not, this is a true lottery number generator blessed by the goddess of fortune herself.

Players can set their desired number range (0–99) and the number of draws (up to 10),

and the goddess Fortuna will personally reveal the lucky numbers meant just for you.

When true luck is with you, she may even appear before you — smiling and beckoning with her divine hand.

These numbers can even be used as a reference when purchasing real lottery tickets,

and the very act of “receiving your lucky numbers” can become a fun and shareable moment within the community.

Test your luck — perhaps the next winning ticket will be yours.

Continue as long as you dare — the more you win in a row, the greater the payout.

But beware — one wrong move can take it all.

Will you stop and collect, or keep going for glory? The choice is yours.

and the goddess Fortuna will personally reveal the lucky numbers meant just for you.

When true luck is with you, she may even appear before you — smiling and beckoning with her divine hand.

These numbers can even be used as a reference when purchasing real lottery tickets,

and the very act of “receiving your lucky numbers” can become a fun and shareable moment within the community.

Test your luck — perhaps the next winning ticket will be yours.

About This Game

Horny Jail: Conjugal Visits

You're a new guard at Horny Jail—the meme prison where the horniest offenders are sent. Your job is to supervise conjugal visits and "definitely NOT" participate. Problem: every inmate is insanely hot and determined to corrupt you. Can you survive your first week without getting "bonked" yourself?

Game Overview

Horny Jail: Conjugal Visits is a comedy dating sim visual novel that turns the "go to horny jail" meme into an absurd, sexy adventure. Navigate your duties as a prison guard while five beautiful inmates try to seduce you—and your stern warden boss keeps catching you at the worst moments.

Features

- Five Hot Inmates: Each with their own seduction style

- Bambi (The Innocent): Pastel pink hair, acts innocent but is secretly the horniest one. "Uwu, I didn't mean to~"

- Valentina (The Seductress): Red hair, zero shame, treats conjugal visits like a sport. Openly flirty and confident.

- Jade (The Reformed): Black hair, glasses, claims she's changed and found Jesus. Definitely hasn't. Librarian energy gone wrong.

- Cherry (The First-Timer): Blonde, nervous newbie who YOU accidentally corrupt through "training." Too pure for this place (for now).

- Scarlett (The Repeat Offender): Purple hair with undercut, been here 47 times, basically runs the place. Knows where the cameras don't reach.

- Warden Steele: Your stern boss who keeps catching you. Silver hair, glasses, clipboard always in hand. Secretly jealous of the inmates.

- Comedy & Romance: Experience absurd situations where every "innocent" interaction turns into a seduction attempt. Meme-heavy dialogue and fourth-wall breaking humor.

- Multiple Endings: Will you resist temptation? Give in to one inmate? Or get caught by the warden? Your choices determine your fate.

- Horny Jail Locations: Explore the pastel pink prison facility with heart-shaped bars, conjugal visit rooms, shower areas, cafeteria, and the warden's office.

Story

You just got hired as a guard at Horny Jail—the internet's favorite meme prison. Your first day, you meet five inmates who are way too attractive for their own good. Your job is simple: supervise conjugal visits and maintain order. But when every inmate is determined to seduce you, and your warden keeps walking in at the worst moments, surviving your first week becomes a challenge.

Can you resist temptation? Or will you end up in horny jail yourself?

This game contains mature themes including explicit sexual content, adult situations, and NSFW scenes. Recommended for mature audiences only (18+).

store_data.about_the_game:
A chaotic PVP party game where you and your friends play as unhinged birds battling over a single precious egg. Use open voice chat to bluff, squawk, scream, and strategize as you dive-bomb enemies, steal their egg, and rush it back to your nest. Fast, frantic, and hilariously loud. This is bird warfare at its finest. Based off the viral meme Bird Game.

🪺 Capture the Egg

The heart of every match is a single, precious egg. Sneak, swoop, or straight-up bully your way into the enemy nest, grab the egg, and haul it home. But holding the egg slows you down—and paints a giant target on your feathery backside. Expect desperate chases, mid-air tackles, and last-second steals that turn the whole match upside down.

🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat

Hear your enemies getting closer… literally. With open proximity chat, nearby players can shout at you, bluff strategies, fake callouts, or panic-scream as they close in. Trash talk becomes a weapon. Strategy becomes chaos. Every match sounds like a wildlife documentary gone horribly wrong.

🪹 Battle Nest: Season 1

Climb the free seasonal Battle Nest to unlock new birds and more.

👥 Team-Based Mayhem

Work together with your flock to set ambushes, defend the nest, run decoy plays, or sacrifice yourself for the egg carrier. Even better—use voice chat to plan, deceive, or intentionally confuse your enemies. Team synergy is powerful… but betrayals are hilarious.

💥 Fast, Frenzied Gameplay

Matches are short, explosive, and always chaotic. Dive-bomb enemies, flap into walls, tackle birds mid-flight, drop the egg on purpose to fake out pursuers, or scream as you’re yeeted into the sky. Every round is unpredictable, loud, and endlessly replayable.

🐦 Choose Your Bird

Pick from an expanding roster of iconic (and slightly feral) birds—each with their own look, personality, and movement quirks.

  • Seagull: Loud, aggressive, loves stealing anything not nailed down.

  • Pigeon: Fast, slippery, perfect for quick snatches and escapes.

  • Parrot: Mimics callouts and causes maximum confusion.

  • …and more unique birds added each season.

Begin your career at the Multiversal Institute for the Rhythmic Arts (MIRA), an interdimensional school where music, magic, and friendship collide. 

Recruit new friends from across realities and times to form a band that will rival the ages and unlock the power of rhythm with your bonds. Can your band make the audience scream Encore!?

Encore! is a rhythm game and a visual novel where you play as a new student at the Multiversal Institute for the Rhythmic Arts (MIRA). Practice your performance skills by tapping the arrow keys in time with songs, and gain access to new music and instruments by making friends at school. Curate your band from a slew of unique characters: a wild-western alien guitarist, an edgy angel harpist, a Victorian bassoonist, and many more. Learn more about each character’s story and play well with them to gain their affection. Win the Battle of the Bands at the end of the school year and make the audience yell Encore!

The game features a 45-minute main campaign and a free-play mode to try out any song in the game.

This game was made by a student team, many of whom are first-time developers, at Amoriem Labs, the game development club at Yale! Follow us  for more updates.

Step into a near-future cyberpunk Chicago — a dazzling metropolis built on neon glamour, corporate power, and hidden control. Behind the city’s beauty lies the Veil, a mysterious force that distorts reality, erases truth, and keeps the population obedient.
When the Veil falters around you, forgotten memories awaken… and so do abilities you were never meant to possess.

Play as a lone outsider in a story-rich action adventure, navigating a city where every alley hides danger, every skyscraper hides secrets, and every choice pulls you deeper into a sci-fi conspiracy that reshapes Chicago’s fate.

Use supernatural powers, high-tech firearms, stealth tactics, and fast movement as you uncover the truth behind the Veil — and face the forces determined to keep the city blind.

Explore the open world, fight corporate enforcers, outsmart surveillance systems, and rise against a regime built to control every thought and every moment.

store_data.about_the_game:
An explorer has disturbed your slumber, and even worse, he stole Nilo 🙀!

In Mummy’s Escape, you will join Rek on a chase through a temple that isn't quite how you remember it. But don't worry, you aren't helpless: you have the power to change your size at will.

Running isn't enough here. To overcome ancient traps, you'll have to use your head... and your whole body. Here is how it works:

  • Large Form: Is a giant box blocking your path? Grow huge and move it as if it were paper. Sometimes, brute force is the only solution!

  • Medium Form: Your natural state. Perfect for swinging around and overcoming challenges with agility.

  • Skull Form: A tiny gap? Need to smash something? Detach your head and roll. You are fast and lethal, but watch out: if you take too long, you won't make it!

This is no walk in the museum. Each zone has its own master and its own rules.

  • Take Back What's Yours: The explorer thinks he won, but you are the Pharaoh. Chase him to the very end.

  • Zone Guardians: A Boss awaits at the end of each area; you'll need to defeat them using your wits.

  • Puzzles with History: The walls speak. Activate forgotten mechanisms and discover what happened in your absence.

Add us to your Wishlist and join us on this adventure. Rek is waiting for you!

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep Board Go brings Go, also known as 围棋 / 圍棋 / 바둑 / 囲碁, into a modern 3D experience.

  • Recreates the feeling of different premium Go sets with realistic stones and handcrafted boards

  • Challenge a computer Go opponent powered by an optimized Go engine

  • Take full control of the board: rotate the camera, zoom in close, change lighting etc

DeepBoardGO is for those seeking a different feeling and a fresh experience. The physical beauty of Go, the weight of the stones, the grain of the board, is a big part of what makes the game so captivating. This 3D interpretation brings that tactile elegance into the digital world, letting you feel closer to the board and enriching your enjoyment of every move.

DeepBoardGO 将古老而迷人的围棋带入精美的 3D 数字世界。无论你是经验丰富的棋手，还是刚刚接触围棋的新人，都能在这里感受到如同亲手落子的真实体验：饱满的棋子、细腻的木纹、沉稳的质感，一切都为还原高级棋具的魅力而设计。

你可以享受传统对弈的宁静氛围，也可以挑战强大的 30 级 Computer Go，体验策略博弈的紧张刺激。

随心掌控棋局视角：旋转、缩放、拉近、切换光影、替换棋盘与棋子材质，让每一盘棋都独具你的风格。

不论是做死活题、复盘经典对局，还是逐级提升棋力，DeepBoardGO 都为你提供沉浸而愉悦的学习与对弈方式。

DeepBoardGO は、囲碁の timeless な戦略性を、美しく洗練された 3D デジタル体験へと昇華した作品です。熟練の打ち手はもちろん、これから囲碁を始めたい方にも、手に取るようなリアルさを味わっていただけます。丸みのある碁石の質感、盤木の温もり、細やかな木目まで――高級な碁盤セットの魅力を忠実に再現しました。

静かで落ち着いた対局の雰囲気に浸るもよし。強力な 30 段階 Computer Go に挑み、読みの深さを競い合うもよし。遊び方はあなた次第です。

カメラの回転やズーム、光源設定、盤面・石のスタイル変更など、自由自在に視点を操れます。毎局、あなたらしい演出で楽しめます。

死活問題の練習、名局の研究、Computer Goレベルを上げながらの棋力向上――DeepBoardGO は、囲碁を学び、楽しむための、没入感に満ちた体験を提供します。

DeepBoardGO는 바둑의 timeless 전략을 아름다운 3D 디지털 세계로 가져왔습니다. 경험 많은 기력자부터 처음 바둑을 접하는 사람까지, 누구나 실제 바둑 세트를 만지는 듯한 생생한 감각을 느낄 수 있습니다. 묵직한 돌, 정교한 나뭇결, 섬세한 질감까지 — 고급 바둑판의 매력을 충실히 재현했습니다.

전통 대국의 평온한 분위기를 즐기거나, 30레벨 강력한 Computer Go에 도전하여 치열한 전략 승부를 펼쳐보세요.

시점을 자유롭게 회전하고 확대/축소하며, 조명이나 바둑판·바둑돌 스타일도 변경할 수 있습니다. 매 대국이 나만의 분위기로 펼쳐집니다.

사활 문제 연습, 명국 복기, Computer Go 난이도 단계별 도전까지 — DeepBoardGO는 학습도 즐거움도 모두 잡은 몰입감 있는 바둑 경험을 제공합니다.

DeepBoardGO 將古老而迷人的圍棋帶入精緻的 3D 數位世界。無論你是經驗豐富的棋手，還是初次接觸圍棋的新手，都能在這裡感受到宛如親手落子的真實感受：飽滿的棋子、細膩的木紋、沉穩的質感，一切都為重現高級棋具的魅力而打造。

你可以享受傳統對局的寧靜氛圍，也可以挑戰強大的 30 級 Computer Go，體驗策略博弈的緊張刺激。

隨心掌控棋盤視角：旋轉、縮放、拉近、切換光影、替換棋盤與棋子材質，讓每一局棋都擁有專屬你的風格。

無論是做死活題、複盤經典名局，還是逐級提升棋力，DeepBoardGO 都為你提供沉浸而愉悅的學習與對弈方式。

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Batamonisk. This world has its own story, One that you, Nakato. Will be following up on. A Story or Rumor about this area says about a Fight a long time ago. A Holy dragon who Fought a Demon king. Rumors say the Demon King won that fight, Taking the holy dragons soul to prevent it from ever ascending or escaping. Taking over Batamonisk and causing the townspeople to flee. What was left of the townspeople, That is. Supposedly, As they fought. Many people died from flying debris or Explosions they just happened to be near. Will you Debunk this Myth Nakato, Or will you end up with a different plan upon arrival? You can only find out by getting there. Perhaps.. You are the story.

Remember: Hope dies last, Fight for the Dawn.

How to Play: Arrow keys are used for movement, X is for your menu and Z is to confirm a selection. X can also be used as back button. 

With the Built in Soundtracks by RPG maker VX ace, Including the Heavy metal DLC, The music in fights is Uplifting and fits the Turn Based combat.

This game has a total of 4 endings for BOTH the Main and Side story

The side story consists of playing as a little girl called Atilina. She left home to look for her father after an event that happened a while ago. But she seems to Break time and Results in a Time Paradox. Will you still fix the world, or are you going to fail and collapse with the tides?

store_data.about_the_game:
Playtest

I'm sharing the entire development journey and I'd love to get continous feedback to help development! (See the YouTube link in the sidebar)

  • Right click inside the "zone" to start building!

  • You can move, resize, combine, split, and delete shapes in there

  • Select two shapes in the zone, and then right click one, to see the "joint" menu

Current State

The game is very rough around the edges and even crashes sometimes (mostly when shapes are deleted by colliding too hard), so be warned, save often!

You can enable god mode with G, but that's only meant for testing purposes.

Press Esc -> Controls to see a list of all controls.

Survival Scenario

A randomized spawn on a planet with average gravity. Use your initial minimal resources to build a contraption to try and bring back a boulder to the station, increasing your resources. You can build and delete anything that's inside the "zone" (focus on one of the walls to activate it).

Venture east to find an abandoned miner, if you manage to bring power and storage then you can fire it up the get even more resources!

Once you've attained some rare resources you can construct more Zone Modules, letting you modify your zone! If you chose to expand your starter zone you'll need a contraption that can for example lift and torch your wall, to insert more segments by lifting and welding them together. But be careful! The physics are generalized, you could slap a thruster on a planet for example, to change its orbit.

store_data.about_the_game:
From a tiny camp to a great Sancak — build your dynasty


14th-century Anatolia. You stand at the head of a small Kayı tribe. A handful of tents, scarce resources, a harsh winter at the door. You are the Bey — feed your people, marry them off, raise warriors against wolf raids, and lead them on a journey from a humble Oba (camp) to a great Sancak (province).

Every villager has a story

  • 12 character traits — Diligent, Lazy, Cowardly, Faithful, Generous, Stingy, Perfectionist, Charismatic, Antisocial, Hasty, Arrogant, Humble. Each one affects work speed, combat behavior, and marriage chances with concrete percentages.
  • Dynasties and family trees — Kayı, Kınık, Bayat, Yıva, Salur, Avşar... Every villager's family, children, and heirs are tracked. When the Bey dies, succession rules kick in.
  • Life cycle — Baby → Child → Adult → Elder → Death. Every age means different productivity, a different story.
  • Inner-voice system — Focus on a villager and a thought bubble appears above their head. A hungry villager says "My belly aches — last bite I had was yesterday"; a sick miner says "This sickness came from the mine — stone dust in my lungs."

A living Anatolia

  • 4 seasons, 3 year types — Bountiful, Normal, Drought. Determined at year start — preparation is essential.
  • Dynamic weather — Rain, snow, storms. Villagers shelter during storms; those without warm clothes freeze in winter.
  • Disease and healing — Plague, dysentery, malaria. Healers treat with Anatolian herbs — hygiene is critical.
  • Wolf raids, Byzantine forces, Mongol raiders — Three enemy types, each demanding different tactics.
  • Alp warrior training — Send villagers to the armory for sword and shield. Shields block 70% of damage.

Depth and progression

  • 5 village stages — Camp → Village → Town → Beylik → Sancak. Each stage unlocks new buildings.
  • 25+ building types — Mosque, trade house, cookhouse, smithy, weaver, pen, well, healer's tent, archer tower...
  • 50+ research projects — One free pick per village level. Production speed, combat, religious teaching, and more.
  • Building upgrades (1–5 stars) — +50% speed, +80% yield. Three villagers do the work of five.
  • Hijri calendar — Ramadan, Friday prayer, religious holidays affect morale. With a mosque built, Faithful villagers gain 2× morale.

For fans of Banished, RimWorld, Crusader Kings, Manor Lords

If you love the human stories behind the numbers, if deep colony mechanics excite rather than tire you, if Turkish-Islamic history calls to you with the promise of an atmospheric world — this game will speak to you. Play for years, write a different fate each run.

This game isn't for you if

  • You want big-studio realistic graphics (this game is stylized, low-poly)
  • You want multiplayer (currently single-player)
  • You expect fast-paced action

A note from the developer

I've been building this game alone for 2 years. It's an Anatolian story I've long dreamed of bringing to life. No studio, no budget — just a dream and a labor of love. I chose a stylized, low-poly look because my time is limited; this way I could spend all my energy on the depth of story and mechanics.

— Mustafa

Early Access — targeting late 2026

The game is in active development. The version you receive will keep growing — new buildings, mechanics, content. Community feedback shapes the direction.

Wishlist now to be the first to know when it launches.

store_data.about_the_game:
<Food! Explosions! Victory!>

'Full Course Mayhem' is a rhythm adventure game.

Run a restaurant as the only human living in the Land of Monsters.

<Restaurant Management>

While running your restaurant, cool (or not-so-cool) Monsters customers will come to visit you.

Cook dishes by pressing buttons to the beat! You can use WASD & Enter, Arrow Keys & Spacebar, or customize the keybindings to fit your style. Gamepads are also supported!

However, Monsters won't just sit quietly and wait for their food.

Monsters will make their presence known in various ways, and that can be quite harmful to you. It's not that they're evil. They simply lack understanding of human fragility and are a bit clumsy with their expressions.

Anyway, serve dishes that perfectly match the Monsters' tastes and survive their eccentric tantrums!

<Adventure>

Your life continues outside the restaurant as well.      

Explore the realm of Monsters, make friends, and go on adventures with them.

Prepare for competitions as a martial artist's coach, help a back-alley detective with their work…

Even assemble parts of a combining robot to explore the secrets of ancient dinosaurs…

Extraordinary journeys are waiting just for you to join!

Build bonds with regular customers, become true friends, and obtain items that help with restaurant management.

<And Much More!>

To be continued!

store_data.about_the_game:
“KUMASAMA” is a horror adventure set in the present day.

◆Story

Recently, bear attacks have been occurring all over the country.

I saw something about it on the news, but I was sure it had nothing to do with life in my town.

…Or so I thought.

Someone spotted a large brown silhouette lurking in the darkness, at night, in an abandoned factory.

There’s no doubt that something terrifying and enormous is hiding in this town.

…and eventually, I came to understand that the “something” was her.

I think of her—and of the days I can never return to.

◆Gameplay Features

A walking simulator where events unfold as you explore.

Inspect objects to progress the story.

No quest markers or time limits—play at your own pace.

“She” is timid, but her claws are sharp.

Playtime: 10–40 minutes

◆Guidelines for Video Streaming

Both individuals and organizations may stream the game without prior permission.

store_data.about_the_game:
The metro is no longer a place of transit. It's a tomb.

In Hunted Within the Metro, you break free from underground imprisonment only to discover that escape is far more complicated than survival.

Pilot your own survival train through an abandoned metro system ,it's your mobile base, your refuge, and your key to reaching new areas, From Dark Tunnels, and Underworld Caverns ,to Frozen Surface.

Fight Diverse Threats: Giant scorpions, burrowing mutant worms, and other monsters and abominations using an arsenal of weapons melee ,pistol, shotgun, and SMG.

Beware: twisted traps are sometimes deadlier than beasts!

Scavenge supplies, gather resources ,craft weapons, complete missions, and gradually uncover the conspiracy that put you in chains.

Every tunnel leads somewhere. Every choice brings you closer to escape ,or deeper into the nightmare.

store_data.about_the_game:
Space Aces is an indie browser-based space shooter that plunges you into an online universe full of action, strategy, and fierce competition. Step into the cockpit and evolve from a rookie pilot into the most feared Ace in the galaxy! Battle through thrilling encounters against more than 30 unique alien threats and test your skills against others in intense Player versus Player space dogfights.

Choose and customize your ship from an expansive arsenal featuring 10 distinct ship types with over 100 possible configurations, each capable of turning the tide of battles! Acquire elite gear, ships, forge powerful alliances and create and manage your own clan to become feared by all other aces! Build battle stations with multiple defence and offence capabilities, ranging from good old reliable Space Nukes, to hi-tech plasma beams and enforce your control over all space sectors in exciting and entising PvP battles!

So, do you have what it takes? Your spaceship is waiting for you pilot!

store_data.about_the_game:
Meet Sir Quichotte, your desktop knight. Watch this brave knight battle hordes of undead while you work, study, or relax. Features Lofi music and a deep idle RPG experience that lives right on your desktop.

🖥️ Your Desktop's Most Valiant Defender Awaits

Sir Quichotte stands guard at the bottom of your screen, a tireless knight who asks nothing but to protect his realm. While you tackle your daily tasks, he battles waves of undead, grows stronger, and unlocks devastating abilities—all without demanding (much) attention.

Build. Fight. Optimize. Repeat. With three skill trees, six auras, and 20+ passive blessings to unlock, Sir Quichotte offers surprising depth for an idle companion.
Your knight, your build, your way.

  ⚔️ Deep Combat & Progression System

  Sir Quichotte doesn't just swing a sword, he masters the arcane arts! Choose from 21 unique skills across three elemental paths and customize  your playstyle:

  • Holy Element - Divine protection and radiant destruction

  • Primal Element - Harness fire, ice, and lightning

  • Void Element - Dark power with devastating risk/reward

 

Equip 3 active skills + 1 passive aura to create your perfect build.

Save multiple loadouts and swap between strategies on the fly!

🌳 Expansive Passive Skill Tree

Spend Power Points earned from leveling to unlock permanent bonuses with exponential results.
Choose your path:

  • The Path of Power: Maximize your damage output

  • The Path of Balance: Blend offense and defense

  • The Path of Fortitude: Become the tank you were made to be

👹 11 Enemy Types to Vanquish

11 unique enemy types—each with their own behavior, speed, and deadly attacks. Early waves test you with undead fodder, but soon skeleton archers rain arrows from afar, ethereal spirits haunt the battlefield, and hulking butchers charge through your defenses.

Fortunately, you won't always fight alone—loyal soldiers sometimes join your cause, helping thin the horde. But beware: loyalty can be fleeting, and betrayal strikes when you least expect it...

Every skeleton.
Every ghoul.
Every dragon.

They all serve one master—and he's waiting for you.

🌊 Progressive Wave System

100+ waves. Escalating difficulty. Milestone rewards. Unlockable checkpoints.

How far can your knight go?

🎵 Chill Beats, Epic Battles

A handpicked lofi playlist keeps you relaxed while the sounds of combat rage on.
Swords clashing. Spells erupting. Enemies falling.

Fine-tune each audio channel to find your perfect balance.

🖥️ A Knight That Knows His Place

Need focus? Shrink him to a tiny island in the corner.
Want to watch the chaos? Go fullscreen.

Pin him on top of your windows or let him guard quietly in the background.
Resize, zoom, reposition, Sir Quichotte serves on your terms.

⚔️ What Awaits You

  • 21 Unique Skills across Holy, Primal, and Void elements

  • 6 Passive Auras for constant battlefield effects

  • 20+ Passive Blessings for permanent progression and exponential power

  • 11 Enemy Types including boss-tier Dragons

  • 100+ Waves with checkpoint restart system

  • True Desktop Integration - use it as an island anywhere

  • Build & Synergize - 3 skills, 1 aura, your perfect combination

  • Cozy Hand-drawn Art in beautiful isometric style

store_data.about_the_game:
ACTION-HORROR ON A SPACE STATION

SCICRY is a sci-fi action game with survival elements set in an atmosphere of technological horror. A disaster struck the base: anomalies opened a portal to another dimension, and the scientific complex turned into a zone of total slaughter. Those who survived the initial chaos now envy those whose suffering is already over.

STORY AND ROLE:

You are a Class III engineer-welder, trapped on the station after the disaster. Everything around is failing: life support systems are malfunctioning, and horrifying creatures roam the corridors. The crew has disappeared, leaving only fragmented records of a hasty evacuation.

OBJECTIVES AND CHALLENGES:

The player will need to:

  • explore corridors, laboratories, technical modules, and portals to another dimension;

  • restore power systems to open locked areas;

  • search for weapons, medkits, ammunition, keys, and upgrade components;

  • upgrade weapons and suit to survive increasing threats;

  • fight infected, mutating in different stages;

  • confront monsters from another world;

  • uncover the secrets of the station’s experiments.

GAME FEATURES:

  • Dynamic combat in the style of classic sci-fi shooters.

  • Weapons can be found on the station. Each weapon is effective against certain types of enemies. The player’s arsenal includes: assault rifle, shotgun, flamethrower, machine gun, rocket launcher, sniper rifle, and a unique experimental tool.

  • Weapon upgrade system allows enhancing key parameters: damage, fire rate, accuracy, stability, and more.

  • Suit upgrades: health, protection, damage, and more.

  • Resource gathering and inventory management.

  • Several types of doors: keycard, button-activated, and power-dependent.

  • Diverse enemies with unique infection stages.

  • Atmosphere of an alternative Soviet scientific station.

  • Exploration of laboratories, engineering blocks, technical modules, and anomalous zones.

store_data.about_the_game:
Battle of the Edges is a fast-paced neon arcade game where you bounce through a physics-based arena and compete against three bots to claim as many edges as possible. Your character moves like a bouncy ball, rebounding off walls automatically while you steer using short directional impulses. Hit the right edges, build your score, and outplay the bots.

Each match lasts only 60 seconds, making the game perfect for quick sessions. After every round you earn XP, unlock new glowing skins, and upgrade your style. Power-ups like the Speed Boost and Freeze can turn the match around and create exciting moments.

Battle of the Edges is currently in Early Access and will be expanded over time with new skins, features, improvements, effects, and updates based on community feedback.

Fast 60-second rounds

Physics-based bouncing movement

Three AI bots competing in their own arenas

Two power-ups:

Speed Boost – temporarily increases your speed

Freeze – stops all bots for a few seconds

XP system with unlockable neon skins

Easy to learn, hard to master

Bright neon visuals inspired by the 80s

Early Access

Battle of the Edges is actively being developed. During Early Access, new content will be added, including:

Additional skins

More power-ups

Physics improvements

Visual effects and UI enhancements

Potential new game modes

Community feedback will directly shape future updates.

An unknown creature wants to eat, and its hunger grows with every passing minute. You were given no choice. There is only one thing left to do: FEED IT at any cost and don't let the monster get to you.

Hunt, go fishing, and descend into the mine to find anything that can help feed the monster. Wild animals, fish, rare minerals, and strange finds from the depths — all of this can become its next “meal”.

You will have to grow vegetables and other crops so that you don't have to rely solely on active pursuits. Perhaps, over time, you will surpass the missing farmer and understand why he disappeared, leaving this place to you...

Sometimes you will have to venture deep into the Lost Forest, where every step can lead to discovery or disaster. There you can find rare resources, new types of prey, and traces of those who have already been lost in the mysterious woods. But there may be no way back if you go there unprepared.

It will be very interesting to see where your obedience to fulfill the monster's every desire will lead you. Will it be the way to freedom, or… something else?

store_data.about_the_game:
MEET YOUR DOUBLE

You wake up. Morning. St. Petersburg, 19th Century. And you're about to meet someone who looks exactly like you. Lives like you. Steals your life.

What begins as a psychological nightmare becomes an interactive game of identity, madness, and the terror of self-recognition.

Based on Fyodor Dostoevsky's 1846 novella The Double, this is not a retelling - it's a modern exploration where literary horror becomes interactive horror.

THE UNIQUE CARD SYSTEM: FATE MEETS STRATEGY

Every confrontation with your Double is a game of 21, but with one twist—Tarot cards that shift reality itself.

How it works:

  • Play 21 against your doppelgänger for survival and sanity

  • Draw Tarot cards that modify the rules, alter probability, bend fate

  • Same cards create entirely different outcomes based on your decisions

  • Replayability: Dozens of card combinations generate new stories

PSYCHOLOGICAL STORYTELLING

The Setting: 19th-century St. Petersburg rendered as a character-opulent halls, shadowy streets, a city that mirrors your psychological descent.

The Narrative:

  • Notes and journals that immerse you in fractured memory

  • Dialogue that shifts based on your choices and card draws

  • An investigation into the nature of identity itself

  • Themes inspired by Dostoevsky: duality, madness, self-recognition, obsession

The Horror: Not jumpscares-first. Psychological dread. The creeping realization that you might not be the "real" version.

GAMEPLAY

Card Battles (Strategic decision-making)

  • Hybrid 21 + Tarot system that rewards experimentation

  • Same deck, infinite replays, different strategies and outcomes

  • Tension between optimal play and meaningful narrative

Exploration (Atmospheric immersion)

  • Navigate St. Petersburg discovering clues, hidden items, secrets

  • Find objects that unlock dialogue and memories

  • Uncover the truth about your Double

Narrative Choices (Meaningful consequence)

  • Decisions that branch the story meaningfully

  • Dialogue that changes based on previous choices

  • Multiple paths through the story

Puzzles (Thematic challenge)

  • Logic sequences inspired by Dostoevsky's writings

  • Psychological challenges that mirror story themes

UPD: I was planning to release 4 chapters of this game, but later I decided to temporarily stop developing it. This is only the first chapter!

While creating this game, I was inspired by games such as: Signalis, Inscryption, Detention, as well as Russian literature, chthonic horror, and the city of Saint Petersburg.

Each chapter expands the card system's complexity and narrative depth. Also it’s a new psychological puzzles! A unified save system carries your choices forward-decisions in Chapter 1 echo in Chapters 2-4.

Post-launch: In addition to developing the game's parts, I also plan to create a free update with endless maps without having to replay the story!

WHY THIS GAME MATTERS

For Literary Enthusiasts: Dostoevsky's psychological masterpiece becomes interactive. His themes of duality, madness, and self-recognition are now something you experience, not just read about.

For Horror Fans: Psychological horror done right - atmosphere over jumpscares, dread over gore.

For Cards Games Lovers: Untypical system which compare strategy, meaning puzzles and forture!

For Strategy Players: The card system creates infinite replayability. Optimize your draws, discover new combinations, master the mechanics.

For Everyone Else: A game that stands on its own. No prior knowledge needed. Dostoevsky's themes enhance the experience but aren't required.

LANGUAGES & SUPPORT

  • Audio: Russian and English

  • Interface and texts: Russian and English

BEHIND THE SCENES

This game is developed by a solo creator with a background in game design and literary adaptation. It's a passion project inspired by classic literature, psychological horror, and innovative game mechanics.

Wishlist for launch notifications!

FINAL WORDS

Welcome to St. Petersburg, 1846.

Welcome to a world where you are not alone.

Because your worst enemy is yourself.
store_data.detailed_description:
Chapter 1 is available for free!

On January 13th, I announced that Chapter 1 would become free-to-play, and immediately submitted a ticket to Steam Support (note: you can't simply make a paid game free through the interface).

And finally, I received confirmation—the game is now free!

Please play! Write reviews (honest ones), leave comments in the community. This can genuinely influence how soon a continuation might come out (I really hope so!).

store_data.about_the_game:
Starfall Deck is a Rogue-lite City Builder where your deck is your city.

On a hostile alien planet, you must build upwards to survive. Your colony is fragile, your resources are scarce, and your only currency is Hope.

Build Your Deck, Build Your City

Forget traditional construction menus. In Starfall Deck, your buildings are your cards, and your strategy is your deck.

  • Card-Based Construction: Every module, upgrade, and emergency action is drawn from your deck.

  • Manage Your Aetherium: Use your limited Aetherium energy during the Night Phase to play cards. Will you build a Fusion Reactor for power, or a Hydroponic Unit for food?

  • Vertical Expansion: Space is limited. You must build vertically, stacking modules on a grid to maximize efficiency and adjacency bonuses.

Survive the Unforgiving Cycle

The game operates on a tight Day/Night cycle where every decision has consequences.

  • Day Phase (Observation): Watch your colony run. If your Energy or Life Support (Oxygen, Water, Heat) runs into a deficit, your colony's Hope will plummet.

  • Night Phase (Action): This is your time to react. Draw your hand, deploy new modules, and fix critical failures before the sun rises.

  • The Threat of Hope: Hope is your health bar. If it hits 0%, the colony falls.

Weather the Storm

The planet is alive and it wants you gone. The Atmospheric Instability meter is always ticking.

  • Disasters: Prepare for Ion Storms, Acid Rain, and Meteor Showers. Build Shield Generators to protect your tower or suffer structural damage.

  • Random Events: Adapt to fluctuating conditions. A "Dense Fog" might reduce card draw, while an "Ion Rain" might cheapen your energy costs.

Rebuild and Adapt

Failure is just a stepping stone.

  • Meta-Progression: Earn Reputation Points after every run based on your population and survival time.

  • Unlock the Legacy: Visit the "Legacy Terminal" to unlock new card blueprints, powerful starting bonuses, and unique Tower Leaders with special abilities.

Add to Wishlist
