store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up in the middle of the night in your cozy one-room apartment and notice something wandering around your five-story panel building. Your only task is to prevent these strange creatures from getting inside. To do this, you can lock the front door and turn on the lights for a while. You also have a security camera system at your disposal to help you track intruders. However, keep in mind that all these security measures consume electricity, and the supply is severely limited at night. If you run out of electricity, you will lose your lights and cameras, leaving you completely defenseless. The entities outside will undoubtedly take advantage of this...

The strange creatures that roam around your home at night may seem funny and absurd at first glance. They don't resemble zombies, vampires, or other terrifying monsters we're all used to seeing in horror games. But don't be fooled, these mysterious entities are extremely dangerous! Do everything you can to keep them from reaching you.

Knock out nettles with a stick, unscrew lightbulbs in a dilapidated entryway, or simply wander aimlessly through a small courtyard past old five-story panel buildings. This game has no goals other than those you set for yourself. Just relax and spend time wandering this nostalgic place.

Thanks to everyone who paid attention to the project. Please add the game to your wishlist, it will greatly help its promotion.

store_data.about_the_game:
🧠 Welcome to "The Incredible Number Puzzles" -- the ultimate test for your numerical skills and mathematical knowledge! Whether you're looking for a serious challenge or a fun way to sharpen your mind, this game is the perfect practice tool💪.

This game features four distinct challenge types, each carefully designed to test a different aspect of your mathematical ability🔎.

  • Linear: 🎯Construction & Strategy

  • Twisted: 💡Numerical Sense & Logic

  • Puzzle 24: 🔢Mental Math

  • Four 4s: ✨Creativity

"Linear" is a fun and challenging math game. You can produce numbers, operators from factories, then pick them up from storages and place into appropriate space of a formula on the top, hopefully its result same as the targeted answer.

"Twisted" provides you a formula, but a few numbers or operators are missing or swapped. Use your keen numerical sense to identify and correct the errors to complete the equation.

The "24 puzzle" is a mental math puzzle. You need to use all given 4 integers exactly once to work out 24, by only using ➕ ➖ ✖️ ➗ and ( ). For example, 4, 5, 8, 8, a possible solution is (5+8÷8)×4=24. Top tip: 4 × 6, 3 × 8 and 2 × 12 all equal to 24.

The "Four 4s" challenge is an old math problem. You need to use exactly four 4s and basic math operations to work out a given numbers.On top of normal four operations, you can also use square roots, factorials, decimals, and repeating decimals. For example, 44÷4-4=7.

We hope you enjoy these challenges🚀! Remember, it is never too young nor too old to learn and enjoy the power of mathematics. 💯

In Anarchy School, you will find yourself in a fictional middle school located somewhere in Finland, of all places. In Graveschool, formerly known as Braveschool, you must uncover dirty secrets from the school and town's past and overthrow the new principal. But what do Nazis have to do with all of this?

Anarchy School is a first-person action-adventure game set in a Finnish middle school. Avoid hallway supervisors, fight bullies with anything from sharp pencils to lighters, and meet dozens of weird and colorful characters as you progress through 17 voice-acted episodes.

You will not be the same after your visit to Graveschool...

In Anarchy School, you will find yourself in a fictional middle school located somewhere in Finland, of all places. In Graveschool, formerly known as Braveschool, you must uncover dirty secrets from the school and town's past and overthrow the new principal. But what do Nazis have to do with all of this?

Anarchy School is a first-person action-adventure game set in a Finnish middle school. Avoid hallway supervisors, fight bullies with anything from sharp pencils to lighters, and meet dozens of weird and colorful characters as you progress through 17 voice-acted episodes.

You will not be the same after your visit to Graveschool...

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO ALBET SALVAGE!

As a Salvage Crew Recovery Associate, your job is simple. Whenever we lose contact with a Salvage Crew, we send you in to collect whatever they've happened to leave behind. Normally, there's nothing to wory about, but just on the off chance you encounter some trouble, remember these tips.

SCRAP IS KEY

You have to navigate through derelict ships to collect scrap to fuel your survival. Scrap is your weapons and the ammunition that feeds them. Scrap is your blood and currency. Scrap is you and your enemy alike. Scrap is everything.

KEEP YOUR WORKSHOP CLEAN

The workshop is where you'll spend your scrap to purchase upgrades. There you can purchase unique weaponry or over 50+ distinct upgrades. Your workshop will be the heart of your operation, and crafting items there will be the key to your continued existance.

BE AWARE OF YOUR SURROUNDINGS

Your time working for Albet Salvage will lead you to seeing various unusual locales. From flooded maintenance chambers to swarming alien hives, it's best to be on your toes and always have an exit plan. Danger can often come unexpected and fast, especially in the dark, abandoned vessels you'll find yourself in, so be ready to act in a minute's notice or risk losing your life.

store_data.about_the_game:
GAME MECHANICS

Red Balloon is a first-person horror experience shaped by your decisions.

🎈 Descent: progress through 66 unique levels into the depths of Hell.
🎈 Observation: every scene is a threat; what you notice —or fail to notice— can save or kill you.
🎈 Items: find objects that open paths, reveal clues, or alter the situation.
🎈 Simple puzzles: movement, logic, and timing under constant tension.
🎈 Choices: your decisions determine your route, encounters, and consequences.
🎈 Controls: the entire game is played with the mouse.
🎈 No text: the story is told through image and sound — no language barrier.
🎈 No save: you can’t reduce the fear by saving every two seconds.
🎈 Permadeath: maximum tension throughout your descent.
🎈 Low requirements: designed to run on most modern PCs.
🎈 Multiple endings: different fates await you and your brother.

You will soon be able to try the experience in the demo.

THE DESCENT

You and your younger brother find an old video game hidden in the attic.
Its cover bears only one number burned into the plastic: 666.

You launch it out of curiosity… and something goes terribly wrong.

Your brother defeats the final boss. He kills the Devil.
But killing the Devil means claiming his throne.

Now he is trapped in the deepest level of Hell, seated on a throne that consumes him,
slowly becoming the very thing he destroyed.

And you are the only one who can reach him.

Descend 66 levels to save him.

Each one darker, more twisted, and more unforgiving than the last.
Each level knows your fears, your guilt, your cracks… and will use them against you.
Every floor brings you closer to your brother.
But with every descent, darkness claims your heart… and your soul.

YOUR CHOICES SHAPE YOUR DESCENT

This is a game built on decisions.

Decisions that weigh.
Decisions that hurt.

Will you sacrifice a defenseless animal in a ritual you don’t understand?
Will you harm someone to obtain the information you need?
Will you accept the pacts Hell whispers to you?

How far are you willing to fall?

Your decisions shape your path, your descent… and your fate.

The ending you reach depends on what you allow Hell to do to you.
There are multiple endings, and you can discover them all…
if you’re willing to pay the price each one demands.

⚠️ WARNING

Red Balloon is designed to make you uncomfortable.

The sound is disturbing.
The visuals are unsettling.
The choices are cruel — and some will follow you long after you close the game.

The game features permadeath, and sometimes its consequences may feel unfair…
but they are part of the descent.

This is not a light adventure or a casual pastime.
It is a lonely, oppressive, visceral journey where you will discover
what you are willing to sacrifice for the person you love.

If you want something light, this is not your game.
If you seek an experience that stays with you for days…

Take the first step downward.

store_data.about_the_game:
History Begins Underground…

"You can’t be fired. Because you are the team."

Underdog Futsal isn’t about the glamour of professional arenas. Your journey begins on a dusty neighborhood court — where true underdogs are born.

You create your own captain, a player who also acts as the team’s de facto manager. Other players may come and go, but you are the one member who can never be released — the core that holds the team together.

Money is short. The gear is worn-out. The squad is raw. But tactics, mentality management, and a series of small, deliberate choices can turn this group into something greater. With just 15 teammates beside you, experience what it truly means to rise from the bottom.

🏅 Build Your Team Around a Captain You Created

  • Choose your captain’s face and name

  • This character cannot be removed — the unwavering core of the team

⚽ The Speed and Tactical Depth of Real Futsal

Futsal is a sport where momentum shifts constantly in tight spaces — and the game captures that rhythm.

  • Authentic futsal formations: 1–2–1, 2–2, 3–1, and more

  • Team styles shaped by role combinations

  • High-tension moments where substitutions and tactical tweaks flip the match

  • Text-based play-by-play that delivers a sharp, satisfying "net-rip" on every goal

🤝 Chemistry That Holds the Team Together

Tactics alone won’t win a season. Morale and stamina define your long-term success.

Guide your squad through off-pitch activities:

  • Team dinner → Morale recovery

  • Training camp → Overall skill boosts

  • Watching pro matches → Inspiration & XP bonuses

  • Rest week → Stamina recovery

Sometimes, managing unpredictable personalities is harder than perfecting your tactics.

💰 Shoestring Budget, Real Decisions

A small club never has enough money.

  • Heal your injured ace vs sign a promising rookie

  • Boost morale with a team dinner vs upgrade worn-out gear

  • Buy recovery items now vs invest for the future

Every option has a cost — and your decisions shape the season’s outcome.

🌍 Built for Futsal Fans Around the World

  • Fully localized into 12 languages

  • National emblems to personalize your club identity

  • UI/UX crafted for a global player base

Wherever you’re from, whichever rhythm defines your country — your team can grow anywhere.

🟦 Every Giant-Killer Started Small

You begin with no star players and no stable finances. But you have the most powerful tools of all: choice, responsibility, and love for your team. A few lines of text become the roar of the court, the breath of your players, and the unfolding story of your rise from nothing.

This is your team. This is your story.

Where will you take them?

store_data.about_the_game:
Your squad of curious whiskered beings decided to check out a newly unearthed pyramid. What's the worst that could happen?

Well… you accidentally woke up its long-dead pharaoh.
A pharaoh who immediately assumed you were tomb-raiding freeloaders, got extremely offended, and kidnapped your entire group—except you.

Luckily, Sekhmet—daughter of Ra, goddess of war, and part-time professional pharaoh-annoyer—steps in to save your furry hide. She's got her own ancient beef with the guy and is more than happy to use you as a whiskered instrument of revenge.

Now it's up to you to battle through waves of undead lackeys, save your friends, and remind a resurrected tyrant why cats were worshipped in the first place.

A Survivors-Like With Claws

Whiskers In The Sand plays like a mix of Brotato and Vampire Survivors, except you're a divine-backed cat in a desert full of undead maniacs. Survive short, intense waves; buy upgrades between rounds; build hilarious (or disastrous) item combos; and pray Sekhmet's blessing doesn't turn into a cosmic prank.

Features

  • Choose Your Hero:
    Unlock a lineup of brave (and slightly overconfident) cats—plus one dog—each with unique traits and divine quirks that shape your playstyle.

  • Wave-Based Mayhem:
    Each wave lasts about a minute. Just enough time for the pharaoh to send overwhelming hordes—and for you to disappoint him again.

  • Shop ‘Til You Drop-mummies:
    Between waves, buy items, upgrade weapons, and experiment with builds that might break the game… or break you.

  • Roguelite Progression:
    Collect scarab coins to unlock permanent upgrades. Become stronger over time until even the gods start side-eyeing your power level.

  • Divine Allies, Petty Agendas:
    The Egyptian gods are actually on your side this time—not out of kindness, but because the pharaoh is that unbearable.

  • Plenty of Items, Plenty of Shenanigans:
    Mix and match relics, augments, and weapons to create wild build combinations. Yes, some of them shouldn't work. Yes, they still do.

  • Epic Music by Dana Roskvist:
    Most of the soundtrack is composed by Dana Roskvist, whose talent ensures the combat feels vastly more dramatic than your cat probably deserves.

  • Save Your Friends, Defy a Pharaoh, Look Cute Doing It:
    Rescue your captured companions and claw your way to the throne room for a showdown thousands of years overdue.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the wolf pack siege—recruit animals to build your final defense!

As the sun dips below the forest edge, starving wolves close in, drawn by scent. As your tribe’s guardian, recruit forest animal companions, tame them at a recruitment hut, fortify defenses with wood and ore, and carve out a sanctuary between dawn and dusk. This isn’t a lonely struggle—it’s a construction counterwar fought alongside your animal allies!

Core Gameplay: Build Your Animal Tribe in 4 Steps

  • Gather & Explore: Venture the Wilds with AlliesAllocate your animals’ labor wisely: command them to forage core resources (wood, ore, food). Delve deeper into the forest to uncover hidden rare materials—laying groundwork for later construction.

  • Build Your Camp: From Tents to FortressesStart with a sheltering animal tent, then expand: build resource warehouses, stockpile wolf-fighting arrows/shields, and reinforce your camp’s gates.

  • Nurture Your Allies: Care & StrengthenNurture companions: provide daily food, equip hammers/bows to assign roles (Worker, Engineer, Archer, Warrior), and let them study books to unlock abilities—boosting their strength over time.

  • Night Defense: Outwit Growing Wolf ThreatsWhen night falls, the fight begins! Wolves surge from the forest, growing in number/strength daily. Prep defenses: lay spike traps outside fences, assign combat roles, and arm frontlines with blacksmith-forged gear. Command Archers to harass flanks, Warriors to block head-on—hold every inch of your camp amid fire and snarls!

When dawn’s first light burns through the fog, gaze at your resting allies and fortified camp—that’s your survival badge. Now grab your tools, recruit companions, and build an unbreakable forest home in Animal Tribe: Wolf’s Night Siege!

store_data.about_the_game:
Viral Hunters is a fast-paced, intense social deduction game designed specifically for two friend. Here, trust is a luxury, and deception is the norm. Your goal is simple: survive and escape—but first, you must figure out whether the friend beside you is an ally or a hunter in disguise.

What begins as a cooperative struggle for survival will inevitably descend into a carnival of suspicion and betrayal.

Core Gameplay: A Life-or-Death Game Decided by "Vaccines"

You are trapped in a perilous facility. The key to escape lies in two mysterious "vaccine injectors." The game revolves around a core puzzle full of variables:

  • Search & Deception Phase: All players must work together to search the facility for two crucial vaccines and unlock key access. Among them, only one is the true "Cure Vaccine" that can neutralize your innate lethal disease; the other might be a deadly "Mutation Vaccine" or a useless placebo. Even more treacherous are the "vaccine tags" scattered across the map. Anyone can secretly alter the labels, plunging the truth into obscurity.

  • Injection & Transformation Phase: When the two vaccines are inserted into the injectors, the real conflict erupts. Two players will be injected simultaneously, their fates diverging:

    • The Mutant: The unlucky player injected with the Mutation Vaccine transforms into a powerful monster. Your new objective: hunt down every last human.

    • The Survivors: Players injected with the Cure Vaccine can head straight to the extraction point for a safe evacuation. Those injected with the ineffective placebo must race against time, evading the Mutant's pursuit, to find the only newly spawned Cure Vaccine on the map and escape with it.

  • Final Confrontation Phase: Once identities are revealed, cooperation shatters. The facility becomes an arena for asymmetric combat. Humans must use the terrain to outmaneuver their foe and complete their objectives; the monster must use its power and guile to prevent anyone from leaving.

Game Features

  • Intense Social Deduction & Mind Games: The core fun comes from verbal deception, reading expressions, and impromptu performances among friends. The existence of "vaccine tags" casts doubt on every vaccine identification.

  • Clear Phased Objectives: From "Cooperative Search" to "Identity Reveal" and finally "Deadly Chase," the game boasts a tight, drama-filled pace, generating unique "feud stories" every round.

  • Refined Asymmetric Gameplay: One map, multiple ways to play. The Mutant and the Survivors possess completely different abilities and goals, ensuring freshness and strategic depth in every match.

  • A Ruthless Test of Friendship: This is the ultimate trial for questionable friendships. Prepare for grand acts of betrayal and "friendly" post-game discussions about what just happened.

This is a party game tailor-made for playing with your close friends.

Can you really trust your best friend?

Even more treacherous are the "vaccine tags" scattered across the map. Anyone can secretly alter the labels, plunging the truth into obscurity.

  • Injection & Transformation Phase: When the two vaccines are inserted into the injectors, the real conflict erupts. Two players will be injected simultaneously, their fates diverging:

    • The Mutant: The unlucky player injected with the Mutation Vaccine transforms into a powerful monster. Your new objective: hunt down every last human.

    • The Survivors: Players injected with the Cure Vaccine can head straight to the extraction point for a safe evacuation. Those injected with the ineffective placebo must race against time, evading the Mutant's pursuit, to find the only newly spawned Cure Vaccine on the map and escape with it.

  • Final Confrontation Phase: Once identities are revealed, cooperation shatters. The facility becomes an arena for asymmetric combat. Humans must use the terrain to outmaneuver their foe and complete their objectives; the monster must use its power and guile to prevent anyone from leaving.

Game Features

  • Intense Social Deduction & Mind Games: The core fun comes from verbal deception, reading expressions, and impromptu performances among friends. The existence of "vaccine tags" casts doubt on every vaccine identification.

  • Clear Phased Objectives: From "Cooperative Search" to "Identity Reveal" and finally "Deadly Chase," the game boasts a tight, drama-filled pace, generating unique "feud stories" every round.

  • Refined Asymmetric Gameplay: One map, multiple ways to play. The Mutant and the Survivors possess completely different abilities and goals, ensuring freshness and strategic depth in every match.

  • A Ruthless Test of Friendship: This is the ultimate trial for questionable friendships. Prepare for grand acts of betrayal and "friendly" post-game discussions about what just happened.

This is a party game tailor-made for playing with your close friends.

Can you really trust your best friend?

store_data.about_the_game:
Survival in a world under a microscope.

You are a tiny virus, just born into the ruthless ecosystem of a single drop of water. There is no mercy here: billions of microbes are engaged in a constant struggle for existence, and their main enemy is hunger. Your life is measured in seconds on a hunger scale. As soon as it drops to zero, you die forever.

To survive, you need to eat constantly.

Small colorful particles, similar to snowflakes, give you +1 second of life for each one—there are a lot of them, and if you play carefully, you won't go hungry.

Large green organisms are a real trophy: each one gives you +10 seconds at once.

At the bottom of the screen is a biological sensor: it scans everything around you and highlights it in

green — safe, you can eat it,

red — deadly threat.

The world is full of dangers:

— fast predators chase you and kill you at any touch;

— immobile giants stand still, but throw out a long sticky tongue and pull in prey from a long distance;

— neutral microbes do not hunt themselves, but colliding with them is also deadly.

Floating bubbles can be pushed. Sometimes they burst without harm, and sometimes they turn into traps: small prey gets stuck inside, and you can calmly eat them.

You have five powerful abilities that give you a temporary advantage:

On the key: I upgrade

Acceleration (key 1) — a lightning-fast dash that allows you to escape any pursuit. The main thing is not to crash into a large enemy at full speed.

Soundwave (key 2) — a powerful impulse that scares away all pursuers around you. Ideal when surrounded.

Brothers (key 3) — you summon four allied fighters. While they are nearby, you become just as strong and can eat anyone. Brothers are very voracious — you need to collect prey before they do.

Spikes (key 4) — you temporarily become the top of the food chain: all microbes flee in panic, and you hunt even former predators.

Dash (left mouse button, 3 charges) — an instant short burst in the selected direction. Each charge regenerates in 45 seconds.

Abilities 1–4 recharge in 1–2 minutes. Special bubbles with letters sometimes appear in the world — they instantly restore the selected ability.

The game keeps track of your points and survival time. The longer you last, the higher your score. With each new stage of evolution, you become larger, change your appearance, and gain new advantages.

After death, the achievements screen opens. If you score more than 1,000 points, your name will be added to the global leaderboard, which can be viewed in the main menu.

The controls are extremely simple: the character moves automatically, you just point the cursor in the direction you want to go.

The game has bright and rich graphics, but you can lower the quality or turn off the sound completely in the settings for maximum comfort.

Virus Brotherhood is a tense arcade game about the eternal struggle for life in a world that we can only see under a microscope. How many seconds can you snatch from this chaos?

store_data.about_the_game:
目覚めたのは、繁華街のど真ん中だった。

記憶を失った主人公は、そこに集う様々な事情や孤独を抱える若者たち――通称『界隈』に声をかけられ行動を共にすることに。

この街ではとある物を飲むと「異世界に行ける」という奇妙な噂があるらしい。

ある日、界隈の一人が行方不明になったことをきっかけに、彼らと共に半信半疑のまま噂の真相を追っていく。

その先にあるのは、彼らの抱える問題や自分自身の過去、そしてこの世界の歪み。

概要：

『トー京Xtrip』（トーキョー クロス トリップ）は

2023年の架空都市「トー京」を舞台にしたシナリオ重視のSF青春アドベンチャーゲームです。

方向キーまたはマウスで街を探索し、クリックで会話を読み進めながら物語を進めていきます。

一部の選択肢でエンディングが変化するマルチエンディング形式です。

特徴：

・理性が試される『自制心ゲージ』：

　選択肢によって増減するシステム。ゲージが低下すると制限時間の出現や、意思に反した選択の強制が発生。0になればゲームオーバーになります。

・約2時間でクリア可能：

　短い時間で楽しめる映画のような濃密シナリオをお楽しみください。

・マルチエンディング：

　主にTrue、Normalの2種類（およびBad）を収録。

・ライトで直観的な操作

　会話が中心のシンプルなスタイルで誰でも簡単にプレイ可能です。

・令和初期を想起させる9名のメインキャラクター：

　性別や個性も様々な、一癖も二癖もある『界隈』メンバーがお出迎えします。

　※主人公のグラフィック表示はありません。

実況：

本作は全編実況・配信可能◎

※各配信プラットフォームの規約に従う。

※本作品はフィクションです。実在の人物や団体を中傷するような表現はお控えください。

store_data.about_the_game:
A roguelike, tile-based adventure on a 9-grid board where you explore, collect items, and manage your inventory strategically to prepare for automatic battles against enemies. Make every resource and turn count to survive and progress as far as you can.

Automatic Combat – Each item activates automatically when its cooldown is complete, such as attacking enemies, applying buffs, or healing the player. Players don’t control actions directly but must manage and choose items wisely to win battles.

Board – Each tile on the board is always randomly generated, whether it’s an event, treasure chest, shop, or weapon-upgrade spot. Players must plan ahead and make the most of each tile before it disappears.

Item Levels – Identical items with the same level can be merged to increase their level. However, multiple low-level items can sometimes be more useful than a single high-level one.

Can you find what’s wrong before the night consumes you?

Tong is heading home after an exhausting night shift,
but as he passes the old three-way junction,

and only then can they escape the strange loop that traps them.

Designed for 30 to 60 minutes of play per run.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reclaim the Rails

Bullet Express is a high-octane rogue-lite where you play as a prototype robot on a mission of reclamation. Your creator’s crowning achievement, the super-high-tech Bullet Express, has been hijacked by the rogue Conductor. To take back control, you must fight your way through the speeding cars of a train that never stops.

Gems are the Ammo...

On the Bullet Express, gems aren't just loot, they are your firepower. Every gem you find transforms your scrap starting weapon into something new. Slot a Spread Gem for shotgun blasts, or a Charge Gem for devastating charged strikes.

...But Synergy is the Weapon

The real power lies in the Forge. By upgrading your gems during a run, you can craft permanent specialized weapons based on those very same powers at the hub.

When you take a crafted weapon into a run, it merges with the gems you find:

  • The Base: Start with your crafted Charge Weapon.

  • The Synergy: Loot a Spread Gem mid-run.

  • The Result: You now have a Charging Shotgun, the longer you hold the trigger, the more bullets you unleash.

With at least 10 unique gem types, you can discover over 100 explosive combinations.

The Machine Evolves

You aren't just building a better weapon, you’re building a better bot. Use scrap recovered from the train to overhaul your chassis and internal systems at the hub.

Features:

  • 100+ Unique Weapon Combinations: Deep merging mechanics ensure no two runs feel the same. Will you build a rapid-fire shredder or a slow-moving orbital strike?

  • Permanent Rogue-lite Progression: Upgrade your robot’s parts and forge new permanent weapons to ensure you return to the fight stronger than you left.

  • Procedural Levels: Fight through procedurally generated levels, each packed with new mutated threats and evolving loot.

  • High-Tech Combat: Master twitch-reflex movement and complex weapon synergies to defeat the Conductor’s mutated army.

Note from the Developer: Bullet Express is currently in ALPHA. We are actively shaping the game based on player feedback. Everything from art to mechanics is subject to evolution as we work toward the final departure!

store_data.about_the_game:
Railroad to Amberfield is a cozy railway strategy game with light puzzle elements. Build your route tile by tile, complete tasks, and guide your train toward its goal. Pick up passengers, connect towns, and deliver goods from farms, mills, and forests. Each completed task earns you a reward that helps you continue your journey.

Each map gives you a limited number of turns, so you need to think through how to build your railway in a way that completes all objectives and still reaches the goal in time. And not all tiles are the same: building on fields is easier and cheaper than digging a tunnel in the mountains or constructing a bridge over a river.

Features

  • Turn based railway construction on a tile map with relaxed gameplay

  • Random track pieces available for building on each turn

  • A variety of tiles on your path, from fields and flower meadows to mountains and rivers

  • Three types of biomes: autumn forests, summer meadows and northern mountains, each changing the visual style and character of the map

Game modes

The game features several modes: a 25-mission campaign with carefully planned maps, as well as a random map generator that can create anything from small 6×6 tile maps to large 18×18 ones.

The maps range from simple, where you mostly encounter field tiles and straightforward tasks, to more complex layouts with mountains, lakes, forests and rivers, which add interesting challenges when choosing the best route.

This means you can always pick a more relaxed play style or something more demanding if you want to think a bit more about your path. In any case, we hope your journey will be a wonderful one! 

We are happy about constructive feedback of all kinds, so feel free to contact us! :)

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is a casual treasure-hunting adventure game with a low-poly art style. Its core gameplay revolves around collecting all the treasure chests in the open, cartoonish scenes. As seen in the screenshots, the game interface displays "Total Treasures" and "Remaining Count," with the clear objective of "finding all treasure chests in the scene."

Players control a character to explore fresh, vibrant environments featuring wooden huts, trees, and hills. Treasure chests are typically scattered around areas like the sides of buildings and near vegetation—each time a chest is collected, the remaining count decreases accordingly. The game also includes control hints (such as pressing the "Q" key to pause). With its relaxing, soothing atmosphere and slow pace, it’s ideal for players who enjoy light exploration and collection-focused gameplay. It tests players’ observation skills while letting them gain a sense of accomplishment from collecting treasures as they wander through the laid-back scenes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Appointed by the royal court to a remote village, you begin your journey as an unknown doctor. Build your reputation from a suspected quack to a reputable Plague Doctor, all while witnessing the spread of the plague day by day.

Step outside the safety of the village walls into an open world filled with natural resources. Travel to lush fields, navigate deep caves, and traverse dense forests to locate rare medicinal herbs, mushrooms, and minerals.

Identify and refine your gathered ingredients. Experiment with mixtures to discover potent medicinal properties, creating treatments that range from simple potions and pills to complex ointments and experimental injectable serums.

Every patient tells a story. Listen to their plight, examine their bodies for symptoms, and establish a diagnosis. Your treatments require steady hands, ranging from basic remedies to invasive surgeries and medieval practices.

Will you uphold the Hippocratic Oath, or decide who gets to live and who doesn’t? Choose carefully. The world responds dynamically to your success and failure. With every untreated patient and every death, the environment decays: homes fall into disrepair, fires break out, the weather turns turbulent, and nature itself withers.

Immerse yourself in a village where every NPC has a unique life, schedule, and behavior. Get to know them as you treat them, or watch them succumb to sickness, or perhaps, to your own malpractice.

Whether you bear the burden of the plague alone or share the task in 4-player co-op, the work never ends. However, when the pressure mounts, you can always find a moment of peace in the tavern, play the lute, or throw some dice.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shogun Chronicles is an adventure game with card play elements. 

Its about a Samurai warrior you control through a world of dangerous creatures and other opponents.

In the card game parts you have to get more card types (marked by colours) than your opponent.

The starting player is decided at random at the start of the game. The type of battle (Melee, Range or Skill) is also decided at random at the start of each turn.

Each card has a colour, stats and abilities that determine the outcome of a battle between two warriors.

The aim is to win battles with more card types (Red, Green, Blue etc) than your opponent.

A higher stat point in Melee, Range or Skill allows a card to win a battle. Abilities also have an effect on the outcome.

store_data.about_the_game:
MUTATE YOUR BULLET. FLAP, EVOLVE, SURVIVE.

THE KULKA is a one-button bullet-heaven arcade roguelite where your single shot slowly mutates into pure neon chaos. Imagine Flappy Bird colliding with Vampire Survivors.

Tap to flap like in a classic flappy game, dodge walls of enemies and stack bullet upgrades until the screen explodes in colour.

Fast, focused and replayable – built for tight controls, punchy sound, online leaderboards, challenges and that “one more run” feeling.

CORE LOOP

  • Tap or click to flap and keep your orb in the air.

  • Your shot fires automatically – destroy enemies to earn XP gems.

  • Level up and choose an upgrade to mutate your bullet.

  • Survive as long as you can, then try to beat your high score – locally or on global leaderboards.

At first it’s just you, one bullet and a handful of enemies. A few levels later the screen is full of bouncing, splitting, homing, exploding shots – and you’re trying to squeeze through the chaos with a single button.

KEY FEATURES

  • One-button gameplay – easy to pick up, hard to master. You only control vertical movement, but every flap matters.

  • Bullet mutation system – every level-up adds new behaviour to your shot: split, ricochet, pierce, homing, explosions, lightning, lasers, novas and more.

  • Tons of builds – turn your tiny pellet into a bouncing storm, a piercing rail, a safe shield bubble or a swirling vortex of damage.

  • Fast arcade runs – instant restarts and quick runs; perfect for short sessions or long “just one more try” evenings.

  • Difficulty options – Relax, Easy, Normal and Hardcore presets – from chill flapping to sweaty record chasing.

  • Two upgrade styles – classic manual upgrade picks (you choose like in Vampire Survivors) or Flow mode with automatic upgrade choices so you can focus purely on dodging.

  • Extra modes – additional ways to play.

  • Neon Geometry Wars–style look – clean synthwave grid, bright orbs and clear hit feedback even when the screen is packed.

  • Punchy sound design – crisp hits, juicy pickups and satisfying upgrade feedback on both speakers and headphones.

  • Flexible controls – keyboard (Space + arrow keys), full gamepad support (Xbox / PlayStation / standard) and touch input; great for PC, Steam Deck and Remote Play.

  • Online leaderboards – compete with other players in global Steam score tables across multiple modes and difficulty levels.

  • Challenges & progression – unlock new options by completing in-game objectives instead of grinding endless gold.

  • Ball Bank – choose your starting weapons, skins and modifiers in a dedicated loadout / armoury screen before each run.

  • Marquee in the main menu – see the top players’ nicknames scrolling across the main menu every time you launch the game.

  • Steam achievements & Cloud – over 100 achievements plus Steam Cloud support for your progress.

MUTATION COMBOS

Start small, then let the chaos grow:

  • Begin with a single bullet.

  • Pick Split Shot – now you fire two bullets.

  • Add Ricochet and Pierce – your shots bounce, pass through enemies and cover huge parts of the screen.

  • Combine Homing, Explosive Bullets, Chain Lightning or Nova Blast to create your own broken combo.

Example mixes:

  • Faster Shots + Multishot + Faster Bullets = Bullet Spam

  • Multishot + Area Size + Bigger Projectiles = Wide Wall

  • Multishot + Pierce = Line Killer

  • Multishot + Ricochet = Bouncing Storm

  • Shield + Time Warp = Slow Bubble

  • Shield + Orbital Drone = Safe Core

  • Freeze + Vortex = Frozen Vortex

  • Poison + Vortex = Poison Zone

THE KULKA is all about making this one run as wild as possible – a quick neon arcade fix when you just want to flap, mutate and survive a little bit longer, with enough progression and competition to keep you coming back.

Cosmetic skins (including holiday themes) – full version only

In the full version of THE KULKA, you unlock additional cosmetic skins and visual variants (e.g. Christmas and New Year themes) that change the look of the game – with no impact on balance, mechanics, or leaderboards.

All skins are earned through challenges and objectives – no currency, no microtransaction grind.

Purely cosmetic. Zero advantage, just style.

Welcome to Stepford Heights - a quiet suburban town with one unusual distinction: the highest stepmom-per-capita ratio in America.

Every year, the dads pack up for the Annual Fishing Trip Weekend, leaving behind their beautiful, lonely wives. This year, you've decided to attempt something legendary: beat the World Record.

THE CHALLENGE

You have exactly 48 in-game hours. Twenty stepmoms scattered across town. One goal: seduce them all before the dads return.

But this isn't just about charm - it's about SPEED. Every second counts. Every route matters. Can you optimize your path to stepmom supremacy?

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

- Speedrun Mechanics: A real-time countdown creates genuine tension as you race against the clock

- Route Optimization: Discover the most efficient paths between locations - the difference between victory and defeat

- Multiple Strategies: Different "strats" unlock as you learn stepmom schedules and preferences

- New Game+ Mode: Keep your knowledge of optimal routes and unlock advanced strategies

- Leaderboard System: Compare your times against other players worldwide

- Skip Previously Seen Content: Speedrun mode lets you blast through dialogue you've already read

20 UNIQUE STEPMOMS

Each stepmom has her own personality, location, schedule, and seduction requirements:

- Yolanda, the Yoga Instructor - Find her at the community center during morning classes

- Veronica, the Wine Mom - Catch her at the country club after 5pm

- Patricia, the PTA President - Always at the school planning the next fundraiser

- Gwen, the Gamer - Streams from her basement setup all night long

- Felicia, the Fitness Fanatic - Runs the local gym with military precision

- Carmen, the Cougar - Prowls the upscale bars downtown

- Beth, the Bookworm - Lost in novels at the town library

- Charlotte, the Chef - Runs the fanciest restaurant in town

- Isabella, the Influencer - Always looking for the perfect photo spot

- Nina, the Nurse - Works the night shift at Stepford General

- Linda, the Lawyer - Burns the midnight oil at her downtown firm

- Aurora, the Artist - Creates masterpieces in her converted garage studio

- Rachel, the Real Estate Agent - Shows houses all over town

- Tanya, the Teacher - Grades papers at the local coffee shop

- Tiffany, the Trophy Wife - Shops at the premium mall all day

- Bianca, the Biker - Hangs out at the dive bar on Route 9

- Charity, the Church Lady - Volunteers at every community event

- Diana, the Divorcee - Drowns her sorrows at happy hour

- Francesca, the Foreign Exchange - Explores the town with wide-eyed wonder

- Victoria, the Mayor's Wife - The FINAL BOSS. Heavily guarded. Maximum difficulty.

STORY

What started as a joke between friends has become a legendary challenge. The "Stepmom Speedrun" has its own online community, complete with route guides, frame-perfect strats, and heated debates about RNG manipulation.

You're a newcomer to the scene, but you've studied the masters. You know the shortcuts. You've memorized the schedules. Now it's time to prove yourself.

But as you race through Stepford Heights, you might discover there's more to these women than conquest points. Each stepmom has her own story, her own desires, her own reasons for being receptive to your advances.

Will you stick to the optimal route? Or will genuine connections slow you down?

GENRE

A comedic visual novel that parodies speedrun culture while delivering engaging adult content. Combines time-management gameplay with branching narratives and multiple endings.

CONTENT

- Adult visual novel with explicit scenes

- Satirical humor targeting speedrun/gaming culture

- Multiple endings based on completion time and choices

- 20+ hours of content for completionists

- 45 minutes to 2 hours per speedrun attempt

REPLAYABILITY

- Unlock new routes and strategies each playthrough

- Discover hidden shortcuts and time-saves

- Multiple endings based on your final time

- Gallery mode to revisit favorite scenes

- Achievement system for various speedrun milestones

store_data.about_the_game:
Detective Inna Duke

A small, fluffy streamer, Oleh Hamston, is suddenly kidnapped from his apartment right in the middle of a livestream. The case is taken on by an ambitious and fearless detective, Inna Duke. What secrets lie behind this crime? Will you be able to uncover the real culprit and save the poor hamster’s life? Help a brave turkey detective uncover the truth in the visual novel “Detective Inna Duke”.

What awaits you:

🔍 Immersive police investigation

Dive into the intricacies of fieldwork and surveillance. Learn how to follow leads and conduct searches. Not a single detail will escape Inna Duke!

🔍 Intriguing and unexpected plot twists

Uncover the mysterious past of the main characters and expose the dark secrets of a city drowning in corruption and impunity.

🔍 Humor

Meet quirky and colorful characters, pick up a few jokes, and spot plenty of clever references along the way.

🔍 Solving a variety of puzzles

You’ll work with an evidence board, pick locks, search for clues, and find your way through abandoned tunnels, as well as take on tasks in a café and more.

🔍 Choices that shape your path

Your decisions determine how the story ends. Will you manage to stay undercover without raising suspicion? What matters more: preserving your reputation or delivering justice? Who is truly guilty, and who has been wrongly accused?

store_data.about_the_game:
Setting: You are in a damp, strange cave where your only company is a mysterious girl clutching a loaded shotgun. She is not here to torture you. She is here to talk. However, her "compatibility check" has zero tolerance for errors, and the price of a wrong word is your life.

​Core Mechanics: ​The girl asks questions, and you have only two options for an answer. These answers directly control her state. Each response affects four specific meters:

​Fun: Your path to victory. Fill this meter to the maximum to earn her trust and survive.

​Madness: Your main enemy. If this meter hits the limit, the date ends in an instant and fatal reckoning.

​Rationality: A sober approach that helps keep madness in check.

​Sadness: The hidden killer of your success. It actively lowers your Fun meter.

​Your Goal: It is not enough to simply stay alive; you must truly get close to her. You need to survive and achieve maximum joy by learning to perfectly balance madness, rationality, and emotions—all while the girl keeps her finger on the trigger.

​The Atmosphere: Your date takes place in a cave, but you are not alone there. She is merely one of this place's oddities. The surrounding world actively reacts to your tension: a cockroach suddenly scuttling by, or bizarre drawings on the walls that seem meaningful but vanish the moment you look away.

​The cave breathes, watches, and actively tries to break you. It is not just a background; it is part of the trial.

                  

​The Phone: Your phone is your only loyal assistant in this strange place... or is it?

​Status Meters: Your phone screen always displays the current levels of Fun and Madness. This is your vital indicator! Keep an eye on them to avoid crossing the dangerous line.

​Random Button: Take a risk! A random press can trigger anything: from a helpful boost of Fun to a sudden surge of Madness.

​Random SMS: Unpredictable messages that might provide a hint, offer a distraction, or simply make you smile.

​Photo Gallery: Each new attempt unlocks a new, intriguing photo that reveals details about the girl or your location.

​Good luck!

store_data.about_the_game:
Dear Princess Player, today is another day for you to fall into love and romance! We are all your prince husbands! The EA version of "1000 Princes 2: Loving You Is My Duty" is officially launched today! Sending you a warm embrace!

Part 1: EA Version Introduction

The EA version refers to Early Access, where developers release a game that is still in development so players can experience it early, provide feedback, and enjoy continuous updates. "1000 Princes 2" is planned to receive multiple updates within one year and complete the full version within this year.

The current EA version includes the following content:

  • Group Romance: Chapters 9–12

  • Individual Romance: Weilong - Fragment 1

  • Music Room: 1 song

  • Study: Weilong’s Love Letter #1

  • Living Room: Chat 1

  • Game Room: Writing Chinese characters with a brush

  • Kitchen: Making Jianbing Guozi

Part 2: Game Content Details

"1000 Princes 2" Group Romance Main Story Chapters 9–12

After your cafeteria officially opens, your numerous prince husbands decide to work part-time there. However, their cooking skills are zero!

Your cafeteria—also your home—is located right above a wormhole entrance. This special energy node overlaps multiple space-time dimensions. When the pink pig from the “Time Administration Bureau” bites off your timeline, your husbands from different timelines all travel through time and gather in your home. They come from every era of human history: primitive people, ancient people, modern people, and even aliens. Their backgrounds, personalities, and lifestyles differ greatly, but they share one common mission—to love you wholeheartedly and protect you!

Individual Romance: Crown Prince Weilong

Weilong grew up in the mountains and was later found by the royal family of the Dragon Kingdom. He is the Crown Prince of the Dragon Kingdom. Born with naturally curly hair, he is nicknamed by the citizens as “Instant Noodle Hair Crown Prince,” “Steel Wool Crown Prince,” or “Deep-Fried Enoki Mushroom Crown Prince.” You are a traditional Chinese medicine pharmacist, and he loves you deeply. Weilong says to you: “Even if I deliberately straighten my curly hair, it will still curl back. Just like how I love you—no matter how hard I try not to think of you, I will naturally miss you again and love you deeply. My curls are innate, and my love for you is also innate.”

Princes’ Mini Game Room

Practice writing Chinese characters with a brush! Weilong was born and raised in the Dragon Kingdom. His name “Weilong” contains the character “Dragon,” which symbolizes good fortune and strength. Every stroke of a Chinese character requires care to be written properly. Let’s practice writing the character “Dragon” together!

Princes’ Kitchen

Let’s make Jianbing Guozi! Jianbing Guozi is a delicious street food made by spreading flour batter into a thin pancake, adding eggs, scallions, sweet bean sauce, roasted pork, lettuce, and crispy crackers. Wow! It’s so delicious!

Part 3: Your Prince Husband List

Your New Husband: Weilong

“My curls are innate, and my love for you is also innate.”

Husbands You Already Have

◆ Bang (Primitive Man)

From the Stone Age, tall and powerful, carrying a unique purity untainted by modern industrial society. He has loved you deeply since prehistoric times.

◆ Yucheng (Programmer)

Unrestrained in style, skilled in aggressive coding, and speaks bluntly. When your electric car’s brakes failed, he hacked into the traffic system and turned all lights green, saving your life.

◆ Haowei (Bear Kingdom Warlord)

Nicknamed Brown Bear. As a young marshal, he is tough, authoritative, and cold, but he reserves all his tenderness for you and cannot bear to see you suffer even the slightest grievance.

◆ Lingtian (Prince of Fang Kingdom)

A student of an Asian military academy, handsome and gentle, deeply devoted. The Fang Kingdom royal family held a “Love Search Event” to find him a princess to divert public attention and ease social tensions. Yet he ignored all other girls—he only cares about you, watches you, and loves you.

◆ Citan (Baike Star Alien)

A hybrid of Baike Star alien and Earth human. Baike Star technology is highly advanced and believes in strict logic and rationality, eliminating emotions. However, because he loves you deeply, he insists on keeping his emotions.

◆ Congwei (Electric Power CEO)

He runs the Quark Power Company and loves and protects you. In his timeline, you were both exposed to electric radiation, turning you into a power bank. He must charge using your body to survive…

◆ Momo (Bear Kingdom Detective)

Nicknamed Black Bear. As a detective, he is decisive, calm, and meticulous. In his timeline, he always meets you at murder scenes and comes to know and like you through repeatedly interviewing you as a witness.

◆ Yongren (Fish Kingdom Prince)

Intelligent, diligent, low-key, and humble. A mechanical engineer. In his timeline, you are his secretary and translator.

◆ Yongmi (Water General of Sacrifice Kingdom)

An ancient Water General skilled in water arts, freely shifting water between liquid, steam, and ice. In ancient times, he often created rainbows with water to make you happy.

◆ Shenjun (Fire General of Sacrifice Kingdom)

An ancient Fire General skilled in fire arts, able to control flames. In ancient times, he often set off firework displays with fire to encourage and comfort you.

◆ MingZun (Judge)

Originally a judge from the underworld, he reincarnated into the human world out of deep love for you and became a human court judge.

◆Zexian (the Pearl Prince) says to you:
"When I discovered you, it felt like discovering the most precious and luminous pearl in this world. I only want to place you inside my strong pearl shell and protect you with all my heart!"

“1000 Princes 2” is a sweet, romance-heavy otome visual novel for women, and the second title in the “1000 Princes” series.

Q1: Why did the 1000 princes decide to work in your diner?

After your diner officially opened, your enormous number of prince-husbands all decided to take part-time jobs there. However—none of them can cook!

Your diner, which is also your home, happens to be located right above the entrance of a wormhole. This special energy node causes different spacetime dimensions to overlap. When the pink pig from the Time Management Bureau bit through your timeline, all the husbands from your various parallel universes traveled through spacetime and converged at your house.

They come from every era of human history: prehistoric, ancient, modern, and even alien civilizations. Their backgrounds, personalities, and lifestyles vary enormously. But they all share one mission—to love you and protect you with all their hearts.

Your home’s elevator has been verified as capable of traveling between the current shared timeline and each prince’s individual timeline. And in each of their worlds, they received extremely grave intelligence:

  • The warlord HaoWei’s enemies plan to use a time-space weapon to eliminate him at the fertilized-egg stage. They intend to kill his pregnant mother so that he can never be born.

  • Prince Ling Tian’s nemesis intends to use a time-space weapon to trap him in an endless loop at age ten, preventing him from ever growing up.

  • Zitan, the Baike-Planet–Earth hybrid, has learned through interstellar intel that evil aliens have long coveted Earth. They plan to travel to the Stone Age to wipe out primitive humans like Bang, preventing humanity from reproducing and allowing them to occupy Earth. Zitan absolutely refuses to let the world he loves be stolen!

The princes deeply understand the terrors of time-space weapons. To counter them, they must uncover the mysteries of spacetime. And your diner, sitting atop the wormhole where timelines overlap, is the key strategic point to solve everything.

Therefore, they decided to disguise themselves as “diner staff,” helping you run the diner while investigating the secrets of spacetime.

Your Chinese-style diner serves freshly cooked stir-fries, hot soups, meat and vegetarian dishes—warm, delicious comfort food every day. Yet constant troubles and chaos unfold daily…

On this shared timeline, you and your 1000 prince-husbands will face countless unbelievable dangers and crises. You will work together to solve mysteries, embark on adventures, and overcome challenges. Through these experiences, you’ll understand one another, communicate, and care for each other. They will confess their love to you and accompany you through every hardship. At the same time, they hope you will choose to enter the personal timeline of one specific prince.

Q2: What is the ultimate goal of the 1000 princes?

The controllers of the higher-dimensional universe know that each soul’s long timeline of reincarnation is like a video player—capable of rewinding, replaying, or fast-forwarding. However, they absolutely do not want lower-dimensional humans to learn these secrets.

The pink pig’s defection has made these secrets vulnerable to exposure, thus placing you in mortal danger.

To protect you, the 1000 princes will give everything they have—even their lives—to ensure your safety. Guarding you, protecting you, and spoiling you is the mission of every prince.

You are their cherished treasure; they care only about loving you. But assassins from the higher-dimensional universe can disguise themselves as anyone and attack you at any time. If you choose to enter one prince’s personal timeline, you can avoid being hunted.

Now, choose the prince you love most—your sanctuary.

Dear Princess Player, today is another day for you to fall into love and romance! We are all your prince husbands! The EA version of "1000 Princes 2: Loving You Is My Duty" is officially launched today! Sending you a warm embrace!

Part 1: EA Version Introduction

The EA version refers to Early Access, where developers release a game that is still in development so players can experience it early, provide feedback, and enjoy continuous updates. "1000 Princes 2" is planned to receive multiple updates within one year and complete the full version within this year.

The current EA version includes the following content:

  • Group Romance: Chapters 9–12

  • Individual Romance: Weilong - Fragment 1

  • Music Room: 1 song

  • Study: Weilong’s Love Letter #1

  • Living Room: Chat 1

  • Game Room: Writing Chinese characters with a brush

  • Kitchen: Making Jianbing Guozi

Part 2: Game Content Details

"1000 Princes 2" Group Romance Main Story Chapters 9–12

After your cafeteria officially opens, your numerous prince husbands decide to work part-time there. However, their cooking skills are zero!

Your cafeteria—also your home—is located right above a wormhole entrance. This special energy node overlaps multiple space-time dimensions. When the pink pig from the “Time Administration Bureau” bites off your timeline, your husbands from different timelines all travel through time and gather in your home. They come from every era of human history: primitive people, ancient people, modern people, and even aliens. Their backgrounds, personalities, and lifestyles differ greatly, but they share one common mission—to love you wholeheartedly and protect you!

Individual Romance: Crown Prince Weilong

Weilong grew up in the mountains and was later found by the royal family of the Dragon Kingdom. He is the Crown Prince of the Dragon Kingdom. Born with naturally curly hair, he is nicknamed by the citizens as “Instant Noodle Hair Crown Prince,” “Steel Wool Crown Prince,” or “Deep-Fried Enoki Mushroom Crown Prince.” You are a traditional Chinese medicine pharmacist, and he loves you deeply. Weilong says to you: “Even if I deliberately straighten my curly hair, it will still curl back. Just like how I love you—no matter how hard I try not to think of you, I will naturally miss you again and love you deeply. My curls are innate, and my love for you is also innate.”

Princes’ Mini Game Room

Practice writing Chinese characters with a brush! Weilong was born and raised in the Dragon Kingdom. His name “Weilong” contains the character “Dragon,” which symbolizes good fortune and strength. Every stroke of a Chinese character requires care to be written properly. Let’s practice writing the character “Dragon” together!

Princes’ Kitchen

Let’s make Jianbing Guozi! Jianbing Guozi is a delicious street food made by spreading flour batter into a thin pancake, adding eggs, scallions, sweet bean sauce, roasted pork, lettuce, and crispy crackers. Wow! It’s so delicious!

Part 3: Your Prince Husband List

Your New Husband: Weilong

“My curls are innate, and my love for you is also innate.”

Husbands You Already Have

◆ Bang (Primitive Man)

From the Stone Age, tall and powerful, carrying a unique purity untainted by modern industrial society. He has loved you deeply since prehistoric times.

◆ Yucheng (Programmer)

Unrestrained in style, skilled in aggressive coding, and speaks bluntly. When your electric car’s brakes failed, he hacked into the traffic system and turned all lights green, saving your life.

◆ Haowei (Bear Kingdom Warlord)

Nicknamed Brown Bear. As a young marshal, he is tough, authoritative, and cold, but he reserves all his tenderness for you and cannot bear to see you suffer even the slightest grievance.

◆ Lingtian (Prince of Fang Kingdom)

A student of an Asian military academy, handsome and gentle, deeply devoted. The Fang Kingdom royal family held a “Love Search Event” to find him a princess to divert public attention and ease social tensions. Yet he ignored all other girls—he only cares about you, watches you, and loves you.

◆ Citan (Baike Star Alien)

A hybrid of Baike Star alien and Earth human. Baike Star technology is highly advanced and believes in strict logic and rationality, eliminating emotions. However, because he loves you deeply, he insists on keeping his emotions.

◆ Congwei (Electric Power CEO)

He runs the Quark Power Company and loves and protects you. In his timeline, you were both exposed to electric radiation, turning you into a power bank. He must charge using your body to survive…

◆ Momo (Bear Kingdom Detective)

Nicknamed Black Bear. As a detective, he is decisive, calm, and meticulous. In his timeline, he always meets you at murder scenes and comes to know and like you through repeatedly interviewing you as a witness.

◆ Yongren (Fish Kingdom Prince)

Intelligent, diligent, low-key, and humble. A mechanical engineer. In his timeline, you are his secretary and translator.

◆ Yongmi (Water General of Sacrifice Kingdom)

An ancient Water General skilled in water arts, freely shifting water between liquid, steam, and ice. In ancient times, he often created rainbows with water to make you happy.

◆ Shenjun (Fire General of Sacrifice Kingdom)

An ancient Fire General skilled in fire arts, able to control flames. In ancient times, he often set off firework displays with fire to encourage and comfort you.

◆ MingZun (Judge)

Originally a judge from the underworld, he reincarnated into the human world out of deep love for you and became a human court judge.

◆Zexian (the Pearl Prince) says to you:
"When I discovered you, it felt like discovering the most precious and luminous pearl in this world. I only want to place you inside my strong pearl shell and protect you with all my heart!"

After your diner officially opened, your enormous number of prince-husbands all decided to take part-time jobs there. However—none of them can cook!

Your diner, which is also your home, happens to be located right above the entrance of a wormhole. This special energy node causes different spacetime dimensions to overlap. When the pink pig from the Time Management Bureau bit through your timeline, all the husbands from your various parallel universes traveled through spacetime and converged at your house.

They come from every era of human history: prehistoric, ancient, modern, and even alien civilizations. Their backgrounds, personalities, and lifestyles vary enormously. But they all share one mission—to love you and protect you with all their hearts.

Your home’s elevator has been verified as capable of traveling between the current shared timeline and each prince’s individual timeline. And in each of their worlds, they received extremely grave intelligence:

  • The warlord HaoWei’s enemies plan to use a time-space weapon to eliminate him at the fertilized-egg stage. They intend to kill his pregnant mother so that he can never be born.

  • Prince Ling Tian’s nemesis intends to use a time-space weapon to trap him in an endless loop at age ten, preventing him from ever growing up.

  • Zitan, the Baike-Planet–Earth hybrid, has learned through interstellar intel that evil aliens have long coveted Earth. They plan to travel to the Stone Age to wipe out primitive humans like Bang, preventing humanity from reproducing and allowing them to occupy Earth. Zitan absolutely refuses to let the world he loves be stolen!

The princes deeply understand the terrors of time-space weapons. To counter them, they must uncover the mysteries of spacetime. And your diner, sitting atop the wormhole where timelines overlap, is the key strategic point to solve everything.

Therefore, they decided to disguise themselves as “diner staff,” helping you run the diner while investigating the secrets of spacetime.

Your Chinese-style diner serves freshly cooked stir-fries, hot soups, meat and vegetarian dishes—warm, delicious comfort food every day. Yet constant troubles and chaos unfold daily…

On this shared timeline, you and your 1000 prince-husbands will face countless unbelievable dangers and crises. You will work together to solve mysteries, embark on adventures, and overcome challenges. Through these experiences, you’ll understand one another, communicate, and care for each other. They will confess their love to you and accompany you through every hardship. At the same time, they hope you will choose to enter the personal timeline of one specific prince.

The controllers of the higher-dimensional universe know that each soul’s long timeline of reincarnation is like a video player—capable of rewinding, replaying, or fast-forwarding. However, they absolutely do not want lower-dimensional humans to learn these secrets.

The pink pig’s defection has made these secrets vulnerable to exposure, thus placing you in mortal danger.

To protect you, the 1000 princes will give everything they have—even their lives—to ensure your safety. Guarding you, protecting you, and spoiling you is the mission of every prince.

You are their cherished treasure; they care only about loving you. But assassins from the higher-dimensional universe can disguise themselves as anyone and attack you at any time. If you choose to enter one prince’s personal timeline, you can avoid being hunted.

Now, choose the prince you love most—your sanctuary.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're a terminally online recent college graduate who just won the vacation of a lifetime: a week on Paradise Island. But when your plane goes down over the ocean, you and five beautiful strangers wash up on a mysterious tropical island that seems to have a mind of its own.

[h2]STORY[/h2]

What starts as a desperate survival situation becomes something far stranger. The island provides for your every need - impossibly perfect weather, fruit that tastes like cherished memories, and supplies that appear exactly when you need them. But the island wants something in return: for you to discover who you really are.

Stranded with five women from completely different walks of life, you'll navigate complex relationships, uncover hidden talents, and face the question everyone's been avoiding: what happens when the real world comes calling?

[h2]THE CAST[/h2]

[b]Jessica Martinez[/b] - A famous influencer with 3 million followers, hiding a secret passion for classical piano that she abandoned for fame.

[b]Sophia Williams[/b] - A brilliant data analyst who uses logic to mask her fear of the unknown. Can she learn to trust her heart?

[b]Scarlett Jones[/b] - A fiery bartender and musician running from heartbreak. Her tough exterior hides deep vulnerability.

[b]Swift (Taylor)[/b] - An energetic fitness trainer who never stops moving - because stopping means confronting what she's running from.

[b]Azami Nakamura[/b] - A mysterious linguistics student who seems to understand the island's secrets better than anyone.

[h2]GAMEPLAY FEATURES[/h2]

[list]

[*] [b]Branching Narrative[/b] - Your choices shape relationships and unlock unique story paths. Every decision matters, from who you sit with on the plane to how you handle intimate moments.

[*] [b]Relationship System[/b] - Build trust and affection with each character through meaningful conversations and shared experiences. Different approaches unlock different scenes.

[*] [b]Multiple Episodes[/b] - 5+ hours of story content spread across multiple episodes, each focusing on a different character while advancing the main mystery.

[*] [b]Scene Gallery[/b] - Unlock and revisit memorable moments as you progress through the story.

[*] [b]Island Mysteries[/b] - Discover the supernatural secrets of the island. Why does it provide exactly what you need? What does it want in return?

[/list]

[h2]MATURE CONTENT[/h2]

This game contains adult content including nudity and sexual scenes. All characters are 18+. Adult content can be toggled in the options menu.

[h2]WHAT MAKES IT UNIQUE[/h2]

Touch Grass blends survival drama with romantic visual novel gameplay. Unlike typical dating sims, relationships develop organically through shared crisis and genuine connection. The supernatural island setting creates unique scenarios impossible in real-world settings, while the diverse cast ensures every player finds characters they connect with.

The game features self-aware humor about internet culture, parasocial relationships, and what it means to be "real" in an age of constant performance.

[h2]PLAYTIME[/h2]

[list]

[*] Main story: 5-7 hours

[*] All routes and scenes: 10-15 hours

[*] Completionist (all choices): 15-20 hours

store_data.about_the_game:
Omoide Cafe is a relaxing café/pastry shop simulation set in a quiet town painted in soft pastel hues. With the help of Bebii—a sweet and gentle companion—you gradually expand your small café, try new recipes, and unlock features that make your space more functional and lively.

Designed with fixed camera angles and point-and-click interactions, Omoide Cafe offers a calm, unrushed progression. Every drink you prepare and every piece of equipment you add brings more warmth and character to your café. Throughout your journey, Bebii stays by your side with helpful hints, light guidance, and encouraging comments.

As you shape the café’s decoration, you can unlock new items, meet customer expectations more effectively, and add your own touch to the town’s daily rhythm. New equipment, features, and small upgrades become available as you progress—your café becomes a more special place the more you care for it.

Omoide Cafe is designed to be pressure-free and gentle, letting you move entirely at your own pace. Each time you open the café’s doors, a small but meaningful sense of progress awaits you—with Bebii right there beside you.

store_data.about_the_game:
BRING THE LIGHT BACK

You arrived for a routine job, but the silence on this rock is deafening. The previous keeper is gone, and the machinery has been sabotaged. You are alone with the storm.

Dear Lighthouse is a tactile puzzle game where you don't just press a button to fix things, you must physically operate the gears, connect the circuits, and fuel the fire.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Immersive Repairs: Interact directly with industrial equipment. You must manually operate valves, connect electrical circuits, and manage power systems to restore functionality.

  • Scavenge & Restore: The lighthouse is in disrepair. Explore the island to find scrap materials and use the workshop to fabricate the missing component needed to fix the mechanism.

  • Narrative Mystery: The previous keeper didn't just leave, he was driven to the edge. His scattered diary pages tell a story of obsession and a 'song' on the wind.

Discover the Truth: Was he crazy, or was he the only one listening?

store_data.about_the_game:
You woke up late this Christmas day to find all of your family members suddenly gone. But that's not the only surprise... Christmas presents are scattered everywhere! What a pleasant surprise.

But wait, what are those items inside? A crowbar? Machine oil? A glue gun? Banana peels?

Well... while those might sound like awful presents, they sure can come in handy to prepare for the Christmas Siege party that's about to unveil.

  • Explore the Family Mansion: From the cozy Living Room and long, eerie corridors to the dark basement, dusty attic, and small hedge labyrinth in the backyard!

  • Survive the Holidays: Manage your 6-slot inventory and take care of your Christmas Mood. Find sweets and food to keep your energy up!

  • Fight Back: Use household items as weapons and traps. Stun your foes, inflict damage, and slow them down with injuries to make them less agile.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Experience an eerie retro-style atmosphere and immersive sound design. The house is well-lit, but you'll never know what's hiding behind a corner.

  • Short & Replayable: A tight, intense experience (30-60 mins) with three difficulty settings - for those wishing to relax and enjoy the holidays as well as those who wish to experience the true survival horror.

  • Dynamic AI: Face off against an intelligent (but comedically stupid) AI that will pursue you relentlessly. He gives you just enough room to breathe, but never lets you feel safe.

You are the only one who can protect the house now. So get to it!

Plays great on Steam Deck! In our testing, the game runs smoothly with a stable framerate and offers approximately 4 hours of battery life on a full charge!

This is simply a visual novel game about reminiscing the past.

You and the girl named “Dirtie” stay together in this forgotten world.
There are no goals to reach, nothing you must accomplish.
You simply keep each other company, chatting idly about the old days — and that’s all there is.

Gameplay

  • Click on the screen to advance the story.

  • Choose the options you want.

  • Think about what Dirtie says.

Sometimes, Dirtie may say things that break the fourth wall, but you don’t need to worry about it.

Streaming of this game is welcome (whether monetized or not).

  • Survive the Inflation: The cost of the gacha increases as you progress through stages. Pay to upgrade your machine and advance to the next stage. Build your fortune before you go bankrupt!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Plunderburg! With manicured lawns, a citation on every door and disastrous delivery drivers raining parcels from the sky - The HOA is on high alert!

But something's not quite right; Someone didn't measure their grass height, there’s glitter paint everywhere, and packages are walking away! Turns out, Package Pirates have infiltrated Plunderburg and they mean business! Can you sniff out the scallywag before they loot every last box… or will you be the scallywag, sailing away with the spoils?

GAMEPLAY:

  • 5 endlessly replayable ‘hoods, each with cheeky secrets and changing weather.

  • 1vs4 PvP deception & co-op detective work—form posses or go rogue.

  • First-person peeking & third-person scheming.

  • Traps galore: airhorn parcels, glitter bombs, and “why is there confetti in my sprinklers?!”

  • Dress for the mess: suburban ladies, business men, pirate punks, and everything in between.

  • A soundtrack so pirate-y, you’ll swear you need a peg leg and a parrot.

PIRATE PLAY:
Pirates begin with the rest of the neighborhood watch, appearing to be part of the HOA. But you don't have long! Your goal is to collect all packages around the neighborhood and return them to your Scaly Wagon (van). If you commit Pirate Deeds, you slowly reveal your true form – a Pirate – making it easier and easier for HOA team to spot, or even hear you coming.

Once all packages have been loaded, the pirate wins.

HOA PLAY:

You and your fellow HOA team must keep up appearances — Issue Violations, Tickets and Headaches! Earn Brownie Points or face the ultimate shame: eviction (aka spectator mode).

Other players can drop airhorn / glitter trap parcels, along with other outrageous traps to try and stop the pirate - So, don't spend too much time around tampered parcels - these things can go off for like - no reason.

If all Neighbors are eliminated, the Pirate wins. If the neighbors catch the pirate, and the pirate is processed at the police station, the Neighbors win.

store_data.about_the_game:
Racing Manager is a motorsport management and strategy game where you take control of a racing team as its Team Principal. Build the perfect staff, develop your car, manage your finances, and make the key decisions that will influence every race weekend.

Analyze performance data, adjust your drivers’ strategy, monitor tire wear, and choose the ideal moment for pit stops. Every decision matters if you want to stay competitive against rival teams.

Recruit skilled staff members, improve your technical facilities, optimize your budget, and guide your team to the top.
The final version will include multiple championships, a wide selection of drivers and teams, additional circuits, and a complete career mode.

Whether you’re a fan of management games or passionate about motorsports, Racing Manager delivers an accessible, deep, and immersive strategic experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
FloraLumina is a peaceful, ambient gardening game about planting seeds, nurturing a growing collection of unique hand-drawn flowers, and watching your mystical garden slowly come to life.

🌷 Grow Beautiful Hand-Drawn Flowers 🌼

Plant seeds, tend to your plants, and discover a variety of fantasy flowers, each one designed and illustrated by hand.

🌤️ A Garden That Changes With the Sky 🌙

Sunlight and moonlight guide your different flowers as they sprout and bloom, while shifting weather may boost or slow their growth. Whether it’s a bright morning or a quiet, rainy night, your garden reflects the atmosphere around it.

Occasionally, rare weather events will light up your garden. From rainbows and meteor showers to solar and lunar eclipses, these moments are beautiful to watch and bring boosts to your plants.

🪴 Customize Your Garden

Personalize your garden with a variety of flower pots in different shapes, colors, and designs; letting you create displays that feel cohesive (or not), and uniquely yours.

🌹 Discover Rare Flower Variants

Every so often, a flower may bloom in a rare color variant; a small, magical surprise that makes your garden feel even more special and sells for a higher amount than the standard color flowers.

🌱 Play at Your Own Pace

FloraLumina is designed to be played however you like; relax with it open in the background while you work, study, or unwind, or tend to your flowers more actively to encourage faster growth.

You can also save your progress at any time. Come back hours or days later and your garden will be right where you left it.

🎧 Soft Ambient Sound & Atmosphere 🎵

Enjoy calming environmental audio and thematic music that create a peaceful backdrop for your garden.

🌟 Game Features

  • A relaxing, mystical gardening experience

  • All artwork is hand-drawn and human-made

  • Tend to your flowers by watering, pruning and fertilizing them

  • Or don't tend to your flowers and simply wait for them to bloom on their own

  • Real-time flower growth influenced by sunlight, moonlight, and weather

  • Rare weather events like rainbows, meteor showers, and eclipses

  • Customize your garden with decorative pots

  • Discover up to 20 flower varieties, including rare color variants

  • Upgrades available to buy in the shop that increase the odds of various rare events, increase the sale price of grown flowers, and other boosts

  • Relax with soft ambience and peaceful music

  • Photo Mode toggle option in the settings menu to hide UI and make it easy to get nice screenshots of your garden

  • Save your progress at any time and come back to your garden later

  • Designed for cozy play at your own pace

store_data.about_the_game:
Boreal Tenebrae: Act 0 is an atmospheric narrative adventure set in the strange, dying town of Tamarack Narrows—a place of disappearing industry, simmering resentment, flickering CRTs, and a crimson aurora that stains the sky like a wound.

You play through the interwoven perspectives of Sarah Walker, her sister Bree, and the people trapped in this remote northern community on the night everything unravels. A centennial celebration meant to save the town becomes the site of a surreal catastrophe, when an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation—and delivering something far older, and far worse.

Inspired by late-90s analog media, fixed-angle exploration games, and the dream-logic horror that defines the full Boreal Tenebrae series, Act 0 blends PSX-style visuals, lo-fi video textures, and narrative-driven exploration to create a world that feels both intimate and unsettling.

This is the night the story begins.
This is the night Tamarack Narrows changed forever.

• A standalone prequel that enriches and expands the world of Boreal Tenebrae: Act 1 while remaining accessible to new players.

• Multi-perspective narrative following Sarah, Bree, Nicole, Sam, and the townsfolk as their lives intersect during one disastrous community event.

• Analog-horror aesthetic: CRT distortion, VHS noise, infrared footage, and PS1-inspired visuals woven directly into gameplay.

• Exploration of a collapsing prairie town, from liquor stores and empty streets to church basements and industrial yards.

• Cinematic storytelling: Fixed-camera scenes, interactive dialogue, and surreal sequences bursting into the real world.

• A mystery rooted in community, class struggle, and cosmic intrusion, setting the stage for the events of Act 1.

• Atmospheric soundtrack that shifts between warm nostalgia and unnerving dissonance.
