KAON: Fragmented Core is a high-energy 2D action-platformer that blends precision combat, fast movement, and striking, stylized animation. Inspired by classic side-scrollers but rebuilt with modern flair, KAON delivers crisp controls, expressive combat, and a unique visual identity driven by hand-crafted frames and bold silhouettes.

Play as Kaon, a young mech-enhanced fighter whose unstable core grants access to powerful Transformation Forms. Each form changes your mobility, attack style, and combat rhythmallowing you to drill, dash, blast, and strike your way through hostile robotic forces.

Explore vibrant industrial zones, corrupted research sectors, and fractured memory-spaces as you uncover the truth behind the Fragmented Core and the world it threatens to destabilize.

A New Spin on 2D Combat

Switch between transformation forms to break enemy defenses, pierce armored targets, and chain high-speed movement. Every encounter rewards timing, precision, and adaptability.

Stylish Hand-Made Animation

Every frame is crafted to emphasize impact, clarity, and character. Smooth transitions, expressive poses, and bold visual feedback bring every movement and hit to life

Transformation Mechanics

Unlock new abilities and switch styles mid-combat:

  • Drill Form – Burrow, pierce, and burst with armored momentum.

  • Core Burst – Release explosive energy for devastating strikes.

  • More forms to discover as your power evolves.

store_data.about_the_game:
The game is currently in an early stage of development, and anyone can join the playtest for free. What are you waiting for? Come and experience it for yourself!
Demolition Expert

Demolition Expert is a simulation game dedicated to the art of building destruction. We have constructed a dual-layer physics engine that allows you to do everything from punching a small hole in a wall to bringing an entire structure crashing down with a thunderous roar, delivering a hyper-realistic destruction experience.

Game Features

Granular Destruction System： Every brick in a wall and every chunk of concrete in a load-bearing pillar can be destroyed independently. Whether it's an office building or a bridge, and no matter how massive the structure is, you can dismantle it down to the smallest unit—a single brick or a piece of concrete.

Building Mechanics Simulation： In Demolition Expert, you don't need to slice a building completely in half to make it fall. Every building is constrained by realistic mechanics. We have built a dedicated physics system to handle gravity and structural load. You can chip away at the structure indiscriminately until the moment the remaining supports can no longer bear the weight, causing the whole thing to collapse instantly.

Real-Time Simulation & Persistent Dust Fields： There are no pre-baked animations for collapsing buildings or smoke effects. Every collapse and smoke plume is calculated in real-time—you will never see a building fall the exact same way twice. When a large section of a building is destroyed, it kicks up a massive dust field spanning thousands of cubic meters that lingers for tens of seconds. Crucially, this dust field respects physics: it will not clip or bleed through the building to the other side.

Gameplay

Challenge Levels： The game offers over a dozen maps and dozens of imaginative, mind-bending levels for players to challenge. From destroying a building within a time limit to breaking through obstacles to reach a specific point, you can utilize a vast array of weapons, sci-fi props, and even magic to achieve your goals.

Balanced Difficulty & Sandbox Destruction： Is a level too hard, or is the massive scale of destruction causing you computer to get stuck? Don't worry—the game features a fail-safe mechanism to ensure you can always clear the stage. Furthermore, Free Mode for each map unlocks simultaneously with its Challenge Mode. This means you have ample time to enjoy stress-relieving destruction—for example, sticking dozens of sticky bombs to a building and detonating them all at once for a spectacular "fireworks" display. This also gives you plenty of time to study the structural attributes of every building.

store_data.about_the_game:
Angry Fans Storm the Pitch. Defend Your Stadium, Command Your Own Security Team!

Take control of characters from different professions, position them strategically, and grow stronger with each wave as you hold off endless hordes of furious fans. Make the right choices in a chaotic football roguelike experience — build your defenses and drive the stands back!

  • Strategic Placement: Deploy your heroes with unique professions and abilities onto the pitch, establish your defensive line, and bring the stadium chaos under control.

  • Escalating Chaos: Each wave brings angrier, larger, and more destructive enemies. Survival gets harder with every round.

  • Smart Resource Management: Invest your earnings into the right upgrades, build powerful synergies, strengthen yourself at critical moments, and push your defense to its peak.

  • Split-Second Decisions: Think fast in the heat of chaos — redirect your characters, shift positions, adapt your strategy, and take complete control of the pitch.

Key Features

• Drag & Drop Inventory System – Easily transfer items between heroes and adapt your build mid-battle.

• Direct Character Control – Select any character and move freely using WASD controls.

• Class System – Unlock powerful synergies by combining heroes of the same class.

• Level System – Level up during runs and choose powerful upgrades.

• Advanced Progression – Strengthen your heroes and unlock new abilities.

• Tactical Combat – Each hero has a unique role and playstyle.

• Intense Visual Effects – Explosions, lightning strikes, healing effects, and dynamic animations.

• Enemy Variety – From enraged fans to deadly hooligan leaders.

• Strategic Depth – Discover item combinations and perk synergies.

• Pixel Art Style – Nostalgic visuals combined with modern gameplay impact.

• Endless Replayability – Every run is different. Every strategy matters.

HOW TO PLAY

• Choose a Hero – Pick one of three random cards or reroll.
• Deploy to the Field – Position your hero strategically.
• Defend the Wave – Hold back incoming enemies.
• Level Up – Select powerful upgrades.
• Earn Money – Defeat enemies and collect items.
• Grow Stronger – Add new heroes or enhance existing ones.
• Choose Perks – Gain permanent bonuses every 3 waves.
• Repeat – Face increasingly powerful enemies.

Tactical Depth. Real Control.

Football Survivors combines the speed of action with the weight of strategy.

Position your heroes at critical points across the field.
Face escalating waves of organized aggression.
Manage your resources carefully to keep your defense intact.
Make split-second decisions that determine the outcome of the battle.

Every wave is a test.
Every defense requires a new strategy.

Class System

Not every fighter is the same.

Different classes offer distinct playstyles:

• Durable frontline units that absorb damage
• Tactical specialists who control the battlefield
• High-damage aggressive operators
• Support units focused on healing and reinforcement

Team composition determines victory.
Without proper class synergy, survival is unlikely.

Shop System

Adaptation is the key to survival.

With the dynamic Shop System, you can:

• Purchase new equipment
• Gain critical power spikes at decisive moments

Experience the vibrant satisfaction of the late game as your screen fills with a massive array of colours, rewarding your patience and growth with beautiful visual density.  

Grow your flowers

You don't need to click your way to success. Just rest your cursor over a thirsting seed and watch as it drinks up the water, growing in steady, calming intervals. It’s a game designed to respect your hand and your peace of mind.

As your garden expands, you won't have to tend to every seed alone. Invest your earnings in high-grade sprinkler systems for constant care, or unlock the power of the sky to summon gentle rain clouds, ensuring every flower blooms even when your hands are off the mouse.

Discover Flowers With Unique Abilities

Discover and unlock a wide encyclopaedia of flora. From common sunflowers to rare, exotic orchids that yield high rewards, every new seed offers a fresh splash of colour for your screen along with unique abilities.

Unlock upgrades

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a bird. You have a nest. Other birds want your eggs.

Birds of War is a team-based aerial PvP. Raid nests, steal eggs, fight beak-to-beak in fast, chaotic matches built around flight and combat.

Your mic is always hot. Your enemies can hear you. Plan accordingly.

CHOOSE YOUR BIRD

Four classes. Four ways to ruin someone's day.

Crow: Go invisible. Sneak behind enemy lines. Steal an egg and vanish before anyone knows you were there. If they catch you, that's what the poison peck is for.

Hummingbird: The fastest bird in the sky. Dash through enemies, rapid-fire peck anything in your path, and move so fast they can't even target you. Just don't get hit. You can't take what you dish out.

Shoebill: Slow. Heavy. Terrifying. Shield your teammates, charge headfirst into a fight, and stun anyone dumb enough to stand in your way. If you see a Shoebill flying at you, run.

Pigeon: The support class nobody expects. Scan enemies through walls with your UAV pulse, slow entire groups with a wing clap, and keep your team in the fight.

RAID NESTS. DEFEND YOURS.

Steal eggs from enemy nests and bring them back to yours. Play objective, play aggressive, or just cause problems for everyone on the map. Multiple game modes keep the action fresh, but the core stays the same: fly fast, fight hard, protect what's yours.

Last team standing takes everything.

ALSO FEATURING

  • Full ragdoll physics. Get launched, tumble, spiral, and crash with deeply satisfying chaos

  • Melee combat that rewards timing, positioning, and the element of surprise

  • A (rear end) projectile system we legally cannot describe in detail on the store page

  • Maps designed for aerial combat, nest defense, and creative egg routes

  • Multiple game modes to keep every session unpredictable

  • Early Access pricing. Get in now, watch it grow, shape it with us

store_data.about_the_game:
Ktrl Smash is a chaotic and fast-paced multiplayer arena brawler where every second counts. Jump into a bright 3D arena, choose your fighter, and battle players from around the world in short, intense matches. Your goal is simple: get the most kills before the timer hits zero.

The arena is packed with weapons and stat boosts, turning every match into a wild scramble. Pick up anything you can find, swing a baseball bat, throw a baseball, or smash someone with a chair. Each weapon changes how you fight, letting you surprise opponents or rush straight into the action.

Scattered around the map are useful pickups like Speed Boost, Damage Boost, and Health Boost. Grabbing them at the right moment can help you survive longer, strike faster, or turn a losing fight around. With players racing toward the same boosts, every pickup becomes a small battle of its own.

Matches are quick, lively, and unpredictable. One moment you are chasing someone with a bat, the next, you’re scrambling to grab a boost before someone else does. Simple controls make it easy to jump in, while the fast pace keeps every round exciting and competitive.

When the timer runs out, the player with the highest kills claims the win and becomes the ultimate champion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Doodle Wipeout is a fast-paced, action roguelite which subverts the classic survivor genre where you hunt the enemies as they look to avoid you.

Play as a tiny eraser fighting against waves of chaotic enemies - a doodle army - that has invaded the notebook canvas. But you don't eliminate them with weapons - but erase them by scrubbing them

But as an eraser your health is your ammunition. Every time you wipeout a doodle - you shrink and deplete your life. 

You not only have to manage your own health, but also manage the canvas integrity, which falls as the doodles invade.

Each run drops you onto a fresh canvas - and it's your job to clean it, one eraser stroke at a time.

  • Erase instead of shoot: You are not fighting with guns, bombs or knives. But you are just an eraser gliding across the page, erasing doodle creatures one swipe at a time.

  • Roguelite progression: Unlock upgrades and combos across runs. Each try is different, but every erased doodle brings you closer to success.

  • Live sketch chaos: Enemy doodles move, swarm, and spread across the page. You not only have to survive waves of doodles but also clean the page to save the canvas.

  • Short play sessions, big fun: With quick runs and escalating difficulty, Eraser Game is perfect both for spontaneous play and deeper replay sessions.

Can you successfully wipe out waves of sketchy troublemakers before the canvas is lost?

store_data.about_the_game:
Legends Reloaded is a roguelike arena shooter where you play as resurrected legends - Alfred Brainstain, Threepac Parkur and Marlin Merlot. Destroy spawners to stop hordes of Lovecraftian aliens, progress through their base to fight the bosses. Get weapons, skills and upgrades to fit your playstyle.

Your main goal is to kill hordes of aliens to fill the spawner vulnerability bar. While you do it, the enemies will keep spawning. Touching them is not deadly, but they do have attacks. Do the killing quickly or they will overwhelm you!

Once the spawners are vulnerable to damage, it is time to destroy them as quickly as possible to stop the aliens from spawning and loot some organs.

Fight unique MINI-BOSSES at the end of each sub-level. Beating them will get you new reusable skills...

...and BIG BOSSES at the end of each level. Beating them will provide you with impactful passive items that will have a huge impact on your playstyle.

Use the unique specials each of the characters have. Threepac has a mic drop ability that pushes enemies away and damages them, Alfred has a black hole that sucks enemies towards it and damages them, and Marlin has the charm ability that freezes all of the enemies.

Each sub-level consists of many rooms. After you clear each room you will get a stat increase — choose from three options.

When you beat the MINI-BOSS at the end of each sub-level you will get a permanent, reusable skill, like damage enemies on touch and become invulnerable, poison all enemies, etc. You are able to have two of them equipped at the same time.

In the third sub-level you will encounter the BIG BOSS of the level. If you manage to beat it you will get a passive upgrade you can choose from that can greatly impact your playstyle. Like split bullets in three on hit, chance to leave a shooting clone after dash, dual wield, etc.

When you destroy spawners you get organs. There will be gun stores you can locate around the level. Use organs to roll for a gun and choose one from the three guns rolled.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Castille has invaded the island! Assemble a team of 4 Engkanto Girls (Monster Girls) and engage in strategic turn-based combat against the Castille and other corrupted engkanto girls!

~Gameplay~

This game features the classic turn-based battles with beautiful and cute monster girls based on Philippine mythos and legends. There's 4 default Engkanto Girls and 16 unlockable ones using special currency gained throughout the game. There are also 53 different 4★ equipment (late-game legendary items) and 100 mementos (unique equipment, each of the engkanto girls have 5) that can shape the way you play your Engkanto Girls. There are 18 bosses/ boss teams, 21 mini-bosses/mini-boss teams with unique mechanics tied to them.

The game is also divided into 2 parts: The Pre-Hardmode early game where you can fish for 3★ and 4★ equipment in special blessings, collect gold and other currencies, and get a feel for the gameplay. And then there's Hardmode, only unlocked when the first 8 bosses are defeated, unlocking better items, equipment, harder difficulty battles, and inching towards the final boss of the game.

~Difficulty~

Make no mistake about thinking this is just a simple "cast skill immediately when available" kind of turn-based game. This game requires strategy, understanding of the skill descriptions, and a lot of theory-crafting. Finding the best team and the best combo for a particular dungeon and/or boss.

store_data.about_the_game:
NEW GAME MODE - ARENA

Seeker ARENA is a couch co-op brawler mode where players can battle each other using various spells.

Gather up to 4 players at one PC in the good old-fashioned HOTSEAT mode with keyboards and controllers.

In the Arena, you will find different types of spells to help you defeat your opponents.

Knock your opponents off the arena with a hurricane or incinerate them with fireballs.

Find out who is stronger in the art of magic!

On the Hunt for Treasure!

Step into the boots of a treasure hunter — the Seeker. Your goal is to gather as much gold as possible and escape alive from the mysterious Skull Castle. Our game is a 2D fantasy hardcore adventure where every reckless move could be your last. But what won't you do for the gleam of gold coins and ancient artifacts?

Hit and Run

"Seeker" is an action-platformer where we aimed to deliver a high-paced experience and create quality gameplay. Overcome obstacles, outsmart cunning traps, and fight for your life. Collect every sack of gold and leave no enemy standing! You won't find lengthy dialogues, drawn-out introductions, or tedious waiting here — only your skills and the game that will put them to the test.

No Mercy… Well, almost

We're crafting a game that will push the player's skills to the limit, so it might sometimes feel unfair. This will evoke a range of emotions, but we want them to be ultimately positive. That's exactly why we're launching in Early Access — to fine-tune the balance and enhance the experience together with you.

"Seeker" is an action-platformer where we aimed to deliver a high-paced experience and create quality gameplay. Overcome obstacles, outsmart cunning traps, and fight for your life. Collect every sack of gold and leave no enemy standing! You won't find lengthy dialogues, drawn-out introductions, or tedious waiting here — only your skills and the game that will put them to the test.

store_data.about_the_game:
Setting, Main Objective, and Victory Conditions

Welcome to the cold tiled toilet floor! You control a determined turd, battling another turd. Your goal in this game is speed and tactical superiority. To win a round, you must fill your storage with resources before your opponent. The winner is the first to deliver exactly 10 items to their base.

Character Controls

The game features an automatic movement system. Your turd slides forward on the tile automatically and continuously. Your task is to timely set the correct direction by pressing the arrow keys on your keyboard to maneuver through the maze.

Unique Game World

You won't be able to memorize the map. Each new game is generated from scratch: the location of bases, the types of collectibles, and the configuration of obstacles are always unique. You will have to instantly navigate a new environment every time you start a game.

Dynamic Environment

The game's difficulty increases as you progress. The board reacts to your actions: as soon as any player picks up an item from the floor, a new obstacle instantly appears in a random location on the map. By the end of the round, your room to maneuver narrows significantly, requiring pinpoint precision.

Penalty System and Risks

The game is unforgiving. Any contact with an obstacle (a cactus) or a trap left by an opponent results in a double penalty:

You lose one health point.

One item already acquired is immediately removed from your storage.

One wrong move can set you back and cost you the victory.

Interception and Steal Mechanics

If you see an opponent carrying an item back to their base, this is your chance. Play cleverly: time your trajectory and get behind them. If you catch them at this moment, you can snatch the item right out of their hands and claim it for yourself. Furthermore, resources in the storage area are not safe: you can drive directly into the enemy base and steal an item they've already delivered.

Combat Arsenal and Bonuses

Special boosters regularly appear on the field, capable of dramatically changing the course of a match. Knowing their properties is essential for victory:

Bombardier – a formidable area control weapon. After picking up this bonus, your character begins to leave a trail of explosive traps (poop mines). When a mine detonates, a powerful explosion occurs, causing an earthquake effect: the screen begins to shake, disorienting the opponent and preventing them from controlling their character.

Sabotage – a means of economic attack. This bonus allows you to instantly destroy some of the items already accumulated in the enemy's storage area.

Snowflake – completely blocks the enemy. The opponent turns into ice and is unable to move, while you freely collect resources.

Ally – summons reinforcements. A computer-controlled assistant appears on the field, which will autonomously carry items to your base for a certain period of time. Beetle – Provides a sharp increase in gliding speed, allowing you to deliver cargo faster.

Medkit – Restores lost health (only works if your health bar is low).

Success depends on how well you combine resource gathering, avoiding constantly appearing obstacles, and timely looting of enemy supplies.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Store looks familiar.

That’s the problem.
You enter a brightly lit furniture superstore made of showrooms, aisles, and corridors.
Everything is clean. Orderly. Normal.
Then it repeats.
The rooms return in the same order, with the same layout — but not always in the same state. Something may be wrong. Or nothing may be wrong at all. And knowing the difference is the only way forward.

Observation is the game

Each room you enter may contain an anomaly - or may be perfectly normal. If you notice something out of the ordinary, turn back. If everything appears normal, move forward. Choose incorrectly, and the loop resets.
There is no combat, no hints, and no confirmation. The Store never tells you what changed - only if you were right or wrong.

Your objective

You are not just trying to escape - you are shopping! As you move through the Store, you must collect items from a shopping list scattered naturally throughout the rooms. Miss an item, and the Store will not let you leave.
Every reset reshuffles your list and your path. Routine turns into pressure the longer each loop continues.

The end of the loop

Reach the cash-out room with all required items, and the Store may finally allow you to leave.
Or it may not.

Every playthrough begins again in the first room.
Nothing is permanent except what you remember.

Key Features

  • Observation-Driven Progression
    Advance by noticing what feels wrong — or realizing nothing is.
  • Endless Marketplace Loop
    A furniture superstore layout built from themed rooms and corridors that repeat, reset, and deceive.
  • Unique Anomalies
    Environmental, audio, and entity-based changes designed to test perception, not reflexes.
  • No Combat, No Guidance
    No weapons. No UI warnings. Only your judgment.

store_data.about_the_game:
PUNISH TALENT - TAX SUCCESS - REWARD MEDIOCRITY

In this card-based simulation, your mission isn't to save the country—it's to stop its motor. Weaponize bureaucracy, break the producers' spirit, and bring the system to a halt.

KEY FEATURES

  • Reverse City-Building: Unlike classic management games, your goal is not to grow, but to strategically leave a living, breathing city without producers.

  • Card-Based Sabotage: Tax hikes, security inspections, and supply chain blockages... Use your deck of action cards to mess with the producers' settings.

  • Producer Psychology System: Face off against unique characters such as Industrialists, Artists, Inventors, and Economists. Each has a “Patience” limit and sensitive points that you must provoke.


  • Grid Mechanics & Chain Reactions: Use your neighborly relationships to your advantage. Isolate a producer whose neighbor has disappeared.

  • Stealth Strategy: Manage your “suspicion” level. If you make moves too aggressively, Parasites and Raiders will detect your presence and come after you.

  • Campaign & Progression: As you conquer more challenging areas, unlock new cards.


YOUR WEAPON: THE STAMP & SIGNATURE

  • Shadow Governance: You don't need a bomb to destroy a factory. Just slap a new customs duty on its raw materials and watch it shut down.

  • Bureaucratic Hell: Want to kill innovation? Set up a committee called ‘Public Interest’ and bury inventors in so much red tape that they can't invent anything while filling out forms.

  • Wear down producers' patience with paperwork and mind-numbing techniques. Do everything secretly.

  • Analyze the positions and roles of producers in the city.

  • Strike at the most critical point.

  • Watch the disappearance.
store_data.detailed_description:
PUNISH TALENT - TAX SUCCESS - REWARD MEDIOCRITY

In this card-based simulation, your mission isn't to save the country—it's to stop its motor. Weaponize bureaucracy, break the producers' spirit, and bring the system to a halt.

KEY FEATURES

  • Reverse City-Building: Unlike classic management games, your goal is not to grow, but to strategically leave a living, breathing city without producers.

  • Card-Based Sabotage: Tax hikes, security inspections, and supply chain blockages... Use your deck of action cards to mess with the producers' settings.

  • Producer Psychology System: Face off against unique characters such as Industrialists, Artists, Inventors, and Economists. Each has a “Patience” limit and sensitive points that you must provoke.


  • Grid Mechanics & Chain Reactions: Use your neighborly relationships to your advantage. Isolate a producer whose neighbor has disappeared.

  • Stealth Strategy: Manage your “suspicion” level. If you make moves too aggressively, Parasites and Raiders will detect your presence and come after you.

  • Campaign & Progression: As you conquer more challenging areas, unlock new cards.


YOUR WEAPON: THE STAMP & SIGNATURE

  • Shadow Governance: You don't need a bomb to destroy a factory. Just slap a new customs duty on its raw materials and watch it shut down.

  • Bureaucratic Hell: Want to kill innovation? Set up a committee called ‘Public Interest’ and bury inventors in so much red tape that they can't invent anything while filling out forms.

  • Wear down producers' patience with paperwork and mind-numbing techniques. Do everything secretly.

  • Analyze the positions and roles of producers in the city.

  • Strike at the most critical point.

  • Watch the disappearance.
store_data.short_description: Are new bans coming to your country? You, bring even more. Forget city-building games. You're not a builder, you're a DESTROYER. Use taxes and bureaucracy to collapse a flawlessly functioning dystopian industrial system from within. A card-based ideological collapse simulation game.

🌊 Motarium, the aquarium of words

Motarium blends the world of words with the tranquility of the ocean. A peaceful, immersive experience where letters float among fish and bubbles. Each game is a unique journey through language, combining fun, focus and a touch of poetry.

From anagrams to SUTOM, from word searches to original ideas, Motarium offers a rich and evolving collection of word games wrapped in an elegant underwater atmosphere. Whether you play for a few minutes or dive deep into challenges, the experience is designed to relax and engage.

🎮 A variety of word games for every type of player

  • Play casually or chase the perfect score with flexible game modes

  • Enjoy a smooth, animated oceanic setting filled with fish, bubbles and motion

  • Discover both classic and original gameplay built around language

⭐ Key features

  • Daily challenge shared with all players

  • Over 35 Steam achievements to unlock

  • Three difficulty levels to suit every skill level

  • Available in both English and French

  • Virtual keyboard included for added comfort

  • Share your results with stylish emoji grids

  • Word game lovers looking for a fresh experience

  • Casual players seeking quick, satisfying sessions

  • Puzzle fans who enjoy daily challenges

  • Completionists and achievement hunters

  • Anyone who just wants to relax with beautiful visuals and smart gameplay

Step into Motarium. The words are waiting for you, just below the surface.

store_data.about_the_game:
🌅

On a sunlit island where light shimmers softly across leaves and water, charming animal adventurers roam between peaceful fishing spots. Each character brings their own vibe, making every journey feel warm and lively.

🎣

Fishing feels like a small but engaging challenge. You need to hook the fish at the right moment, keep the line in a stable state, and react to the catch as it moves. Every successful pull feels rewarding.
Rods differ in appearance and the feeling they bring to the fishing process. Some are better for calm lakes, others work well in the ocean. You can buy them from the local merchant and gradually build a colorful collection.
After each session your catch goes into your inventory. You can sell fish to earn coins and then use them to unlock new animal heroes or get fresh fishing gear.

🏝️

The island reveals itself little by little. The wide river is home to lively fish, the lakes offer a relaxed experience, and the ocean holds the rarest species. Each place has its own mood, and the soft shimmering light gives everything a magical touch ✨

🎯

Your journey is about exploring every fishing spot, gathering rare species, and unlocking new characters. Step by step you grow into a true fishing master, discovering new areas and collecting memorable rods along the way.

🐾

Dive into a cozy adventure where the hero you choose, the rod you use, and the places you visit form your own story. Every catch brings joy, and every shore hides something new. Welcome to an island that lives and breathes fishing!

store_data.about_the_game:
VRMのキャラたちが、あなたの箱庭で生活

作業のお供に、休憩のひと時に、あなたの暮らしをちょっと楽しく。

見守って、設置して、また見守って。あなたの暮らしで成長する箱庭アプリ

最大10人のVRM読み込みに対応、置いた家具はキャラクターが使ってくれるかも？

【機能紹介】

・VRM対応『最大10人』

箱庭のLvが上がっていくと、最大10人まで読み込むことができます

箱庭の住人となったキャラクターたちは、あなたの置いた家具などで生活します

椅子に座って休んだり、疲れたらベッドで寝たり、時には遊んだり

住人同士で楽しんでいる様子や、気ままに生活している様子を覗いてみましょう

・クラフト機能

地面や壁、床、扉や家具など、思いのままに設置

溜まったポイントで配置したいものと交換して、自分だけの箱庭を作ろう

箱庭のLvが上がると新たな家具なども？

・スケジュール機能

カレンダーに自分のスケジュールを登録してみましょう

時間が来たら、箱庭に通知が届きます

用事が済んだらスケジュールをチェック、ポイントと交換できます

先々のスケジュールまで登録すれば、いいことがあるかも？

・タイマー機能

作業をここまで頑張ろう、あと１時間頑張ろう

そんな時はタイマーをセットして、作業に戻りましょう

時間になったら、また箱庭を眺めて、クラフトするのもいいかもしれません

・箱庭Lv

住人たちが家具を使ったり、楽しんだりすると

島の幸福度が溜まっていき、箱庭Lvが上がります

たくさんいい家具や施設を置いて、住人達を楽しませましょう

ポイントが無くなったら、作業などしながら待ちましょう

プレイ時間の経過でポイントが貰えて、その間に住人たちが楽しんでくれているかも？

・スクリーンショット機能

ゲーム内のスクリーンショット機能で、住人たちのいろんな場面を撮影

お喋りしているところ？休んでいるところ？眠っているところ？

色んな場面を撮影して、思い出フォルダをいっぱいにしましょう

store_data.about_the_game:
You’re an ordinary tourist on a relaxing vacation to Emerald Valley.

But shortly after arriving, the tour guide brings troubling news — a sudden landslide has sealed off the only road out.
No one can leave. At least… not for now.

Soon, you realize this may be more than just an accident.
Strange noises in the distance, scattered notes that don’t quite add up, eerie stone formations — the valley feels like an invisible maze waiting to be unraveled.

This is a point-and-click puzzle game, in this game, you will:

🔑Explore environments by clicking through each scene
🔑Collect and organize clues
🔑Share information with other stranded tourists

🔑 Use the correct items to interact with tourists and gather more information. First, "click the item" to select it, then         "click the target" to deliver it. (If there is no response, it usually means the selected item does not match the target.)
🔑 Travel between different locations to investigate further

Piece together fragments of memory, logic, and observation to uncover the real reason no one can leave.

Find the truth — and lead your companions out of the valley.

If leaving is still possible…

store_data.about_the_game:
关于本作故事——

作为《星标》系列的第四部作品，本次的故事舞台设定在全新的世界“奥克恩迪”，奥克恩迪一共由五块大陆组成，其中据说是神所居住的乐园“帕拉迪”位于中央大陆“希幽大陆”之上，而其余的四块大陆“碧脉大陆”、“战庭大陆”、“漠罪大陆”以及“霜寂大陆”则有着各自截然不同的人文地貌，围绕着中央的“希幽大陆”。

主人公“锐昂”是个善良乐观的少年，他有一个梦想，那就是前往乐园“帕拉迪”，为此他需要锻炼出足够强大的实力，更重要的是，他必须筹集到一笔足以组建起前往“帕拉迪”的庞大资金。

而就在某天，锐昂所在的“莉丘墨商会”的老板莉丘墨就给了他这样一个机会，让他去与神秘的大客户“戴丝”洽谈任务……

本作特色——

作为经典JRPG的爱好者以及制作者，本作在继承前作《星标3》的系统基础上，进一步完善和扩充了各类系统与细节，战斗序列和天赋保留并革新了自不必多说，还增加了更多强化系统，优化了传送机制等，对于那些想要挑战强大BOSS的玩家，在通关后也会有专门的爬塔内容。

二十几座截然不同的城镇，上百名NPC能够提供的主线+支线内容之丰富远超前作，预计总时长超过三十个小时，更不要说还有各式各样的BOSS。

总之，如果你是经典JRPG的爱好者，那就绝对不能错过本作！

备注——

本作的剧本灵感来源于《异度之刃2》，因此熟悉《异度之刃2》的玩家会在其中找到不少眼熟的设定和剧情发展，但这绝不是照搬《异度之刃2》，首先我没有能力和资源去还原如此庞大的世界观和那么丰富的角色塑造，其次，作为《星标》新三部曲的开端，它将开启一个不同于前三作的主舞台“亚尔泰亚斯星”的新世界……

store_data.about_the_game:
Reflex Run is a fast paced 3D troll platformer about a wizard who lost everything. His powers, his dignity, and possibly his patience.

A mysterious troll caused a black curse, and now the only way forward is through a series of brutal challenges. Each level is split into short runs filled with traps that lie, floors that disappear, and mechanics that change just when you start to feel safe.

Between runs, a magical portal sends you forward. It also mocks you. Constantly.

Upgrades make you stronger for exactly one run. Then they are gone. Levels introduce new rules, then break them. Death is quick, restarts are instant, and progress comes from learning not to trust anything.

Reflex Run is built for players who enjoy tight controls, fast retries, and games that know exactly what they are doing to you.

Features

  • Fast paced 3D troll platformer gameplay

  • Short runs designed for quick retries and muscle memory

  • Temporary upgrades that reset every run

  • Constantly changing level mechanics

  • Sarcastic, voice filled portal that reacts to your progress

  • Stylized black, white, and grey visual style

  • Instant restarts with no downtime
store_data.detailed_description:
Reflex Run is a fast paced 3D troll platformer about a wizard who lost everything. His powers, his dignity, and possibly his patience.

A mysterious troll caused a black curse, and now the only way forward is through a series of brutal challenges. Each level is split into short runs filled with traps that lie, floors that disappear, and mechanics that change just when you start to feel safe.

Between runs, a magical portal sends you forward. It also mocks you. Constantly.

Upgrades make you stronger for exactly one run. Then they are gone. Levels introduce new rules, then break them. Death is quick, restarts are instant, and progress comes from learning not to trust anything.

Reflex Run is built for players who enjoy tight controls, fast retries, and games that know exactly what they are doing to you.

Features

  • Fast paced 3D troll platformer gameplay

  • Short runs designed for quick retries and muscle memory

  • Temporary upgrades that reset every run

  • Constantly changing level mechanics

  • Sarcastic, voice filled portal that reacts to your progress

  • Stylized black, white, and grey visual style

  • Instant restarts with no downtime
store_data.short_description: A fast, unfair 3D troll platformer where a cursed wizard tries to regain his powers. Short runs, changing rules, temporary upgrades, instant retries, and a sarcastic portal that enjoys your suffering.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Light of Y》是一款经典回合制RPG，保留传统的队伍构建、技能搭配与装备养成机制，玩家将在充满谜题与挑战的地域中探索、完成任务并与各类敌人交锋。游戏聚焦角色成长与策略性战斗，通过升级技能、收集合成材料与打造装备来优化队伍战力，适合喜欢策略思考与养成的玩家。

在叙事上，游戏的世界曾被一种被称为“Y之光”的古老光辉所照耀，光的衰退带来了动荡與腐化；主角因一段意外卷入了与“Y之光”有关的古老传承。光在本作中更多担当的是文化、信仰与秘密的线索：城镇的传说与若干关键剧情节点都与“Y之光”有关，玩家将通过探索与对话逐步拼凑出光与世界衰变的真相。

store_data.about_the_game:
The main goal in Rabbit Samurai is to build a unique deck. Each card belongs to a specific type. Create powerful synergies by combining different card types with relics to progress AS FAR AS POSSIBLE!

In Rabbit Samurai, you'll explore a multitude of rooms. Behind their doors lurk unusual creatures: some are ready to help, others—to harm. Moreover, on your journey, you will find secret chests containing unique relics that will make you stronger.

Face off against dozens of enemies and bosses. Each foe will use specific actions against themselves or you: from attacks and defense to thorns and life steal! Prove your strength and your ability to stand against evil!

Game Features:

  • Build a Unique Deck from a Growing Collection.
    Create your deck from an expanding card pool. Add new cards or remove old ones to assemble the most effective deck possible. Every card is unique, and the ability to replace and upgrade them will make your adventure unforgettable!

  • Find Powerful Relics and Create Synergies.
    Collect relics, each granting unique passive abilities. Choose wisely—with the right cards, even the weakest artifact can completely turn the tide of the game!

  • Explore Diverse Locations and Uncover Their Secrets.
    Your deck isn't the only thing that makes each run unique. Every location is a procedurally generated map, giving you the freedom to choose your path. Will you engage enemies or encounter mysterious inhabitants? The choice is yours!

Prepare yourself and embark on a perilous adventure!

store_data.about_the_game:
Become Passus Pulpum: A humble peasant with a steady hand, one splintered toothpick, and a dream to save the mouths of the people of Bocalia (and maybe win the heart of the Princess while he's at it).

Royal Dental is a quirky dental simulation RPG where you diagnose ailments, pull teeth, perform treatments, and rise through the social ranks of a kingdom that most certainly does not take oral hygiene seriously.

Treat peasants, servants, merchants, nobles, and eventually the beloved Princess Penelope Calahan herself, all while outsmarting the jealous Prince Daniel Silvertongue, who will do anything to sabotage your practice and steal your spotlight.

🦷 Treat Patients, Master the Craft

Each morning brings a new lineup of unfortunate mouths in need of help.
Diagnose conditions like cavities, rotten teeth, fractures, gum infection, and more.
Then decide how to approach each case:

  • Use anesthetic (or don’t… their screams build character)

  • Sanitize your tools

  • Pick the correct instrument

  • Perform the procedure

  • Waive the fee, charge a fair price, or gouge them for all they’ve got. Just remember the people of Bocalia talk.

Every choice affects patient happiness, outcomes, and your climb through the land’s social strata.

📈 Rise From Peasant Dentist to Royal Legend

Progress through distinct quadrants of Bocalia, from muddy peasant villages to the gold-trimmed halls of the Royal Palace.

Unlock new tools, learn advanced dental techniques, upgrade your clinic, and complete Tooth Trials to earn permanent Wisdom Tooth Buffs, powerful upgrades that help you in your craft.

Your journey from dirt-poor dentist to elite healer is driven entirely by your skill and decisions.

🕰️ The Daily Grind (Get it? Tooth Pun 😁)

Your daily routine is yours to shape. With action-based time progression, each day you can:

  • Treat as many patients as you can handle. Your reputation affects how many patients show up, and how much they trust you.

  • Visit the town square to buy tools and supplies, educational texts, and new furniture for your clinic.

  • Study dental texts to improve your techniques.

😈 A Rival Prince With Terrible Intentions

Prince Daniel Silvertongue is your persistent thorn.

He spreads rumors, steals your tools, disrupts patient flow, and grows more aggressive with his sabotage as you rise through the ranks.

💘 The Ultimate Treatment: Princess Penelope Calahan

Your final and greatest challenge.

Princess Penelope’s teeth are... well... legendarily awful. Restoring her smile will require everything you’ve learned, every upgraded tool you’ve bought, and every ounce of courage Passus has left.

Your success determines not just her fate, but your own.

🤢 A Very Immersive Audio Experience

Royal Dental doesn’t shy away from the sounds of medieval dentistry:

  • Crunching tooth extractions

  • Gagging, choking, and spitting from your patients

  • Drills, tooth scrapers, scalpels cutting flesh

  • Passus muttering, reacting, and talking through his day

  • Unique background music for every location in Bocalia

And if any of that makes your stomach turn, don’t worry. Music, voice lines, and all SFX can be turned off or volume-adjusted independently.

🌟 Key Features

  • 🦷 Story-driven dental simulation RPG

  • 📚 Learn and unlock medieval-inspired dental techniques

  • 💰 Earn gold, upgrade tools, improve your clinic

  • 👑 Progress through five societal tiers: Peasants → Royalty

  • 🎓 Complete Tooth Trials and earn permanent Wisdom Tooth Buffs

  • 📅 Daily action-based routine with free exploration choices

  • 🤕 Perform diagnoses, apply anesthetic, sanitize tools, and treat ailments

  • 😈 Battle sabotage, rumors, and rivalry from Prince Silvertongue

  • 💞 Treat Princess Penelope and win her heart

  • 📰 Check the daily newspaper to see the goings-on of the people and royalty of Bocalia

  • 📝 UI/text-driven design with humorous encounters and memorable NPCs

  • 🛠️ Minimalist visuals with stylized icons and character portraits

  • 🎧 Detailed dental SFX, patient reactions, voice lines, and background music with full volume control

翻開日記，找回遺失的記憶與消失的真相——你，準備好一起迎接黎明前的真相了嗎？」

關於本作 (Story)

《Before Dawn》是一款結合校園霸凌與網路暴力議題的文字冒險遊戲 (ADV)。玩家將扮演失去記憶的主角「千穗」，在迷霧中探索，試圖從與他人的互動、破碎的線索中拼湊出真相。 這不僅是一個尋找記憶的過程，更是一次直面當代社會沉重議題的心靈拷問。你所看到的「真相」，真的是真相嗎？

遊戲特色 (Key Features)

  • 沉浸式劇情體驗： 深入探討校園霸凌與網路暴力，劇本細膩且發人深省。

  • 多重結局 (Multi-endings)： 隨著記憶恢復，你將面臨數個關鍵抉擇。你的每一個決定，都將引導千穗走向截然不同的命運。

  • 多樣化玩法： 不只是閱讀對話，還包含「社群媒體模擬」互動與「解謎小遊戲」，讓你能更具體地感受到主角面臨的輿論壓力與心理狀態。

  • 獨特的視覺風格： 細膩的手繪風格、獨特的色調、結合科技與真實的場景創造更符合遊戲氣氛的畫面。

玩法介紹 (Gameplay)

遊戲透過滑鼠點擊進行。玩家需要在場景中尋找關鍵道具、在手機介面上與 NPC 進行訊息互動，或是解開謎題來推動劇情發展。當關鍵選項出現時，請謹慎選擇——因為這可能決定了黎明是否會到來。

store_data.about_the_game:
STORY

As unexplained deaths begin to plague the place where Jacob’s family lives, they plead for him to come and take them away. But when Jacob arrives, the house is silent scattered belongings, interrupted traces… and his family is nowhere to be found.

The source of the terror soon becomes clear: a man detached from reality, plagued by severe psychological instability, convinced that the residents are cursed and must be punished. As Jacob follows the broken clues left behind, the darkness around him grows deeper.

While searching for his family, he encounters something that defies all reason a mysterious elevator whose doors open to different and unpredictable places each time. This strange mechanism seems to connect the fate of the missing with the madman’s twisted beliefs.

To uncover what happened to his family, Jacob must step through this unknown doorway and face whatever lies beyond.

THE ELEVATOR

Within the story, it serves as an irregular passage that links random locations together. Each time the doors open, they reveal a different environment sometimes the village square, sometimes the entrance to an abandoned room, or perhaps even a bathroom. Uncertainty is the only constant within this structure.

ESCAPE FROM DEATH

The moment Silvarn appears in the doorway, everything quickly slips out of control. As you move through narrow corridors beneath flickering lights, the heavy sound of his footsteps behind you grows more unsettling with each passing second.
Every turn holds a new danger, every door opens to an uncertain escape. Silvarn never slows down; every step you take walks the thin line between life and death.
It creates a relentless chase where the pressure never lets up, leaving you barely any room to breathe.

CORE FEATURES

  • Intense Atmosphere
    A suffocating environment set in a dark, sealed-off village where even the silence feels threatening.

  • Constant Sense of Pressure
    An unseen presence that grows closer with every step, creating an ongoing feeling of danger.

  • Visual Tension
    Cinematic camera work, realistic lighting, and detailed environments that reinforce the unsettling tone.

  • Lurking Threat
    Disturbed stranger wandering the village, leaving traces, sounds, and shadows that keep you on edge.

  • Story-Driven Puzzles
    Short, non-repetitive puzzles carefully tied to the narrative, deepening the mystery as you progress.

store_data.about_the_game:
A charming pixel-art fantasy where every decision shapes the fate of your humble settlement.

It begins with a handful of villagers, essential resources, and the unwavering dream of survival. But the world is harsh, filled with monsters and natural threats. Can you prove that neither the monstrous invasions nor random disasters can scare you? This is your village, and everything depends on you!

Key Features:

  • Deep Village Management: Start from scratch and grow into a thriving community. Assign specialized tasks to your villagers, manage key resources like wood, stone, and food, and optimize your production lines to ensure your populace stays happy and safe.

  • Expand Your Territory: Unlock and construct a diverse range of buildings—from humble lumber mills and farms to powerful defense towers and fortresses—each structure is crucial for expanding and strengthening your unique settlement.

  • Survive the Onslaught: Prepare your defensive positions! Face down a multitude of enemies and natural disasters. Every new challenge will test your management skills to the limit.

  • Forge a Mighty Army: Train units and create an army that will defend your borders. Be brave and choose the right strategy to repel the hordes and protect your citizens.

  • Passive & Permanent Upgrades: Invest in the passive strengthening of your village. Research new technologies, erect sturdy walls, and unlock permanent bonuses that will allow your settlement to withstand tougher challenges and survive for longer periods.

  • Suitable for All Players: Whether you’re a casual player looking for a relaxing building experience or an experienced strategy gamer seeking a true challenge, the adjustable difficulty and deep mechanics offer an engaging experience for everyone.

  • Achievements and Quests: Embark on exciting in-game quests and unlock achievements that reward careful planning and successful survival, giving you milestones to aim for and bragging rights to earn!

Can you master the balance of building, gathering, and defense to transform your small camp into an enduring pixel kingdom?

Wishlist now and start building your legacy!

store_data.about_the_game:
Everything is dirty. Everything. You're the only one who can clean it all.

In Wash It, you play an interstellar cleaner. You travel across different worlds and forgotten corners of the universe, getting rid of dirt wherever it hides. You'll clean muddy crystals, mossy statues, rusted starship panels, abandoned space outposts, mysterious alien relics, and bizarre cosmic oddities that no scientist can explain. If it's dirty, you'll clean it.

You have a high-pressure washer and many tools. Your mission is simple.

Point. Spray. Shine.

Each location presents a new challenge and a new way to make things better. One moment, you're washing ancient ruins on a desert planet. Next, you'll blast slime off floating crystals in zero gravity or uncover hidden markings on alien monoliths.

No stress. There are no timers.

You make the whole universe feel pure and clean.

It's clean and fun.

It's Wash It!

store_data.about_the_game:
Once, a young boy rescued a raccoon from the hands of poachers. But one day, the boy disappeared — and now the raccoon is left alone in a vast, beautiful, yet unforgiving world.
You play as that raccoon, guided by memories, scents, and instinct. Your journey will lead you through dense forests, abandoned hunting camps, shadowy streams, and open fields where every noise can be either a clue… or a threat.

Along the way, you’ll encounter old traps left behind by poachers, flee from danger, search for shelter, follow tracks, and uncover small mysteries of the wilderness. And the deeper you venture, the clearer it becomes: this is not just a story about searching for a boy. It’s a story about trust, freedom, survival, and the fragile bond that can form between a human and a wild creature.

Explore. Survive. Remember. And find the one who once saved your life.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ticket #404: User cannot find their soul.
Ticket #500: The printer is breathing again.
Ticket #237: URGENT - Floor 3.5 won't stop existing.

In I.T. NEVER ENDS, you are the newly hired Systems Administrator at a company that was definitely founded in 2015, regardless of what the USB drive buried in the wall says.

Your job? Process tickets. Keep the lights on. Don't let the coffee machine's prophecies ruin anyone's morning.

The pay is bad. The hours are worse. If any of your metrics hit zero, you're gone. And something tells you the Bahamas aren't in your future.

Every day brings a deluge of tech support requests from your coworkers. The interface is simple. The choices are not.

  • SWIPE TO SURVIVE: Gary needs his password reset to GaryRocks123. Again. The brute-force bots are thrilled. Swipe Right to approve or Swipe Left to deny. Both options have consequences.

  • BALANCE FOUR METRICS: Productivity. Budget. Morale. Entropy. Let any one flatline and your shift ends. Permanently. Let Entropy climb too high and the building starts... remembering things.

  • EVERY TICKET MATTERS: That keyboard pulsating with ectoplasm? Not your biggest problem. The elevator now goes to a floor that doesn't exist. Three coworkers have been texting "almost back" for an hour. And Legal needs VPN access from somewhere redacted.

Get your hands dirty with tactile Manual Override Minigames:

  • REDACT FORBIDDEN TEXT: Marketing accidentally CC'd the summoning ritual to the whole company. Again. Censor the document before anyone reads it and loses their mind. Some things were not meant for mortal eyes.

  • STABILIZE THE NETWORK: The server room has developed its own weather system. Patch Packet Loss, plug violent Stack Overflows, and reroute power before rack 7 floods. It rains at 2:47 PM. Precisely.

  • HUNT ROGUE DATA: Track volatile data entities through the server architecture before they corrupt something important or find you first.

"Connection lost, like ships in stormy sea / The server sleeps, and will not answer thee."
Actual error message. Beautiful but unhelpful.

You are employee #47. Or maybe #48. The numbers keep changing.

Punch in. Process tickets. Don't ask what happened to Marvin.

store_data.about_the_game:
Strap in, grab your controller, and rid the planet's orbit of asteroids.  Unlock new weapons, powers, and achievements to dodge and demolish space rocks in a nonstop assault.  Upgrade your ship and choose sponsors based on your play style.  Compete for the high score among your friends and aim for the high score world-wide.

Which path will you take?  Will you focus on clearing each level quickly to satisfy corporate mining interests?  Will you focus on accuracy, chaining together kills without missing a shot to max out your multiplier?  Are you a daredevil who can slip between asteroids like a Tai Chi master avoiding fists?  Or are you a showman who entertains the masses through the sheer spectacle of close calls and chain reactions to a thumping beat?

But why choose?  Just because one is paying you doesn't mean the others aren't watching.  After all, ads pay the bills, and the more eyeballs on you, the better.

You were born for this.

Asterisk is a retro-modern space rock shooter at its core.  Designed with the Steam Deck in mind, it combines the classic Asteroids game with modern Roguelike elements for a perfect blend of casual gameplay and a deeper story.

store_data.about_the_game:
“COLLAPSE COMPANY” is a co-op horror roguelite action FPS for 1–4 players, centered around repeated expeditions into underground dungeons.

Your primary objective is to activate the Particle Accelerator Reactor located at the deepest level of the dungeon and escape alive.

Each round sends players into a procedurally generated dungeon, where they must explore, search for scattered items, collect resources, and manage their inventory while progressing deeper underground.

Corridor layouts, room placements, item locations, and enemy spawns change every round, requiring players to adapt to new routes and unpredictable situations each time.

The dungeon is populated by multiple enemy types with distinct behaviors: some close in while out of sight, others ambush from walls or blind spots, and some remain hidden, waiting patiently for the right moment to strike. Enemy behavior dynamically reacts to player movement and positioning.

The environment itself is also a constant threat. Darkness, narrow corridors, confined spaces, environmental hazards, traps, and various gimmicks all add to the risk.

Resources and materials discovered during exploration can be brought back to the base, sold for currency, and used to prepare supplies or purchase equipment for future runs.

The game does not feature a fixed final stage or ending. Instead, it progresses in rounds.

After activating the Particle Accelerator Reactor, players must evacuate the dungeon under a strict time limit. The game continues until the team fails to escape or is completely wiped out. By challenging increasingly dangerous areas, players can earn greater rewards at higher risk.

A save system is implemented, allowing players to carry over their money and owned weapons into subsequent expeditions.

■ Key Features

  • Procedurally generated underground dungeons
    (Layouts and placements change every run)

  • Multiple enemy types
    (Ambushers, gaze-triggered movement, trackers, and more)

  • Exploration and collection
    (Search for items and manage them through an inventory system)

  • Environmental hazards
    (Darkness, traps, mechanisms, sound-reactive elements, and confined spaces)

  • Round-based progression
    (Collect resources, escape, and prepare for the next run)

  • Post-round upgrades
    (Sell collected materials and acquire new equipment)

  • Endless structure with no final goal
    (Rounds continue until the team fails)

Players continually adjust their loadout and inventory while delving into dangerous underground dungeons, collecting resources, and attempting to survive as long as possible.
store_data.detailed_description:
“COLLAPSE COMPANY” is a co-op horror roguelite action FPS for 1–4 players, centered around repeated expeditions into underground dungeons.

Your primary objective is to activate the Particle Accelerator Reactor located at the deepest level of the dungeon and escape alive.

Each round sends players into a procedurally generated dungeon, where they must explore, search for scattered items, collect resources, and manage their inventory while progressing deeper underground.

Corridor layouts, room placements, item locations, and enemy spawns change every round, requiring players to adapt to new routes and unpredictable situations each time.

The dungeon is populated by multiple enemy types with distinct behaviors: some close in while out of sight, others ambush from walls or blind spots, and some remain hidden, waiting patiently for the right moment to strike. Enemy behavior dynamically reacts to player movement and positioning.

The environment itself is also a constant threat. Darkness, narrow corridors, confined spaces, environmental hazards, traps, and various gimmicks all add to the risk.

Resources and materials discovered during exploration can be brought back to the base, sold for currency, and used to prepare supplies or purchase equipment for future runs.

The game does not feature a fixed final stage or ending. Instead, it progresses in rounds.

After activating the Particle Accelerator Reactor, players must evacuate the dungeon under a strict time limit. The game continues until the team fails to escape or is completely wiped out. By challenging increasingly dangerous areas, players can earn greater rewards at higher risk.

A save system is implemented, allowing players to carry over their money and owned weapons into subsequent expeditions.

■ Key Features

  • Procedurally generated underground dungeons
    (Layouts and placements change every run)

  • Multiple enemy types
    (Ambushers, gaze-triggered movement, trackers, and more)

  • Exploration and collection
    (Search for items and manage them through an inventory system)

  • Environmental hazards
    (Darkness, traps, mechanisms, sound-reactive elements, and confined spaces)

  • Round-based progression
    (Collect resources, escape, and prepare for the next run)

  • Post-round upgrades
    (Sell collected materials and acquire new equipment)

  • Endless structure with no final goal
    (Rounds continue until the team fails)

Players continually adjust their loadout and inventory while delving into dangerous underground dungeons, collecting resources, and attempting to survive as long as possible.
store_data.short_description: “COLLAPSE COMPANY” is a round-based roguelike action FPS for 1–4 players exploring shifting underground dungeons. Your goal is to activate the deep Particle Acceleration Reactor and escape before time runs out. Gather resources, upgrade gear, and push into riskier zones.

store_data.about_the_game:
OddCrops is a cozy farming game where you plant, water, and harvest crops while experimenting with unique mutation combinations. Grow your garden, manage nutrients, adapt to changing weather, and unlock strange new species as you play.

🌱 Grow and Harvest Your Garden

Plant seeds, water your crops, and harvest them once they mature. Each crop grows in real-time and has different needs such as nutrient levels, water amounts, and optimal placement.

🔬 Manage N-P-K Nutrients

Each plot contains Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), and Potassium (K) levels.
Different crops consume and produce different nutrients:

  • Plant nutrient-hungry crops carefully

  • Balance the soil using the right plant combinations

🧪 Discover Crop Mutations

Some crops can mutate when planted next to specific neighbors. Experiment with different layouts to discover new species, each with its own stats, growth times, and visuals. Every mutation you find is added to your Mutation Notes.

🌦 Experiment With Different Weather

Weather conditions can be harmful or beneficial to your crops. Some days help your garden grow faster, while others may introduce new challenges. Pay attention to the forecast and plan your farm layout accordingly.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are not conquering civilizations. You are rewriting the way they think. 

Your choices do not merely change numbers. They gradually rewrite belief, order, and the final destiny of civilization.

Every logic evolves into three radically different and mutually opposing faction strategies.
Every strategy saves the world in its own way and destroys it in another.
The same question produces completely different answers across different factions.

In this world, there are no neutral choices. There are only answers interpreted by different civilizations.

Consciousness invasion is a more efficient method of civilizational destruction than fleets.
War no longer requires armadas. Thought is the ultimate weapon.

In another parallel universe, after repeated military invasions of the Blue Planet ended in failure, an alien civilization finally learned a far more efficient method of conquest—one that saves the immense energy required for interstellar travel.

They abandoned traditional fleet expeditions and instead adopted interstellar consciousness deployment: no physical armies, no soldiers sent across the void. By casting “seeds” of thought and ideology into a target planet, they could trigger the self-collapse of social structures, the corrosion of belief systems, and the slow descent of a civilization into internal conflict and annihilation.

Compared to expending the energy of dozens of stars to transport a single soldier, the infiltration of ideas is clearly more efficient, more humane—and far more “environmentally friendly.”

In the game, players choose one of three major factions and take part in this war of civilizations shaped by ideological invasion:

🟩 ZYRA-NUL: Centered on freedom, nature, and instinct, this faction guides the world toward a gentle extinction—without resistance, without coercion, spreading instead like a tide that slowly covers every corner of the mind.

🟥 DRAZTHAR: Built on order, loyalty, and hierarchical difference, this faction drives the world toward destruction under absolute power—achieving surface-level stability through control and sacrifice, only to fall into a spiraling abyss of cyclical collapse.

🟦 Awakeners: As the awakening force of the native civilization, they pursue education, communication, and integration, striving to lead the world toward a higher stage of civilizational evolution—resisting both erosion and oblivion.

The same question leads to different civilizational answers.

Every logic evolves into three mutually opposing faction strategies.
Every strategy saves the world in its own way and destroys it in another.

For example, choices around bloodline structure.

🟥 Bloodline Closure (DRAZTHAR). Stability maintained through exclusionary order.
🟦 Marital Diversity (Awakeners). Social structures reshaped through integration and education.
🟩 Anti Natalism (ZYRA-NUL). Systemic pressure relieved through population decline.

A unique World Fragment system and News system.

📰 Over 1000 news fragments showing how ideas infiltrate institutions, manufacture consensus, and trigger disorder.

🧩 36 Fate Fragments depicting how individuals choose resistance, corruption, betrayal, or sacrifice under ideological invasion.

🧩 36 Civilization Fragments revealing the hidden philosophical structures, institutional logic, and ideological principles behind these destinies.

This is not merely an experimental game about alien invasion—it is a journey of civilizational divergence, guided by your hand.

This indie game blends philosophical reflection, institutional simulation, and minimalist interaction to construct an experimental world focused on civilizational evolution and the consequences of choice.

store_data.about_the_game:
A modern corporate slave wakes up to find himself reincarnated as the 100th incarnation of Golden Cicada! Stumbling into the all-female Western Liang Kingdom, he must unravel the earth-shaking conspiracy behind the polluted Mother-Son River while navigating deep emotional bonds with 7 goddess-level characters of distinct personalities—from the powerful and glamorous queen to the vengeance-driven Scorpion Demon, the innocent and impulsive monkey apprentice, the arrogant and willful Dragon Princess, the loyal and calm Sand Guardian, the fox demon who wields dream-invasion magic, and the cold yet compassionate Immortal.

This is the ultimate choice between Buddhist compassion and mortal desire! Assume the role of the protagonist Chen Yi in first-person perspective, making crucial decisions in demon-subduing puzzles and sweet interactions. Every conversation shapes favorability, and every choice alters the fate of the Three Realms. Will you honor the bet between Tathagata Buddha and the Demon King, sever earthly ties, and attain Buddhahood? Or follow your heart and spend a lifetime with your beloved?

Many distinct endings await—from achieving Buddhahood in the West to staying in the Women's Kingdom, from becoming a dragon palace son-in-law to wandering the world. Every step writes your unique time-travel adventure!

Key Character Introductions

  • Mingkong: The powerful and glamorous queen of the Western Liang Kingdom. Devoted to her people's safety, she develops a special affection for the unexpectedly arrived Chen Yi.

  • Sha Yue'er: Chen Yi's third apprentice. A calm and restrained bodyguard of the Western Liang Kingdom, she possesses agile skills and unwaveringly upholds her duty to protect her master.

  • Su Qinglian: A foreign fox demon skilled in dream-invasion techniques. With enchanting beauty, she harbors an almost obsessive devotion to Chen Yi

  • Sun Xiaoyao: Chen Yi's eldest apprentice. A naive and lively monster ruler from Flower and Fruit Mountain, she wields the Golden Cudgel with immense strength and is fiercely loyal and protective of her master.

  • Ao Bing: Chen Yi's second apprentice. An arrogant and willful Dragon Princess of the West Sea, she exudes nobility and keeps others at arm's length due to past obsessions.

  • Liu Niang: Known as the Purple Gold Queen, a Scorpion Demon with stunning beauty and a eccentric temperament. Driven by a vengeance obsession, she acts with ruthless determination.

  • Immortal Lianxin: A cold yet compassionate cultivator, Ao Bing's master. Wielding a protective magic artifact, she is the key tester of Chen Yi's emotional tribulations.

Core Features

  • 7 Unique Heroines & Immersive Bond Cultivation: Covering diverse settings such as queens, demons, immortals, and dragon princesses, each character has exclusive storylines and heartfelt interactions to satisfy different preferences.

  • Highly Free Choices & Dual Narrative Branches: The Buddhist Path focuses on subduing demons and fulfilling destiny, while the Mortal Path delves into emotional bonds and unlocks exclusive endings—no forced plot direction.

  • Fantasy Worldview + Puzzle Elements: Blending legends of the Women's Kingdom, the Buddha-Demon bet, and the Mother-Son River crisis, the game interweaves brain-teasing puzzles with romantic interactions for richer gameplay.

Game Highlights

  • First-person perspective for enhanced immersion, featuring dialogue choices and specific free branches.

  • A balanced mix of humor, sweetness, passion, and suspense, with a well-paced narrative.

  • Richly crafted characters: Each heroine has exclusive backstories and personality highlights, avoiding "tool character" tropes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Take Fate into Your Own Hands

After quelling the coup d'état that shook the Kingdom of Liberl, Estelle and Joshua have finally become senior bracers.

However, on the eve of the Queen's Birthday Festival, Joshua reveals the dark truth of his past before vanishing into the night, leaving only his brief farewell: "Goodbye, Estelle."

Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner.

During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos.

The capital in flames. A colossal airship darkens the skies. The looming threat of the Shining Ring...

Confronted with the greatest crisis in the history of Liberl, Estelle and her allies battle to find Joshua and untangle the web of intrigue and conspiracy woven by Ouroboros!

Key Features

■ CONTINUE YOUR 1ST CHAPTER JOURNEY

By carrying over your clear data from 1st Chapter, you can obtain exciting bonus items that will let you progress through the story more smoothly.

■ MORE COMBAT OPTIONS THAN EVER BEFORE

Overpower your enemies with new Crafts and S-Crafts! Link your characters' attacks during Quick Battles with the new Brave Rush, and make full use of the orbment system for access to Arts.

■ AN UNFORGETTABLE STORY

Dive into an intricately woven narrative to uncover the conspiracies threatening the Kingdom of Liberl.

■ EXPANSIVE SIDE CONTENT

Enjoy a variety of new content in the sequel, including minigames like fishing and poker, cooking with your companions, and fan-favorite characters joining as playable party members.

Experience the expansive combat system, richly realized world, and stirring story of the 2nd chapter of the Trails series!

store_data.about_the_game:
"お家で甘える社会人彼女の恋愛模様" is a choice-based visual novel.

This game depicts the ideal romance between a realistic, modern working couple. Packed with situations unique to adult life—from secret exchanges during work hours to the sweet domestic bliss of living together—players can enjoy a mature romance where two partners heal each other's daily fatigue.

While the story features occasional quarrels stemming from jealousy or misunderstandings, it focuses on their supportive journey together, offering an authentic experience of office romance and a relatable love story.

Story

"Aren't you ever going to get married?"

Teased by his boss over drinks, the protagonist offers a standard reply: "I plan to, once this project settles down."

But to him, these aren't just empty words. He has been dating a junior colleague from the same company for two years. They are already living together, enjoying the thrill of a secret office romance unbeknownst to anyone around them.

However, a secret relationship brings more than just excitement. It comes with her hidden anxiety and loneliness, leading to moments of jealousy and the occasional lovers' quarrel.

To put her mind at ease and prove his devotion, the protagonist makes a firm decision: He is going to propose.

This is a sugar-sweet story leading up to that life-changing question. Follow the protagonist as he works hard to complete his project for the sake of their future, and watch over his girlfriend—who, despite her struggles as a young professional, always comes home to be spoiled by the man she loves.

Key Features:

  • Secret Office Romance: Experience the thrill of dating a coworker and the challenge of keeping it hidden.

  • Living Together: Enjoy the intimate, domestic life of a couple who have been together for two years.

  • A Journey to Proposal: A heartwarming narrative about working hard for a shared future and taking the next big step in love.

store_data.about_the_game:
"What is death?"

With this question in my heart, I visit a cemetery far from the noise of the city.

There, I am greeted by a woman—the town’s sole gravekeeper, a quiet watcher of death.

She offers neither affirmation nor denial; she simply speaks.

Why must we die?

What happens after we are gone?

Is eternal life beyond our reach?

Through conversations with the gravekeeper, I begin to confront the anxieties and fears humanity has carried since the dawn of time.

There is no absolute answer to death.

The gravekeeper’s philosophy is only her own outlook on life and death—it is not a truth meant for everyone.

Even so, in a society where death has grown distant and hard to see,

it is my hope that this story offers a moment to reflect on what it means to live a finite life.

Estimated playtime: 40–60 minutes

A linear visual novel with no choices.

Streaming Guidelines

What Is Death? may be streamed freely by individuals and organizations without prior contact or permission.

Monetization features provided by each platform are also allowed.

However, streaming the full game without commentary or editing (i.e., uploading the entire game unedited) is not allowed.

When streaming, please include the game title in the video title.

Including a link to the Steam store page in the video description would be greatly appreciated.

Please refrain from using the game for ideological, political, or religious propaganda.

AI Disclosure

This project uses AI tools for text proofreading, localization support, and some background visuals.

The story text, direction, programming, and character illustrations were created by Mokuso Latimeria.

Most of the music and photographic assets were sourced from services that permit commercial use.

The background images and character illustrations were then edited using image editing software to achieve a sketch-like style.

AI was used only in a supporting role, and the majority of the work was created by human hands.
