store_data.about_the_game:
My Text Immortal World

This first commercial text-based immortal cultivation online game is crafted by two independent developers.

We cherish the pure gaming experience of classic online games from the early millennium era, and have polished this masterpiece of immortal cultivation centered on high freedom, true randomness, and pure loot drops.

It features no AFK gameplay, no offline solo mode, and fully online interaction. Limited by development resources, the game still has many areas awaiting optimization. We sincerely welcome every player’s feedback, and wish to refine this original vision of immortal cultivation together with all fellow cultivators.

We’ve also prepared an official Discord community.

Core Immortal Cultivation Experience: Boundless Freedom

Master online cultivation, spirit herb planting, and pill refining. Earn Sect Contribution by completing sect quests and submitting rare treasures, then exchange it for a vast collection of cultivation manuals and skills. In your spare time, explore trial zones, challenge world bosses, venture into secret realms, conquer the Star Chessboard, chat and duel with fellow immortals, or compete in sect tournaments to win fame and abundant rewards!

Four Unique Sects, Distinct Cultivation Paths

Choose from four exclusive sects, each with a unique innate heart method and tailored cultivation direction—no restrictions on sect selection, pick your perfect immortal path freely:

  • Sky Sword Sect: Specialized in sword-based skills with 30% armor penetration. Innate heart method Maxed Sword of the Enlightened Heart boosts physical/magical critical strike chance by 30% and reduces enemies' physical/magical defense by 45%.

  • Scarlet Cloud Sect: Ideal for fire/lightning skills. Fire skills deal pure magical damage with stackable burn effects; lightning skills blend physical and magical damage with dominant crowd control. Innate heart method Maxed Scarlet Flame Thunder Tactic grants 150 Fire/Lightning Attribute and 150 Fire/Lightning Resistance.

  • Flowing Moon Sect: The top choice for water/earth skills. Water skills scale damage with True Essence, focusing on slow, healing and buffs; earth skills scale damage with your own defense—the higher your defense, the deadlier your attacks. Innate heart method Maxed Flowing Moon Scripture provides 150 Water/Earth Attribute and 150 Water/Earth Resistance.

  • Spirit Treasure Hall: Specialized in enhancing magical treasures. Innate heart method Maxed Spirit Treasure Control Scripture increases magical treasure ATK/DEF by 20% and True Essence regeneration by 1%, while boosting treasure usage times. No restrictions on skill selection—create your personalized build freely.

Core Sect Gameplay: Immersive Immortal Daily Life

  • Sect Main Hall: Donate resources to upgrade your sect and gain personal contribution, then rise through the ranks from a handyman disciple to a core disciple. Complete quests from the Examination Elder for more contribution, and compete in Outer/Inner/Elite Sect Tournaments to defeat rivals and claim generous ranking rewards.

  • Sect Treasure Shop: Exchange Sect Contribution for basic cultivation manuals, skills, herbs and pills, or purchase functional items and stylish costumes with Immortal Jade (premium currency).

  • Sect Alchemy Room: Refine all kinds of pills by unlocking corresponding pill recipes and upgrading your alchemy level—all alchemy materials are farmable in-game.

  • Sect Cave Abode: Your exclusive spot for online meditation and cultivation. Upgrade the cave to speed up cultivation progress (requires matching sect rank). For time-strapped players, the 100x Speed Secret Realm is available for fast cultivation, and you can claim free Secret Realm Tokens daily based on your sect rank.

  • Sect Trial Zones: Unlock trial zones by reaching specific cultivation realms. Explore via grid-flipping to collect spirit stones, equipment/treasure shards and heavenly materials. Encounter demonic beasts, defeat them and loot rare gear and items.

  • Sect Spirit Plantation: Every disciple starts with 10 spirit fields, with more unlocked as your sect rank rises. Upgrade spirit fields to plant higher-tier spirit herbs and cultivate your own alchemy materials for self-sufficiency.

Equipment & Magical Treasures: Endless Build Customization

Equipment System: Realm-Aligned, Quality-Progression

Equipment is divided into 10 tiers, corresponding to the 10 major cultivation realms—each tier has Early/Mid/Late stages for different cultivation levels. All tiers feature 12 pieces of gear (6 weapons, 6 armors), each with 5 quality ranks: Low, Mid, High, Mystic and Heavenly.

Every piece of equipment has base attributes (upgradeable) and affix attributes (reforgeable)—zero build restrictions. Earth skill players can equip shields to stack defense and maximize damage; sword skill players can choose swords, broadswords or spears for burst damage. Customize your gear fully to match your cultivation path.

Magical Treasure System: Offense & Defense, Auto-Combat

Magical treasures share the same tier (10) and quality (4) system as equipment, with upgrade and reforge options. Unlock and use them by reaching the required cultivation realm (consumes True Essence in combat). Treasures are split into Offensive and Defensive:

  • Offensive treasures auto-attack enemies by consuming True Essence at set intervals—solo all foes with powerful offensive treasures without manual operation.

  • Defensive treasures generate a protective shield for you—enemies can’t break through with a strong enough shield.

    Combine offensive and defensive treasures to forge your unique immortal combat power.

Cultivation Manuals & Skills: Unlimited Free Combination

Unlock dozens of heart methods and active skills in-game, all divided into 5 tiers (higher tiers = stronger effects). Zero restrictions on learning—no class or sect limits, build your character freely!

  • Heart Methods: Passive effects that take effect immediately after learning, boosting your power permanently.

  • Active Skills: Equip to use in combat (6 skills max per character). Categorized by attribute: Sword (Physical), Fire (Magical), Lightning (CC), Earth (Defense), Water (Healing & Support). Coordinate with teammates in party play for seamless battles.

All skills are farmable via in-game systems, while rare high-tier skills drop randomly from world bosses—your luck decides everything.

Free Trading, Real Player Economy

The game features an Auction House with unlimited free trading—all materials, items, equipment, treasures and skills can be listed for sale, enabling true player-driven economy and farming for profit!

Loot rare Mystic-tier treasures/equipment or Heavenly/God-tier skills from boss fights and secret realms, list them on the Auction House for a large amount of Spirit Crystals (in-game currency), which can also be freely traded on the market. Your luck and hard work both pay off!

Fair Play Notice: To maintain a fair trading environment and protect players' legitimate interests, large-scale profit-making with bot/ studio accounts is strictly prohibited. Violators will face permanent account ban without warning.

Diverse Gameplay, Rich Immortal Journey

Beyond the core cultivation gameplay, the game offers a wealth of fun features: real-time chat, player duels, popularity & charm ratings, exclusive titles, customizable costumes, server-wide leaderboards, spirit pattern forging, secret realm exploration and more. Discover endless immortal cultivation fun in the game yourself!

Core Game Declarations

  • This is a fully online text-based MMORPG—no AFK auto-play or offline single-player mode, online play required at all times.

  • All in-game items, equipment, skills and treasures are 100% random drops—no manual interference, no pity system, luck is everything.

  • Our development team will continuously collect player feedback to optimize game content and experience. Thank you for your support and understanding!

About NEON HEX

NEON HEX is a stylish hexagonal puzzle game that fuses cyberpunk aesthetics with classic puzzle mechanics.

🎮 Features

  • Hex Grid Puzzle: Experience strategic matching unique to hexagonal grids, offering a fresh twist on traditional square-grid puzzles.

  • Cyberpunk Visuals: Immerse yourself in a world of glowing neon interfaces and sleek, minimalist design.

  • Chill & Relax: No time limits, no pressure. Just you, the grid, and your thoughts. Perfect for a relaxing gaming session.

  • Score Attack: Chain combos and aim for the high score. Simple rules with deep mechanics create an addictive loop you'll want to play again and again.

🌌 The World

Drifting in the sea of digital data, "NEON HEX" awaits. Your mission is to repair lost data clusters and restore order. Surrender to the beautiful synthwave soundtrack and immerse yourself in a world of light and logic.

Simple, beautiful, and intelligent. Experience the ultimate puzzle journey with NEON HEX.
store_data.short_description: NEON HEX is a minimalist cyberpunk puzzle game. Dive into a strategic matching experience on a hexagonal grid, accompanied by chill synthwave beats and stunning neon visuals. Restore the data clusters and find your flow in this addictive logic journey.

Immerse yourself in festive spirit with Look and Find - Christmas, a hand-crafted hidden object game.
Unwind, explore stunningly realistic scenes, and experience the joy of the Christmas season, from the creators of Look and Find - Curiosity.

Unwind with Festive Scenes:

Discover a vast collection of cozy Christmas levels. Traverse warmly decorated environments, explore charming festive houses, and peek into bustling holiday workshops. Every scene is packed with intricate details and Christmas charm!

Hunt for Hidden Objects:

Each level challenges you to find 12 cleverly hidden Christmas items, culminating in a challenging search for the Christmas Star.

Earn Rewards & Unlock New Challenges:

Every item you find has a value, adding to your festive reward total. Hunt for the elusive Christmas Star in each level for a big bonus! Use your earnings to unlock new, more challenging scenes.

Enjoy a Cozy and Relaxing World:

Designed for relaxation and that "aha!" moment of discovery. Whether you have five minutes or an hour, dive into a stress-free, festive world!

Features:

  • Hand-crafted, realistic scenes offering enjoyable festive exploration.

  • A rewarding progression loop: Find items, earn rewards, and unlock new levels!

  • Find each level's hidden Christmas Star for an extra challenge and reward!

  • The ultimate relaxing and cozy holiday vibe. Perfect for de-stressing!

store_data.about_the_game:
Hidden Paradise invites you into a warm, festive escape where holiday spirit meets sunlit New Zealand charm. While a gentle backstory ties the world together, the heart of the experience lies in exploring beautifully crafted scenes and unraveling a delightful variety of puzzles designed to spark curiosity and comfort.

Join the Garcia family as they celebrate Christmas the Kiwi way: starting with a cozy morning of decorating, then stepping into the vibrant summer glow of Auckland. From strolling along Queen Street to wandering through lush parks and seaside paths, they uncover festive sights, heartfelt moments, and touches of magic that turn each corner of the city into a holiday treasure.

Settle in for a captivating mix of hidden object challenges and engaging mini-games. No matter if you’re seeking cleverly concealed items or testing your logic in bite-sized puzzling moments, every scene brings something new to enjoy.

Featuring:

🔎 Dozens of atmospheric hidden object scenes

🔎 Exploration of Auckland’s iconic landmarks and must-see spots

🔎 Turn on your magnifying glass and explore the scenes in detail so you don’t miss a single find

🔎 Festive activities: match tree ornaments, spot tiny differences, assemble garlands, and more

🔎 Collect joyful souvenirs along the way

🔎 A wide range of unique mini-games and puzzles

🔎 Earn achievements to celebrate your progress

🔎 Wander through sparkling streets, glowing parks, sunny beaches, and cozy cafés

Wrap yourself in the warmth of a Kiwi-style Christmas and enjoy a relaxing holiday adventure filled with charm, color, and discovery!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Bosforus

As a country boy who has never stepped foot outside his small village, you have arrived in Bosforus, the capital of the world built on two continents. Your pockets are empty, but your goal is big: Save Money. Here, people rush, traffic comes to a standstill, and seagulls scream. Learn the language of the streets and grind tooth and nail for every single penny.

The Grind & The Hustle

Swallow your pride in this city where you came to save money. From slicing Döner to smuggling, do whatever it takes to hang on. Meet locals in legal and illegal jobs, and remember: every Lira counts.

Heavy '70s Driving

Enjoy driving bulky, heavy '70s vehicles against the sunset in a city spanning two continents. Master the unforgiving driving physics of retro games. Outrun the cops and feel the true weight of the classics as you drift through the narrow streets.

Survive the Chaos

Don't hesitate to defend yourself when needed, but watch out for the cops. Dodge bullets, mess with neighborhood gangs, and survive the chaos on traditional ALATURKA food.

A Living, Breathing City

You are no longer a tourist; meet the real face of Bosforus. Throw simit to seagulls, beat up that annoying ice cream man, chase pigeons, and feed stray cats. The city lives its own life, and you are right in the middle of it.

SOLO BUT NOT ALONE

"Can a single person create those legendary games we played with admiration as kids using today's technology?"

ALATURKA is a transparent community project developed entirely on live streams with the comments and contributions of the community. The game continues to develop and grow with regular weekly streams. Share your feedback on our Steam Community page; let's lay the bricks of this nostalgic Bosforus together!

store_data.about_the_game:
The game centers on three girls and women with different fates:

One battles family pressure and bias.

One carries the trauma of injury and lost Olympic chances.

One refuses to let age or society limit her ambition.

Through immersive dialogue, cinematic emotional writing, and a powerful branching choice system, your decisions determine everything:

Push for“impossible tricks” once labeled only for men? Or choose self-preservation?

Rebel against a mother who fears danger more than failure? Or rebuild understanding?

Carry a father’s Olympic fantasy at the cost of your body? Or turn it into reconciliation?

Characters

Bai You: Female, 23 years old, a retired skier. She was once a rising star full of promise, but an injury during training cost her the chance to shine at the Olympics, leading her to retire. She later became Lin Zhi’s coach, and with Lin Zhi’s encouragement, overcame her fear and returned to competition as an FWT athlete.

Lin Zhi: Female, 18 years old. Her father was a ski mountaineering explorer who died in a tragic accident in the mountains when she was very young. Her mother strongly opposes her skiing, but Lin Zhi’s deep love for the sport has caused intense conflict between them.

Qin Miao: Female, 20 years old, a professional skier from a skiing family. Both her father and mother are former national team members. She has a stubborn personality and firmly believes that “If male athletes can do it, female athletes can too!” Under her father’s strict supervision, Qin Miao has maintained high-intensity training for years. However, the prolonged intense training led to an ACL injury during a crucial competition. Only then did her father finally realize his mistake.

Key Features:

Multi-Branch Narrative System

Character-Driven Healing & Dream Arc

Choices change relationships, career paths, injuries, and endings

Olympic-inspired Freestyle Skiing Narrative

Fear, reconciliation, rivalry, ambition, and breakthrough endings

One slope, countless dreams. One girl, countless outcomes. Will you take the leap?

Gameplay Focus

Classic Visual Novel storytelling with deep psychological and emotional focus

Multi-branch choice system creates multiple divergent storylines

Player decisions reshape relationships, trauma, career, fear, comeback, and endings

Multiple endings: triumph may mean gold, healing, or reconciliation

Olympic-inspired Freestyle skiing narrative beats built for emotional immersion

store_data.about_the_game:
In Nederfall, you are the leader of a survivor camp. Your primary tasks involve managing resources, upgrading your camp, and ensuring the well-being of your community. Send soldiers on missions to scavenge for crucial supplies, explore the ruins of civilization, meet other survivors or engage in combat with hostile survivors.

The world of Nederfall

It is 2040 in the Netherlands. The government has fallen and society has collapsed. Gangs and crime have had chance to thrive so the country has become a dangerous place to live. Most of society has left but those who remain try to survive in the harsh environment that has remained of what was once a well-faring country full of culture and tradition.

Survivor progression

A survivor gains experience points in a skill by performing actions related to the skill they are training. For every action performed they also gain character experience. Nederfall tries to be original with skills like 'gaming', 'music', 'scuba-diving' and more.

Camp progression

The camp is the home of your survivors, where you store all your materials, heal up and craft items. Throughout the game you learn of new ways to improve your camp and collect resources to do so. A camp has many buildings and features that can be built and upgraded. The type of buildings that can be built depends on the location (tier) of the camp. So go and find a good location to progress your camp the best you can. Survivors that are not scavenging in the dangerous wilderness can be assigned to play videogames, train a skill in your VR station or one of many other camp activities.

Gameplay Loop

  • Camp Management - Start by managing your camp of survivors. Assign survivors to different stations, build and upgrade buildings, craft items, cook meals, and farm produce.

  • Resource Scavenging - Gear up and send out soldiers on raids to specific locations to scavenge for essential supplies and resources. Maybe you will find some treasures.

  • Exploration & Missions - As your soldiers explore, they encounter abandoned buildings, wreckage, and other survivors. Complete missions to progress the story and unlock features.

  • Combat & Survival - Combat occurs when your soldiers encounter hostile survivors or other threats. They must fight using the gear and weapons you've provided them.

  • Return to Camp - After completing their mission, your survivors return to camp with gathered resources and loot. Use these to improve infrastructure and upgrade equipment.

  • Progression - With each successful mission, your camp advances. Expand the camp, build new structures, recruit more survivors, and unlock new abilities.

The cycle continues as you build, explore, and survive in the harsh post-apocalyptic world.

Features

  • Camp management - Build and upgrade your camp, assign survivors to tasks and stations

  • Player controlled raids - Gear up and send soldiers to explore locations, scavenge food and materials and try to survive

  • Passive raids - Send out survivors on their own to hopefully come back with treasures

  • Story missions - Find out what went wrong and discover how a country transformed without a government

  • Auto-played combat with top-down player intervention and special combat skills

  • Elaborate skill system - train construction, hacking, climbing, language, agriculture, driving, gaming etc.

  • Faction system - Deal with all kinds of groups that think that their way is the right way

  • Gaming - (game in a game) Earn rewards with riddles & puzzles or passively train a game character & sell your loot and levelled characters

  • AFK progression (come back online and get 'away' progression)

content_descriptors.notes:
Nederfall contains themes and situations suitable for a mature audience. Violence is presented in a top-down, stylized way without gore. Players may engage in combat using firearms or melee weapons, and characters can become injured or incapacitated.

The game takes place in a post-apocalyptic setting where criminal actions such as breaking into buildings, stealing supplies, and fighting hostile groups may occur as part of the survival experience. Alcohol and soft drugs can be found as items in the world and may be consumed by characters for gameplay effects. No sexual content, nudity, self-harm, or graphic depictions of violence are present.

store_data.about_the_game:
How loud can the silence be in your own house? Step inside and find out.

​By Myself is an intense psychological horror thriller in 2D, where you take on the role of a child left alone, navigating their fears and the disturbing mysteries of their environment. Trapped in this domestic nightmare, you must unravel the central puzzle and try to escape before time runs out forever.

​Key Features and Gameplay:

  • Unique 2D Exploration: Navigate a claustrophobic domestic environment in 2D. Use the perspective to plan your movements and stay alert for details the scenario might hide.

  • ​Engaging Mysteries and Puzzles: Explore the detailed and claustrophobic initial environment (bedrooms, kitchen, bathroom) and use key items to interact with the world, solving the puzzles that advance the narrative and unlock new pathways.

  • ​Challenges Against Time (Timer Events): Face high-pressure sequences where interacting with the surrounding world is crucial. You must complete objectives and overcome challenges before the clock expires. Failure can lead to permanent consequences and environment resets.

  • ​Striking Narrative: Follow the story divided into chapters that explore themes of loneliness and trauma, utilizing cutscenes and environmental lore to build a deep and emotional experience.

  • ​Item Progression Mechanic: Collect and utilize the 8 key items found in Chapter 1, which are vital for your survival and for unraveling the house's mysteries.

​Original soundtracks and immersive audio design complement the constant psychological tension.

​Story and Objectives:

​Your mission is clear yet challenging: Seek to understand the world you encounter, and try to escape. With every new room unlocked and every mystery solved, you move closer to the truth about what truly happened. Your journey's progression will be marked by advancing through chapters and overcoming the cruelest timer events.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grey in White: The 77th Room is a minimalist puzzle-style indie game created and published by Kyros. Most of the scenes in the game are made up of blocks. Players need to solve various mechanisms within a huge maze consisting of 77 white rooms, ultimately reaching the final destination — the 77th room — and achieving a mysterious goal.

The game features:

1. Grey — the gray little block controlled by the player

2. Moving Mechanisms — movable blocks that players can use Grey to move onto in order to reach intended locations

3. Friendly Golden Keys — they are crucial for the player to clear the game. Players need to find them scattered throughout the maze to unlock locked doors (use them wisely!)

4. Annoying Doors — obstacles for the player. Players need to use the friendly golden keys scattered in the maze to open them

5. Red — troublesome enemies that constantly try to approach Grey. If they touch Grey, players have to start over

6. And that’s not all! If you want to know the rest of the content, go buy my game!

The game is small and short, with the fastest completion taking only 2 minutes (this record is achieved by someone familiar with all the routes). For regular players, it takes about 1-2 hours to complete. Although small, the game is very carefully crafted. If you’re interested, go buy it! I hope my game brings joy to you on the other side of the screen!

—Kyros

store_data.about_the_game:
《醉中幻想》是一款结合卡牌构筑与自走棋的roguelike游戏。

在《醉中幻想》中，你作为一名醉酒者，通过畅饮来激发各式各样的幻想：想要超大的“别野”，闪亮大钻石，还是直接冲上云霄和太阳肩并肩？构筑你的幻想，并在每一轮畅饮中控制酒量在最佳状态，追求越来越高的幻想分数！

游戏特色

自走棋

你需要在限定的回合内达到目标分数来取得游戏胜利。每回合你会从牌组自动抽取特定数量的卡牌，你可以调整这些卡牌的排序，或者将其与手牌调换位置，来达成更理想的combo。点击开始幻想，即可自动结算分数。

牌组构筑

每回合结束，你可以选择1张新的卡牌加入你的牌组。根据你的combo需要来选择分数更高的幻想或者特定的饮酒牌。

独特的醉酒机制

在《醉中幻想》中，你的卡牌会为你提供醉意值，来让你在清醒，醉中，昏死三种状态间切换。醉意值会为你提供额外的乘区倍率，但要小心如果喝到昏死倍率会直接变为0。控制好你的饮酒状态，来让你的分数更上一层楼！

store_data.about_the_game:
20+ handcrafted cases — a sharp, satisfying puzzle set, priced like a good coffee.

Think of it as a series of small mystery scenes laid out on a grid.

You study the characters, read how they relate to each other, and slowly piece together who’s who.

There’s no guessing—every correct deduction reveals more of the board, so it kind of cascades into the solution. Some puzzles even have you physically rearranging people until everything clicks into place.

It stays fresh because the clues vary a lot—neighbors, patterns, positions, little logic twists—and everything is built around spatial thinking and logical deduction.

It’s basically a compact set of handcrafted cases you can work through over a few sessions—clean, satisfying logic without filler.

*Works across a wide range of hardware and screen sizes. Steam Deck compatibility has not yet been tested; support will be evaluated if the game gains sufficient traction.

store_data.about_the_game:
FROM CASTAWAY TO LEGEND

Awaken on the shores of a deserted island with nothing but your will to survive. Captain's Crew is an open-world survival adventure where you must rise from a lost shipwrecked sailor to the most feared pirate of the seas.

Your goal is clear: gather resources, rebuild your strength, and hunt down the pirate captain who destroyed your fleet.

KEY FEATURES

  • SURVIVE THE WILD

    You start with nothing. Hunt for food, find fresh water, and craft basic tools to endure the harsh island elements.

  • BUILD YOUR PIRATE HAVEN

    Establish a settlement on your starting island. Construct buildings, manage resources, and create a thriving base of operations for your future empire.

  • ASSEMBLE YOUR FLEET

    Gather materials to construct vessels ranging from simple rafts to mighty galleons. Prepare your ships for the dangers of the open ocean.

  • RECRUIT YOUR CREW

    You can't sail a warship alone. Explore the world to find survivors and mercenaries. Hire them to work in your base or man the cannons on your ship.

  • EXPLORE & CONQUER

    Set sail across a stylized 3D archipelago. Discover hidden treasures, fight rival pirates, and uncover the secrets of the islands.

Will you reclaim your honor, Captain?

Create an oasis of community in a dystopian mythical Ireland.

In this retro futuristic version of mythical Ireland, take control of Dan, the new owner of the last independent cafe in Galway City. 

Make coffees and chicken fillet rolls, meet the eccentric locals of Galway City, customize your cafe and create a community in the city once again...

Start your day with prep work and open the cafe to customers. Make coffees, teas, chicken fillet rolls and more! 

Stock your cafe with the latest offerings from the WAACF Corporation like Dagda Lite or Uisce Pro! Get to know your customers, from mythical beings like Fomorians and the Tuatha De Dannan to regular folks called Greg...

Customize you cafe and apartment

Put your creativity to use and make your cafe and apartment your own. Change the wallpaper, change the counters, add wall art and furniture.

Use a mix of cozy, sci-fi and distinctly Irish styles to make The Corner Cafe stand out!

Expand your offerings!

Use your computer to shop for new items to sell in your cafe, buy new furniture and decorations or just check your emails and the news!

Explore the city

Explore unstable caverns, derelict facilities, and bioluminescent ecosystems filled with predators, contamination hazards, collapsing structures, and failing equipment. Manage oxygen, light, sonar, and suit integrity, because the deeper you go, the fewer second chances you’ll get.

After a crash landing, your only way out is to rebuild your ship. Its scattered components lie deep within dangerous facilities and lost zones across the ocean floor. Push further, take greater risks, and decide how much you’re willing to lose to make it back.

Uncover a fragmented, optional narrative through corrupted VHS logs, distorted audio, and decaying terminals. Follow the signal and piece together what happened here or ignore it, and focus on survival.

Play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Coordinate, communicate, and survive together using proximity voice chat—where distance, interference, and panic can turn even simple plans into chaos. Every dive creates new, unpredictable situations driven by player interaction and the hostile world around you.

store_data.about_the_game:
An emotional, narrative point-and-click game about love, care, and the act of letting go.

Love is heavy. Care is relentless. Watching someone you love fade is a quiet, piercing heartbreak you can’t prepare for. In this game, you step into the shoes of a daughter, moving through a world shaped by dementia - not to solve it, not to fix it, but to live it, feel it, and carry it alongside the one you love. Every gesture, every pause, every choice matters.

Gameplay isn’t a distraction - it is the story. Simple, deliberate interactions and inventive puzzles put you inside moments of tenderness, confusion, and heartbreak. Seven chapters guide you through caregiving’s emotional terrain: the exhausting patience, the fragile joys, and the quiet sorrow of learning when to hold on - and when to let go.

Dementia is at the heart of the experience, shaping every conversation, memory, and interaction. Each day reveals shifting moods and fractured recollections, blurring the line between truth and misremembering. As the mother’s world becomes more fragile and uncertain, the gameplay mirrors her fading clarity — guiding you through moments of confusion, tenderness, and the quiet heartbreak of watching someone slip away.

Seven days, seven chapters, seven steps.

Take one step and embrace…
beautiful hand-drawn illustrations - pencil-sketch lines washed with gentle watercolor.

Take two steps and witness…
emotional storytelling and touching dialogues showing the hardships of dementia and its impact on those closest.

Take three steps and dive into…
a world of beautiful music and sound - some lifting you to the sky, others carrying a quiet sting of pain.

Take four steps and jump…
into unique gameplay scenarios, each crafted to serve and deepen the story.

Take five steps and get a tad confused by…
dual perspectives on truth and memory, as you untangle the increasingly fragmented mind of someone living with dementia.

Take six steps and reflect…
on yourself, through a role-reversal journey within a shifting mother-child relationship.

Take seven steps and experience…
a catharsis - where love and care meet the quiet peace of finally letting go.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tear up the streets in this 90s themed beat'em up motorcycle racing game. Kick and bash your way through a slew of roughneck bikers all trying to claim victory and the cash prize. Competition isn't the only danger, the local police will be hot on your tail.

Enjoy the great sense of speed as you wind down the many long roads of the American west coast. Watch out for the many vehicles, pedestrians and street obstacles that will just slow you down or send you flying! One too many hits on your rider or bike may end your race. Run out of money to repair your bike or bail out of jail and it's game over!

After the race is over, head back at your favourite bar to mingle with your fellow bikers to mingle or take on the next race. Having a hard claiming 1st place? Take your hard earned cash to the bike shop next door. Get rid of that junker and buy yourself a new bike to keep up with the pack or leave them in your dust.

Bash Moto features easy pick up and play controls, a stylistic 2D aesthetic and a unique race on rails feeling reminiscent of classic bike racing games from the past.

*Those wanting to see the latest development updates are welcome to follow @Developerdob on YouTube, Instagram or X

store_data.about_the_game:
STORY

In a lone nation recognized as the 'Summer Island', the young half-human-half-dragon, Steve Cross, is chosen by the Summer King to slay an ancient, evil beast known as the 'Chandelier Serpent'. Meet many of the strange inhabitants of the Summer Island, as well as the dangerous beasts Steve must survive against, while he discovers the hidden secrets regarding what his quest truly entails. Awaken mysterious abilities, and collect precious valuables that aid Steve and his journey to rid of the chaos plaguing his homelands, and find sacred peace through it all.

GAME

CROSS QUEST is a turn-based fantasy RPG made with RPG Maker MZ, visually stylized to homage particular retro video game consoles of the past. Throughout the game, visit the Holy Chapels to unlock special abilities, and save progress. Meet many of the friendly or bizarre characters as the disturbing truth regarding the island unfolds. Duel chaotic monsters in the wild and the Spring Arena, to collect resources and money to aid Steve on his Quest sent by the Summer King.

store_data.about_the_game:
A CARAVAN ON THE BRINK OF COLLAPSE

The Black Breath is a turn-based tactical game with roguelite elements in which you manage a caravan of survivors, make narrative decisions, and fight multiple enemies in a turn-based grid-to-grid combat system.

Features:

  • Manage the caravan’s scarce Resources to ensure the survival of the civilians.

  • Choose which path to follow among several dangerous Regions, each with its own enemies, climates, and mechanics.

  • Within each region, the path is composed of multiple procedurally connected Nodes.

  • Along the way, you may find different Retinues that can join the caravan and contribute in their own ways.

  • Rely on various Characters who will bravely fight to defend the caravan.

              

                         

TURN-BASED TACTICAL BATTLES

The Black Breath offers a a turn-based tactical combat system where positioning decides every encounter, played on a face-to-face grid that forces direct confrontation with unique enemies.

        

The caravan will encounter dozens of different enemies, each with unique behaviors, weaknesses, and mechanics, depending on the current zone and the strength of the Black Breath.

Caravan characters are generated from six main classes, and within each class there is a wide variety of abilities and traits ensuring every Character is unique.

During the journey, characters may perform campaign activities to help the caravan in different ways and can also fall ill, grow fatigued, or even die permanently.

A DEATH RATTLE

At last, after being destroyed by the united forces of mankind, the Lich Kadryn released with his final breath a pestilence of death and rot that condemned every living being in the Great Blue Peninsula.

Several desperate caravans of survivors began to form throughout the region, all seeking to flee toward the Port of Serria, where dozens of ships are being prepared to carry them safely across the ocean and escape The Black Breath.

                     

ROGUELITE REPLAYABILITY

Each run begins with a new caravan, but the world does not reset: Global Corruption advances permanently every time you start a new journey, whether it succeeds or fails. Once it reaches a certain level, no more caravans can depart, and the only option left is to face the Final Mission at the Port of Serria, where characters from all caravans who managed to arrive must defend the civilians as they board the ships to escape.

Between caravans, the civilians you rescue take shelter in the city and contribute with improvements, structures, and bonuses that strengthen future caravans. Thus, every defeat leaves a mark, every victory brings hope, and every run pushes the world a little closer to its inevitable fate.

If you want to see how far the caravan can go… add us to your wishlist.
store_data.detailed_description:
A CARAVAN ON THE BRINK OF COLLAPSE

The Black Breath is a turn-based tactical game with roguelite elements in which you manage a caravan of survivors, make narrative decisions, and fight multiple enemies in a turn-based grid-to-grid combat system.

Features:

  • Manage the caravan’s scarce Resources to ensure the survival of the civilians.

  • Choose which path to follow among several dangerous Regions, each with its own enemies, climates, and mechanics.

  • Within each region, the path is composed of multiple procedurally connected Nodes.

  • Along the way, you may find different Retinues that can join the caravan and contribute in their own ways.

  • Rely on various Characters who will bravely fight to defend the caravan.

              

                         

TURN-BASED TACTICAL BATTLES

The Black Breath offers a a turn-based tactical combat system where positioning decides every encounter, played on a face-to-face grid that forces direct confrontation with unique enemies.

        

The caravan will encounter dozens of different enemies, each with unique behaviors, weaknesses, and mechanics, depending on the current zone and the strength of the Black Breath.

Caravan characters are generated from six main classes, and within each class there is a wide variety of abilities and traits ensuring every Character is unique.

During the journey, characters may perform campaign activities to help the caravan in different ways and can also fall ill, grow fatigued, or even die permanently.

A DEATH RATTLE

At last, after being destroyed by the united forces of mankind, the Lich Kadryn released with his final breath a pestilence of death and rot that condemned every living being in the Great Blue Peninsula.

Several desperate caravans of survivors began to form throughout the region, all seeking to flee toward the Port of Serria, where dozens of ships are being prepared to carry them safely across the ocean and escape The Black Breath.

                     

ROGUELITE REPLAYABILITY

Each run begins with a new caravan, but the world does not reset: Global Corruption advances permanently every time you start a new journey, whether it succeeds or fails. Once it reaches a certain level, no more caravans can depart, and the only option left is to face the Final Mission at the Port of Serria, where characters from all caravans who managed to arrive must defend the civilians as they board the ships to escape.

Between caravans, the civilians you rescue take shelter in the city and contribute with improvements, structures, and bonuses that strengthen future caravans. Thus, every defeat leaves a mark, every victory brings hope, and every run pushes the world a little closer to its inevitable fate.

If you want to see how far the caravan can go… add us to your wishlist.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a story-driven walking simulator horror game (featuring occasional light action sequences, unique stealth mechanics, and simple puzzles). It is designed as a casual, simple adventure game where you progress by walking, exploring, and triggering flags through conversations and events.

The estimated playtime is around 2 hours.

Synopsis

The protagonist, Tsutomu, is a salaryman overwhelmed by his job. Even his long-running ramen blog has nearly stopped updating as he finds himself pushed to his mental and physical limits.

One night, on his way home from work, he stops by a ramen stall near the station for a change of pace and decides to order his noodles with more deluxe toppings than usual. However, there is an urban legend whispered among children about this particular stall.

"If you eat it with 6 toppings, you will disappear."

Unaware of the rumors, Tsutomu adds the six toppings, crosses a boundary, and meets Susumu—a streamer who reviews ramen. Together, they are drawn into the history of the town surrounding the stall. The karma connecting the town and ramen stretches back to the Heian period, and eventually begins to eerily overlap with present-day events.

Heart, food, and karma. When these intertwine, a terrifying battle you never imagined begins.

Game Features

  • A simple adventure format where you progress by walking, exploring, and engaging in conversations and events.

  • A horror game themed around Japanese ramen—surprisingly rare.

  • Despite the absurd premise, the story unfolds quite seriously, interspersed with a casual atmosphere.

  • Features extensive dialogue that fleshes out character relationships and backgrounds. (Japanese text includes furigana for easy reading.)

  • Includes light action and puzzle elements in certain scenes. Clearing the game unlocks a standalone challenge mode.

  • Includes a hidden collection element: "Barrel Collecting" (Taru-atsume)—nice to have, but not essential.

【Streaming and Video Guidelines】

We welcome gameplay videos and live streaming of this title by both individuals and corporations. Please read and adhere to the following guidelines before streaming or posting.

  • Regarding Credits
    ・Please include the game title "Shoyu Ramen FOREVER" in the video or stream title.
    ・Please include the Steam store page URL in the description or a location visible to viewers.

  • Regarding Monetization
    ・Monetization via functions provided by video platforms (ad revenue, Super Chats, subscriptions, etc.) is permitted.

  • Prohibitions
    Do not perform commentary or streaming that includes the following:
    ・Content that unjustly hurts third parties, such as slander, discrimination, or excessive abuse.
    ・Content that violates public order and morals, or encourages illegal acts.
    ・Any other content deemed inappropriate by us.

  • Disclaimer
    ・POCKET HORROR BOX assumes no responsibility for any troubles, damages, or disputes with third parties arising in connection with streaming or video posting. Please resolve any issues at your own responsibility.

  • Changes to Guidelines
    ・These guidelines are subject to change without notice. Postings or streams made after changes will be subject to the updated content.

  • Use of Logo Assets
    ・A logo PNG file is included in the same directory as the game's executable file. Permission is granted to use this solely for the purpose of stream/video thumbnails.
    ・Use for any other purpose (resale, redistribution, distribution as processed material, use in other works, etc.) is strictly prohibited in all cases.

store_data.about_the_game:
Jump, dodge, slash, and survive in this fast-paced 3D action platformer where the ground is never stable — because it's made of barrels. Lots of barrels. Racing forward at full speed.

In Barrel Madness, every level is a frantic obstacle course set in unique fantasy worlds. Leap from barrel to barrel before they slip away, avoid swinging traps, and defeat enemies while everything around you is in motion. Use your sword in close combat or throw it from afar to take out threats before they reach you.

Each world introduces new mechanics, new enemies, and new ways to fall hilariously into the water (or off a cliff, or into a shark).

Can you stay on your feet long enough to reach the portal?

Features:

Fast-paced barrel platforming – Jump rapidly from one moving barrel to the next before you lose your footing.

Dynamic movement – Barrels travel at high speed in one direction, turning every level into a constant race against time.

Combat on unstable ground – Fight enemies while balancing on moving platforms. Throw your sword to hit distant targets.

Deadly traps – Dodge swinging pillars, moving obstacles, and other environmental hazards.

Multiple fantasy worlds – Each level has its own theme, enemies, and challenges.

Chaotic physics moments – Enemies flying, barrels exploding away, players being launched across the map… chaos included.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Considered by many to be the first, (and funniest), Real-Time-Strategy video game, GENERAL CHAOS was a non-stop-action, squad-based, battle game in which players controlled up to 5 different soldiers with unique weapons and abilities. The gameplay was way ahead of its time, and the humor was in the same tongue-in-cheek style I’d used in several of my previous games: RAMPAGE, XENOPHOBE, ARCH RIVALS and PIGSKIN 621ad. The game was very well received and was one of EA's best-selling original Intellectual Properties for the Sega Genesis System the year it was released.

"Currently, GENERAL CHAOS - MAJOR SNAFU is considerably more than halfway to the finish line! This time around, its a sprite-based, multiplayer PC Game that uses an Xbox-style Game Controller &/or Keyboard & Mouse .

"ALL of the original characters are back; only more versatile, smarter and funnier. The 'Gunner', 'Chucker', 'Scorcher', 'Blaster' & 'Launcher' have already been created and implemented. In addition, several new character/weapon types, have been created, including two-fisted 'Ultimate Commandos', (double the firepower), shotgun-wielding 'Sergeants', as well as wildly over-enthusiastic 'Raw Recruits' ...who are already on patrol in places of tactical importance; giving a General a definitive 'home field advantage'.

"Generals now have much greater control over Troop Movement, too. Generals can order a single Soldier or an Entire Squad to swiftly advance straight to a specific map location. When treacherous terrain or overwhelming odds makes a frontal assault less than ideal, selected Soldiers can surreptitiously sneak along a Serpentine path to take the enemy by surprise.

"Best of all, Generals can go 'Commando' and grab any Grunt at any time to control their every move! (Because "calling the shots" is even more fun when your finger is on the trigger!) The fact that now you'll be able to give everyone their Marching Orders AND take direct control of any Grunt at any time during the Battle will make everything a little more "up close and personal" . . . and isn't that what fighting is all about?

"Grunts still follow orders blindly; but they're much smarter than before; avoiding obstacles, seeking 'cover' when available, and best of all... they can learn new skills and weapon capabilities. Between levels, Generals can use 'Attitude Adjustment' to fine tune each individual Grunt's actions; their level of aggression, their targeting priorities, or their 'Close Combat' preferences. 

"As you might expect, the Levels are larger and the Environments are more interactive, and there will be plenty of new Terrain nuances just waiting to trip up the unwary. But the action is just as immediate as the original; thanks to a Dynamic Camera system that reacts, and even anticipates, the Squad's every move. Of course, we still have another few dozen levels to go...

"Although everything above has been created , and much of it has been implemented, we're not yet at a finished state. There's still months of level creation, game-play tuning, debugging, and head-to-head multiplayer play-testing ahead of us. 

- Brian F Colin

store_data.about_the_game:
Touch Grass: A Bit-Sized Christmas Adventure

It’s Christmas Eve 2001, the snow is falling, and you and your friends have one mission: earn enough cash before bedtime to finally buy the newly released GameStation 2.
How? By doing what any self-respecting kid would do: Go door to door across the neighborhood and blast Christmas carols for donations.

🎄 A Tiny Town, a Big Goal

Explore a cozy, 2D pixel-art town filled with quirky characters, Christmas vibes, and secrets tucked behind every snowman. You’ve only got one day, so hustle! Visit houses, play music, talk to NPCs, complete quests, and upgrade your musical gear to impress your audience.

🎶 Play Carols, Hit Beats, Earn Cash

Perform a set of classic holiday tunes with your keytar through a quick-time rhythm mini-game.
Time your notes, build long streaks, and squeeze every coin out of your festive performances.

🎮 Visit the Arcade & Master Boxerino

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a real-time strategy (RTS) game rooted in China’s most romantically turbulent era—spanning the late Eastern Han Dynasty to the Three Kingdoms period—weaving epic tales of the warlords who rose amid chaos. "Witnessing them build towering mansions, host grand feasts, and watch those mansions crumble into dust"—this unique and poignant experience lies at the heart of all historical-themed games.

Drawing its narrative foundation from Romance of the Three Kingdoms, the game features three campaign series centered on the three major powers: Shu Han, Cao Wei, and Sun Wu. Players will follow iconic heroes to build cities, stockpile grain, raise armies, and engage in battle, striving to fulfill the grand mission of unifying the realm.

Core Features:

  • General System: Command unique skilled generals as hero units in combat. Additionally, generals can perform auxiliary tasks such as rituals.

  • Mount System: No initial cavalry units are available, but horses can be produced. Any unit or general can become cavalry upon mounting a horse.

  • Cities & Prefectures: Unlike most RTS games with a single map, each city and village in this game functions as a separate map. Manage production and organize armies within cities/villages, and use the prefecture map to dispatch troops between different locations.

  • Tech Tree & Generals: Tech officials influence tech tree progression—more brilliant strategists unlock additional technological bonuses.

store_data.about_the_game:
◆ A First-Person Escape Horror Experience Set in a Decaying Mansion

The Clown -White Pursuer- is a first-person 3D horror game in which you must escape from an abandoned Western-style mansion while being hunted by a white-painted clown.

As you explore the mansion, you will encounter light puzzles that can be solved within the areas you are able to reach. By observing your surroundings and uncovering scattered hints, you gradually carve out a path toward escape.

But during your investigation, the “White Pursuer” may appear from anywhere.
Footsteps, a faint presence, and a heartbeat that grows faster and heavier as he approaches—
the constant uncertainty of when he will appear creates relentless tension throughout the experience.

◆ Game Overview

Your objective is simple:
Escape the mansion.

However, the white-painted clown roams the halls, and his appearances are entirely random.
A place that felt safe a moment ago can become a danger zone the next.

◆ Key Features

■ Immersive First-Person Horror

Dim hallways, broken lights, and dust-covered furniture create a suffocating atmosphere.
The limited field of view and realistic environmental details enhance the feeling of being trapped.

■ Randomized Pursuit System

The clown’s appearances are completely unpredictable.
He may show up:

  • at the end of a hallway you casually walk down

  • inside a room you entered to investigate

  • at the very moment you focus on a puzzle

  • or right behind you when you turn around

This unpredictability leaves a lasting impact, even in a short playtime.

■ A Tight 10-Minute Horror Experience

With the pacing unique to a short title,
exploration → tension → puzzles → escape
are packed into a compact yet intense experience.
Perfect for short sessions and replayable by design.

◆ Controls

WASD: Move
Mouse: Look
Left Shift (Hold): Sprint
E: Interact
B: Open/Close Inventory
Esc: Open/Close Menu

◆ Final Goal: Escape the Mansion Alive

All of your exploration leads toward one purpose—finding a way out.

But the closer you get to the end, the more aggressively your pursuer closes in.

Footsteps grow louder.
White shadows flicker at the edge of your vision.

In this rising tension,
will you manage to escape—
or will you be trapped in the mansion forever?

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep in the mountains lies a remote village long abandoned and left to decay.
You arrive alone in the ruins of a once-inhabited settlement, determined to bring it back to life.

Cut trees, mine ore, till the soil, cook meals, build facilities—
slowly restoring the essential functions of a living village.
This game is a crafting × farming × life-sim × defense experience where you rebuild a collapsed community from the ground up.

🏡 Rebuild a Forgotten Village Through Crafting and Creativity

Gather materials such as wood, stone, and ore.
Craft tools and structures at your workstation.
Lay out farmland plots, expand your fields, and grow seasonal crops.
Weather affects your fields, including automatic watering during rain.

Your long-term goal is to fully restore the shrine at the center of the village—a symbol of its revival.

👥 Villager AI Brings the Settlement Back to Life

As the village grows, new residents will arrive.
Each villager has their own routine and personality, and assigning jobs increases overall productivity.

  • Resource gathering (wood & stone)

  • Farming

  • Cooking

  • Defense

  • Trading & stall management

🌱 Farming and Cooking for a Rich Village Life

Plant seeds, till the soil, water and fertilize crops.
Cook dishes from your harvest to gain useful buffs.
Raise cows, pigs, and chickens to obtain milk, eggs, and meat.
Feed and upgrade livestock facilities to boost production.

A simple yet satisfying rural lifestyle awaits.

⚔️ Night Raids: Defend the Village

Every three days—at each seasonal shift—wild animals will attack the settlement.

  • Deer, boars, wolves, and bears appear depending on the raid level

  • Spawn numbers, simultaneous enemies, and spawn points scale with difficulty

  • Damaged structures require costly repairs

  • Raid performance affects the village’s reputation

Assign villagers to defend the village, or take up arms yourself.

🛒 Run a Village Stall and Build an Economy

Construct a small stall and sell the items you gather or craft.
Visitors will purchase goods, allowing the village’s economy to naturally grow as you expand.

🗻 Explore Diverse Biomes

The surrounding regions feature several biomes, each with unique resources and wildlife.

  • Plains

  • Forest

  • Valley

  • Mountain

Defeat the boss of each biome to unlock new areas.

🧱 A Relaxing Village Builder with Just the Right Amount of Action

Play at your own pace as you shape the village’s future, crafting, farming, and building a life from scratch.

🚩 Main Objectives

  • Fully restore the shrine

  • Conquer all biomes

  • Develop stable infrastructure for villagers

  • Earn high marks during raid events

  • Defeat biome bosses

  • Maximize the village’s reputation

You are the village’s last hope—
a lone settler restoring a forgotten community into a place where people can once again live.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

When the gears of fate begin to turn, will you go all-in or play it safe?

Chrono Spin is a unique Slot-Driven RPG. Here, battle is not decided by the swing of a sword, but by an ancient Square Relic. Strategically allocate your limited Mana to place bets, spin the wheel, and unleash attacks, defenses, or powerful magic.

Core Gameplay: Master Luck with Strategy

  • Square Spin Combat: Say goodbye to traditional battle menus. Attack, Heal, Restore Mana, Earn Gold—every action is decided by the icons on the wheel.
  • Strategic Betting: Mana is your chip. Go heavy on "Attack" for a quick kill, or spread your investment across "Health" and "Defense" for stability? Your decisions directly impact the battle.
  • More Than Just Luck: Use character Active Skills (like "Poison Blade", "Vengeance") and Passive Talents to control the battlefield. In critical moments, sacrifice HP to wish upon the Lamp and rewrite the wheel's outcome!

Explore & Grow

  • Four Unique Worlds: Traverse the treacherous Misty Forest, uncover the curses of the Desert Ruins, conquer the stormy Pirate Bay, and finally challenge the Goddess's trial in the Temple of Seasons.
  • Multiple Classes: Unlock and play heroes with distinct styles—from the armored Warrior and elusive Assassin to the element-wielding Mage. Each has a unique skill tree and combat style.
  • Gear Driven: Collect hundreds of unique weapons and accessories. A dagger determines your minimum damage on the wheel, while a heavy battle axe sets your burst potential.
  • Gem Socketing: Socket Rubies, Sapphires, and other mystic gems into the wheel to double the effects of specific icons—but only if you bet on the right one!

Are you ready? Activate the Square Relic, let the gold and magic dance in the spin, and write your own Chrono Spin legacy!

store_data.about_the_game:
About Fourteen Years of Flames

Fenghuo Fourteen is a story set against the backdrop of the fourteen years of war, offering players a chance to return to the battlefields of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression from a Chinese perspective. Experience once again the smoke of war that engulfed 400 million people in those turbulent years, a time when the entire nation stood united in its struggle for survival.

Campaigns

Fourteen Years of Flames presents players with renowned historical battles. Your journey begins in the rugged terrain of Northeast China and leads to the ancient capital, Nanjing, as you participate in the massive national anti-invasion war that spanned across China. Experience the sorrow, sacrifice, and heroism unique to that era.

Weapons and Equipment

Fourteen Years of Flames strives to faithfully recreate historical details, offering a 1:1 representation of the weapons, vehicles, and soldier gear used during the war. The game includes most of the weaponry and military equipment that appeared on the battlefields, from cold and hot weapons to various vehicles and gear.

Campaign Scenarios

In Fourteen Years of Flames, you will experience diverse and richly detailed campaign scenarios. The game aims to reveal the truth hidden behind the fog of history, bringing to life the solemn landscapes of China during the fourteen years of anti-invasion war. Each campaign offers a unique terrain and atmosphere, immersing players in the full intensity of the conflict.

Looking Back at History, We Wish Our Motherland Remains Unshaken for All Eternity.

2025 marks the 80th anniversary of China's victory in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. We wish for the world to enjoy peace and tranquility, for the people to live in prosperity, and for the future to always hold hope.

Justice prevails! Peace prevails! The people prevail!

store_data.about_the_game:
LOW VALUE JOB is a dystopian job simulation game.
A single, mind-numbingly simple task awaits you: sorting scattered parts on a desk by type.
Bolts of various lengths. Nuts. Washers.
Your job is to pick them up one by one, examine them carefully, and place them in the correct category.

This game offers nothing but atmosphere and labor. There is no story.
Would you like to experience the emptiness of endless part-sorting in a dimly lit future?

Features

  • Mindful Immersion: A simple parts-sorting action that lets you tune out the world.

  • Ghost Presence: In single-player mode, share your progress to feel the faint presence of other workers.

  • Competitive Sorting: Online multiplayer for up to 8 players. Compete for speed and precision.

  • Subtle Interaction: Send "Deep Breaths" or "Throat Clearing" voice lines to your opponents.

  • Office Evolution: Watch your workspace transform as you progress.

  • Co-op Mode: Co-op mode for up to 64 players (Early Access)

The True Ending

The world we offer is an escape from the complex, grueling decisions of reality; a quiet space for those who find peace in quiet, monotonous work. At first, players focus intensely on identifying the parts. As they habituate, their minds begin to wander, creating space for various reflections.

If you find yourself thinking, "I want to do something else," then that is your cue to stop. To quit the game and start something else is the True Ending. Regardless of the number of parts sorted, that person has reached the conclusion.

Who Is This Game For?

The design of this game—requiring players to perform endless, repetitive tasks—is certainly not for everyone. However, I truly believe that the unique atmosphere and the sensations it evokes will resonate deeply with a certain audience.

I highly recommend this game to those who find peace in solitary, monotonous work, as well as those looking for a simple, casual competition to enjoy with friends.

Streaming & Content Creation

We warmly welcome gameplay videos, live streams, reviews, and other content featuring LOW VALUE JOB.

Both individuals and organizations are free to monetize their content, including ad revenue, memberships, and donations.

No prior permission is required—please simply follow the terms of the platform you use and applicable laws.

This game is a task-based work simulation, so the on-screen visuals may not change significantly over time.

The work this game offers is not for everyone.

Its portrayal of parts sorting as a “low-value” or “meaningless” job is strictly a narrative device within the game’s dystopian setting. We do not intend to diminish or devalue the real-world work performed by professionals involved in parts sorting or related tasks.

The developer has previously worked in parts-sorting roles in a professional capacity and acknowledges that such work is both necessary and meaningful in real-world contexts.

Part sorting is often an undervalued line of work, and I truly hope that affordable tools to support it will become more widely available.

store_data.detailed_description:
LOW VALUE JOB is a dystopian job simulation game.
A single, mind-numbingly simple task awaits you: sorting scattered parts on a desk by type.
Bolts of various lengths. Nuts. Washers.
Your job is to pick them up one by one, examine them carefully, and place them in the correct category.

This game offers nothing but atmosphere and labor. There is no story.
Would you like to experience the emptiness of endless part-sorting in a dimly lit future?

Features

  • Mindful Immersion: A simple parts-sorting action that lets you tune out the world.

  • Ghost Presence: In single-player mode, share your progress to feel the faint presence of other workers.

  • Competitive Sorting: Online multiplayer for up to 8 players. Compete for speed and precision.

  • Subtle Interaction: Send "Deep Breaths" or "Throat Clearing" voice lines to your opponents.

  • Office Evolution: Watch your workspace transform as you progress.

  • Co-op Mode: Co-op mode for up to 64 players (Early Access)

The True Ending

The world we offer is an escape from the complex, grueling decisions of reality; a quiet space for those who find peace in quiet, monotonous work. At first, players focus intensely on identifying the parts. As they habituate, their minds begin to wander, creating space for various reflections.

If you find yourself thinking, "I want to do something else," then that is your cue to stop. To quit the game and start something else is the True Ending. Regardless of the number of parts sorted, that person has reached the conclusion.

Who Is This Game For?

The design of this game—requiring players to perform endless, repetitive tasks—is certainly not for everyone. However, I truly believe that the unique atmosphere and the sensations it evokes will resonate deeply with a certain audience.

I highly recommend this game to those who find peace in solitary, monotonous work, as well as those looking for a simple, casual competition to enjoy with friends.

Who are you?

You are a famous author embarking on a global book tour to promote your latest release.

During this tour your will:

  • Drive in an old beat up car with no GPS and a malfunctioning radio

  • Travel through unique locations resembling a pop up book

  • Plan your coffee shop visits to make sure you don’t run out of fuel

  • Encounter interesting characters (and unexpected passengers) during interactive visual novel segments

Will you be able to make it through your book tour in one piece? Or will you find yourself succumbing to what lurks in your back seat...?

Meet the dev team

Kotiya is comprised of two developers:

  • Atiya Nova is a professional game developer who previously released “You’re Not Family”. She’s handling the code, narrative, 3D models, UI, game design, and sound design.

  • Kodey Owen is a pen and ink artist who will be contributing hand drawn illustrations and helping with the editing, QA, game design, and sound design.

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up at a battered kitchen table in a cramped apartment somewhere in the neon future.

Your head hurts, your memory is full of gaps, and the city outside sounds like a machine grinding its teeth.

Across the table sits a girl you do not recognize.

Your implants and files say she is your girlfriend.

Your gut says you have never seen her before.

The entire game unfolds in this one room, in real time, as you talk to her, test your memories and push against the seams of reality. The more you question what is happening, the more the world around the table begins to glitch.

This is a short, story focused visual novel about trust, guilt and how far a corporation will go to rewrite a human mind.

Negative Time is a bullet hell rogue-lite shooter where each time you get hit, you are sent further and further back in time, until you are sent into the past they tried so hard to erase. A past before time began - NEGATIVE TIME.

Get more powerful by collecting new weapons in this past realm. Then, when time becomes positive, use your newfound power to make it further through the halls of enemies in order to defeat the ones who erased you from existence.

Time Travel

Each time you die, you are sent back in time a number of seconds, called your interval. Then next time, your interval is double what it was previously. If your interval sends you back before the game started, you enter NEGATIVE TIME - an inverted copy of the game, with its own unique enemies, and new weapons to unlock.

Weird Weapons

Curate your loadout of unique weapons from 5 different tiers and 3 different categories. Some of these weapons are quite strange - try to find good combinations!

Blessings

Collect blessings to power up yourself and your weapons. But don't think you can just wait around and get by on god's gifts, because these boons don't last forever!

Difficult Opponents

Face off against 4 bosses and 20+ regular enemies, as you try to dodge their bouncing, exploding, predicting, homing, and wall-piercing bullets - even one hit sends you back before your mistake, so at the end of the day, you'll need to be flawless if you hope to win.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tap into the mystery as a stranger in the city — a mild mystery visual novel.

[Story]

Kisen runs a tracing agency in Stanisla, a city far from his home, together with Beatrix, a talking pocket watch that his deceased brother left for him. There, he is asked by a local university student Dimir to look for his younger brother who disappeared twelve years ago.

Twelve years ago, there was three peculiar incidents in Stanisla: the serial kidnapping case, the acrid smell at the city's traditional Aenjan Festival, and the suicide by drowning of a foreign clockmaker, i.e. Kisen's brother.

As he learns more about what happened back then, he understands the struggle between the brothers and the true intention behind the series of incidents.

  • A classical visual novel where you read text to advance the story

  • Around 4 hours of gameplay

  • Includes light puzzle-solving such as filling out Investigation Reports by dragging & dropping keywords, choosing the correct item / person / statement for the given question, etc.

[Key features]

  • A captivating story set in a fictional Southeastern European city

  • Colourful, hand-drawn crayon art style

  • Soft and melancholic chiptune music

  • A helpful in-game Notebook that keeps track of the story so far, people's names, any lore-related terms, and so on

[Credits]

  • Written & Programmed by Tokiwa Hosomi

store_data.about_the_game:
• Final Breach is a fast-paced wave-based FPS where stylized horror collides with high-impact gunplay. Step into a world on the brink of collapse, where twisted experiments, failed evacuations, and overrun districts have left only pockets of survivors struggling to hold back the tide. Every corner of the battlefield tells a story of desperation — ruined city blocks swallowed by infection, torn-apart facilities humming with malfunctioning power grids, abandoned neighborhoods littered with barricades and the remnants of last stands.

  • Made by a single developer, Final Breach is an intense zombie first person shooter where your only goal is to survive as long as you can and aim to reach the highest wave on the leaderboards. Upgrade your weapons, from a pistol all the way to ray zappers with different attachments and different sights. Round 1 might start off easy, but the higher the round gets the more zombies there are and with increased health and damage.

  • As the waves begin, the undead surge forward with increasing ferocity. Each round pushes you harder, demanding sharper aim, faster reflexes, and smarter resource management. Earn points by surviving, eliminate threats with precision, and use your momentum to unlock new weapons as the pressure intensifies. From reliable sidearms to devastating power weapons, every gun feels distinct, impactful, and built for carnage.

  • Uncover special weapons hidden across the environment, experiment with different loadouts, and refine your strategy with each attempt. No two runs unfold the same — sometimes you’ll dominate early and crumble late, other times you’ll barely survive the opening waves only to snowball into a powerhouse run. Every attempt is another chance to push deeper, learn enemy patterns, optimize your path, and fight longer against impossible odds.

  • Between the chaos, perk machines offer powerful boosts that reshape your playstyle. Whether you want heightened speed, hardened defense, boosted recovery, or enhanced lethality, each upgrade helps you claw your way through the next onslaught. Managing ammo, scavenging opportunities between waves, and rebuilding what little defense remains becomes essential as enemies evolve and aggression spikes.

The outbreak is spreading. The cities are failing. And the breach is widening with every passing moment.

Face the horde. Hold the line. And see just how long you can survive the Final Breach.

store_data.about_the_game:
In News Faker, you find yourself in a fictional TV station that’s barely holding together. The equipment dates back to the days of analog television, the studio looks like a basement after a bargain-bin renovation, and the only thing growing faster than the bills is the debt.

Your goal is to drag this ruin to the top of the ratings - even if it means... slightly “enhancing” reality along the way.

Gather footage, cherry-pick convenient facts, bend the rest, and watch your news station slowly transform into a full-blown propaganda factory.

  • Decide what goes on air: a proper report or a sensational piece of nonsense that breaks the charts.

  • Stitch reports from half-truths, out-of-context quotes and very convenient camera angles.

  • Keep an eye on viewers, politicians and watchdogs breathing down your neck.

  • Every story is a choice: your station’s reputation or pure, juicy popularity?

  • Rework the image of politicians and celebrities so viewers either worship them or hate them on sight.

  • Push facial expressions, colors, lighting and captions until a normal interview turns into the meme of the week.

  • Build a wall of shame and fame – see who’s today’s hero and who’s the demon of your prime time.

  • Upgrade your studio: from a moldy green screen in a basement to a shiny, loud infotainment circus.

  • Recruit your crew: decide whether viewers value their skills... or their other assets.

  • Unlock new show formats, studio toys, tickers and flashy graphics.

Will you build a channel that shapes public opinion, or end up as a case study for “how media went too far”? The choice is yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are Carlos Ramirez, a well seasoned detective that works in the sleepy town of Amorita. On a fateful day, you and your partner Carolina Flores are called to scene of a reported murder in the outskirts of town. Was this a textbook homicide case, or perhaps something far worse? As the mystery deepens, the looming shadows draw closer. Creatures from unknown origins stalk the lands and lust for bloodshed. You must brave yourself and confront the darkness, before it takes you first!

Players will traverse many different areas on this case, delve deeper into the mystery and find evidence and files related to your mission. Ready and stock yourself up to fight against the evil horrors that walk amongst the living. Or perhaps take a more silent, and flight approach while evading the monsters that halt your path. You will find cunning enemies, towering gruesome bosses, hidden collectibles and optional dialogue and paths just to name a few!

Shadow Seeker will challenge the players accuracy and reflexes in the heat of the moment. Taking inspiration of the tank-like controls from the older PS1 horror era, players will have to strategize their items and positioning and commit to their attacks to overcome their enemies! Every enemy in the game including the Bosses come with a variety of movements and attacks to always keep the engagement tense and the player on their toes! Exploration in the game is heavily rewarded with additional items, optional equipment, and currency to use within the game!

Players need to examine and search for various clues to uncover the truth of the entire event.

Choices​

At key decision points, players must make choices that determine the direction of the story.

Judgment​

During certain stages, players must decide how to respond to progress the plot.

Gestures​

Throughout the game, players must learn sign language to solve puzzles at critical moments.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sinapse

The crew of the research vessel GRV Gauda-85 travels through the Muridia system, prospecting asteroids in search of valuable minerals. Everything would be peaceful—if not for a mysterious threat that has recently begun spreading across the star system, endangering both mining operations and the well-being of its inhabitants. Your mission is to uncover its origins and try to stop the looming danger…

Environmental puzzle

The game features 20 levels where you must optimize your path, manage limited resources, use various modules, and adapt to the surrounding environment.

Variety of challenges

Each level offers its own atmosphere, challenges, and hazards: distant asteroid fields, solar flares, comets and gas giants, automated mines, abandoned outposts, parasite nests, and pirate hideouts.

Story of GRV Gauda-85 crew

All of this is tied together by a single story about a small crew caught in the middle of events that could change the fate of the entire star system… and perhaps something even greater.

Game features

  • Turn-based gameplay that lets you plan every move.

  • Hop around fully 3D asteroids.

  • Puzzle levels with unique layouts and challenges.

  • Variety of modules and upgrades.

  • Numerous cosmic threats and unusual creatures.

  • Charming atmosphere and lighthearted humor.

  • Story-driven adventure that unfolds across an entire star system.

Compact 4–5 hour experience designed to be cozy and enjoyable.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU BUILT THE SYSTEM. NOW DESTROY IT.

Project: AFTERSHOCK is a narrative-driven Arcade Hacking Roguelite set in a dystopian future.

You are Dr. Rudolf Reinhardt Richter, who was once known as "The Architect". You built the nation's neural grid. The Regime branded you a traitor and buried you in a cell to silence you. But last night's suspicious "earthquake" shattered the prison walls.

Now, you are operating from a forgotten bunker you built 20 years ago. In front of you is a legacy terminal. The Regime is hunting for digital footprints, but they are blind to your analog signals.

They think the quake is over... But the real shockwave is coming.

GAMEPLAY

Reflexes are your only weapon. You have 3 seconds to breach the Regime's firewalls.

  • BE FAST: Identify the correct data nodes, decrypt the files, and siphon the funds.

  • BE CAREFUL: Avoid traps and aggressive AI countermeasures like AEGIS.

  • EVOLVE: The basic law of nature: If you want to survive, you must evolve. Use the funds stolen from the Regime to upgrade your legacy hardware in the Black Market.

store_data.about_the_game:
Haramball is a football tactics card strategy game. You pick the players (cards) from a deck, pick and choose the players whose attributes you want to merge together to make better players, put the players out on the pitch in the best-suited positions according to their attributes and then watch the result of your strategy unfold in front of your eyes in a real-time simulation.

As the great Michael Owen once said - "Whoever scores the most goals usually wins"

This holds true in the world of Haramball as well. You play through 2 halves and 18 rounds (including set-piece rounds) against other players or AI to determine the outcome of the game by scoring the most goals. 

Each outcome on the pitch is determined by the attributes of the players, which are broken down into 4 main categories :

  • ATT (Finishing, Crossing, Anticipation)

  • DEF (Tackling, Marking, Interceptions)

  • TEC (Dribbling, Passing, Set Pieces)

  • PHY (Pace, Strength, Heading)

The key to winning in Haramball is to maximize the effectiveness of your players' attributes by putting them in the right positions. For example, someone with a high crossing attribute on the flanks can be a lethal weapon to put crosses into the box whereas someone with a high interception attribute can best break opposition attacks sitting in the midfield. Getting the best players is only half the journey, setting them up in a suitable formation is the other.

What if luck isn't kind to me and I get a very bad choice of cards to pick from ?

It doesn't matter because your cards and your opponent's cards are exchanged at the end of the first half. No luck, only skill matters here !

FEATURES

  • PvP and PvE : In Haramball, you can play against other human players or against the AI

  • Strategic Decision-Making : Haramball challenges you to think strategically to beat your opponent at each step. From merging the right cards or holding on to them for later, choosing the right formation and players, all decisions require strategic thinking

  • Deep Attribute System : With 12 attributes to take into consideration across 4 main categories, there is always potential to outwit your opponent by picking the right players to counter your opponent's strategies and formations

  • Dynamic Simulation and Commentary System : There are no pre-determined outcomes in Haramball, each decision is taken in real-time with due consideration of the attributes of the players on the pitch. All of this is relayed to you in the form of a dynamic commentary system
