store_data.about_the_game:
One Thief. Four Residents. Infinite Chaos.

Not In My House is a 4v1 physics-based party game where stealth meets slapstick. One player controls the greedy Thief, trying to physically carry stacks of loot to the extraction zone. The other four players are the Residents, armed with nothing but household objects and bad attitudes, desperate to defend their property.

PLAY AS THE THIEF
You are outnumbered, but you are crafty.

Physics Stacking: You don't just click to steal. You have to physically pile TVs, toasters, and lamps into a wobbly tower and carry it to the door without dropping it.

The Vents are Your Friend: Outrun the Residents by diving into the vent system or hiding inside wardrobes... just don't get caught sneezing!

Juke the Squad: Use the "Swiss Cheese" house layout to break line-of-sight, jump over beds, and leave the Residents confused in your dust.

PLAY AS THE RESIDENTS
This is your house, and you’re not letting go without a fight.

Barricade Everything: Drag sofas, pile up chairs, and jam doors shut. Create physical blockades to funnel the Thief into your traps.

Set the Trap: Throw bars of soap to create slip-zones, turn off the lights to ambush the Thief in the dark, or just stand at the door with a frying pan.

Teamwork (Mostly): Split up to patrol the hallways or group up to corner the Thief. Just try not to trip over your own furniture.

KEY FEATURES
Living Comic Book Visuals: Experience a unique, stylized world rendered with halftone shadows, stepped lighting, and vibrant outlines. It feels like playing inside a graphic novel.

Procedural Neighborhood: No two heists are the same. The house layout, room themes, and furniture placement are procedurally generated every match.

Physics-Based Comedy: Every object has weight. Rugs crumple, lamps tip over, and door-blocking chairs fly across the room when rammed.

Interactive House: Use light switches to hide, flush toilets to create distractions, and smash windows to make an escape.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

SECOND WIND is a fast, melee-focused sci-fi action roguelite where every encounter is a test of timing, precision, and survival. You fight through a collapsing orbital station filled with hostile mechanical creatures, discovering new upgrades, mastering parry-based combat, and carving your path through increasingly brutal zones.

Built around clear telegraphs, tight enemy patterns, and forward-driving progression, SECOND WIND delivers a clean, readable, and rewarding combat experience for players who enjoy skill-based action without randomness interfering with the fight.

⚔️ PRECISION MELEE COMBAT

Combat in SECOND WIND is built entirely around clarity.
Enemies broadcast their attacks through sharp animations and glowing telegraphs:

  • Blue telegraph = parryable attack

  • Red telegraph = must evade

If your parry window overlaps the enemy’s parry window, you break through their attack and reduce their armor, creating openings to punish more aggressively.

Every attack is animation-locked, consistent, and learnable.
No hidden modifiers. No unpredictable RNG.
Just pure skill.

store_data.about_the_game:
Protocol Nightmare
Is a first-person horror game that combines exploration, survival, upgrades, and intense chases. You will have only three nights to uncover the secrets of the facility — while more than 10 different monsters relentlessly hunt you down.

Trapped in a mysterious location filled with power failures, broken cameras, and creatures that move through the darkness, your only chance is to stay one step ahead of whatever is stalking you.

Main Features

More than 10 unique monsters
Each creature has its own behavior, sounds, and hunting strategies. No night will ever be the same.

Flashlight and task scanner
Use your flashlight to illuminate your path and repel certain threats.
The scanner helps you find tasks scattered throughout the map — essential to keep systems running and to survive.

Task System
There are two types of tasks:
• Normal tasks: repair cameras, lights, and essential systems.
• Special tasks: unique events that completely change the course of the night.

Secret paths
Discover hidden passages that allow you to escape monsters, access exclusive rooms, and reveal pieces of the story.

Player upgrades
Improve abilities such as speed, stamina, flashlight duration, scanner accuracy, and other crucial advantages for survival.

Three nights of pure terror and adrenaline
Each night increases the intensity, monster aggression, and task complexity.
Survive… if you can.

Cinematic atmosphere and heavy tension
Dark lighting, unpredictable sounds, jump scares, and random events create an experience where you never feel safe.

If you enjoy psychological horror, intense chases, and oppressive atmosphere, Protocol Nightmare delivers an adventure full of adrenaline, mystery, and pure despair.

store_data.about_the_game:
Storm into Alea and demolish your enemies! In this high-pressure arena battler, each character has two distinct combat forms, allowing you to adopt a playstyle that is uniquely your own. Shift from defence to offense at the press of a button to outsmart, out-manoeuvre, and out-combo your opponent. Craving another battle? Immediately launch into another fast-paced battle with MMR-based matchmaking, and blaze your way up the public leaderboards.

FEATURES

  • Rapid, high-intensity matches with seamless matchmaking mean that you can make quick work of your opponents whenever you feel like it.

  • Carry your team to victory. Rise the ranks in high skill-ceiling 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 arena matches and earn respect from your fellow warriors.

  • Show off your quick thinking and master combat styles of every hero, adapting to any situation like few others can.

  • Outside the arena, engage with the community and have an impact on the future of Alea - with a responsive, active development team and regular updates and patches.

MASTER YOUR HERO AND CRUSH YOUR OPPONENTS

Earn respect from your fellow combatants by battling your way up the ranks, with intense battles that you’ll always have time for. Outplay your opponents by mastering form swapping, allowing you to start a fight with pressure and quickly pivot for a tactical retreat, ready for a counter-push!

MAKE ALLIES AS WELL AS ENEMIES

When you begin dominating the arena, the community is sure to take notice. Make allies on the battlefield and bring them up to your level - or carry them to victory. Find allies in Discord or via MMR-based online matchmaking in 2v2 and 3v3 modes, and make a name for yourself.

store_data.about_the_game:
BlastForge– Forge your legend is a fast-paced tactical FPS built for players who value clean gunplay, instant responsiveness, and fair competitive combat. Every action, every shot, and every movement matters — only skill, precision, and strategy decide the outcome.

Enter a world of intense firefights, carefully crafted maps, and polished core mechanics. From solo training sessions to coordinated team battles, BlastForge delivers a flexible progression system, realistic weapon behavior, and refined movement designed to reward mastery.

  • ⚔️ Tactical PvP Modes
    Control objectives, hold angles, push aggressively, or play strategically — adapt to every situation.

  • 🎯 Clean, Responsive Gunplay
    No unnecessary visual noise. Just crisp recoil, predictable patterns, and fair duels.

  • 🤖 Training Mode & Bots
    Sharpen your aim, explore maps, and master movement before entering real battles.

  • 🗺️ Unique Maps
    Fight across industrial zones, night environments, and more — each built for tactical gameplay.

  • 🧨 Grenades, Gadgets & Specialized Weapons
    Use tactical tools to break defenses, force rotations, and outplay your opponents.

  • 🛰️ Killstreak Abilities
    Earn powerful rewards that can shift the momentum of the match when used skillfully.

  • 👥 Active Development
    New maps, modes, events, and improvements guided by community feedback.

Free For All

A fast and chaotic every-player-for-themselves mode. No teams, no allies — eliminate anyone you see. The player with the most kills by the end of the match wins.

Team Deathmatch

Two teams fight head-to-head in classic combat. Work together, hold angles, control the map, and outscore the enemy team before the time runs out.

Elimination

A high-pressure round-based mode. No respawns — once you’re down, you wait until the next round. The team that eliminates all opponents or completes the objective wins the round.

Demolition

Attackers must plant and defend the bomb, while defenders must stop them or defuse it. Tactical gameplay with strong focus on strategy, utility, and teamwork.

Kill Confirmed

Classic kill collection mode. Eliminate enemies and secure their dropped tags to score. Deny enemy points by picking up tags from fallen teammates.

Airstreak Mode

Earn killstreak points to unlock powerful Airstreak abilities. Use air support, recon tools, or high-impact tactical strikes to change the momentum of the match.

Capture the Flag

Two teams compete to infiltrate the enemy base, steal their flag, and return it safely to their own. Protect your flag, coordinate attacks, and outmaneuver opponents to secure points and dominate the battlefield.

BlastForge is a game where skill, teamwork, and quick decision-making forge legends.
Forge Your Legend.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your job is simple: classify forgotten reports.

The Archive is an OS-driven, UI-based investigative psychological narrative where nothing is quite what it seems.

You play as Nathan Reed, Who has been hired to work the night shift at the Bureau of Investigation – Case Processing Unit, tasked with clearing a classified backlog of highly sensitive reports that were never meant to resurface.

Every case you open is inspired by real-world documented incidents and unsolved mysteries, drawn from genuine accounts that were quietly forgotten over the years.

But as the nights pass, the cases grow more mysterious, the patterns more deliberate, and the archive begins revealing a truth that was never meant for you.

You play as a newly hired night-shift case analyst. Your responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing classified incident reports

  • Cross-referencing subjects through a secure database

  • Examining attached evidence

  • Reading internal memos and system messages

  • Making classification decisions that influence how cases are handled

The Archive is played entirely through an immersive computer interface, featuring:

  • An in-game email system

  • A case file viewer

  • A secure subject database

  • Evidence attachments such as transcripts, photos, and reports

  • Internal memos that appear as the story unfolds

Progression occurs over multiple night shifts, each one introducing stranger cases, deeper connections, and escalating tension as the larger narrative slowly reveals itself.

  • UI-based investigative gameplay

  • Narrative-driven psychological mystery

  • Inspired by real-world unsolved incidents

  • In-game operating system with multiple tools

  • Database-driven case tracking

  • Internal memos and hidden system communications

  • Multiple nights of escalating story progression

  • Player-driven classification decisions

  • Atmospheric, tension-focused experience

  • Single-player only

This is a tension-filled investigative experience designed to make you question the information presented to you and your role in processing it.

The truth is buried in the archive.

Your job is to decide how far you’re willing to dig.

A massive update is coming to Glowbot Galaxy featuring:

  • Full visual overhaul (shown in current screenshots and trailers)

  • 4-player local multiplayer

  • Enhanced UI and level select screens

  • Improved loading screens

About the Game

In Glowbot Galaxy, you’ll step into a glowing universe where the fate of the Glowbots rests in your hands. When the Demon King steals their Queen and scatters their stars across distant galaxies, the Glowbots’ only hope is a daring voyage across seven vibrant worlds to reclaim the power that fuels their ships.

Travel through galaxies that burst with color and personality:

  • Starfield Falls – shimmering skybridges among the stars

  • Cascade Tides – radiant beaches and drifting currents

  • Basalt Barrens – a crumbling realm of volcanic stone

  • Blightbloom Grove – glowing with spores and strange life

  • FrostBite Nebula – frozen platforms drifting in the void

  • Lavatide Cliffs – pulsing with molten danger

  • Stellar Abyss – a haunting world of shadows and starlight

Each world is packed with hidden paths, glowing challenges, and secret stars waiting to be uncovered.

With 35 handcrafted levels and 7 unique boss battles, your journey is full of surprises, platforming challenges, and cosmic adventure.

Charming, colorful, and glowing with atmosphere, Glowbot Galaxy invites you to explore, discover, and fight for the light of your people.

Can you reclaim the stolen stars, save your Queen, and restore hope to the galaxy?

store_data.about_the_game:
OVERVIEW

Street-Spec lets you live the Japanese car life of your dreams. Customize your car to perfection and push it to its absolute limits at Japan's most famous driving hotspots. Race through busy streets or drive on the track and enjoy a nostalgic, atmospheric vision of early 2000s Japan.

In its early stages, Street-Spec will offer a mostly open, unrestricted experience. As development continues, more structured career/progression elements will follow.

FEATURES

Deep Vehicle Customization

  • Install a variety of aftermarket parts such as body kits, engine parts, interior parts and more

  • Repaint or transform any part of your car with no limits in the livery editor

  • Import and export custom paint designs from the internet

  • Import custom 3D models to use as aftermarket parts

  • Fine-tune your vehicle’s performance and handling to your personal driving style

Diverse Driving Experiences

  • Drift at Tokyo's industrial areas in the dead of night

  • Beat your best time on the touge

  • Swerve through the dense traffic of central Tokyo

  • Beat your best track times or learn to drift on the track

  • Enjoy dramatic crashes with parts scattering everywhere

  • Choose from a selection of legendary golden era cars

In-Depth Personalization

  • Adjust weather, time of day, and driving conditions

  • Adjust camera and graphics settings

  • Personalize your garage to match your style

  • Play it even on a potato, at the lowest graphics

Unique Development Approach

  • Development is documented in detail from the very start

  • Community has control over the direction of the project

  • The game takes inspiration from modern games, but also classics like NFSU2, Midnight Club, SLRR, or GT4

  • The art style is slightly low-poly and retro, allowing for more content to be produced faster as a single developer

store_data.about_the_game:
Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet.

Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet. Let the words flow with the soft waves of Lo-Fi music. Chill, ease your mind and create.

Haiku is a form of poetry, originated in Japan. The basic rules are very simple. It consists of 3 lines. Very, very short and compact! 5 Syllables in the first line, 7 in the second line and finally 5 in the last, third line. And it doesn’t even have to rhyme. Quite nice, right? And how relaxing it’s to create one! Especially with calming notes of Lo-Fi Music, magical animations and steam rising from a cup of coffee.

Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill is a tool which will help you on your journey of becoming the greatest Haiku Master. Use the words we provide, play around with them, change them, form them into sentences and in no time you will have your own poem. Traditionally Haikus describe nature and its wonders, but YOU can make it about anything! You can write about your cat or grandma. Anything goes as long as you have fun!

Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill features:

Solid selection of words, you can use to create poems

Tools to help you count syllables

Plenty of good vibes coming from chill and nice Lo-Fi music

Stunning, magical animations

All the good vibes :)

store_data.about_the_game:
The Long Way Home is an atmospheric sci-fi stew that blends classic Point & Click and Visual Novel storytelling with a first-person (FPS) view and survival/RPG elements.

Are you ready to watch the universe through the visor of the miner’s helmet on your head?

You wake up on an abandoned ship; there’s no one else breathing here but you. Soon you realize something: the only beings you can talk to are the ship’s Artificial Intelligence, the galaxy’s odd robots, and aliens from every step of evolution.

But what about humans?

THE MYSTERY OF THE FUTURE

While trying to figure out what happened to humanity, you also have to get the ship back to Earth. Along the way, you’ll need to befriend humanoid robots, out-of-control AIs, and extremely weird aliens—trade with them, fight to survive, or solve problems through diplomacy.

A MINER’S SKILLS

Crossing the galaxy isn’t easy. On this journey, you’ll have to rely on your skills. Improve your engineering to bring scrap back to life, or use your cybersecurity talents to hack systems. Or focus purely on survival—cook and grow food, and prepare delicious meals for a first-class journey. Buy new parts to upgrade your gear and even your ship, or discover new blueprints and craft them yourself.

“WAR AND PEACE” IS A FILTHY STICK—DIRTY ON BOTH ENDS

There are many ways to get what you want. From turn-based ship battles to QTE-based melee fights; from choice-driven stealth actions to tricking minds through lies, misdirection, and manipulation. The choice is yours: will you be a hero, or will you destroy anyone who stands in your way?

YOU MUST LIVE WITH THE CONSEQUENCES OF YOUR CHOICES

There isn’t a single “right” in the universe. Sometimes an action taken for a good cause can lead to a terrible end. But no matter— a traveler always keeps moving forward. As a wise man once said: “Just as a single good deed doesn’t make us a good person, a single evil deed can’t turn us into a bad one.”

CHASING THE STORY IS UP TO YOU

Where are you? Who are you, even? Where did everyone go? What happened to humanity? Are you curious?

Explore abandoned ships, examine logs, collect curios, trade with robots, and hunt for clues on galactic web pages.

Don’t care what the story is trying to tell?

Then focus only on the mission. Don’t let anyone burden you with the galaxy’s troubles.

Your road is long, 13-553. Are you ready?

store_data.about_the_game:
Stackable is a first-person tower-building game where every object is a building block.

Your goal is simple: build the tallest structure possible using whatever items you can grab.

Play solo or team up in online co-op, working together to create massive towers that shouldn’t exist, but somehow do.

Gameplay

Junk keep's getting thrown into your backyard. Pick up the junk, place it carefully, and build the tallest tower you can and climb to the top.

Every placement changes the tower’s stability, forcing you to adapt, reposition, or reinforce weak points.

Objects have different weights, shapes, sizes, and balancing properties, meaning every run feels different. A tall, stable tower requires planning… or pure chaos and luck.

Progression & Upgrades

Earn points for every meter you stack, then use your points unlock a growing list of tools and upgrades, like:

  • Tape – Secure objects together to prevent wobble or collapse.

  • Jetpack – Reach higher placement spots faster or make mid-air saves when pieces fall.

  • Upgrades – Climb faster, jump higher, spawn junk faster, & more.

Co-Op & Multiplayer

store_data.detailed_description:
Stackable is a first-person tower-building game where every object is a building block.

Your goal is simple: build the tallest structure possible using whatever items you can grab.

Play solo or team up in online co-op, working together to create massive towers that shouldn’t exist, but somehow do.

Gameplay

Junk keep's getting thrown into your backyard. Pick up the junk, place it carefully, and build the tallest tower you can and climb to the top.

Every placement changes the tower’s stability, forcing you to adapt, reposition, or reinforce weak points.

Objects have different weights, shapes, sizes, and balancing properties, meaning every run feels different. A tall, stable tower requires planning… or pure chaos and luck.

Progression & Upgrades

Earn points for every meter you stack, then use your points unlock a growing list of tools and upgrades, like:

  • Tape – Secure objects together to prevent wobble or collapse.

  • Jetpack – Reach higher placement spots faster or make mid-air saves when pieces fall.

  • Upgrades – Climb faster, jump higher, spawn junk faster, & more.

Co-Op & Multiplayer

Invite friends to build together, each player carrying, taping, and climbing at the same time. Work as a coordinated team—or sabotage each other and watch the whole thing fall apart.

Features

  • First-person physics-based tower stacking

  • Solo play or online multiplayer co-op

  • Unlockable tools and upgrades

  • Dynamic object physics with real weight and balance considerations

  • Endless replayability through physics-driven chaos

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is a fantasy RPG set in a 2.5D world, illustrated with cute artwork, featuring symbol encounter battles.

There is no grand story, and no ending.

Play as long as you like, in any way you like—
Hunt monsters, cook and eat, or simply travel at your own pace.

◆A Free RPG with No Restrictions

In Michikusa Wanderer, there is no story that forces you to progress, nor any requirement like “you must do X to continue.”

The world and its monsters simply exist, and within it lives the dragonkin girl, the protagonist Erin.

You can rush through the world, take your time, interact with monsters, or master the art of cooking.
Play at your own rhythm.

There are powerful bosses, but battles are optional.
Challenge them only when you feel ready.

◆Unique and Diverse Monsters

Cute, cool, and strangely shaped creatures—
The world is overflowing with all kinds of monsters.

Sometimes you’ll hunt them, sometimes eat them, sometimes run away.
You may even aim to complete the monster encyclopedia.

◆Companions to Aid You in Battle

Although Michikusa Wanderer is primarily a solo journey,
you can call upon allies when facing mighty bosses.

These companions are also colorful and full of personality.

◆Watch Erin’s Hunger

Erin has a Satiety Gauge that decreases over time and during battles.

If it reaches zero, her HP will drop, and eventually she will starve to death.

To avoid this, cook meals using ingredients obtained from monsters, manage her satiety, and continue your journey wisely.

◆No Story, But a Past

While the game has no overarching story, the world itself has a past.

By defeating field bosses, you can uncover fragments of that history—
Why are there no Demon Lords or Heroes?
Why have humans vanished entirely?

Bosses are very strong, so prepare carefully before taking them on.

◆Roguelite Dungeons

Scattered across the world are dungeons waiting to be explored.

Unlike the overworld, dungeons follow different rules:

  • Random encounters

  • Randomized floors

  • Saving disabled

This creates a unique tension in exploration.
Should you press forward, or retreat? The choice is always yours.

※ This game was created using RPG Developer Bakin.
System requirements follow those of the engine.

store_data.about_the_game:
PrimeCraft is a sci-fi sandbox about exploring a vast, procedurally generated universe of miniature planets, training AI companions, and jumping into handcrafted scenes created by the community. Every world you visit has its own gravity, terrain, and strange little challenges, and you’re free to roam, experiment, or simply relax and explore.

Travel between billions of unique planets, drop into “bubble” scenes for small self-contained experiences, and return seamlessly to open-world exploration. Play solo or bring friends along in multiplayer and local split-screen modes.

Your AI companion learns directly from your actions. Teach it how to move, navigate worlds, help you, or take your place entirely inside any scene. AI behaviour persists across worlds and sessions, creating a growing sense of personality as you explore.

PrimeCraft is built around playfulness, physics, and discovery. Whether you’re drifting between planets, testing a new AI reflex, or showing friends a strange world you found, the universe is designed to surprise you.

Key Features

• Billions of unique planets — Procedurally generated worlds with dynamic gravity and seamless travel.
• AI companions that learn from you — Train behaviours in real time and let them assist you or take over.
• Jump into “bubble” scenes — Load custom levels, puzzles, experiments, or mini-scenarios created by players.
• Singleplayer, co-op, online co-op, and split-screen — Explore together across multiple modes.
• Physics-driven sandbox — Lasso objects, teleport, bounce, glide, and experiment with playful mechanics.
• Stylized 3D universe — Colorful, atmospheric worlds designed for wandering and curiosity.
• Ongoing updates — New biomes, tools, AI features, and scenes will be added throughout Early Access.

store_data.about_the_game:
Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End

1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation…?

Satisfying Whip Action

The iconic whip of the series is now more important than ever!

Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!

Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combats!

A Large Selection of Weapons and Abilities

The whip is not the only tool at your disposal. You will need to strategically plan your next move in combat and make full use of all the weapons and abilities to stand a chance!

Environment Hazards That Will make you grit your teeth

Biomes are packed with secrets, traps and puzzles.

It is not just about muscles, it's about brains too!

A New Art Style

Expanding further the series-classic gothic style, this unique colorful art style will let you discover the world of Castlevania like never before.

Beloved Elements of Castlevania Make Their Return

True to the roots of the series, you will encounter colorful characters and powerful foes, stumble upon many secret chambers, dig up numerous hidden items, and whip your way through challenging areas!

store_data.about_the_game:
== ABOUT THIS GAME ==

Emberion is an intense action survival roguelike where you fight endless waves of enemies in the cursed Ashen Ruins. Master powerful spells, unlock legendary heroes, and see how long you can survive. Every run is different, every death makes you stronger.

== KEY FEATURES ==

• AUTO-ATTACK COMBAT - Focus on positioning and strategy, not button mashing

• MULTIPLE HEROES - Unlock and master the Battle Mage, Sorcerer, and Warlock

• POWERFUL SPELLS - Lightning bolts, spectral skulls, flame slashes, and more

• PROGRESSIVE DIFFICULTY - Each wave gets harder, bosses appear every 10 minutes

• PERMANENT UPGRADES - Spend gold earned in runs to permanently strengthen your hero

• STEAM LEADERBOARDS - Compete globally for the longest survival time

• ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY - No two runs are the same

== GAMEPLAY ==

Start each run weak, but grow stronger as you survive. Collect experience to level up and choose powerful upgrades. Earn gold to spend on permanent stat boosts back in the Sanctuary. Face increasingly difficult enemies and epic boss battles. How long can you survive?

== HEROES ==

• BATTLE MAGE - Balanced warrior-mage hybrid

• SORCERER - Master of arcane magic

• WARLOCK - Dark magic specialist

Each hero has unique abilities and playstyles. Unlock them all and find your favorite!

== FUTURE UPDATES ==

Emberion is actively being developed with regular content updates planned:

• NEW HEROES - More heroes coming in future patches

• NEW MAPS - Additional areas to explore and survive in

• ACHIEVEMENT SYSTEM - Unlock achievements as you progress

• MORE CONTENT - New spells, enemies, bosses, and features

== Social ==

Join our community to stay updated on the latest developments!

== SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS ==

Requires Windows 10 or later. See store page for full system requirements.

• SORCERER - Master of arcane magic

• WARLOCK - Dark magic specialist

• NEW MAPS - Additional areas to explore and survive in

Join our community to stay updated on the latest developments!

store_data.about_the_game:
The world has been plunged into Eternal Darkness, and the Ancient Shadows have awakened, consuming everything in their path. According to Elder legends, only the Elixir of Light can dispel the darkness and banish evil back into the void. You must embark on a perilous journey through the Cursed Lands and overcome 25 trials to collect the rarest ingredients to create a life-saving potion. The fate of the world depends on you!

Game Objective and Rules

Your goal in each level is to collect a certain number of ingredients. Current objectives are always displayed on the left side of the screen.

How to Play:

Create combinations: Swap adjacent tiles to line up 3 or more of the same type in a row or column. If you can't see a move, the game will prompt you after 15 seconds.

Keep an eye on the task: Simply exploding tiles is not enough. If a level requires a certain number of red and blue tiles, focus on them.

The levels have a unique structure: pyramids, spirals, rings, and other shapes await you. Each stage features a unique block layout, creating a unique board pattern and new obstacles. Empty spaces and walls change the trajectory of falling tiles, which must be taken into account when planning your moves.

Boosters (Helpers)

If you get stuck or run out of moves, use artifacts from the panel on the right. Select a booster, then apply it to the board:

Hammer: A pinpoint strike. Destroys any single selected tile. However, it is actually unpredictable—with an extremely rare chance, it can destroy the entire level and move you to the next one.

Sword: Slices space. Destroys an entire horizontal row.

Two Swords: Cross Strike. Destroys both an entire row and an entire column intersecting at a selected point.

Bomb: A medium-power explosion. Destroys all tiles within a 3x3 radius of the target.

Lightning: The magic of color. Select any tile, and lightning will destroy absolutely all tiles of that type on the board.

Hurricane: Chaos for Good. Completely shuffles all tiles on the playing field (activates immediately when pressed).

Booster Shop

Your points are valuable currency. The game features a Shop where you can replenish your supplies.

The more tiles you destroy and the longer your combinations, the more points you earn.

You can use these points to purchase any missing booster right during the game. Don't be afraid to spend your earnings if it helps you pass a difficult level!

Features and Tips

Combo Attacks: Matching 4 tiles in a row triggers a magic beam that destroys the line. Matching 5 tiles destroys all elements vertically and horizontally (in a cross).

Collection: After each completed level, you receive a unique story item. You can examine your trophies and read their story in the Collection menu. Difficulty: The game starts with easy levels, but gradually the number of magic items increases, and the board shapes become more complex.

Controls

Left mouse button: Select a piece, swap positions, use boosters, buy in the store.

Right mouse button: Deselect a booster (if you change your mind about using it).

ESC key: Exit to the menu.

M key: Quickly turn music on or off.

N key: Quickly turn sound effects on or off.

B key: Turn the background on or off.

store_data.about_the_game:
StalSide is a coop like rogue-lite survival game set inside a mysterious, simulated post-apocalyptic world. The simulation is populated by both simple creatures and mysterious entities – some guarding its secrets, others unleashing chaos. Only the player has the capability to reveal simulation secrets. But beware: the simulation itself actively hinders intruders to maintain its balance between the known and unknown, so survival is a constant struggle.

Gameplay & Features:

Procedural Exploration: Each game session is unpredictable with a wild zones, random loot and spawn. No two expeditions are the same.

Cooperative Play: Team up online with up to 8 players to explore and survive together. Share resources and cover each other’s backs as you push deeper into the rabbit's hole.

Survival Mechanics: Scavenge for materials to craft weapons, tools, and shelter. You can face an enemies ranging from wild animals to hostile humans. And even face the unknown creatures that never seen before. The Zone is full of deadly traps – from the weather and deadly anomalies that can kill on sight.

Light Progression: There’s a minimal leveling system for slight stat boosts, but the focus remains on action and teamwork rather than grinding.

Anime-Style Visual: The game features colorful, anime-inspired characters that can be customized with a various clothes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Operation Mode and Swinging Mechanics

The game introduces a completely new control scheme where players no longer directly command a protagonist. Instead, one or two players manipulate the main character by controlling ropes. Players must cleverly utilize the swing and pull of these ropes to guide the character's movement, jumping, evasion, and attacks.

In single-player mode, the player uses the keyboard to control the left rope and the mouse to control the right rope. As the character moves from the ground into the air, the ropes are affected by forces, building up potential energy. According to the transfer of force, when a rope's force meets an obstacle, the remaining energy transfers through the character's body to the other side of the rope, enabling large, dynamic swings.

In two-player mode, each player controls one rope (via keyboard and mouse respectively). Success requires the two players to be mentally in sync, cooperating seamlessly to overcome challenges. A full playthrough typically takes about 1 to 2 hours to complete.

The game's backstory

The player navigates a virtual game universe, maneuvering a puppet guided only by threads. They explore cavernous ruins and ultimately overcome adversity on a journey to its final destination.

Game Introduction and Genre

This is a lighthearted 2D action-adventure simulation game focusing on movement and manipulation. Players control two ropes, using their swing to guide the character forward, make them jump, dodge obstacles, and attack. Armed with a rope-controlled knife, players explore a vast 2D map to collect special A and D abilities as well as hidden diamonds. Along the journey, they will encounter small mushrooms, cunning Skeleton Guards, archers, and elusive little birds. Deep inside caves, players must navigate moving mechanisms, saw blades, spike traps, enemies in confined areas, and various hidden paths—using both wits and skill to eventually escape the caverns.

Additional Modes & Rewards

After the game's launch, two DLCs will be released sequentially.
One mode takes place in a closed room where players must avoid various mechanisms, obstacles, and enemies. Completion times will be displayed on a leaderboard.

The other mode is a roguelite Vampire Survivors-like experience. Players explore a vast open space, collect weapons, defeat enemies, gain experience, and upgrade abilities—such as lightning, bombs, and arrows. The Puppet can carry and attack with these acquired weapons.

Game Duration

It takes approximately  2 hours for players to complete the game.

Left Rope

The left rope controls the puppet's left arm and can lift the puppet by pulling up its arm. The left rope also has the ability to absorb the power of Item A and Item D. Once the player obtains either Item A or D, they can force the rope to move left or right.

Right Rope

The right rope controls the puppet's right arm and can also lift the puppet independently. The right arm is connected to the puppet's weapon, which deals damage to enemies and causes them to disappear upon defeat.

Item A or D

Items A and D allow the rope to be forced to move left or right for a short duration, thereby influencing the movement of the puppet.

Acquiring Rope Items

The game features a variety of AD items. When players obtain an AD item, they can press the A and D keys to forcibly move the rope left or right.

Cherry

Cherries must be collected directly by the character (not by the ropes). Picking up a cherry restores the player's HP.

Diamond

Hidden diamonds are scattered throughout the game, requiring players to explore carefully to discover them.

Skeleton

Skeleton Guard: Possesses high health and attacks enemies at close range.

Skeleton Archer: Can shoot three arrows in fixed directions and ranges, or fire a single homing arrow.

Spike Trap

Spike traps inflict significant damage to Puppets. Some are fixed in place, some are mounted on wood, and others are set on moving mechanical stones.

Saw Blade

Continuous Damage Saw: These remain stationary or move in a set pattern.

Intermittent Damage Saw: Activates and spins at intervals.

Small Fly

Tiny flying insects that disrupt the movement of ropes and Puppets, causing minor damage to the player. They can be eliminated by swinging the knife.

Enemies and Mechanisms

The game features various enemies and mechanisms. Arrows fired by enemies can alter the player's movement trajectory.

Numerous flying enemies are also present, and contact with them will affect the player's movement. Some mechanisms and traps require careful judgment to avoid.

Four Achievement Modes

These provide players with higher difficulty challenges and achievements, allowing them to complete the game without collecting special abilities to increase the challenge.

Full Collection
Players must find all hidden gems to earn this achievement.

Permanent Death

This game does not feature a save mechanism, meaning that upon death, players will have to start over from the very beginning of the game. The overall playthrough takes approximately 1 to 2 hours to complete.

Inspiration and Development Process

The creator is a 40-year-old homeless man. During eight years of drifting, he recorded many sparks of inspiration. One day, lying on a bunk in a youth hostel, he pondered what regrets remained in his life. He recalled a game concept he had envisioned at 18—one that still had no equivalent in gaming history. So, he returned home and taught himself C#, Unity, and Photoshop.

While struggling with the art, he discovered a pixel art software called Aseprite on Bilibili (a Chinese video platform). Implementing and fine-tuning the force transmission between the rope and the character became an immense challenge, keeping him up night after night for three months before he finally settled on this difficult-to-realize mechanic.

Research was a tortuous journey. You start with a general direction that seems feasible, only to encounter countless smaller problems along the way. You try dozens of methods, hundreds of approaches to solve them. When nothing works, you circle back and reconsider the broader direction—which itself branches into countless alternatives, demanding relentless experimentation.

During this period, the developer fell into severe depression. For four months, he was stuck on the rope physics, making no tangible progress. He genuinely believed it might be impossible to achieve. After a week of lying in bed, lost and helpless, he decided to give up. But then, he resolved to try one more time. After three days of intense effort, he finally succeeded in making the rope gameplay work.

Keep moving forward, never look back. Countless hard days and nights had passed; so many "impossible" tasks had already been accomplished. Future problems would be overcome step by step. The final lines of code ultimately resolved everything: the force, its transfer, its release, damping, resistance, collision response and entanglement between the rope and character, rope clipping, model penetration, and freezing.

This journey also carries a message to all young people: pursue what you truly want to do. Keep moving forward, never look back. Anything is possible.

Overture!

HIEROSAGA: OVERTURE is the initial proof-of-concept iteration of the game presenting the first chapter of the story. It covers the arrival into the desert town of Akimor and the majority of the first dungeon. It also includes an infinite mode that takes full advantage of the generation algorithm for a more roguelike experience!

What's going on?

HIEROSAGA chronicles the adventure of a small town knight who journeys to a mythical desert town in the east seeking riches and ancient treasure. Along the way, he crosses paths with a gang of rowdy slave traders, as well as their captive: a scheming mage who unknowingly manages to land all of them - and perhaps even the world - in hot water.

The DNA

HIEROSAGA is a rogue-lite tactical role playing adventure inspired by games like Azure Dreams, Tactics Ogre, and Chrono Trigger. Featuring a free movement "Exploration mode" when out of combat, discover secrets and collect helpful items at your own pace- unearth artefacts that grant you skills and play around with your build in the equip menu to prepare for whatever might be around the corner. A grid-based "Combat mode" is triggered when an enemy is nearby, affixing the player to the "battle board" and turning the dungeon into a turn-based chess match where the name of the game can be escape, survival, or elimination of all enemies!

store_data.about_the_game:
Absølve places the player in the role of an empowered warrior who channels both strength and corruption to face endless waves of enemies.

The combat combines precise melee action with dynamic movement mechanics such as dashing, jumping, and ability-based attacks. Each encounter challenges the player to maintain momentum while managing limited-use ability cards that offer powerful attacks or movement options.

Monster Waves

Face large waves of enemies, where every wave gets harder and harder.. how far will you get?

Wheel of Judgement:

The Wheel of Judgement is a unique mechanic where the player draws random abilities from a holy arsenal to empower him during combat, this arsenal grants abilities in randomised fashion causing the player to have little-to-no influence over the abilities that will be granted.

Every time an available ability gets used, it will be removed from the player and put back into the Wheel of Judgement, then the Wheel will randomly appoint a new ability to the player, replacing the earlier ability.

Rage:

In order to use these abilities you will need to build the resource called Rage, this resource automatically builds up when using your light and heavy attacks to hit enemy monsters.

Corruption:

The corruption adds a risk-reward element, using the Wheel of Judgement you will gain access to random abilities but not all abilities are created to your advantage.. these are what we call Corruptions gain and use one these corruptions will activate a negative effect on the player.. so be wise in your decisions on when to active certain abilities.

Boss Monsters:

Face unique boss monsters (with unique archetypes/mechanics) that each will challenge you in a different way to test your gameplay, tactical and mastery.

The player’s journey emphasizes control, spectacle, and skill expression. Every battle rewards mastery, awareness, and creative combinations of attacks and abilities. The experience aims to create a strong feeling of empowerment while still challenging the player to stay composed amid chaos.

store_data.about_the_game:
Soul's Gambit is a strategy-focused card game that blends classic poker hands with RPG elements and roguelike mechanics. Experience Balatro-style addictive gameplay within a deep and dark atmosphere reminiscent of Undertale.

At this table, your opponents are not just AI; each has a unique playstyle and a soul they put on the line. Combine luck with strategy, utilize cheat cards, and survive the dealer's ruthless game.

Key Features:

  • Roguelike Deckbuilding: Every run is unique. Strengthen your deck with winning hands, discover new "Joker" cards, and create endless combinations.

  • Tactical Battles: Making the highest hand isn't enough. Analyze your opponents' moves, use defense cards at the right time, and take risks to increase the reward.

  • Deep Atmosphere: A dark casino experience featuring a retro "Dirty Pixel Art" style and dynamic music that heightens the tension.

  • Moral Choices: Will you bankrupt your opponents and take their souls, or show them mercy? Your choices affect the game's ending.

  • Replayability: Thanks to procedurally generated encounters, no two games are alike.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a data clerk in a late-90s bureaucracy, where the corporation has assigned you a new role: process tax forms. Simple work. Repetitive work. Harmless work.

Until the documents start arriving for the deceased, the unborn, and those who should not exist.

Every field you fill, every number you enter, every correction you submit... the system reacts instantly. It knows what you've done. It decides what happens next.

There is no supervisor coming. No escape. Just the forms. And you.

Your task is straightforward:

Read each form. Enter the correct data. Submit it.

But the ordinary quickly becomes impossible.

  • Birthdates that occur decades in the future

  • Debts assigned to people long dead

  • Internal memos contradicting themselves

  • Urgent phone calls demanding specific outcomes

  • Emails timestamped from days you haven’t lived yet

The software behaves like a living thing... updating, correcting, and escalating faster than any human oversight should allow.

The horror isn’t in what you see.

It’s in what your actions cause.

As you process chains of interconnected documents, the world outside your desk begins to distort. People suffer or

vanish depending on your entries. Some plead for help. Others demand compliance. And some… were never supposed

to contact you at all.

The system responds to everything you do...

It watches...

It judges...

and no matter what choices you make ... it always decides the final outcome.

All you can do is keep typing.

FEATURES: 

  • Process increasingly impossible tax forms for clients who may or may not exist.

  • Experience narrative chains formed entirely through your data entries.

  • Receive calls and emails from desperate strangers, supervisors, and things pretending to be both.

  • Face moral decisions that feel meaningful even when the system overrides them.

  • Immerse yourself in authentic 90s office software with retro UI, audio cues, and corporate coldness.

  • A short, atmospheric experience (1–2 hours) focused on dread, consequence, and inevitability.

This game includes themes related to:

  • Violence (non-graphic)

  • Child harm

  • Abortion

  • Domestic conflict

  • Psychological distress

  • Paranoia and helplessness

Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
Socket is a first-person psychological horror game about the victims of a Great Tragedy thirty years ago

“30 years later: the Van der Wonder cocoa factory disaster”

The city still remembers that terrible day when fire engulfed the Van der Wonder factory. Witnesses say the flames were visible for miles, and the sirens blared all night. But even 30 years later, the details of what happened remain a mystery. What was Van der Wonder's reaction? Who was punished? What lies behind the legacy of the world's largest cocoa empire?

Worm your way into their confidence

Congrats on your first day at work! Here’s what you’ll be doing: going door-to-door, handing out flyers, and meeting the locals. Remember to be friendly and polite - it goes a long way!

Dig through their dirty laundry

We need to know what they eat, what they read, and what notes they leave in the margins. Trust me, Tim, there will definitely be notes in the margins.

Burn out

Tim, you probably just felt unwell. Maybe it was stuffy or something like that. Don’t overthink it — that idiot isn’t worth stressing over.

Don’t forget to take care of yourself

You’ll have the last task. This time, the very last one. We can’t take any risks, Tim. We left something in the locked apartment on the second floor…

store_data.about_the_game:
A CRACKED, EMPTY VESSEL. 

A GIRL WHOSE SOUL IS BURSTING WITH LIFE AND HATE. 

THERE CAN ONLY BE ONE FUTURE FOR THEM. 
_____ 

Clover is a shell of a person, living an empty, isolating existence. While it struggles clumsily trying to figure out the basic aspects of its identity, its future seems like more of the same, with homelessness looming and no support from family or friends.

Lotus is an overachieving trust fund girl, beloved by those around her, while miserably drowning in boredom and empty relationships. She wants an escape.

And she knows about someone who might want it too. And if it doesn't, that doesn't matter — She'll make sure it does.

The two become hopelessly entangled as they embark on a morbid road trip to the Cobalt Belt, a gargantuan, anomalous zone where reality is suspended and return is all but impossible.

And if that doesn't kill them, Lotus has a hardware store built IED for guaranteed instant oblivion. Their fates were sealed the moment they met.

What freedom and joy can they claw back in the time they have left? How much pain will come with it?

_____

  • A linear visual novel. You cannot change the outcome, you can only watch.

  • Roughly 22K words of pain and manic longing. About 1-2 hours of reading.

  • Lively animated text effects to help convey the script's disordered, emotional turmoil.

  • A surreal and intense soundtrack from various artists. Gritty chaos paired with melancholy catharsis.

store_data.detailed_description:
A CRACKED, EMPTY VESSEL. 

A GIRL WHOSE SOUL IS BURSTING WITH LIFE AND HATE. 

THERE CAN ONLY BE ONE FUTURE FOR THEM. 
_____ 

Clover is a shell of a person, living an empty, isolating existence. While it struggles clumsily trying to figure out the basic aspects of its identity, its future seems like more of the same, with homelessness looming and no support from family or friends.

Lotus is an overachieving trust fund girl, beloved by those around her, while miserably drowning in boredom and empty relationships. She wants an escape.

And she knows about someone who might want it too. And if it doesn't, that doesn't matter — She'll make sure it does.

The two become hopelessly entangled as they embark on a morbid road trip to the Cobalt Belt, a gargantuan, anomalous zone where reality is suspended and return is all but impossible.

And if that doesn't kill them, Lotus has a hardware store built IED for guaranteed instant oblivion. Their fates were sealed the moment they met.

What freedom and joy can they claw back in the time they have left? How much pain will come with it?

Face multiple levels, uncover fragments of a small-scale but meaningful story, and watch your power evolve across countless runs. Whether you fail or succeed, every journey brings you closer to becoming the true UltiMage.

store_data.about_the_game:
DULMYR is an isometric roguelite action-RPG focused on fast-paced combat, permanent progression, and repeated dungeon runs.

Players control a single character viewed from an isometric perspective and explore procedurally generated floors filled with enemies, traps, and combat encounters. Each run starts from the beginning, and death permanently ends the run.

Combat is real-time and action-oriented, relying on positioning, timing, and skill usage rather than turn-based mechanics. During a run, players collect gear, upgrades, and resources that influence their build and playstyle.

The game features:

  • Infinite dungeon progression with increasing difficulty

  • Permanent death per run (roguelite structure)

  • Character growth through upgrades

  • Procedurally generated environments and encounters

  • A long-term progression system that persists across runs

There is no final floor or ending — progression continues as long as the player survives.

---

We plan to progressively localize the store page and the game content in supported languages. Localization work will continue throughout Early Access.

store_data.about_the_game:
1965, Vietnam.

You arrive at an Airborne Brigade not as a frontline fighter, but as the administrative officer responsible for keeping a platoon alive on paper.

Your decisions determine everything:
– who deploys,
– who rests,
– who gets promoted,
– who goes home,
– and who will remain forever inside a personnel file.

12 Months: Vietnam is a minimalist yet emotionally heavy, paper-based military simulation inspired by historical statistics, period-accurate organization, and real wartime casualty patterns.

Your task is simple only on paper — survive your Tour of Duty while keeping your unit combat-ready.

In reality… nothing about it is simple.

Controls.: 

Mouse for interaction, Mouse Wheel to zoom in and out on the table, and WASD for movement when zoomed in.

Key Features

► Tour of Duty Simulation (12-Month Cycle)

Every soldier serves a 12-month tour, with optional extensions up to 3 tours — if morale allows it.

Soldiers constantly:
– arrive
– rotate out
– get wounded
– recover
– die
– change roles
– or extend their service

You must maintain a deployable platoon at all costs.

► Morale System That Truly Matters

Every decision affects morale:

– medals
– rest
– casualties
– promotions
– injuries
– deployments

Low morale collapses the entire unit.
High morale boosts survival — but nobody is bulletproof.

► Injuries and Consequences

– Three wounds = automatic discharge
– Severe wounds = permanent removal from duty
– Every death lowers morale and adds pressure on you

► Promotions & Qualifications

Wartime cares nothing for protocol.
If a leader is needed, even a fresh replacement may be promoted instantly.
The machine must keep turning.

► Paper-Based Presentation

The entire game takes place inside the administrative reality of the platoon:

– dossiers
– reports
– assignment boards
– personnel files
– wounded and casualty logs

No combat.
No cinematics.
Just the quiet horror of paperwork in war.

► A System Built on Chain Reactions

Every choice ripples outward:

→ bad choises

→ more injuries

→ morale collapse

→ an undeployable unit

→ you are relieved from duty

Every campaign is different:

– different casualties

– different outcomes

Infinite replayability — with a finite number of men.

► You Can Send Them Out — But You Can’t Bring Them Back

The game offers:
no reload
no undo
no alternate saves

Every choice is final.

This Is Not…

 Not an action game
 Not a shooter
 Not a power fantasy

This is a responsibility–morale–decision simulator, depicting the most invisible yet most brutal side of war: the administrative burden of keeping a unit alive.

The game does not depict:
– civilian casualties
– graphic violence
– real historical tragedies
– war crimes

Everything occurs within fictionalized military structures.

Content Warning

Themes include:
– war and military loss
– stress and moral decline
– administrative pressure
– failure and monotony

No blood or graphic violence.
Flashing effects can be disabled.

About the Developer

12 Months: Vietnam was created by a solo indie developer with a background in law enforcement.

The goal is not to glorify war, but to reveal its unseen side — where paperwork decides who goes home and who does not.

Your Mission

– Serve your Tour of Duty

– Keep the platoon alive

– And try to keep your conscience intact

store_data.about_the_game:
The protagonist, a member of a university occult club, discovers an old notebook hidden in the library.
Inside are detailed records of a high school’s “Seven Mysteries” — rumors, testimonies, disappearances, and unexplained events, written with unsettling precision.

Driven by curiosity stronger than caution, the protagonist seeks help from Soujirou, a childhood friend currently working at that same school as a student teacher.
Together with fellow club members, the investigation begins on a strangely warm December night — a date mentioned repeatedly in the notebook, tied to a rumored seven–year cycle.

As soon as the group steps onto school grounds, the entries in the notebook stop being history.
They begin to unfold — one by one — in the present.

Your decisions determine where the story leads.
Will you reach the truth, or fall into an ending sealed long before you arrived?

Features

  • Horror visual novel with branching paths based on player choices

  • A suspense-focused mystery surrounding seven school legends

  • Multiple endings, including avoidable bad endings

This is a story about curiosity, belief, and the cost of knowing too much.

Can you uncover the Seven Mysteries—
or will the school write your ending for you?

store_data.about_the_game:
⭐ LONELY HEARTS – LONG DESCRIPTION

Lonely Hearts is a 2D, narrative-driven relationship simulation about a solitary garbage collector surviving on the unseen edges of a vast city.
From crumbling districts to polished upper-class neighborhoods, you’ll meet women with unique personalities, build relationships through your actions, and slowly uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the city.

Every choice matters: odor level, reputation, gift preferences, rival interactions, district differences, and mini-games all influence the fate of your connections.
What begins in piles of trash evolves into a story tangled with crime, mafia shadows, and the most delicate form of affection.

⭐ Key Features

❤️ Relationships Shaped by Your Choices

Each woman has her own temperament, boundaries, and past.
Some are gentle, some toxic, some dangerously passionate.
Your dialogue choices and behavior can completely alter the course of each relationship.

🛒 Odor & Hygiene System

Your smell affects how people react to you.
Fail to clean up after work and certain characters may avoid or reject you; stay fresh and you become more appealing.

🎁 Gift & Interaction Mechanics

Items you find or earn throughout the city can improve your relationship if given to the right person.
Every character has different likes, dislikes, and triggers.

🌆 Three Districts – Three Different Worlds

Lonely Hearts is a 2D, narrative-driven relationship simulation about a solitary garbage collector surviving on the unseen edges of a vast city.
From crumbling districts to polished upper-class neighborhoods, you’ll meet women with unique personalities, build relationships through your actions, and slowly uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the city.

Every choice matters: odor level, reputation, gift preferences, rival interactions, district differences, and mini-games all influence the fate of your connections.
What begins in piles of trash evolves into a story tangled with crime, mafia shadows, and the most delicate form of affection.

⭐ Key Features

❤️ Relationships Shaped by Your Choices

Each woman has her own temperament, boundaries, and past.
Some are gentle, some toxic, some dangerously passionate.
Your dialogue choices and behavior can completely alter the course of each relationship.

🛒 Odor & Hygiene System

Your smell affects how people react to you.
Fail to clean up after work and certain characters may avoid or reject you; stay fresh and you become more appealing.

🎁 Gift & Interaction Mechanics

Items you find or earn throughout the city can improve your relationship if given to the right person.
Every character has different likes, dislikes, and triggers.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

This is a first-person action RPG where you explore dangerous environments, battle deadly creatures, complete quests, and build your character through looting and forging.
You’ll fight through dark dungeons, ruined halls, and underground zones using melee weapons, spells, or tools you craft yourself. Enemies react to hits with blood effects, making combat feel weighty and impactful.

As you progress, you’ll pick up quests that lead you to new areas, hidden rooms, and tough boss encounters. Every region is packed with loot — weapons, armor, materials, rare items, and powerful relics that change the way you fight. Your gear can be upgraded or forged into stronger versions, letting you adapt to tougher challenges and customize your build.

Boss fights are a major focus: each one demands skill, timing, and preparation. Learning their patterns and finding the right equipment is key to surviving. Between battles, you’ll gather resources, unlock new crafting options, and discover better equipment to push into deeper, more dangerous zones.

Welcome to Cybersoul, where high-octane Deckbuilding, glitched-out card games, and a compulsive Souls & Star Power incremental idle system collide in a flash of neon. Jack into the ultimate Cyberpunk Card Battler, launching with 3+ dystopian Factions and over 500 cards.

Compiled in the static of a dying world, Cybersoul takes the card battlers you know and hard-wires them into a high-tech, low-life future.

Command the scrap-metal juggernauts of the Rust Legion, the chemical-fueled speedsters of the Stim Freaks, and the corporate overlords of the Credit Barons.

With over 500 distinctive cards, each surging with cybernetic augmentations and system-breaking hacks, the tactical possibilities are limitless. But the Grid is unforgiving. Engage in visceral, turn-based combat against a ruthless AI that learns your exploits.

And when you need to disconnect from the warfare, the Glitch Arcade awaits! Gamble your life away and earn Credits & Energy in corrupted simulations of classics like 9-Player Poker, Blackjack, Pool, Match 3, Chess, Space Invaders, Brick Break, Snooker, and more.

Then, set your system to idle farm Soul Coins & Star Power. Spend your ill-gotten credits to upgrade your rig, overclock your cards, and farm resources even while you sleep. 🔋

SYSTEM FEATURES

  • 3+ Dystopian Factions: Master the streets—from the brute force of the Rust Legion to the arcane code of the Stim Freaks and the corrupted wealth of the Credit Barons.

  • 500+ Cybersoul Cards: Compile a deck of cybernetic horrors, viruses, traps, and glitches, each rendered in a visceral analog-horror art style.

  • Neural-Net AI Battles: Test your build against adaptive AI opponents that exploit your weaknesses and show no mercy.

  • Visceral Turn-Based Combat: Fast, brutal, and strategic. Execute combos that shatter the game logic and overload your opponent’s CPU.

  • Deep Deck Optimization: Tailor your loadout with a diverse host of mechs, mutants, and programs. Unlock encrypted data packs to find rare, holographic foils.

  • The Glitch Arcade: Hustle for Credits & Energy in hacked versions of Poker, Pool, Blackjack, Snooker, Chess, and Retro Arcade shooters.

  • Idle Crypto-Mining: Grow your influence and harvest resources from the Mainframe through an expansive idle system. Your wealth grows while you sleep.

  • Acid-Graphic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a world of hyper-stylized "Analog-Glitch" art, neon-soaked environments, and geometric brutalism.

  • 27+ Hour Industrial Soundtrack: Lose your mind to over 27 hours of pounding Synthwave, Dark Techno, and Industrial noise designed to keep your heart rate critical.

  • 819 Corrupted Voiceline Data Logs: Absorb cryptic truths and proverb-packed lore files from a world that has forgotten its own history.

  • Daily Login Rewards: Jack in daily to receive a supply drop of Credits, XP, and Energy.

  • New User Protocol: Learn the systems with interactive tutorials, making it easy for fresh meat and veteran hackers to upload their consciousness.

  • Offline Mode: Hone your skills solo against the machine. No signal required.

💀 UPLOAD YOUR SOUL. BREAK THE SYSTEM. 💀

Cybersoul is a realm where strategy meets static, and humanity meets hardware. Overclock your deck, exploit the code, and engage in neon-soaked battles against the worst the future has to offer. Easier to learn than a firewall, harder to master than the stock market.

The System is broken.
Exploit it. 💾

store_data.about_the_game:
This unique trivia game is the perfect way to be tested to see if you could actually follow in the steps of the famous adventurers, Indiana Jones and Nathan Drake! Developed by a professional treasure hunt designer with hunts facilitated all over the world, this trivia game will test your knowledge on everything from outdoor survival skills and basic handguns to geography and world history to even how to SCUBA and basic plane flight and so much more.

You find yourself stumbling across the Quest Adventure Society, an underground society responsible for creating adventure across the globe, and desire desperately to become a member of the team. They don’t accept new members so readily, though. You’re tasked with finding 50 treasures hidden all over the world. You’ll go from location to location in a treasure hunt fashion to find each treasure and only way to continue on your adventure will be to correctly answer trivia questions on a variety of topics that Jones and Drake would likely know. With numerous randomizers utilized, there are literally trillions of possible combinations of locations and trivia questions possible to find each treasure.

Additionally, sometimes when you answer a question correctly you’ll be given an opportunity to answer a BONUS question based on classic adventure stories in the movies and literature for additional experience points in various categories.

Your progress is also tracked with a variety of possible XP categories from specialties in specific continents to proficiencies in vehicle handling and negotiating jungle terrain. Over 20 different categories are tracked.

No matter what your knowledge base currently is, find all 50 treasures in this game and you’ll be primed by the end to travel the globe in search of your own real world adventures.

This game plays in your Internet browser and with nearly 1500 adventure trivia questions being asked, you’ve likely never been tested like this before...

Build a time machine to see your deceased mother one last time. Driven by grief

revealing varied interpretations of pain, obsession, and loss.

An Introspective Journey

Experience an emotional journey through grief, the fear of facing reality, and the

consequences of clinging to the past in a world where logic breaks down and time

no longer behaves as it should.

store_data.about_the_game:
A chainsaw. Moronic enemies. A washed-up comic. And a playlist that makes you want to destroy it all.

MeetMeat is pure carnage in a top-down shooter package. Don't think — just shred. Face down hundreds of enemies, accompanied only by the voice of Roach—a failed comedian whose jokes are almost as dire as your predicament.

Is a satirical shooter that grabs you by the throat and doesn't let go.

From insane villages to secret bases — fight your way through a whirlwind of locations, each throwing new hordes of enemies at you and making you question this world's sanity. Grab whatever weapon is at hand — be it a trusty chainsaw or a heavy machinegun — and shred everything in your path. Earn MeatCoins, upgrade yourself in the arena mode, and remember the golden rule: don't listen to Roach. He's funny... and suspiciously alive.

This is a dark comedy that laughs at action clichés, at you, and at itself.

  • A (Terrible) Wingman: Roach commentates on the chaos over the radio. Constantly. Even when it's the worst idea.

  • An Arsenal of Chaos: Solve problems the classic way — with an abundance of lead and sharp steel.

  • 'Meat Grinder' Mode: Test your limits in the arena against endless waves.

  • Your Style: Wear armor for seriousness or a traffic cone for style. The choice is yours.

  • Hordes of Varied Enemies: Each new type is a new headache.

  • Reactive Soundtrack: Music that fires you up and adapts to the on-screen chaos.

  • Pure Action: Intuitive top-down gameplay without complications. Run, shoot, survive.

"I see an enemy. Or maybe it's a mirror..." — Roach, probably.

store_data.about_the_game:
CREATION OF A GOD: THE ETERNAL VILLAGE

The game combines action roguelike mechanics, platforming, village building, puzzles, and combat in a procedural world where you never know what might happen. You must fulfill the demands of a mysterious god or you will be destroyed!

-You'll build a village from nothing, choosing from over twenty types of buildings. You'll gather resources in four procedural worlds, filled with unique enemies and surreal environments.

-The world will be full of enemies to defeat in real time. You'll be able to utilize melee combat and the numerous spells available throughout your travels. You can also use your armies to protect the village from attacks.

-During your adventure, you'll solve puzzles using the power of the Crown. With it, you can move allies on the board and use the power of the gods' cards.

-Build houses to bring various types of creatures to the village. Increase the quality of the village by building structures like taverns and artist tents. A high-quality village will generate special citizens with important traits: for example, some will be researchers, others miners, and others diplomats. Be careful, thieves and layabouts may also develop! Furthermore, special citizens, called Anomalous, can give gifts to the king and offer real quests!

-Infinite levels, thanks to the game's procedural core!

-Evolve your village's materials and research new buildings

-Exchange resources and forge armor

...Lost dreams resonate in deep space. They can only be reached by closing your eyes...

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to an adrenaline-filled car parkour experience that blends challenging platforms, deadly traps, and fast-paced driving! Prove your skills solo, or race with a friend in 2-player mode to reach the finish line.

Players use their own unique set of abilities to progress through each course: Super Jump: Leap over high obstacles and escape tight spots with ease. Push Ability: Help your friend by pushing them out of tricky areas—or send them straight into traps and slow zones. Speed Boost: Gain a burst of speed at critical moments to secure your path to victory.

Every corner is filled with deadly platforms, slowing traps, and distracting moving obstacles designed to sabotage your run. Each level offers a unique challenge that tests your reflexes, timing, and decision-making.

Key Features

  • Fun gameplay for solo players or 2-player co-op/versus

  • Skill-based parkour mechanics

  • Use special abilities to complete courses and create speed strategies

  • Creative platform designs packed with lethal traps

  • Perfect opportunities to sabotage your friend

Reaching the finish line may be easy… but truly winning requires both strategy and skill. Are you ready? The parkour challenge awaits.

store_data.about_the_game:
We are counting.

I open my eyes.

Suction cups.

On my chest. On my arms. Everywhere.

Seventeen.

Eighteen.

Voices whisper.

Mom is waiting.

A short psychological horror visual novel about compulsive counting. A fragmented narrative where the ordinary melts into absurdity.

Key features:

  • Short length (5–15 minutes).

  • Stylized pixel and glitch visuals with grunge horror vibes.

  • Psychedelic text: repetition, memory gaps, voices inside.

  • Open to interpretation — for fans of abstract psychological VNs (Milk / Lain vibes).

store_data.about_the_game:
IT’S NOT JUST SNOW. IT’S LIQUID GOLD.

It’s a freezing morning. You look out the window and see him: your annoying neighbor, revving the engine of his brand-new, absurdity expensive Golden Sports Car. He smirks at you behind his designer sunglasses. You check your wallet. Empty. You look at your backyard. It's covered in tons of deep, white snow.

Wait a minute... people pay $5 for "Premium Glacier Water" at the store, right? It’s time to get down to business.

I can't be worse than my neighbor is a first-person simulation tycoon where spite is your fuel and snow is your currency. Start with a rusty shovel and a dream, and work your way up to a high-tech snow-processing empire.

CORE FEATURES:

🏔️ SATISFYING TERRAIN DEFORMATION Forget boring progress bars. Here, you physically carve the path to success. Use your shovel to dig deep holes, tunnels, and trenches. Watch the snow vanish voxel by voxel as you fill your inventory. The terrain changes dynamically—just don't dig a hole too deep to climb out of!


💧 MELT, BOTTLE, PROFIT Take that raw "white fluff" to your melting station. Watch it transform into crystal clear water (don't ask where it came from). Package it into bottles, load up the crates, and prepare for shipment.

🤝 CO-OP ENTREPRENEURSHIP Why freeze alone? Team up with up to 3 friends (4 players total) in online co-op to turn your backyard operation into an industrial powerhouse. Quadruple the shovels mean quadruple the profits. Coordinate your assembly line one digs, one melts, one manages logistics or just mess around and bury each other in the snow. Working together is the fastest way to wipe that smirk off your neighbor's face.

🚁 DRONE LOGISTICS No more walking to the store. Call in your fleet of delivery drones! Watch them swoop down, grab your cargo, and fly off to deposit cold hard cash directly into your account. Upgrade your fleet to handle heavier loads and faster deliveries.

🐶 WATCH YOUR STEP The neighborhood is alive. Traffic flows, neighbors walk their routes, and... there's the dog. Sometimes the local stray decides your premium snow supply is his personal toilet. Yellow snow is NOT premium water. Avoid the hazards or clean up the mess before it ruins your batch!


🚗 THE ULTIMATE FLEX Why are you doing this? To prove a point. Your goal is simple: Earn enough cash to buy a car so massive, so expensive, and so cool that your neighbor's Golden Sports Car looks like a budget toy in comparison. Will it be a Monster Truck? A Hypercar? Whatever it is, it HAS to be better than his.

Grab your shovel. The race for the best parking spot starts now.

store_data.about_the_game:
Brainrot Online is a fast, chaotic, and absolutely unhinged multiplayer FPS where strange brainrot-inspired creatures clash in ridiculous battles. Join existing servers or create your own, jump into matches filled with real players or AI bots, and fight your way to the top across three unique maps designed for nonstop action.

Choose from four bizarre characters, each with their own strange backstories and over-the-top personalities. From mutated fruit bodybuilders to surreal meme-like anomalies, every fighter brings their own flavor of madness to the arena. Whether you’re blasting through tight corridors, sprinting across open combat zones, or outmaneuvering enemies in vertical environments, gameplay is built for pure fun and instant chaos. Take the fun to the next level with the Steal a Brainrot (capture the flag) mode! Our main characters: Tripi Tropi Tropa Tripa, Brr Brr Patapim, Udin Din Din Dun and Tung Tung Tung Sahur!

Designed to be easy to pick up and play, Brainrot Online embraces humor, simplicity, and fast-paced combat, making it perfect for casual players and competitive shooters alike. With multi-language support, global matchmaking, and dedicated community-driven updates, the battlefield is always full of life—well, strange life.

Jump in, lock and load, and let the brainrot begin.

store_data.about_the_game:
A dark-fantasy RPG about identity, betrayal, and the thin line between humanity and monstrosity.

Monsters and Men is a story-driven, 40+ hour JRPG where goblins, orcs, dragons and humans all struggle under the shadow of a corrupt kingdom bent on creating the “perfect lifeform.”

What begins as a simple mission to track down a mysterious green-haired woman spirals into a world-shaking rebellion filled with ancient magic, cosmic relics, and the sins of forgotten ages.

You’ll guide a diverse cast of creatures and heroes as they uncover the truth behind Project Genesis and the dark experiments fueling The Kingdom’s rise.

Travel from burning cities to frozen frontiers, from holy cathedrals to ancient Tribunal islands, and deep into cosmic ruins where the very air hums with the breath of forgotten gods. Face tragic knights, mutated beasts, celestial guardians, and the ghosts of your characters’ pasts.

Forge alliances with rebel factions, confront monstrous creations, and make choices that challenge what it truly means to be human… or something else entirely.

*A Character-Driven Epic

*Tactical Turn-Based Combat

*Explore Mythic and Dangerous Lands

*Fight the Sins of The Kingdom

*Discover Legendary Loot

*A World Where Every Monster Has a Story

And every “hero” harbors a secret.

A war is coming.

The Kingdom seeks to rewrite life itself. 
The Revolters seek to stop them.
And you…
You stand in the space between monsters and men.
