store_data.about_the_game:
Astralis: Dawnblades is a heroic fantasy tactical RPG where you lead the Dawnblades, an independent mercenary company operating across a land of kingdoms, ancient magic and rising threats.

Prepare your squads, choose your contracts, explore dungeons node by node, survive tactical battles, and bring enough resources home to make the next expedition possible.

Every mission asks the same question: push deeper for better rewards, or retreat before wounds, losses and bad decisions cost too much?

Lead the Dawnblades

You do not play a lone hero. You manage a company.

Recruit fighters, assign them to squads, develop their roles, and send the right team into the right mission. Your mercenaries can be shaped through classes, specializations, equipment and combat synergies, so preparation matters long before the first enemy appears.

- Build multiple squads with complementary strengths.

- Adapt your party to the contract, region and enemy type.

- Make choices for a company caught between common folk, powerful rulers and legends that become very real.

Prepare at Your Stronghold

Between expeditions, your headquarters is the heart of the game loop.

Use the barracks to manage recruits and squads, the academy to unlock new tactical options, the guild bank to organize recovered gear, and the crucible to craft or improve equipment.

Your base is not decoration. It is where loot becomes strategy.

Explore Node-Based Dungeons

Expeditions unfold across connected maps filled with battles, events, choices and rewards.

Each node can change the state of your mission. A fight can drain your resources. A detour can reveal materials you need. A risky decision can pay off, or leave your squad too weak to finish the route.

- Choose your path through hostile regions.

- Manage health, resources and momentum across the whole mission.

- Decide when to push forward and when to bring the loot home.

Turn Loot Into Builds

Recovered weapons, armor, accessories and materials feed your long-term progression.

Equip useful finds immediately, dismantle what you do not need, and craft gear that supports the way you want to play: durable frontline squads, burst damage teams, control-focused builds, or more balanced groups able to survive the unknown.

Fight Tactical Battles

Combat is turn-based, readable and built around skill choices, cooldowns, positioning of roles, resistances and synergies between your mercenaries.

Every encounter is a tactical problem: choose the right skill, protect the right character, exploit the right weakness, and keep enough resources for the rest of the expedition.

Master the MATB Layer

MATB is an optional layer over classic turn-based combat.

Characters act when their skill charge bar fills, and initiative makes that bar fill faster. Musical tension creates timing windows that boost physical or magical attacks, with critical opportunities when those windows begin.

You choose what to do, but also when to do it. Keep MATB off for a more classic pace, or enable it for extra pressure and mastery.

A Heroic Fantasy Campaign

The Dawnblades travel across regions shaped by rival powers, ancient legacies and creatures that can turn every contract into an adventure.

Across a three-act story, contracts become quests of loyalty, courage and command. The question is not only whether your company can win battles, but what kind of force it becomes along the way.

For Players Who Want

- Tactical RPG combat with clear long-term progression.

- A stronghold and squad-management loop between missions.

- Dungeon expeditions built around risk, retreat and reward.

- Loot, crafting and build decisions that matter.

- A heroic fantasy world with narrative choices, regional conflicts and legendary threats.

- Optional music-timed combat layered over classic turn-based battles.

A Steam demo is available from the button above.

store_data.about_the_game:
A card game by the name of Magic Monsters is taking the country by storm. Itsuki Nakajou doesn't have many friends and isn't passionate about anything, but that all starts to change once he's introduced to the world of Magic Monsters. He soon finds out that there are people using Magic Monsters for their own nefarious purposes, and it's up to him to save the game he's grown to love!

Craft a winning deck of cards and battle your way to the top! From hotheaded classmates to seedy criminals, everyone's getting in on the Magic Monsters craze, and they're all ready and waiting to put you in your place! Don't know the first thing about card games? Never fear, these simple, speedy battles can be enjoyed by people from all walks of life! And if you're still struggling, you can always purchase booster packs to strengthen your deck and obtain rare cards!

You never saw this coming! Like with any good card game, taking down an evil organization and saving the world is only the beginning. If you're ever in the mood for a breather, you can enjoy unique interactions with your favorite characters through Campaign Mode. But if you're looking for something *more*... Challenge Mode will show you just how pathetic your deck truly is.

Gimmicks Galore

Uncover new types of cards as the story progresses, unlocking unique synergies that can take your play to the next level.

Find Out Who Holds All the Cards

Seek the truth about the sinister group that's turning your hometown into a melting pot of greed and wickedness. Who's the woman behind it all, and what drove her to this?

Prove You're the Real Deal

A gauntlet of battles against difficult bosses awaits you in Challenge Mode... as well as a reward for those able to conquer it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trapped is an immersive psychological VR horror-thriller that places you in the role of Peter, a man battling the demons of a traumatic childhood, mental illness, and addiction.

After an accident leaves you concussed and disoriented, you awaken in a dimly lit hospital room with no memory of how you arrived. But this is no ordinary hospital. The corridors stretch endlessly, walls pulse with life, and shadows whisper in the dark. To escape, you must navigate the shifting, nightmarish landscapes of your own subconscious—from the sterile halls of a decrepit hospital to the lonely corridors of a boarding school and the decaying remains of your childhood home.

KEY FEATURES

  • Immersive VR Exploration: Navigate a tactile, nerve-wracking world where every door you push open and every object you interact with pulls you deeper into the nightmare. Experience a world that reacts to your presence, simulating the physical effort of moving through a fractured reality.

  • A World That Breathes: Reality is unreliable here. Watch as environments morph before your eyes—doors slam shut, lights flicker, and ordinary objects distort as Peter’s mental state deteriorates. Shadowy figures stalk you from the periphery, forcing you to question what is real and what is a hallucination.

  • Light is Your Weapon: You cannot fight the darkness with violence. Navigate near-total blackness using only fleeting sources of illumination. Master the use of your flashlight to hold back the shadows and reveal the hidden truths of your past.

  • Environmental Storytelling: Piece together the narrative through scattered diary entries, medication bottles, and audio recordings from your mother, Mari. Every artifact you find uncovers a layer of the trauma that has kept Peter trapped for so long.

  • Choose Your Fate: The ending is in your hands. Will you confront your demons with empathy and truth, or will you succumb to anger and destruction? Your choices—to use the flashlight or the gun—will determine if Peter finds redemption or remains trapped in his nightmare forever.

Are you brave enough to face the monsters within?

Only the truth can set you free.

store_data.about_the_game:
Can you escape this colossal maze within 60 minutes?

Lost in the Dark Labyrinth is a maze-exploration survival FPS set inside a colossal labyrinth built on a near world-largest scale.

With only a weak personal light and scattered braziers to guide you, you must navigate twisting corridors and looming chambers and find a way out before time runs out.

The maze is huge and deliberately complex.

Similar-looking junctions, sudden open spaces, and vertical shifts between floors make it almost impossible to grasp the full layout on your first attempt.

The more you challenge it, the more you slowly learn, map, and master the labyrinth in your head.

Sneak past threats… or fight for an advantage

Dangerous enemies roam the maze, and the tension spikes the moment you sense them nearby.

You can try to avoid them and slip past in the dark, or take the risk and engage.

Defeating enemies will sometimes cause keys, health items, or coins to drop, giving you a valuable edge in your escape — but only if you survive.

Doors, keys, and the path forward

The labyrinth features multiple door types and matching keys.

As you progress through the stages, new door–key pairs are introduced, and finding the key required in that stage becomes critical to pushing deeper into the maze.

If you fail to secure the necessary key, you simply will not reach the exit.

Step by step, run by run, you piece together your own personal route to freedom.

60 minutes of pressure and replay

This maze is not meant to be cleared on your first attempt.

Instead, each run teaches you a little more — a landmark you recognize, a safer corridor, a dead end to avoid next time.

The 60-minute time limit keeps every decision sharp, while the enormous scale and branching paths give the game strong replayability and a powerful sense of growth.

Evolving structure and difficulty

Later stages increase the density of the layout, the danger of threats, and the number of tricks waiting for you.

The maze is built so that getting lost, discovering new routes, and gradually understanding the structure is the core of the experience.

Explore a massive labyrinth, evade threats, sometimes fight back, collect keys, and escape within 60 minutes.

Lost in the Dark Labyrinth delivers simple rules, deep tension, and a huge rush of achievement when you finally break free —

a unique blend of maze-exploration and survival FPS.

store_data.about_the_game:
Wizards in the Woods is an online co-op adventure game where you and up to 7 friends set out to save the lands from the cursed god that has come to inhabit it. To do so, you must navigate through these foggy woods, being careful to stay together and not alert any monsters that may be lurking just out of sight.

INTRICATE SPELL CASTING

Cast spells by collecting materials you find on your journey, and then use them in combination with DDR-style movements, drawn symbols, and voice-activated phrases, in order to cast powerful spells.

CHOOSE YOUR WIZARD ORDER

Choose from (at least) 3 wizard orders and use your particular skills to help out your team as you make your way through these dangerous lands.

NAVIGATE THROUGH THE CURSEWOOD

Using just a map, the sun and the stars to tell direction, navigate together through the dense fog and treacherous terrain, going between landmarks as you head towards your goal. Be sure to stay together! It's easy to get lost in these woods.... Wait, where's Barry?

ABOUT THIS GAME

Prepare for a mind-bending arcade challenge.
Yin Yang Fun takes the classic falling-block formula and turns it inside out: instead of controlling one grid, you must command two independent boards at the same time. Two hands, two rhythms, one brain-melting test of coordination.

As the speed rises, your focus will be stretched to its limit. Can you keep both sides alive, clear lines under pressure, and stay in harmony before everything collapses?

If it took twenty years to master the old challenge…
will it take forty to conquer this one?

It took 40 years to overcome the previous challenge. Will it take 80 years to overcome this one?

Two Hands, Two Grids. Back in Block again.

Key Features

Dual Grid System — Control left and right boards simultaneously. A pure multitasking challenge.
Campaign Mode — 20 handcrafted stages with increasing difficulty.
Endless Mode — Push your limits and chase your best score in local leaderboards.

Full Controller Support — Play comfortably with either keyboard or gamepad.

As the speed rises, your focus will be stretched to its limit. Can you keep both sides alive, clear lines under pressure, and stay in harmony before everything collapses?

If it took twenty years to master the old challenge…
will it take forty to conquer this one?

It took 40 years to overcome the previous challenge. Will it take 80 years to overcome this one?

Two Hands, Two Grids. Back in Block again.

Key Features

Dual Grid System — Control left and right boards simultaneously. A pure multitasking challenge.
Campaign Mode — 20 handcrafted stages with increasing difficulty.
Endless Mode — Push your limits and chase your best score in local leaderboards.

Full Controller Support — Play comfortably with either keyboard or gamepad.
store_data.short_description: Test your reflexes and multitasking skills in this unique arcade block-puzzler. Control two grids at once, clear lines on both sides, keep up with the rising speed, and chase the high score. Two hands, two grids… back in block again!

store_data.about_the_game:
Build towers directly from your poker cards, stack interest, bend the rules with Jokers, and turn wild hands into completely busted builds. Poker TD is a strategic, high-stakes tower defense game where smart planning matters more then you would think! With many ways to set your towers up for success!

Classic Mode

Place towers using real poker cards. Pairs, straights, flushes, and more all create different tower effects. The better the hand, the stronger the build… but stronger plays come with high risk.

Advanced Mode

Just like classic, the cards you play are the towers you get. However, a significant twist with a ton of tower placement, wall placement, & maze strategies come into play.

Jokers Break the Game! (In a Good Way)

Jokers bend the rules. Boost towers, modify effects, break hand limits, and create insane synergies that turn losing runs into legendary comebacks.

♥ Super Fun & Replayable!

No two runs play the same. New card combinations, different upgrades, and evolving challenges keep every attempt fresh. Expect to fail, learn, adapt… and eventually have one of the best runs of your life!

Global & Friend Leaderboards! Awesome Stat Tracking, Achievements, Challenges, Jokers!

Play it safe, or go all-in and become absurdly overpowered… if you survive long enough!

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore tightly-packed worlds and move around all banana peel-y like in this exploration and adventure focused 3D platformer collectathon game!

WHO are you?

YOU are Banan, a banana peel-shaped creature of the species "Banan". You are orange and - judging from the expression on your face - happy all the time. It's the perfect life.

WHAT do you do?

During your adventure you explore varied and various worlds to collect many trinkets and in the process help out all the Cute and Quirky beings you may encounter along your way. But beware! The worlds you visit happen to be 3D platformer-shaped and have funky geometry you will have a hop and slide your way around. Also, some of the beings you come across may not be as nice as the others...

Some of these aforementioned trinkets might even grant you entrance to mystical temples that lay high up in every world, which contain more challenging and complex platforming sections for you to really show off your skill, if you're into that sort of thing.

WHY do you do?

You are hanging out and dancing with your Banan friends when... oh no! Suddenly a mysterious figure comes around and slips on everyone, sending them flying into the nearby volcano! You need to go around and collect gears that are just floating around everywhere so you can build a jetpack to fly up to the now angry volcano and rescue your friends!

WHEN does this all end?

You can expect the game to occupy around 1.5-3 hours of your amazing life, depending on how thorough you are.

HOW do I experience all this?

Simply utilise all the senses you have at your disposal! I believe in you.

store_data.about_the_game:
The probability of losing his beloved wife was said to be only 0.0035%.

During childbirth, a sudden cardiac arrest claimed both his wife and their unborn child. Statistically, it was an event that “should almost never happen.” The hospital explained it as rare, but possible.

Yet, one haunting doubt lingers in the protagonist’s mind:

“Was her death truly caused by cardiac arrest?”

“Or is the hospital hiding something?”

Determined to uncover the truth, he sneaks into the hospital late at night, when no one is around…

Game Overview

“0.0035%” is a mystery & horror game where players piece together fragmented information to uncover the hidden truth.

  • Investigate clues scattered across items and objects within the hospital.

  • Unravel the secrets behind the tragedy through careful exploration and deduction.

  • Multiple endings await, with a shocking finale and deep layers of interpretation.

Streaming & Content Creation

We warmly welcome gameplay streams, reviews, and theory videos.

If possible, please include a link to this Steam page in your video description—it would mean a lot to us.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Children's Future" is a short visual novel/adventure game set in a rural elementary school. Players explore the school and advance the story by clicking on areas of interest. The game has a playtime of approximately one hour.

■ Supported Languages

This game currently only supports Japanese/English.

■ Story Overview

The story takes place in Country J, a fictional country located in the center of the Eurasian continent. You, the protagonist, work as a teacher at a rural elementary school in Country J. But one day, you suddenly realize that your familiar school building has been transformed into a world different from reality. A mysterious space with no exit in sight. Time seems to have stopped. A school building filled with only silence. In an attempt to return to your original world, you begin exploring the elementary school.

■ Game System

Exploratory adventure where you click to investigate interesting locations Collecting clues hidden around the school advances the story Finding "dolls" of students and colleagues changes the ending Playable with just a mouse Compatible with Windows (x86)

■ Features

A tranquil yet slightly mysterious world set in an elementary school Simple controls and a short story Multiple endings depending on your exploration Explore a silent elementary school and attempt to escape from another world in this short adventure. Collect clues and experience changing endings.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the chaos. Build broken loadouts. Adapt or die.

Every run plays differently thanks to randomized weather, enemy compositions, and upgrade paths. Choose your playstyle, stack perks, unlock new characters and cosmetics, and survive relentless WW2-inspired battlefields filled with hordes of enemies.

Jump in for a few minutes or push for long survival runs.

Key Features

  • Permanent Progression: Level up characters to unlock permanent upgrades, new abilities, and cosmetics that carry over between runs.

  • 15+ Weapons & Deep Upgrade Paths: Create overpowered builds with damage boosts, fire-rate upgrades, grenades, flamethrowers, and more. No two runs play the same.

  • Classes: Choose from several character classes, each with unique abilities and special weapons that radically change how you play.

  • Dynamic Weather: Fight across multiple handcrafted maps, each featuring randomized weather conditions.

  • Relentless Enemy Waves: Survive increasingly intense waves of infantry, officers, dogs, and elite units. Every round gets faster, harder, and more chaotic.

  • Temporary Power-Ups & Bullet-Time Chains: Pick up short-term boosts and chain kills to trigger frenzy moments that help you dominate the enemies,

  • Steam Workshop Support: Create and share your own cosmetic items — standout creations may even get featured in-game.

Tired of waiting in the castle for a prince? This time, the Princess is grabbing a pickaxe and diving deep!

Princess Miner perfectly blends classic "Gold Miner" gameplay with Roguelike strategy. Say goodbye to the single rope—it’s time for Multi-Hook Mayhem! In randomly generated mines, draft powerful items, upgrade your arsenal, and strip the underground clean of every last treasure.
store_data.detailed_description:
Unique "Multi-Hook" System

Who says a miner only gets one shot? Unleash a barrage! Start with a humble single hook and evolve into a screen-filling, multi-grabbing machine. It’s royal firepower, delivered underground.


Unpredictable Roguelike Experience

No two descents are ever the same. Collect over a hundred different companions and items. Some warp the laws of physics, while others boost your raw power. Will you build for High-Speed Snatching or Violent Demolition? The strategy is yours to craft.


A Princess of Many Talents

Our protagonist, Sophia, is more than just royalty. Unlock and choose from a variety of Classes and Jobs for her! Each class brings a completely different playstyle to the mines.


Massive Variety for Replayability

Everything a Roguelike fan needs:

  • 20+ Playable Characters/Classes

  • 20+ Distinct Hook Styles

  • 100+ Unique Perks Unlock them all and bring them into the depths!


Charming Pixel Art

Watch the Princess shine in a retro, golden-hued pixel world. Accompanied by a lighthearted and cheerful soundtrack, this is a return to pure, unadulterated gaming joy.


About the Game

Tired of waiting in the castle for a prince? This time, the Princess is grabbing a pickaxe and diving deep!

Princess Miner perfectly blends classic "Gold Miner" gameplay with Roguelike strategy. Say goodbye to the single rope—it’s time for Multi-Hook Mayhem! In randomly generated mines, draft powerful items, upgrade your arsenal, and strip the underground clean of every last treasure.

store_data.about_the_game:
KHAN 2 – The Return of a Legendary Warlord

Twenty years after the original KHAN defined an era of early MMORPGs, the legendary world rises again—reborn, renewed, and more powerful than ever. KHAN 2 is the true continuation of a beloved classic, bringing the essence of the original back to life while expanding it for a new generation of adventurers.

Step into a vast ancient kingdom shaped by war, faith, and heroic conquest. Become a true “Khan”—a warrior forged in battle, tested by fate, and destined to stand among legends.

Experience the Heart of Classic MMORPG Gameplay

A Massive World of Myth and War

Begin your journey from humble lands and venture through deadly forests, forgotten ruins, sacred temples, and war-torn continents. Discover ancient races, mythical beasts, and dark forces threatening to engulf the realm.

Fight, Rise, and Become a Khan

Grow stronger through battles, master unique skills, and face powerful enemies in solo challenges, guild wars, and massive kingdom-wide conflicts.

An Epic Storyline Continuing the First Game

Set years after the original KHAN, the sequel expands the lore with new characters, factions, and sinister threats that push the world toward chaos.

All-New Storyline

Discover an expanded narrative that follows the events after the first KHAN, introducing new heroes, enemies, and conflicts across the land.

Seasonal Battle Pass

Progress through monthly seasons, unlock exclusive rewards, weapon skins, costumes, buffs, and special items designed to keep every moment meaningful.

Year-Round Events

Limited-time quests, special bosses, seasonal festivals, and bonus drop periods ensure the world is always alive and evolving.

Tower Challenge (Tae Tower)

Climb a multi-floor tower where difficulty increases with each level. Earn greater rewards the higher you ascend—perfect for solo players or group parties.

Enhanced Classic MMORPG Combat

Faithful to the original KHAN yet rebuilt for smoothness and modern playstyle. Master class abilities, gear upgrades, and fast-paced battles.

Modern Gear & Rarity System

Collect equipment of various rarities, build your character’s stats, and customize your power progression to suit your playstyle.

Strong Community & Guild System

Join guilds, participate in massive battles, defeat world bosses, and compete for ranking dominance across the kingdom.

Privacy Policy

This game requires acceptance of a third-party EULA

store_data.about_the_game:
The chocolate factory blew—now everyone’s covered in sweet chaos. Play Chuppy, a jelly heroine who can morph into a slime cube. Hop across a tile field where enemies only move when you move. Carve safe routes through lasers, spikes, and saw-tracks, clearing chocolate tiles to reveal the candy girl trapped behind them. Stay still and time stands still—it’s puzzle-tactical, not twitch.

Each level ends with a short, playful scene as Chuppy de-cubes and chats with the rescued girl—light, flirty, and sweet. From Dragon Beard to Brigadeiro, Coffee Pudding to Licorice, every rescue is a sugary personality to uncover.

Arcade feel, puzzle heart: simple inputs, tight pacing, no grind. Just 18 handcrafted stages, smart hazards, and a charming gallery to revisit your rescues.

  • Move-when-you-move: Classic step-based puzzle flow. If you wait, everything waits.

  • Hop & reveal: Remove chocolate tiles with each hop to uncover the girl in the background.

  • Sweet dangers: Lasers, spikes, saw rails, and hazardous candies that demand timing and planning.

  • Power-ups: Extra hearts, Stop Time (move while hazards pause), and Invulnerability Star for bold routes.

  • 18 levels: Bite-sized, handcrafted puzzles with a flirty end scene for each rescue.

  • Gallery: Rewatch your rescues and unlocked art.

  • 11 achievements: For clean runs, power-up mastery, and full reveals.

  • Controls for everyone: Keyboard, mouse, controller, and touch. Full Steam Deck support.

  • Settings: Rumble on/off, audio sliders, basic accessibility and comfort options.

store_data.about_the_game:
The moment they touch the ground, the invasion begins.

There is only one rule: never let the aliens raining from the sky set foot on the surface. You are the world’s last line of defense — a knight of the cyberpunk era. Launch your enemies into the air and slam them like missiles into the boss to trigger devastating chain explosions.

No complex commands required.

Move, Jump, Dash. With just three actions, experience an overwhelming spectacle of pixel art. The controls are intuitive and easy to pick up, yet they conceal extreme speed, precision, and deep, skill-based action.

Unpredictable Combo Action

Launch enemies into the air, corner them, and blow them apart. Each map is procedurally generated every run. Use a variety of objects such as bounce platforms and teleporters to create dynamic, ever-changing combat — never repetitive, always fresh.

A Cruel Fate, Yet a Satisfying Counterattack

Each time the Knight falls, they inherit new abilities and return to the past. Experience a story that transforms an endless cycle of death and rebirth into dark comedy. Explore the world through strategic ability combinations and precise control

The World Itself Is a Grand Story

Why is the Knight doomed to repeat death?
Why did this world fall?

Sometimes, a single landscape speaks louder than a hundred words. Beneath the glowing neon lights lies a hidden tragedy. Grotesque yet beautiful environments will quietly tell their stories. Uncover the secrets of a world shattered by alien invasion — not through text, but through your own eyes and hands.

Core Features

  • Simple & Stylish: High-speed combo action that’s easy to learn and visually spectacular

  • Aerial Combo System: Launch enemies and use them as living missiles

  • Infinite Ability Combinations: Diverse skill synergies for the Cyberpunk Knight with roguelite mechanics

  • Visual Storytelling: An immersive narrative told through environments, without relying on text

  • A Distinct Atmosphere: High-quality pixel art blending dystopia and dark comedy

  • Perfect Control Support: Full support for both keyboard and gamepad

store_data.about_the_game:
Primus Numen is a dark fantasy tactical RPG built around positioning, class synergy, and momentum in battle.

You control a small party on grid-based maps, choosing how to move, who to target, and when to commit. Fights are designed to reward planning, but things can turn quickly if you misread the situation.

Tactical combat

Battles play out on a grid where positioning matters.
Getting the right angle, controlling space, and setting up attacks is often the difference between winning cleanly or getting overwhelmed.

Evil Mode

Win the battle and unlock the option to play the battle again as the bad guys! Earn extra rewards for your main party this way.

The Nexus Beast

At key moments, you can join your party together to unleash the Nexus Beast.

It is powerful unit but will damage you party as the battle goes on. Will you continue with it for just one more turn at the risk of putting your party in grave danger when it disappears?

Class combinations

Combine 2 classes to play as a hybrid of them. A Rogue and a Mage will become a Shadow Wizard. A Knight and a Priest will become a Stalwart Cleric. Use both classes' sets of skills, but beware that your unit's stats will be based on just one of them.

You can build around:

  • heavy frontline pressure

  • ranged damage

  • control and setup

  • or balanced teams built around adaptability

There isn’t one “correct” setup — it’s about what works for you. 

Enemies

Enemies aren’t just damage sponges. Intelligent enemy AI will push you to adjust how you play — some force you to reposition, others punish mistakes, and some need to be dealt with quickly before they escalate.

store_data.about_the_game:
DreadHold is a relentless top-down roguelite horde shooter where survival is everything. Trapped in a shadowy building under siege by endless waves of enemies, your goal is simple: hold out as long as you can, barricading entrances and fighting back with whatever you've got.

Dive into fast-paced runs where every session feels fresh thanks to semi-procedural level generation - doorways might be blocked off or wide open, keeping you on your toes while the core layout stays familiar. Rack up points by mowing down foes, then spend them on upgrades mid-run to turn the tide: unlock lifesteal for staying in the fight, explosive bullets that detonate on critical hits, and more. These stack up as you go, letting you build insane loadouts to push further.

Between runs, invest in meta upgrades to beef up your starting stats, giving you that edge for the next attempt. Power-ups drop during the chaos too - grab double points, infinite ammo, or instant reloads to amp up the action. It's all single-player, set in perpetual night time for that tense, arcade vibe, drawing inspiration from classics like COD Zombies but with a top-down twist that makes every corner a potential kill zone.

Key features:

  • Intense horde defense with barricades and special events to shake things up.

  • Roguelite progression: in-run upgrades and meta unlocks for endless replayability.

  • Semi-procedural levels that mix familiarity with surprises.

  • Power-up drops to fuel epic moments in the heat of battle.

Whether you're grinding for high scores or just unleashing mayhem, DreadHold delivers non-stop adrenaline in a compact, addictive package.

store_data.about_the_game:
“The Shuffling Man” is a short visual novel based on the story of the same name — a tale about silence that lets something shuffling into your home.
It’s an intimate story about fear and the cracks that grow between people, slowly eating a family from the inside.

Dive into the story of a woman suffering a nervous breakdown, trying to protect her daughter from something she believes comes at night.

This visual novel opens the horror anthology “BLACKMURK” — a series of short standalone stories, each created with a unique art style and adapted from a work by a contemporary author.

Features

  • 🪚 Heart-Wrenching Story - Based on “The Shuffling Man” by Roman “Chainsaw” Chyorny, an author whose horror cuts deep and lingers.

  • 🩻 Dark Soundtrack - A dark, minimalistic and unsettling dark ambient score by REDCHINAWAVE — exactly the sound this story needs.

  • 🩸 Familiar Touch - From Hinterland Mood, the same developer behind the fan-favorite visual novel “Banebush”.

store_data.about_the_game:
Elegon is a fantasy MMORPG built for players who miss the soul of early online worlds, where exploration mattered, progression felt earned, and every piece of gear told a story.

Open World

Set in a vast, seamless open world, Elegon invites you to carve your own path through dangerous wilderness, forgotten ruins, and living cities filled with opportunity. Whether you venture alone or alongside allies, the world is persistent and designed to reward curiosity and commitment.

Progress

Advance your character through a deep, stat-driven progression system that puts meaningful choices back into the hands of the player. Every level, every talent, and every item shapes how you play. Powerful gear is earned through perseverance, mastery, and discovery.

Quests

With thousands of quests spread across the world, there is always something to do and somewhere new to explore. From simple tasks to long-form adventures, questing in Elegon is designed to feel rewarding at every stage of your journey, encouraging players to explore every corner of the world.

Dungeons & Raids

Dangerous dungeons test coordination and skill, filled with mechanics that reward teamwork and planning. For those seeking the ultimate challenge, large-scale raids push groups to their limits, offering legendary encounters and highly sought-after rewards.

Professions & Economy

Beyond combat, Elegon offers deep non-combat progression through professions such as crafting, gathering, and specialization paths. Master your trade, supply the economy, and create powerful equipment, consumables, and rare items that adventurers depend on. The player-driven economy ensures every role feels valuable.

Key features

  • A huge open-world fantasy realm

  • Classic stat-based character progression

  • Challenging group dungeons and large-scale raids

  • Meaningful gear with visible power growth

  • Deep professions and crafting systems

  • Social-focused gameplay built around community

Elegon is more than a game. It is a world meant to be lived in.

Step into a realm where adventure is earned, legends are forged, and your journey truly matters.

store_data.about_the_game:
RW Trapped Inside?

You wake up in darkness.

Cold metal bars stand between you and the unknown. Your head throbs, your memory shattered into fragments. You don’t know who you are… or why you’re here.

But one thing is certain — this house is not what it seems.

Escape the House

Explore a mysterious, locked-down residence filled with secrets, puzzles, and hidden paths. Break free from your cage and uncover the truth room by room. Every object, every shadow, every locked door could be the key to your escape… or your downfall.

Reconstruct Your Memory

As you progress, fragments of your past begin to surface. You remember arriving here for what was supposed to be an unforgettable party. But something went terribly wrong.

Moments of intimacy, desire, and temptation return to you in flashes — scattered across different locations in the house. These memories are not just echoes of the past… they may hold the answers you need.

Choices & Consequences

Your decisions shape the experience. Solve puzzles, unlock hidden scenes, and piece together what really happened that night. Will you uncover the truth… or remain trapped inside your own mind?

Features

  • Psychological horror atmosphere with immersive sound design

  • Puzzle-solving and exploration gameplay

  • Memory reconstruction system tied to progression

  • Mature themes and suggestive content

  • Multiple outcomes based on player choices

The deeper you go, the more you remember.

The more you remember… the harder it is to escape.

store_data.about_the_game:
NYRA: The Fall of Light

A dark fantasy Action RPG focused on skill-based combat and exploration.

NYRA: The Fall of Light is a story-driven, single-player, third-person Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world.
The game focuses on real-time combat, demanding reflexes, precise timing, and ability management.

You play as Nyra Valen, a warrior summoned from another world, exploring ancient ruins, cursed lands, dungeons, and fallen cities—shaping both the fate of the world and your own destiny.

Gameplay

Every encounter rewards timing, positioning, and smart ability usage.

  • Real-time third-person combat

  • Dash, defense, area-based magic, and time-slow abilities

  • Melee and magic-based attack combinations

  • Reflex- and positioning-focused encounters

Traversal & Movement

Movement plays a key role in exploration and combat flow.
Abilities are not only tools for fighting, but also for reaching new areas and gaining vertical advantage.

  • Fast and responsive character movement

  • Ability-based traversal mechanics

  • Vertical exploration and environmental navigation

World & Atmosphere

The world of NYRA is built to be explored at your own pace, blending dark fantasy themes with environmental storytelling.

  • Ancient cities, castles, and underground ruins

  • Dynamic atmosphere and weather

  • Cinematic presentation without losing gameplay control

Boss & Enemy Encounters

  • Unique enemies with distinct attack patterns

  • Arena-based boss fights

  • Mechanics that reward learning patterns and precise timing

Character Progression

  • Active and passive abilities unlocked over time

  • Ability upgrade system

  • Equipment and inventory management

  • Player-driven combat style customization

Technical Features

  • Single-player (Offline playable)

  • Third-person camera

  • Keyboard & mouse support

  • Cinematic cutscenes

More content and systems will be expanded during development.

Our protagonist Fyodor sets out to a mysterious cursed island to find a cure for his tribe. On his journey through the island he will encounter a lot of strange characters, many of which he can recruit to his party to aid him in navigating and surviving the horrors that haunt the island.

Heavy Wake combines overworld exploration and strong RPG elements with deckbuilding driven combat. Characters you recruit add unique cards and passive effects to your build. But be careful! The island is dangerous and often deadly, and if your party members perish, so do their contributions.

store_data.about_the_game:
The empire decays. Primordial forces rise. And the Celestial King awaits.
When the Relic Binder tears open a rift between dimensions, an ancient power long sealed away begins to stir. Fallen Revenants return, and the Celestial King rises with them.

Built on the foundations of the original Desert Revenant, The Reawakening expands every system with deeper mechanics, new content, and a far greater threat. Summon persistent minions, stack powerful effects, and unleash devastating combos against brutal enemies across ever-escalating challenges.

Will you survive the Reawakening?

Command the Battlefield

Summon persistent minions that fight across multiple turns, create openings, protect you, and grow stronger through buffs and synergies.

Stack Effects. Chain Combos

Layer buffs, debuffs, and passives from a pool of 800+ effects. Interactions emerge naturally as turns erupt into explosive payoff moments.

Face Complex, Coordinated Enemies

Enemies coordinate, analyze the battlefield, and escalate mid-fight. Each region introduces new and returning foes with deeper spell kits and multi-turn mechanics.

Forge Your Build Each Run

Gain cards, passives, Blessings, and upgrades to shape unique strategies. With dual upgrades and Power Cards, no two runs play alike.

FEATURES

  • Four distinct heroes: Leper, Combatant, Seer, Relic Binder. Each offering a completely different combat style.

  • Deep build variety: 310+ unique cards with 2 upgrades each, 800+ stackable effects, Blessings, Power Cards, Passives, and Reputation meta-progression.

  • Escalating challenge: Six themed regions (three per run), Regional Hard Modes, Curses, and the Genesis system for varied starts.

  • Weekly competitive challenges: Fixed seeded runs, global leaderboards, dynamic modifiers, and seasonal rewards.

  • A world rooted in ancient Middle Eastern mythology: Battle Jinn, Ifrits, Ghouls, and other legendary beings through ritualistic ruins as you challenge the Celestial King.

store_data.about_the_game:
🌟 About This Game

The Sigil Engine is a magical automation puzzle game where you teach a small spirit automaton how to move, sense, harvest, and purify using a set of elegant visual spell blocks.
No typing. No code. Just pure logic, wrapped in a gentle fantasy world.

As you explore forgotten ruins and dormant sigils, you’ll uncover how this ancient network once pulsed with energy, and how to bring it back to life through your own crafted routines.

✨ Program with Magic

Create logic by snapping together spell blocks such as Move, Enseed, If, Loop, Reap, and Purify. New spell blocks unlock as you explore.
Everything is transparent, readable, and welcoming, even as puzzles grow deeper.

Design clever routines.
Watch your spirit automaton execute them.
Refine, optimize, and marvel at the emergent results.

🌱 Harvest Energy & Cleanse Corruption

Travel across a world of dormant sigils and corrupted runes.
Harvest spirit energy, restore broken nodes, and uncover how each region behaves differently.

Some puzzles reward precision.
Some reward creativity.
Many have more than one solution.

🌟 A Puzzle Game for Thinkers, Tinkerers, and Daydreamers

Whether you enjoy optimization, creative problem-solving, or exploring magical worlds,
The Sigil Engine invites you to build spells, understand systems, and restore light to ancient sigils.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mei Paranormies is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Mei, the paranormal investigator, who got a call from the owner of a haunted restaurant to check it out for proof of the paranormal.

Nokiloc restaurant was built during the 1980s in San Francisco by Rob, the former owner of the restaurant. The business was booming during the late 1980s. But in the year 1990, there was a devastating fire incident that killed a restaurant waiter and a few customers. While most of the people, which included customers and restaurant staff, were evacuated safely by the firefighters. A few of them who were stuck in the restaurant during the evacuation process died either due to suffocation or burns.

In 1992, the Nokiloc restaurant was sold to Chris, the current owner, who reopened the restaurant later that year after renovation, and customers started to come in again. But there were reports of paranormal activities in the restaurant. During the night hours, the spirits are often seen sitting on empty chairs, in the kitchen areas, etc. The dark apparitions are also often observed by the restaurant staff in the basement and in the storage rooms. It is said that a spirit with a badly burned face is often seen roaming in the hallways near the staff's bedrooms. Disembodied crying and screaming noises are often heard during the midnight hours.

Because of the rise in paranormal activities, the restaurant business got affected. This had compelled the owner, Chris, to contact Mei, the paranormal investigator, to check it out and provide him with some answers.

You play as Mei, a paranormal investigator, and will you be able to help out your client?

Key Features:

  • Explore the haunted restaurant for the proof of the paranormal.
  • Collect items like keys, haunted objects like ladies bag, engagement ring etc.
  • Come face to face with the spirits!
  • Use scientific equipment like EVP recorder, emf meter!
  • Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation!

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

How is Gebinden pronounced? Nobody really knows, but it's fun to play anyway! Gebinden is a minimalist and simple to learn puzzle game that becomes exponentially more complex as you get farther in the campaign. Move 2 characters around a grid to maneuver them to their respective goals, while the character's movement is limited by the tiles around them AND the other color. 

Key Features:

  • 200+ Handcrafted levels

  • 9 uniquely themed chapters

  • 7 types of simple tiles that interact in complex ways

  • Complete Level Editor that can be used to create millions of levels for yourself and your friends to play

  • Minimalist design that keeps you calm as you solve puzzles

  • Bonus tiles available in settings that aren't in the campaign, can be put into the editor for extra creative players!

store_data.about_the_game:
“It’s not a sword. It’s not glitter. It’s a bow. Only a bow. Everything else is trash.”
You play as a tired elf, considered dumb even by the NPCs, who only wants to gather enough gold to retire in luxury. No world-saving quests, no epic prophecies. This is the daily life of an adventurer who spends decades picking herbs and struggling to level up.

🎯 A Different Premise

In Phantom, elves aren’t wise or magnificent. They’re just slow. Leveling up takes decades, and the guild has no patience for you. Your goal isn’t to defeat the ultimate evil, but to survive daily life and accumulate gold for retirement.

  • Slave Mode – play at your own pace, no pressure.

  • Worker Mode – 100 days to gather as much gold and reputation as possible, with over 50 different endings (yes, mostly text and music changes, but it still counts).

⚔️ ARPG Combat – Fast and Frenetic

Forget turn-based battles. Combat here is real-time, dynamic, and relentless.

  • 🏹 Agile Archer: continuous attacks, quick dodges, and arrow combos.

  • 🔥 Elemental Arrows: fire, ice, and poison, each with unique effects.

  • ⚡ Active Progression: the more you fight, the more skills you unlock.

  • 🎮 Constant Action: every encounter is unpredictable, no waiting for turns

🌍 Unique Systems

Over 100 systems built from scratch, transforming RPG Maker into a brand-new engine:

  • 🌙 Day/Night Cycle: enemies grow stronger at night, rare ghosts appear carrying extra gold.

  • ⛈️ Dynamic Weather: rain reduces visibility, wind alters arrow trajectories, fog hides enemies.

  • 🛌 Exhaustion System: skip resting at the inn and your character loses efficiency, misses attacks, or even collapses.

  • 🛠️ Advanced Crafting: over 200 items to create, with recipes affected by weather and time of day.

  • 🤝 Dungeon NPCs: allies who can tank or heal, but also saboteurs who hinder your progress.

  • 🗺️ Adaptive Maps: environments that reshape themselves in real time based on your quest choices.

  • 📊 Career Management: every day brings you closer to retirement—or bankruptcy.

📜 Narrative Content

  • Over 4,000 lines of dialogue that change based on your rank and choices.

  • 300 unique NPCs with detailed art and distinct personalities.

  • A dynamic quest system with 180 random variations.

  • Maps that reconfigure themselves depending on the missions you accept.

🚀 Elite Engineering

This is not a standard RPG Maker project. It’s a rebuilt engine designed to deliver performance and mechanics you won’t find anywhere else.

  • Dynamic quest algorithm that ensures no two runs feel the same.

  • Organic weather system that impacts both visuals and gameplay.

  • Adaptive maps that react to your decisions.

  • Career management with day counters and multiple endings.

Phantom the Huntress isn’t about being a hero. It’s about being a tired elf, considered useless, who relies on you to prove that even the slowest can retire in style — through frenetic ARPG combat and systems you’ve never seen before.

Welcome to the oh-so-glorious life of a real huntress: tracking prey through endless mud, gathering herbs that smell like troll feet, exterminating goblins until your fingers bleed, climbing guild ranks slower than continental drift, and babysitting NPCs whose “AI” couldn’t outsmart a sack of hammers. (Don’t worry, I carry the team. As always.)

Think you’ll slay the Demon Lord? Rescue the princess? Cute. You’ll be picking flowers, skinning rats, and dying to the same goblin for the 47th time while I roll my eyes so hard they nearly fall out of my perfect elven skull.

Now, before you run away screaming (please do), do the one thing that might make this nightmare slightly less unbearable: Add this game to your wishlist. Seriously. There’s a progress bar. When it fills, I get a bonus. Actual gold. Enough to buy the good elven wine and drown the memory of your existence. Do it. Save what’s left of my sanity.

Wishlist. Now. Or vanish forever. My patience died sometime around the Third Age. Choose quickly.

TECHNICAL SPECS (For those who actually care about the craft):

  • Engineered for Excellence: Over 100+ unique systems developed from scratch specifically for this game. This isn't a standard template; it’s a rebuilt engine designed for high performance and mechanics you won't find anywhere else.

  • Real Narrative Content: +4,000 lines of dialogue and 300 unique NPCs with detailed portraits.

    Dev Note: I paid a high price for this—with my own money and my own time adapting every single pixel. Don't even start with that "AI" crap. If you doubt it, check the in-game credits for the names of the humans who actually worked on this. This is human sweat, period.

  • Dynamic Questing Engine: An exclusive algorithm featuring 180 variations of procedural quests. No static worlds here: quests are integrated into a custom management system that includes automated maps and special item counters.

  • Adaptive Maps: The world reacts to you. Maps adapt based on the quest you choose, changing the exploration experience in real-time.

  • ARPG Combat & Progression: * Skill Tree focused on Technical Archery.

    • Special Arrows (Fire, Ice, Poison) with real combat impact.

    • Over 50 combat animations locked at a crisp, stable 60 FPS.

    • Deep Crafting and Dungeon Support NPCs.

Com certeza! Ter a página em inglês é fundamental, já que a maior parte das vendas da Steam vem do mercado internacional. Use esse texto para atualizar a seção "About This Game" (Sobre este Jogo):

New in the World of Phantom: The World is Now Alive! 🌍

1. Custom Day/Night Cycle: High Risk, High Reward 🌑 The sun doesn't just set; it changes the rules of the game.

  • The Night Hunt: When darkness falls, powerful ghosts emerge. They are lethal and relentless, but they carry the massive amounts of gold you need for your retirement.

  • Exhaustion System: Don't push your luck forever. If you ignore your fatigue and stay out too long, exhaustion will take its toll, forcing you back to the Inn. Plan your day, survive the night!

2. Dynamic and Immersive Weather System ⛈️ The environment now reacts to the elements. Feel the atmosphere shift with our new weather engine:

  • Visual Variety: Battle through Rain, Wind that sways the trees and scatters leaves, and dense Fog that challenges your vision.

  • A Living World: Weather patterns occur organically every hour, ensuring that every day of farming feels visually unique and strategically different.

3. The Veteran’s Rest: Inn Reward System 🏨 The Inn is more than just a place to sleep—it’s where your progress is forged.

  • Aventurer Rewards: Finish your day like a true Veteran Adventurer and receive exclusive bonuses when checking in.

  • Career Management: Time is money. Manage your days wisely; every time the day-counter advances, you move one step closer to your ultimate goal.

store_data.about_the_game:
A little Jumpingspider's Garden Adventure is an unconventional 3D Platformer for young and old.

Experience the world through a macro lens following the adventures of a cute, little jumping spider, which is on the hunt for food and wants to find a mate.

Funny, happy and full of color!

A little bit of action and lots of surprises...

This game consists of 16 levels.

Instead of using the same mechanics for each level and just raising the difficulty, in this game each level is designed as its own unique mini game.

This gives you the opportunity to experience many different forms of movement like running, jumping, swinging, flying, gliding...

Some levels test how fast you can react, others challenge your sense of direction and some are just the joy of collecting things...

This game has simple controls and no manual camera control is needed, which makes it approachable for beginners (who are not used to complex control schemes with many buttons and more than one thumbstick).
However, this game is not easy in general. Some levels require you to recognize patterns, focus on precise movements or practice a bit to get into the flow of the level.

It's more like a 90s game. No permanent dopamine kicks and frequent checkpoints.

There are 4 stages of difficulty in each level so you can slowly learn to master the gameplay.

You can play this game with mouse controls or a controller - choose what you like!

Everything in this game is built with our heart and soul, everything is handmade and absolutely no AI was used for it.

We wish you (and your kids ;-) ) a lot of fun, excitement and a really good time!

Forget your everyday worries for some time and enjoy this sunny, colorful game!

store_data.about_the_game:
In the world of Magic Cauldron, anything can go wrong. Especially if you are kidnapped by a madman and thrown into a dark dungeon.

Who is this madman who has left you little clues? Why were you chosen? What awaits you in the tower of madness?

You must do everything you can to survive in this dungeon. You can also use the magical cauldrons to brew useful potions.

Perhaps you will also find weapons left behind by other captives who did not survive the Tower of Madness.

Magic Cauldron - Dungeons - The Tower of Madness is a classic dungeon crawler with a retro look. The game is reminiscent of the good old days of grid crawlers, which did not need 3D at all... only this time in 3D. Turn-based battles and hidden chambers will bring out the explorer in you.

movies.name: A trailer that will waste 58 seconds of your life (exactly)

store_data.about_the_game:
In this award-winning* satire of gaming culture, you'll face the ultimate test of willpower against history's most manipulative pirate. He'll beg. He'll bargain. He'll gaslight. He'll hit you with uncomfortable psychological questions and make you question your own life choices if need be! He'll assault you with anime references and memes from all ages - some so ancient your grandpa might still remember them!

He'll even try bribes like "I have a Half-Life 3 beta key!" (He's lying).

Features:

  • 💬 1,000+ Lines of Trash Talk: Dialogue that reacts to your deaths, timing, and hesitation.

  • 🤡 Unpredictable Humour: Fourth-wall breaking gags about developers, players, and the game itself. Some references are so old and obscure you’ll wonder if you and the developer are the only two people on Earth who get them!

  • 🏴‍☠️ Master of Mischief: Our antihero is a real master of his craft! He controls the lighting, the fog, and even the wind! He can summon music out of thin air (how does he even do that?) just to set the mood and mess with your head. But that's not all - rumor has it he possesses the technology to count your deaths! Unbelievable!

  • 🎵 JRPG Vibes & Lo-Fi Chills: Need a break? Just leave the game running in the background! The Pirate has nearly an hour of original arrangements inspired by the golden age of JRPG legends and more. It’s basically "Lo-Fi Pirate Beats to Press X To."

  • 🌍 Devious Localization: Our pirate has sailed the seven seas and knows the cultures well. He adapts his jokes to specific national tastes that hit really hard! Nothing is sacred to him.

  • ⏳ Respects Your Time (Not like the Pirate): We cut out the crafting system, the fetch quests, and the 50-hour campaign. What's left? A concentrated dose of 30-60 minutes of madness. Perfect for a lunch break or a quick existential crisis.

Press X to experience regret!

(Seriously, don't press it. Or do? We're not your mum.)

* "Awards" may include "Participant" ribbon from Dev's nephew's art contest.

store_data.about_the_game:
Be Your Own Boss!

You rented a small shop with the last money in your pocket. Now it's time to show off your art and rewrite the rules of this town!

Listen to customer requests, choose the right design, and get to work. Earn money by providing tattoo and piercing services, but be careful; every mistake lowers customer satisfaction. Use different levels of tattoo machines, manage ink stocks, and keep your equipment in working order at all times.

Don't settle for just a tattoo shop! Use your earnings to buy cafes, pizzerias, and hotels in the city to generate passive income. Create extra revenue streams by acquiring hotdog and ice cream selling licenses. Roam freely with your motorcycle and explore the city.

Track every detail of your business. Manage your inventory, monitor your shop's popularity and cleanliness. As your business grows, hire employees who each possess different skills. Maintain your financial balance through the banking app and keep your shop safe from bankruptcy.

The city's thugs are not open to change, so they might scare away your customers. Grab your bat and defend your shop! Stop these thugs from damaging your business.

The city isn't always quiet and sunny. Changing weather conditions and city events can impact your entire business. Letters from the municipality can change your fate. Always be prepared for events happening in the city.

Return to the comfort of your home after a busy day. Leave the stress of work behind, take care of your pets, and make time for yourself. Find balance in your life within the day and night cycle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Batticuore. What was once nothing more than one of many european islands turned touristic attractions after their practical use faded over time, with plenty of history and untouched natural scenery... now has been rid of any life form by a mysterious curse. The only survivor? An eccentric fisherwoman that goes by the name of Martha Mahkklen. 

Not only that! The waters surrounding Batticuore have been repopulated by a new race of creatures, the Trauma Pets! Bloodthirsty animals that have seemingly no other desire than to cause chaos and destruction, which is hardly worth concern for us humans since they're tiny acquatic creatures.

While scientists continue to research their bizarre biological makeup and behaviour, the common people have began to use them for sports in all sorts of competitions, both peaceful and violent. Now that's where you step in, not to stop this senseless abuse, but to be the very best at it. 

-TAKE PART IN 20+ MINIGAMES, some involving your Trauma Pets, others testing your own skills!

-HAVE COMPLETE CONTROL OVER THE TRAUMA PETS, raise them to perfection through selective breeding and genetic engineering!

-UNCOVER THE MISTERY OF BATTICUORE, earn Martha Mahkklen's trust, find out what happened to the inhabitants of the island!

This, AND MORE, on Trauma Pets! Coming out June 15st!

在游戏中，玩家可以自由探索多个区域，与不同的 NPC、敌对势力及隐藏事件互动。队伍中的每位角色都有各自的战斗风格与成长路径，玩家需要根据敌人的属性、行动顺序与战场结构制定策略。战斗节奏紧凑，同时包含多种战斗资源（技能冷却、能量管理、异常状态克制），使每一次战斗都具有独立的策略性。

游戏提供完整的主线剧情、多种剧情分支与支线任务。随着推进，玩家将解锁新的区域、装备、特技，以及更复杂的战斗机制。对于喜欢传统 RPG 的玩家来说，本作提供了稳定的可玩时长、明确的成长体验和不断加深的战术挑战。

主要特色：

  • 策略性回合制战斗：包含行动顺序、属性相克、控制技能等多种战术要素。

  • 角色成长系统：角色可通过战斗经验与技能进行培养，构筑自己的战斗风格。

  • 完整的主线+支线内容：深入探索奇幻世界的历史与秩序。

  • 装备与资源收集：通过探索与战斗获得装备素材，打造或升级武器。

  • 可探索的多区域地图：不同区域有独特敌人、环境事件与隐藏宝物。

  • 多样化的敌人设计：敌人具备不同攻击方式、状态效果与弱点，战斗方式更加多变。

《World of Y》旨在提供一个完整且节奏明确的 RPG 战斗体验，让玩家在战斗、探索与成长中逐步沉浸于这片神秘大陆。

store_data.about_the_game:
Halls of the Damned is a hardcore multiplayer extraction dungeon crawler where survival is everything. Players enter a dark, labyrinthine dungeon, facing off against rival squads and deadly fantasy creatures. Each match is a high-stakes race to gather loot, outwit enemies, and escape before the dungeon seals shut. With limited resources, shifting zones, and the constant threat of death, every decision counts — and only those who survive keep what they’ve earned.

Designed for intense short-session gameplay, the game blends competitive PvP with cooperative survival. Players who die lose all their gear, while successful extraction preserves hard-won items for future runs. Whether you're coordinating with teammates or clashing with others in brutal combat, Halls of the Damned delivers a relentless, risk-reward experience where strategy, skill, and timing determine your fate.

store_data.about_the_game:
===一套遊戲二套玩法===

(1)劇情冒限模式(適合一邊玩一邊學習) 

以傳統RPG遊戲的方式冒險、打怪、闖關救人，如果遇到過不去的小關卡就查字典，當然，闖關時找朋友或同學一起來腦力激蕩會更有趣。


(2)地產建設模式:(適合一邊複習,同時建設城城市遊玩) 

相同的世界故事線, 幾百年後, 魔王不甘平凡, 開始起了抄地皮的壞心思。

於是一場 勇者 VS 魔王 相互搶錢的之爭就此展開。 

===更多介紹===

(一)這是一部怎樣的作品(雙重設定)

(1)要冒險也要學習

這是一部自由開放式的RPG冒險遊戲,想冒險就冒險,想學習就學習。

這也是一部故事內容有趣、劇情感人的遊戲。

當然,這一定是一部充滿美少女、美少男的遊戲。(12+限定)

(2)是遊戲也是英文單字學習工具

這也是一部『輔助背單字』的工具遊戲。

內容包含雅思(IELTS) 以及 託福(TOEFL)共用基礎英文單字1200個。

這也是『轉生打怪學英文系列』的系列作,其餘『我獨自升級系列』作品將陸續發售。

無論您是國高中學生還是在職場工作...;

這絕對是一部能『提升英文技能』的最佳工具，更是一部能收藏一輩子的遊戲。

(二)如何開始玩這部作品

進入遊戲後，決定好主角的性別及職業，之後就能開始自由冒險。

攻略方法有二種

(1)想獲得最佳的遊戲體驗 :

以傳統RPG遊戲的方式冒險、打怪、闖關救人，如果遇到過不去的小關卡就查字典，當然，闖關時找朋友或同學一起來腦力激蕩會更有趣。

(2)想獲得最佳的學習體驗 :

這部作品收集了雅思(IELTS) 以及 託福(TOEFL) 常考的1200個中階單字，按照遊戲設定的引導，一邊背英文單字一邊解世界任務(即使不學習也能通關)。

(三)遊戲結束您會獲得什麼

(1)您將獲得玩遊戲的樂趣。

(2)你將熟悉1200個基礎單字。

(3)完成所有系列六部作品之後,如果您有8000+以上的單字量,就相當於:

-專業英語4級(TEM-4)

-全民英檢中高級(臺灣)

-雅思(IELTS) 以及 託福(TOEFL)可以一腳踏入高分的門檻了。

store_data.about_the_game:
Goat Nuclear Clicker is a darkly humorous incremental/idle game where reckless goats, cosmic engineering, and far-too-many nukes collide. Tap to generate resources, unlock bizarre automation, and escalate from a single silo to an intergalactic meltdown that reshapes entire realities.

Gameplay Loop:
Start by clicking your goat to produce energy and feed your first silo of nuclear mischief. Spend earnings on producers, upgrades, and market gambles. Automate production chains, place wagers in shady markets, recruit pantheon gods for passive bonuses, and spend radiation-saturated currency on radical upgrades. When things get predictably chaotic, detonate — and ascend to higher galaxies with persistent bonuses that rewrite how your next run behaves.

Why Play:

It's a mix of tactile clicking satisfaction and long-term idle progression, peppered with offbeat systems: wager-driven risk/reward, warfare mechanics, a pantheon of meta-upgrades, and singularity-level late-game transformations. Each run reveals new layers of absurdity, from rad steroids to multiverse-scale achievements.

Key Features

  • Click & Idle: Fast, satisfying clicking plus meaningful automation that keeps progression interesting even while AFK.

  • Detonation & Ascension: Sacrifice progress for powerful persistent bonuses — detonate to unlock new galaxies and reset with style.

  • Bizarre Progression Systems: Pantheon gods, silos, market wagers, war rooms, and entropy mechanics create unusual strategic depth.

  • Multiverse & Singularity: Late-game systems let you expand across universes and chase singularity-level meta goals.

  • Achievements & Leaderboards: Unlock twisted achievements and compete on scoreboards to prove whose goat is the most catastrophic.

  • Audio & Presentation: Quirky soundtrack and visual flair accompany every meltdown, from humble clicks to cosmic explosions.

  • Final Hook:
    If you like irreverent idle games with strange systems, high-stakes prestige, and enough nuclear nonsense to make your goat blush, Operation Meltdown offers countless runs worth of catastrophic fun. Click, automate, detonate — then do it again on a galactic scale.

store_data.about_the_game:
“离校School’s Out” is a first-person horror adventure game independently developed by a solo creator.

   Each level offers a different gameplay experience.

    Puzzle Exploration: Investigate environmental clues and search for items to uncover the rules of the looping classroom.

    Anomaly Detection: In an endless looping space, carefully spot subtle environmental changes (anomalies) and choose the correct door based on the number of anomalies found.

    Mini Shooting Game: Enter a shooter titled Gunfire Elite, and complete matches under unfair rules.

    Stealth & Survival: Stay alert in monster-infested corridors, and use the environment changes triggered by blinking to pass through trap-filled areas.

    More levels and gameplay modes are currently in development.

    This game features one main story and two side stories, giving you a total of five different endings to uncover.

    You’ll team up with several heroines to explore looping-classroom puzzles, track down strange anomalies hidden throughout the environment, and toy with various quirky gadgets prepared just for you.

    The two side stories, you’ll need to find hidden branching paths within the game’s environments. Find the right way and enjoy their fully independent endings.

    No need to stress — think of it as a trip through a haunted house.
    You play simply as yourself, nothing complicated.
    So… ready to begin?
    Let’s go!

  • Basic Controls

    WASD — Move     Shift — Run    Space — Blink    Ctrl — Crouch

    Q / E — Lean left / right   F — Interact    G — Flashlight

    Left Mouse Button — Grab item     Right Mouse Button — Drop item   

    Hold Left Mouse Button + Move Mouse — Rotate item

    If you have any questions or ideas about this game, please feel free to send an email to finalmachine.game@gmail.com .

    If you encounter any issues during gameplay or would like to share feedback, feel free to join our Discord and get in touch. Thank you very much for your support!

store_data.about_the_game:
Shape the First Breath of a Civilization

Build, explore, and expand across an infinite world.

FireMatch Empire is a multi-city building and exploration game where your journey begins in a land that exists only where you can see.

As you move, the world unfolds—forest by forest, ridge by ridge—revealing the space where your civilization will rise across ten ages.

The journey is designed to unfold over time, beginning with the First Age.

Found Your First City

Your earliest tool leads you to establish Downtown, the heart of your first settlement.
Here, settlers gather, production begins, and the outline of your realm takes shape.

Within moments, you will place your first structures, welcome your first population,
and watch the land respond as your city comes alive.

A Calm, Organic Building Experience

Early shelters, fire sources, gathering spots, and simple storage form the roots of your settlement.
Growth follows a gentle, readable rhythm shaped by terrain, resources, and your choices.

Food plays a central role, yet scarcity becomes part of your city’s quiet story—
something remembered rather than punished.

As the settlement expands, a distinct identity begins to surface.

Explore, Discover, Expand

Stepping beyond your borders reveals new resources, varied landscapes, and promising locations for future cities.
Exploration expands the world; returning home remains effortless.

Natural events appear softly in the environment, adding texture without disrupting pace.

Build a Realm of Connected Cities

Even in the First Age, your vision can reach farther than a single settlement.
Roads link cities both practically and culturally, forming the foundation of a broader realm.

As ages advance, these connections evolve—carrying momentum as your civilization stretches toward the horizon.

Technology and the First Traces of History

Technology progresses through the work of your people.
Meanwhile, each city quietly gathers its earliest memories—
small shifts in weather, habits, and everyday decisions.

Over time, your settlements grow from simple clusters of structures
into places with presence, rhythm, and a story of their own.

The Beginning of a Ten-Age Journey

Establish your first city, explore an endless world,
and guide a young civilization through its earliest steps—
the spark that will carry your story across ten ages.

This is where the journey begins.

If this world speaks to you, follow it—
your civilization will be waiting.

The game is currently in development.

To follow its development, consider adding it to your wishlist.

store_data.about_the_game:
Roll Or Die is a momentum mastery arcade game built around one feeling: saving yourself at the last possible second. The floor collapses, the path gets tighter, and every clean dodge turns into a faster, riskier run.

Current Game Modes:

  • Arena Collapse: A shrinking safe zone survival run where tiles vanish. Stay alive, keep moving, push your score.

  • Endless Runner: Enter the flow state. Test your endurance on a procedural path that builds in speed and difficulty. How far can you roll before the physics - or your nerves - give out?

  • Obstacle Course: Conquer the course. Tackle a series of challenging obstacles and checkpoints designed to push your reflexes and precision to the limit. Every section offers a new test... How well can you navigate through it all without falling behind? NOTE: This is REALLY HARD!

Key Features:

  • Collapsing floor runs that force constant movement

  • Tight physics movement built for clutch saves

  • Three modes: survival arena, endless distance, hardcore obstacle course

  • Instant restart loop for “one more run”

  • Steam leaderboards for time and score chasing

store_data.about_the_game:
Like has come to a deserted island to live a second life.

You can fight and survive, fish, and live a slow life,

You can develop the land, build a village, and go defeat strong enemies! The possibilities are endless!

You can also run away! Start with what you can do.

Cheating is fine, so we recommend changing jobs from the start!

You'll encounter weak enemies that you can defeat in various places, as well as strong enemies that are currently impossible to defeat.

You can also create items and aim for drops.

This is a free-spirited open-world deserted island survival game!

This game does not have a scenario.

This will be a series, but the first installment will be more of a hack-and-slash RPG!

It may be a game where you enjoy survival and, in the process, defeat strong opponents.

It's a slow-paced game, but there's no romance this time around. Instead, enjoy new discoveries as you watch characters grow, find hidden, powerful enemies, and defeat them over and over again.

Defeat the truly powerful final boss in the Paladin's Labyrinth!

The protagonist, Like, has more starting skills, and they're all unlocked!

(So maybe taking on formidable foes with just Like...maybe!?)

You can now recruit 18 characters!

The number of skills has increased dramatically!

Random encounters have been removed from the early maps, up until village building.

All bosses are symbols. There are some with symbols. But that's really just the early stages.

Perfect for when you want to take it easy and explore a deserted island while listening to the background music!

And what's more! When you set out on the Pirate Seas, you'll find the Paladin's Labyrinth in the middle!

It's a random dungeon. It's open-world, but if you get bored of that, just jump around randomly and

defeat the boss at the very back! There are two bosses: "Paladin" and "True★Paladin"! Which one will you end up with?

To recruit people, you create a village and can choose from 18 people.

◆Guidelines for Testimonials and Reviews

Posting is OK. In fact, we encourage it.

We absolutely prohibit any actions that damage our brand, slander, or otherwise lead to a decrease in sales.

As we're an indie company, there will be some hits and misses. We apologize for this, but we appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

◆Guidelines for Live Commentary

Please feel free to commentate. It's very welcome.

Revenue-generating commentary is also OK. However, please be sure to follow the rules below.

Abusive comments (such as pointing out only negative aspects to make people laugh, streamer comments, or listener comments) are not allowed.

We will take appropriate action against anyone who violates the rules.

We will request removal or report the user.

Please be sure to observe common sense and good manners.

store_data.about_the_game:
“When love fades, the water remembers.”

⚠️ WARNING: This game explores themes of emotional distress, strict parenting, and psychological pressure ⚠️

~~~~~

Step into a slow-burn psychological horror through the eyes of a child. Experience the heavy feeling of a broken home, where the only thing you want is to be free.

Gameplay

The game focuses on a child’s daily routine inside the house. You will perform familiar actions and interact with ordinary objects. There are no enemies to fight and no difficult puzzles to solve. The experience centers on emotional pressure and the desire to escape it.

This game avoids cheap jumpscares. Horror is built through atmosphere, sound, and emotional weight. Seen through a child’s eyes, the home feels heavy—where the only source of comfort is a small aquarium fish.

Fish
The only place that feels safe. Or so it seems.

House
Something about this place feels off. Even when it shouldn’t.

Mama
She’s just trying to keep things in order. Even if it feels too much.

Routine
Follow the rules. Don’t question it.

Book
You start noticing things.

Water
The thirst for something more doesn’t go away. It only grows.

Grandma
She’s the only one who understands. Or at least, it feels that way.

Features

🕯️ Psychological Horror Narrative
A quiet story about control, routine, and emotional neglect.

👁️ First-Person Perspective
Experience the world from a child’s height inside a tense, confined home.

🏠 Routine-Based Interaction
Perform familiar actions and follow your mother’s rules.

🎧 Atmosphere Over Jumpscares
No cheap scares. Horror emerges from silence, sound design, and emotional unease.

🐠 The Aquarium
Your only comfort. A small space where emotion feels safe.

🔀 Multiple Endings
Your actions and attention shape how the story concludes.

⏱️ Short, Focused Experience
Approximately 90 minutes, designed to be completed in one sitting.

~~~~~

Psst... you aren't the only one here. Unlock a new perspective. A different viewpoint. A different story. Did you really see everything the first time?

store_data.about_the_game:
CodeWar Kingdom – Command Your Army with Scripts, Dominate the Algorithmic Battlefield!

Welcome to CodeWar Kingdom, where there is no traditional point-and-click control—only lines of code that decide the fate of battles. You are not just a player controlling soldiers; you are the commander who strategizes and programs the scripts. On this automated battlefield, the Lua scripts you write in advance become the sole law governing every unit under your command. Will you forge an invincible army of iron and blood, or design cunning tactical traps? Victory is determined by your wisdom long before the battle begins.

🎮 Core Gameplay: Program Your Commander Scripts

  • Say goodbye to micromanagement and embrace strategic programming! The core joy of the game lies in writing unique behavior scripts for your six unit types: Infantry, Cavalry, Archer, Mage, Pastor, and Bolt Thrower.

  • Build Logic from Scratch: Use our rich set of APIs to command units to move, search for enemies, attack, and cast skills. For example, program your Archers to "maintain distance and prioritize the weakest enemy," or script your Pastor to weave through the battlefield, healing the most endangered ally.

  • Fully Automated Epic Battles: Once your scripts are ready, deploy them into battle! As a spectator, you'll watch your "Code Army" execute your will with precision, engaging in intense and unpredictable auto-battles against enemy AI or other players' scripts. Every victory is a perfect validation of your programming logic.

⚔️ Six Unique Unit Types, Endless Strategic Depth

Each unit type is not just a set of stats, but a unique programming challenge. Understanding and leveraging their traits is key to victory:

  • Infantry / Cavalry: The backbone of your army and your shock troops. Script them to hold formations, intercept enemies, or charge headlong into the fray.

  • Archer / Mage: The core of your ranged firepower. Their scripts require intelligent target selection, distance calculation, and focus-firing on high-threat targets. The Mage's powerful area skill demands precise timing and positioning in your code.

  • Pastor: The lifeline of your team. Writing efficient healing priority algorithms and movement scripts is the art of keeping your front line intact.

  • Bolt Thrower: A strategic area-denial unit. Its script revolves around prediction and zone control—one perfectly placed shot can turn the tide of battle.

🚀 Easy to Learn, Deep to Master

  • Programming for Everyone: We use the simple and easy-to-learn Lua language, accompanied by complete Chinese & English API documentation and examples. Even if you're new to programming, you can quickly write your first script to move a soldier forward and attack.

  • From "Hello World" to "Elite Script": Start by controlling a single unit, then gradually learn to orchestrate multi-unit synergies, and ultimately create a highly intelligent, automated legion capable of handling complex battlefield situations. Your progress is clear and tangible.

  • Powerful Built-in Debugging: Use the Log() function to output variables and analyze your scripts decision-making in real-time, allowing for rapid iteration and optimization of your scripts.

🌐 Prove You're the True "Code Commander" in the Arena

  • Seamless Steam-Integrated Online Platform: Your battle scripts are automatically uploaded to our global servers after each match.

  • Challenge Players Worldwide: Throw your best scripts into the ranked ladder and compete against commanders across the globe. Your Scripts will represent you, accepting challenges 24/7 from around the world.

  • Learn and Evolve: Studying the public scripts of top-ranking players is the best way to learn advanced strategies and optimization techniques. Every defeat provides valuable data to refine your algorithms.

🛠️ Made for Geeks and Strategists

This game is tailor-made for you if:

  • You love programming and enjoy the thrill of solving problems with logic.

  • You're a devoted fan of strategy games, reveling in deep planning and long-term decision-making.

  • You're fascinated by artificial intelligence and automation, wanting to see how simple rules can give rise to complex behaviors.

  • You crave a unique, creative, and intellectually challenging gaming experience.
