This work is a first-person perspective pure love visual novel (galgame), featuring full dynamic character sprites, full voice acting, a complete collection system, and 20 hours of gameplay. It includes 5 dateable female characters, 6 good endings, and 4 bad endings.

Story Introduction

The male protagonist (Yan Yuechu) accidentally enters a "real-life escape room" shop and gets to know the shop owner (Xu Aiyoe). He hears rumors that the female shopkeeper is an incarnation of a demon; those who have played in this escape room will be enchanted by her and trapped in nightmares. Despite dismissing the rumors, the protagonist still decides to participate in the game.

After returning home from the game, he really has a nightmare of being trapped in an escape room. From then on, he is constantly involved in bizarre incidents, with people around him being attacked and kidnapped one after another, and he also keeps wandering between nightmares and reality.

The story unfolds around the escape room, gradually revealing the protagonist's past and the love-hate entanglement with Xu Aiyoe, the owner of the escape room shop.

Main Character Introduction

store_data.about_the_game:
Battlemage Ascension is a fast-paced, physics-based first-person melee slasher. 

You are a mage trapped in a prison pocket dimension and you must fight to escape.

Physics is your weapon.

The environment isn't just a decoration - it’s part of your arsenal. Fight smart using the environment.

  • Kick enemies into spikes, traps, or off the edge. Why waste a spell when gravity does the work? 

  • Use Telekinesis to grab a barrel, a crate, or heavy rocks and throw them with bone-crushing force, or grab enemies and throw them into each other.

  • Ragdoll Physics - hit, throw, and watch enemies react naturally to every impact.

Use powerful spells to destroy your enemies.

Mix magic and sword to crush your enemies.

  • Fire: Set enemies on fire and watch them burn.

  • Ice: Freeze enemies and then shatter them into pieces.

  • Lightning: Shock enemies with chain lightning.

  • Earth: Smash enemies with heavy stones and force.

  • Ultimates: Unleash powerful spells to wipe out huge groups of enemies.

Adapt. Destroy. Ascend.

  • Battle through diverse biomes filled with zombies, skeletons, orcs and goblins. Face armored Knights, Demons, and other monsters.

store_data.about_the_game:
Current Version: Alpha.

Fish Fortune is a cozy idle aquarium game about making smart choices, and building efficient setups.

You buy fish packs, place fish into detailed tanks, and decide how to grow your setup. Play actively by feeding low rarity fast-growing fish with upgraded food, or optimize your tanks by picking out low rarity fish until the tank consists of only high rarity fish, do that with multiple tanks and let fully grown fish generate income while you’re gone. Whether you check in often or let things run, progress continues.

Progression and Regions

As you earn money, you’ll improve each area by constructing key buildings. These projects reshape the environment, help fill your fish collection, and prepare you to move on to new regions with new conditions and species.

The journey begins in a quiet forest, where your first long-term goal is building a communication tower. Completing it marks your readiness to move forward, with future updates unlocking new regions, including a harsh frozen biome home to species that can’t survive elsewhere.

More will be described as development continues.

store_data.about_the_game:
SlimyLeap is a fast-paced pixel-art infinite runner where you play as a brave little slime trying to go as far as possible without dying.

Cute, colorful, and just a little chaotic – how far can your slime go?

As you go farther, new environments appear: from grassy fields to deep jungle and tall mountains.

Each run feels slightly different, with handcrafted level designs and new challenges waiting ahead.

But beware – a creeping red fog is always behind you!

The farther you go, the faster it moves, leaving no room to stop.

Keep jumping, dashing, and moving forward – or be consumed by the mist!

Jump, dodge, survive… and collect gems to unlock new skins that let you show off your style!​

Features:

• Control your slime with simple swipe gestures: drag your finger/mouse to aim and release to launch

• Master the unique dash mechanic: dash mid-air, bounce off enemies, and stay airborne longer

• Retro pixel-art style and smooth animations

• Fun sound effects and colorful visuals

• Unlock new slime skins to customize your look​

• Local best-score system – beat your own record

• No ads, no internet required

Can you keep the slime alive long enough to become a legend?

Challenge yourself and see how far you can leap!

This game was made by Blazej Cholinski, a 17-year-old independent developer from Poland.

This game includes both original assets created by the developer and third-party assets, which were used under their respective free asset licenses.​

Asset Credits:

Tilemaps, backgrounds, and some spritesheets by Ansimuz

Chest spritesheet by Admurin

Whispers to Remember is a short psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, realism, and quiet dread.

Inspired by unsettling, everyday situations, it tells a self contained story where ordinary plans slowly turn into something deeply wrong.

Emily survives only if she makes the right choices.

The Gameplay

A first-person narrative horror experience built around exploration, interaction, and choice based decisions with a retro horror presentation.

Key Features

  • Choice-driven psychological horror

  • VHS film aesthetic

  • Short, story focused experience

  • Atmospheric sound design and minimal UI

  • Environmental storytelling over jump scares

Some memories fade.
Others refuse to stay silent.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Curiosity always leads you further than fear ever could."

The Dark Curiosity is a first-person psychological sci-fi horror set on an abandoned space station. Left alone, you explore, observe, and piece together what happened. As you move through the station, you uncover fragments of the past while trying to avoid something that reacts to your presence.


You awaken alone on a silent space station, with no memory of who you are.
Something happened here, and you were part of it.

Your thoughts are fragmented, your surroundings unfamiliar, and nothing feels entirely real.
You move forward without answers, driven only by the need to understand where you are and why everything feels wrong.

Move through corridors, labs, and living spaces left behind in silence.
The station shows clear signs of recent activity, but no one remains.

The silence feels unnatural, and the deeper you go, the more the atmosphere begins to weigh on you.
Every room can hold a clue, a warning, or something you were not ready to find.


The station was never truly empty.

At first, it’s just a feeling. Then a sound. Then something you can’t fully see.
You begin to notice movement where there should be none, and patterns that don’t quite make sense.

A presence moves through the station, reacting to your actions and presence. Sometimes hiding buys you time. Sometimes it doesn’t. Learning when to move, when to stay still, and when to listen carefully is the only way to avoid it.

Search abandoned rooms, access terminals, and recover personal logs to understand what happened.
The crew didn’t escape. Their belongings remain, their routines interrupted, their presence still visible.

Piece together clues, follow the traces left behind, and slowly reconstruct the events that led to their disappearance.
But you’re not sure you can trust what you’re seeing.

The deeper you go, the more the pieces connect, revealing how quickly everything fell apart.


Features

  • Explore a detailed space station across multiple areas and levels

  • Avoid something that reacts to your actions and moves through the station with you

  • Navigate around cameras and alarm systems that can reveal your position

  • Use focus mode to detect nearby movement through sound

  • Manage your sanity as darkness takes its toll, and recover by staying close to light

  • Unlock new paths using keycards, clues, and useful items

  • Search rooms, terminals, and logs to piece together what happened

  • Solve light environmental puzzles and interact with station systems

  • Multiple difficulty options, including a lore-focused mode without save points

  • Estimated playtime: 2-4 hours, depending on exploration and playstyle

store_data.about_the_game:
THE DAY THAT WASN’T

is an atmospheric psychological horror / thriller visual novel where your choices don’t just change the story — they decide who you become.

You wake up.

Morning. Coffee. Routine.

And an unsettling feeling that this day has already happened.

But you don’t remember it.

You only feel it.

⸻

🧠 Four Alter Egos. One Mind.

Every decision you make feeds one of four inner alter egos:

• Alex — the rational, “normal” voice

• Shadow — suppressed thoughts and instincts

• Mad — obsession, fixation, emotional instability

• Bully — aggression, denial, control

They influence how the world behaves — and which version of the story unfolds.

⸻

🔄 Nine Days. Diverging Paths.

The same day repeats nine times.

But the experience doesn’t.

• After day 4, the story begins to shift toward one of four narrative scenarios, based on which alter ego dominates.

• The core events remain familiar — but descriptions, choices, tone, and meaning subtly change.

• After days 2, 5, and 8, you experience dream sequences that hint at the path you’re walking — often before you fully realize it.

Some scenarios lead to multiple conclusions.

In total, the game features 16 endings, with branching sub-endings.

⸻

🌀 Psychological Glitches & Distortions

Reality reacts to your inner state:

• visual glitches unique to each alter ego,

• screen distortions, flickers, and noise,

• unstable UI elements,

• audio anomalies and unsettling sound cues.

The more dominant an alter ego becomes,

the more aggressively it reshapes the world around you.

⸻

🎮 What You Will Do

Players will:

• read a branching psychological narrative,

• make meaningful, personality-defining choices,

• observe how reality reacts to their inner state,

• navigate one of several narrative scenarios,

• uncover one of 16 endings — or something in between.

This is not an action game.

It’s a psychological descent shaped entirely by your decisions.

⸻

⏱️ Length

• 2.5–3.5 hours per playthrough

• Replayable paths and endings encourage multiple runs

⸻

🎨 Visual Style

Two background styles reinforce the atmosphere:

• Pixel style — stylized, minimal, unsettling

• Bit / Grain style — darker, more realistic, oppressive

Both emphasize the feeling that something about this day is fundamentally wrong.

Cyndefense Remastered is an HD remake of the original Cyndefense. Cyndefense is a Tower Defenese game set in the universe of Cynn, the God of Light. In Cyndefense Remastered you can expect to battle across multiple different environments using the defenses that Cynn has provided for you and collect tokens that will allow you to face off against the ultimate evil.

With 8 maps available to play right from the start, you can expect a unique journey to unfold unlike anything Cyndefense has ever seen before. Use towers both familiar and new to play in levels that consist of sunny forests, desolate deserts, and fiery hellscapes. 

Cyndefense Remastered is a really easy to jump into game, not requiring a huge time sink, with most matches taking 10-15 minutes to play. However if you do decide to play for a lengthy period of time, there is a lot of content to play through with the many different levels and multiple gamemodes that you can play on each one.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lone Tower is a roguelite survivor where every run lets you turn a single Tower into a completely broken monstrosity. Level up and choose perks, building synergies until your arrows, upgrades, and stats are unstoppable! This isn't a traditional Tower Defense game, each decision will make or break your run and learning how to handle different types of enemies is key to success!

Push deeper and upgrade your Tower to face hundreds of Dark Ones minions, unlock new crafting items, powerful arrows, and a ton of other items that improve future runs. Between attempts, plant seeds, farm crops, mine resources, that give your Tower more power!

Collect and level up Cards to unlock powerful new abilities for your tower. Gather resources and materials around the world to Craft with and build up your arsenal!

Explore the crumbling kingdom of Estaria, overrun by the Dark One’s creatures. Hold the line, survive the chaos, and when everything inevitably falls apart go ahead and start another run and try to make it a little further!

Key Features

  • Roguelite Tower Defense – Every run reshapes your Lone Tower with new perks, arrows, items and synergies

  • Deep Perk & Upgrade System – Modify arrow types, tower abilities, and defensive mechanics in surprising ways

  • Card System – Collect, level up, and play powerful Cards from your deck for stronger runs

  • Crafting & Unlocks – Discover new arrow types, items, and systems that expand future builds

  • Farming System – Grow resources between runs with a simple but useful farming mechanics

  • High Replayability – No two runs play the same thanks to random story events and a variety of level up choices

  • Challenging Endless Waves – Push your limits and see how long your Tower can survive

  • Explore a Dark Fantasy World – Defend Estaria as it slowly collapses under the influence of the Dark One

Explore the Kingdom of Estaria today!

A door. A drawer. Or a curtain.

Have you ever felt strangely unsettled when they’re left just slightly open?

Rules

Somewhere in the room, a gap will slowly begin to open on its own.

You can close it by investigating the gap.

If a gap opens completely, it’s game over.

Survive safely until 5:00 AM to clear the stage.

Overview

You are trapped inside a room.

Look around carefully and check for unnatural gaps that may have appeared.

With each stage you clear, the area you can explore expands.

Clear all stages and attempt to escape from the room.

This game contains scenes designed to evoke anxiety and tension. Player discretion is advised.

Estimated playtime: 1–2 hours.

Contact & Information

Streaming guidelines are available on Patreon.

store_data.about_the_game:
Press your luck in a fight for survival!

Within these walls, your fate rests in the hands of luck. Overpowered 2 - Crux of Fate is a survival shooter where you’ll have to surround yourself with the most powerful weapons you can find in order to fend off relentless waves of enemy monsters! But as you will soon discover, in this arena your luck increases with each failed attempt, and your determination will ultimately be rewarded!

Enter a dark arena where everything is out to kill you. The action ensues in top-down retro pixel art style where you control a lone human combatant, strategically navigating in every direction and around columns to keep incoming enemy hordes at a safe distance, but still within striking range. Start by selecting a single weapon, then pick up experience drops to level up and improve gear or choose additional armaments. Collect hearts to recover health, gain temporary speed boosts and more! How long can you hang on?

Features:

  • Run from enemy hordes while keeping them within range of your selected weaponry!

  • Pick up experience boosts from fallen foes and level up on the fly.

  • Add new weapons to your growing arsenal, each with unique attacks and effects!

  • Focus on strategic movement while your weapons automatically strike nearby enemy monsters.

  • Survive 20 menacing waves and escape the arena.

  • Increase your luck with each failed attempt, gradually creeping towards your goal with determination!

store_data.about_the_game:
"This isn't a game. This is literally just the chat logs from the Game Jam I participated in last month!"

—— An anonymous indie developer

"Have you ever wondered —

What exactly do thousands of developers talk about in their group chats

when a 21-day game creation competition begins?"

Welcome to... the most chaotic development group chat in history.

You've received a group invitation.

【Space, Gugu Gu, Weng Bin, Wu Hai, Long QAVC, Chao Fan, Yu Zhi..... joined the group chat】

【Jishu Meishu LX, Little Green Bug, Little Pudding, and many others joined the group chat】

The moment you click in, you know — you're not getting out for the next 21 days.

This isn't an ordinary chat group. This is a 1:1 accurate simulation of the entire 21-day Game Jam (time-limited game creation competition) process. You will play as a contestant and personally experience all the "wonderful" moments from team formation, to development, to the pre-deadline breakdown, and finally to the post-competition celebration.

Core Gameplay: Two Modes, Double the Fun

Mode 1: Chaotic Group Chat Story

  • Immersive chat experience: Dozens of distinctively quirky online personalities (cat girls, lone wolves, corporate planners, slackers...) chat with you in real time.

  • Ridiculously authentic dialogue: "Four planners argued, kicked out the artists and programmers, and submitted a PPT." "11-person team, only 3 people left by the end." "If I don't fix the bugs, the game is all bugs!"

  • Overflowing with internet memes: Crazy Thursday V50, anime cringe, can your cat do a backflip... every line is exactly how you surf the web.

  • Unexpected "surprises": A hacker invades the group chat? An urban legend crawls into your computer? A teammate suddenly vanishes — is it human nature or...? This is so competition, this is so internet.

Mode 2: Game Jam Production Simulation

1:1 accurate restoration of the entire 21-day competition process, divided into three phases:

📋 Preparation Phase: Form teams! Find teammates! Fill out forms! Will you ride on someone's coattails or go solo? Wuxia fantasy or puzzle boxes? Choose the wrong direction, and everything that follows will be a disaster.

💥 Production Phase: Let's get to work! Write game designs, create art, write code, adjust sound effects. Team management? Doesn't exist. Not fighting is already a win.

You will encounter:

Teammates going MIA (read but not replied)

Scope creep ("Just add one more feature")

Theme misunderstanding ("Bugs? I am bugs")

Feature cutting (from seven chapters down to two)

And... Crazy Thursday V50 begging for an artist.

🎉 Final Phase: All-nighters before the deadline, the relief of submission, post-mortem discussions, and... will you come back for the next one?

🇨🇳 Authentic Chinese Internet Culture, You Know the Drill

  • Crazy Thursday: "Venmo me $50, I'll draw three character sprites for you."

  • Group Chat Alignment Chart: Are you a "chaos enjoyer" or a "tech guru"?

  • Cat Girl Literature: "Baby you're a sweet, soft, squishy little cake, so cute, I want to train you into my little helper."

  • Ghosting Culture: Teammate disappeared? Try summoning them first, if that fails, go solo.

  • And much more... you'll just have to join the group to see for yourself.

So who is this game for?

  • ✅ You've made games (or thought about making games) — you'll laugh, you'll cry, because this is all your past/future.

  • ✅ You've been in any interest group (game groups, fan art groups, even fandom groups) — you'll think "this is literally my group chat".

  • ✅ You just love watching chaotic online friends chat and witnessing epic failures — 21 days guaranteed to make you laugh until your abs hurt.

  • ✅ You're curious about "what indie game competitions are really like" — come, this is ten thousand times more real than any documentary.

Finally, in the words of a group member:

🕹️ Ready for your first (or Nth) Game Jam?

Click "Add to Wishlist"

This isn't an ordinary chat group. This is a 1:1 accurate simulation of the entire 21-day Game Jam (time-limited game creation competition) process. You will play as a contestant and personally experience all the "wonderful" moments from team formation, to development, to the pre-deadline breakdown, and finally to the post-competition celebration.

Core Gameplay: Two Modes, Double the Fun

Mode 1: Chaotic Group Chat Story

  • Immersive chat experience: Dozens of distinctively quirky online personalities (cat girls, lone wolves, corporate planners, slackers...) chat with you in real time.

  • Ridiculously authentic dialogue: "Four planners argued, kicked out the artists and programmers, and submitted a PPT." "11-person team, only 3 people left by the end." "If I don't fix the bugs, the game is all bugs!"

  • Overflowing with internet memes: Crazy Thursday V50, anime cringe, can your cat do a backflip... every line is exactly how you surf the web.

  • Unexpected "surprises": A hacker invades the group chat? An urban legend crawls into your computer? A teammate suddenly vanishes — is it human nature or...? This is so competition, this is so internet.

Mode 2: Game Jam Production Simulation

1:1 accurate restoration of the entire 21-day competition process, divided into three phases:

📋 Preparation Phase: Form teams! Find teammates! Fill out forms! Will you ride on someone's coattails or go solo? Wuxia fantasy or puzzle boxes? Choose the wrong direction, and everything that follows will be a disaster.

💥 Production Phase: Let's get to work! Write game designs, create art, write code, adjust sound effects. Team management? Doesn't exist. Not fighting is already a win.

You will encounter:

Teammates going MIA (read but not replied)

Scope creep ("Just add one more feature")

Theme misunderstanding ("Bugs? I am bugs")

Feature cutting (from seven chapters down to two)

And... Crazy Thursday V50 begging for an artist.

🎉 Final Phase: All-nighters before the deadline, the relief of submission, post-mortem discussions, and... will you come back for the next one?

🇨🇳 Authentic Chinese Internet Culture, You Know the Drill

  • Crazy Thursday: "Venmo me $50, I'll draw three character sprites for you."

  • Group Chat Alignment Chart: Are you a "chaos enjoyer" or a "tech guru"?

  • Cat Girl Literature: "Baby you're a sweet, soft, squishy little cake, so cute, I want to train you into my little helper."

  • Ghosting Culture: Teammate disappeared? Try summoning them first, if that fails, go solo.

  • And much more... you'll just have to join the group to see for yourself.

So who is this game for?

  • ✅ You've made games (or thought about making games) — you'll laugh, you'll cry, because this is all your past/future.

  • ✅ You've been in any interest group (game groups, fan art groups, even fandom groups) — you'll think "this is literally my group chat".

  • ✅ You just love watching chaotic online friends chat and witnessing epic failures — 21 days guaranteed to make you laugh until your abs hurt.

  • ✅ You're curious about "what indie game competitions are really like" — come, this is ten thousand times more real than any documentary.

Finally, in the words of a group member:

🕹️ Ready for your first (or Nth) Game Jam?

Click "Add to Wishlist"

It truly captures the laughter and struggles of indie developers.

store_data.about_the_game:
A minimalist strategy-puzzle game where you guide a cube through mazes filled with moving obstacles. Think ahead, find the safest path, and conquer increasingly challenging levels in this relaxing yet addictive low-poly maze adventure.

Dive into one hundred uniquely handcrafted levels, packed with obstacles, that will keep you thinking, experimenting, and exploring for countless hours of fun.

  • 🧩 100 Unique Levels – Every maze is carefully designed for challenge and variety.

  • 📈 Increasing Difficulty – Start easy and gradually tackle more complex mazes.

  • ⭐ Master Every Level – Complete each maze at your first try and earn all stars.

In every level, your goal is straightforward: guide your cube through the maze and enter the portal. But be careful — the red moving cubes are deadly. Even a light touch will destroy your cube and you’ll have to try again.

  • ⚠️ Avoid Red Cubes – Timing and precision are crucial to survive each maze.

  • 💎 Collect Coins and Gems – Gather rewards to upgrade your cube and unlock new abilities.

  • 🌀 Reach the Portal – Successfully enter the portal to progress to the next level.

Every level offers its own distinctive environment. Journey through diverse biomes as you discover the world of CUBERIO: tranquil forests, sweeping open lands, towering mountain ranges, enchanted woods, and many others waiting to be explored.

Explore a variety of stylized biomes, including:

  • 🌲 Lush forests filled with calm, natural scenery

  • 🌾 Open lands and fields with wide, spacious layouts

  • 🏔️ Mountain regions carved with vertical challenges

  • ✨ Magical woods glowing with mysterious atmosphere

  • 🌌 And many more unique environments waiting to uncover

Collect coins and gems throughout the levels to upgrade your cube, unlock new abilities, and customize its appearance.

  • Speed Upgrade – Move faster and navigate mazes with greater precision.

  • Enemy Freeze – Temporarily stop moving obstacles to create a safe path forward.

  • Cube Customization – Change your cube’s color or even apply your own custom image.

  • And Much More – Discover additional upgrades and abilities as you progress.

store_data.about_the_game:
The river remembers everything. But is this a blessing, or a curse?

You are Jonas Callow, a city investigator. Seven years ago, your mentor and adoptive father, Ewan Merron, was declared dead in a river accident. Now, a single piece of evidence—a blurry photo of a figure on a stone bridge—draws you to the remote, rain-lashed village of Aelwater. You arrive only to find a community already drowning, not just in water, but in the ghostly echoes of its own forgotten past.

Aelwater is not like other places. Shielded by time and strange faith, its people believe the memories of the departed are tangible things, flowing into the waters of the Ael River to be guarded by a mortal keeper. This Riverkeeper’s sacred duty is to purify these memories of their pain, maintaining a delicate balance between the living and the dead. But the balance has shattered. The river is sick, memories bleed into the streets as haunting visions, and a deeper, more mysterious flood threatens to wash everything away for good.

A Story of Memory, Guilt, and Choice

  • Unearth a Personal Mystery: Follow the fragmented trail Ewan left behind. From your shared past in the city to the heart of this cryptic village, piece together the truth of his final days and discover why a man who lived to save others would vanish into legend.

  • Wade Into Living Memories: Wield an ancient compass to stabilize and experience the memories scattered by the flood. Step directly into the defining moments of the villagers’ lives—their love, loss, guilt, and rare peace—and feel the profound emotional weight the Riverkeeper was meant to bear.

  • Decipher the Narrative: The core of interaction lies in an ancient script, the “River Glyphs.” Learn new characters through exploration and solve simple, intuitive fill-in-the-blank puzzles to progress. Understanding the puzzle is understanding the story.

  • Explore a Haunting World: Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted, mini-open world. Traverse the rain-soaked and flood-ravaged landscapes of Aelwater, from its crumbling village center to the silent, dense woods. Every environment tells a story of what was lost.

  • Shape Your Journey: Through dialogue choices, define Jonas’s voice—will you be empathetic, analytical, or guarded? Your tone shapes your unique relationship with your radio contact, Beatrice, as you slowly unravel the mystery of who—or what—is really on the other end of the line.

The river is rising. You are the final witness.

Key Features:

  • A deep, emotional narrative exploring memory, sacrifice, and the cost of truth.

  • Immersive first-person exploration of a mysterious and atmospheric world.

  • Experience vivid, impactful memories from a first-person perspective.

  • Light, narrative-integrated puzzle-solving through an intuitive glyph system.

  • Dialogue choices that meaningfully shape your character’s relationships and tone.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Psychological Horror Visual Novel

You wake up in "The Nursery" - an underground research facility with no memory of how you got there. 100 women claim to be your "mommy" - each one desperate, obsessive, and convinced YOU belong to HER.

A distorted AI voice announces the rules: **Only one mommy can leave alive.**

You must choose who eats, who sleeps, who gets medicine. Every choice starves, poisons, or condemns another. They'll do ANYTHING to survive - manipulate you, betray each other, kill when you're not looking.

The twist? One of them might actually be your real mother. You'll never know which one you sent to the incinerator.

Features

- **100 Unique Mommies** - Each with distinct personalities, psychological profiles, and survival strategies

- **100 Ways to Die** - Brutal, varied death scenes based on your choices

- **Psychological Horror** - Gaslighting, manipulation, guilt, and mind-breaking choices

- **Choice-Based Survival** - Your decisions determine who lives and who dies

- **Multiple Endings** - The final survivor reflects your playstyle

## Content Warning

This game contains:

- Graphic violence and death scenes

- Psychological horror and manipulation

- Disturbing themes and imagery

- Mature content

**Not suitable for children or those sensitive to psychological horror.**

store_data.about_the_game:
Max had a simple goal: help his lonely aunt find a boyfriend.

It was supposed to be sweet.
It was supposed to be helpful.
It was supposed to be harmless.
It was not.

What starts as a well-meaning push toward romance quickly spirals into a mess of awkward conversations, misunderstandings, and questionable interference. The more Max tries to fix things, the stranger romance in Valentine Town becomes.

  • Dates go wrong.

  • Emotions flip unexpectedly.

  • And somehow… it’s all Max’s fault.

With his aunt’s relationship on the line and the town’s love life unraveling, Max must face the chaos he caused and try to fix what he unintentionally ruined.

Max’s Adventures: Valentine’s Edition is a story-driven comedy adventure full of awkward dating, chaotic choices, and meta humor. Step into Max’s shoes—a mischievous kid with the best intentions and zero understanding of romance—and watch the chaos unfold.

store_data.about_the_game:
Max’s Adventures: Summer Edition

Dive into a surreal, story-driven comedy adventure where mischief, player choice, and dreamlike logic collide.

Play as Max, a chaotic kid enjoying a perfectly normal summer day at the beach, running around, causing harmless trouble, and soaking up the sun, until the heat becomes too much and he drifts off to sleep.

When Max wakes up, everything feels… off.

The beach is still there, but it’s been twisted into a dream-born island, shaped by imagination rather than reality. Strange structures, broken landmarks, and impossible scenarios emerge as Max explores a world that no longer follows normal rules.

At its core, the game is about being a carefree kid again. Players are free to be as mischievous as they want, making bold, silly, or absurd decisions without real-world punishment. There are no traditional fail states—only meaningful narrative consequences.

Every choice directly affects how the story unfolds and how the narrator responds. The narration dynamically adapts to player behavior, commenting on disobedience, acknowledging unexpected actions, and reshaping the tone and direction of the experience. Different decisions lead to distinct narrative paths, reactions, and outcomes, encouraging replayability and experimentation.

Stranded on a dream-born island version of the shore, Max must:

  • Survive the strange environment

  • Explore broken structures and bizarre landmarks

  • Uncover hints of other life on this surreal island

What starts as a carefree summer outing quickly becomes a surreal survival adventure, shaped by heat, exhaustion, and imagination. Can Max find his way back to reality, or will the dream become his new normal?

store_data.about_the_game:
Enjoy this short 15-minute first chapter of A Father's Growth Spurt. Which includes: 


Resource Management: 

Choose each day between maintaining the water and fertilizer levels, or weeding out the bonsai pot. If you don't keep the water and fertilizer levels at each weeks random level for three days, the bonsai will die from malnutrition.  Ensure that weeds never encroach on the bonsai's stem; otherwise, no matter how well you've been maintaining the bonsai, the weeds will ultimately kill it. 

Purposeful Limited UI: 

Just like in real life, there is no UI to help keep track of the water and fertilizer levels. This is an intentional design; you need to be aware of the bonsai yourself. You can keep track of any way you seem fit and use in-game clues to help you along the way. 

Storytelling: 

Enjoy a story based on reality between a grandfather, father, and grandchild as they work through the intricacies of life together. Over the span of four weeks, you will talk with both your father and son as the first chapter of A Father's Growth Spurt unravels.

store_data.about_the_game:
Far Below is a calm, cozy 2D mining game about digging downward, collecting resources, and shaping your own branching network of tunnels. No combat — just relaxing exploration, careful planning, and the steady rhythm of carving your path into the earth.

Dig, Mine, and Explore

Use your tools to break through different types of terrain, uncover pockets of ore, and carve out tunnels that lead ever deeper. Each material has its own feel and reward, making every layer unique to explore.

Manage Tunnel Stability

Unsupported caverns can collapse, so you’ll need to reinforce your mine as you go. Place supports, ladders, and platforms to keep your tunnels safe and accessible as your mine grows.

Collect and Upgrade

Gather ores like copper, iron, coal, and rarer materials found in the depths. Bring resources back to the surface to refine, sell, or use for future upgrades.

Build Your Own Vertical World

Shape the mine however you want — straight shafts, branching tunnels, scenic caverns, or tight, efficient corridors. The deeper you go, the more rewarding (and risky) the trip back to the surface becomes.

Relaxing Gameplay Loop

Far Below is designed to be peaceful and satisfying. Dig at your own pace, experiment with tunnel designs, and slowly push deeper with each new day. Until you are... Far Below.

Current Early Gameplay Features

  • Fully destructible tile-based world

  • Multiple ore types with different values

  • Ladder and support placement

  • Tunnel stability system

  • Merchant for selling resources

  • Smelter for turning ore into bars

  • Inventory limits that encourage surface runs

Planned Features

  • New biomes and underground layers

  • Additional tools and upgrades

  • More structures for your mine

  • Surface buildings that expand your capabilities

store_data.about_the_game:
Cube Dodger 3D is a high-speed, neon-soaked arcade runner about pure survival. You pilot a glowing cube ship down an endless highway while waves of enemy cubes get faster, larger, and smarter the longer you stay alive.

Simple controls, brutal difficulty, and a ridiculous rank ladder make every run a tight, score-chasing challenge.

Features

  • Fast, responsive left/right movement and a one-button shield

  • Dynamic difficulty: cubes speed up, grow, and gain moving / homing behavior as you progress

  • Ship Garage with score-unlock ships, premium cosmetics, and a legendary shield-heavy ship

  • Road Garage and Enemy Garage to customize the look of the highway and cubes

  • Local saves only: high scores, unlocks, and equipped cosmetics live on your machine

  • Steam achievements for ship-specific score milestones and an extreme 1000-point goal

There are no ads, no online accounts, and no grind passes—just you, your reflexes, and an endless wall of cubes trying to end the run.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

A man awoke by the lake with no name, no past, nothing.

Rescued by Seren, a pilgrim traveling to the shrine of Saint Nimue, he slowly learns about this world. The "Saint" worshipped in this land. The "evil sorcerer" she sealed away long ago.

Then his memories begin to return.

Who he truly was. Who the woman called "Saint" truly was. And why he was at the bottom of that lake.

When you learn everything, you will be forced to choose.

Features

□□ — The Lost Name The story unfolds from the perspective of a man who has lost his memory. Names he cannot recall appear as "□□" — and when memory returns, those blanks are filled.

Three Endings "Return." "Go back." "Grant her wish." — Three choices with similar weight lead to entirely different conclusions. None of them offer salvation.

A Tale of Unrequited Love This is not a story of revenge. Not a story of anger. He simply loved, and was not loved back. That is all.

Game Info

  • Playtime: 1–2 hours

  • Endings: 3

  • Language: Japanese (English support planned)

Content Warning

This game contains depictions of emotional distress and themes related to death.

From the Developer

A solo-developed visual novel. I wrote a story about unrequited love.

AI-Generated Content

Some visual assets in this game were created using AI image generation technology.

...Repeating for all newly arrived officers. Forget what you were taught. There is no rear here. No reinforcements. There is only Peak and Valley. And "The Dove."

store_data.about_the_game:
Unleash hell in a pixel-art real-time strategy game where you forge your own demonic empire! Lead treacherous hordes of demons and fiendish allies to conquer alien worlds in fast-paced, bloody matches. Every victory rewards new blueprints, letting you customize your faction's tech tree by hand-picking buildings—do you prioritize swarm-spawning hives, gore-fueled siege engines, or shadowy ambush lairs?

Planned Key Features:

  • Brutal Pixel-Art Combat: Gore-drenched battles with strong violence in a retro style—command demons to rip enemies apart!

  • Unleash your greed, collect Blueprints of different units. Upgrade your demons as new Blueprints drop during matches in an action-rpg style. Can you find the rarest blueprints ? By owning the rares blueprints you can unleash the most bizarre and eldritch demons !

  • Choose 1 of 7 factions ... or 2 ... or 3 ? you can combine different units from different factions, as long as you have collected the Blueprints and

  • Engage in different game modes like a tower-defense-like survival mode, a raid mode or a classic rts match.

    (Please note that the game is still in the early phases of developing. Some of these features may be absent in a demo. The type and number of features might change while developing. I am currently overhauling the sprites, so the screenshots are in the early phases of the game.)

store_data.about_the_game:
• Fast-based combat with gorgeous visuals and beautifully animated characters offering a twist on the traditional turn-based formula.

  • 25-30 hours of gameplay, including side-content.

  • A beautiful and vibrant world that rewards exploration.

  • Stunning artwork complements a mature story centered around the themes of love, grief and acceptance in a world that no longer remembers the dead.

  • Augment your equipment through the Crysta system.

  • Build and strengthen relationships through the game’s unique Bond system.

  • Seven playable characters, all with their own unique style of play.

  • Mouse, keyboard and gamepad support!

"In a world that can no longer remember the dead,

The gods have abandoned us.

Seven bells tolled, seven nations were sired

And from it, "they" came, born from the ashes of war"

Death is naught but non-existence, a fleeting memory. Freed from the shackles of grief and compassion, humanity engages in endless war along the ebb and flow of an infinite shoreline.

This is but one tale.

Two superpowers, the Stelgard Empire and Dominion of Heilaheim, have been at war for decades.

Both the Empire and Dominion aim to become the overwhelming force in Sephira – by seizing giant mechanical beings known as “Deus-Machina”; constructs imbued with godlike power, in a bid to become the saviour of humanity.

A prophecy foretells that the “Saviour Legend” shall open up a new path and lead humanity towards a bright future as well as break the unending chains of war.

The figureheads of Sephira are coerced by the Council to seize these "machines of the gods". Their eventual plan is to force all countries into an all-out war, gather all 7 Drives in one place and to accelerate a phenomenon known only as “Tempus Finis”.

Unknown to the Council however, their predecessors put in a fail-safe method to stop a potential Deus-Machina in its tracks – the Divergent; a bio-mechanical being with the ability to shape-shift between human and weapon.

There is only one Divergent in existence: a young girl by the name of Lyd1a who has been subjected to cruel experiments under the guise of the Stelgard Empire’s R&D division and billed as a top-secret project.

Assigned to her is a knight named Elika von Brabant, a skilled swordswoman who leads the Schwartz Ritter or “Black Knights”. When Elika frees Lyd1a from the Grahl Labs, their paths cross with the enigmatic wanderer by the name of Faviann Freki. 

So do their paths entwine, leading them deeper and deeper into the mysteries of the Deus-Machinae, Sephira and perhaps going beyond time and space itself...

store_data.about_the_game:
Dive into The Granny Detective Society, a cozy, funny, and delightfully quirky detective game where you play as Madeleine, a retired little mouse. From her window, she observes her street, pins the secrets of her neighbors… until she’s contacted by a mysterious sisterhood of spy grandmothers. She soon discovers that everyone in the neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

What Awaits You

  •  Observation & Deduction - Watch the street, take photos, track suspicious behavior, and gather clues.

  •  Multiple Perspectives - Unlock several Grannytectives, each with a unique ability (enhanced hearing, night vision, occult sense…) to observe the street from a whole new angle.

  •  Retro Mini-Games - Take a break between investigations with crosswords, word searches, or nonograms… which also hide essential clues.

  •  A Slowly Unfolding Mystery - The whole story takes place in a single street, over a few days that keep repeating. Short or long sessions: every step moves the investigation forward.

  •  Cozy Atmosphere & Humor - A warm world, quirky tone, colorful characters… and grandmothers who are nothing like what they seem.

🧩 Key Features

  •  An accessible, non-violent detective game full of humor

  •  A group of granny detectives with unique abilities and perspectives

  •  One street, one week looping over and over, but endless mysteries

  •  Free observation, photography, grandma-style mini-games, and deductions

  •  A poetic, warm tone inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn, Duck Detective and Don’t Feed the Monkeys

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter HANGAR 51, follow the protocol.

Don’t trust the lights. Don’t trust the recordings.

And whatever you do, don’t open sealed doors without authorization.

WELCOME TO HANGAR 51

HANGAR 51 is a first-person investigation game set inside a sealed 1980s bunker. You play as an inspector sent to examine what remains after a classified incident. The official reports are incomplete, the evidence is scattered, and the facility feels frozen in time. Your mission is to reconstruct the truth.

YOUR CAMERA IS YOUR MAIN TOOL

You don’t just look for clues, you document them. As you explore and solve puzzles, you must use your camera to capture the details that matter:

  • Photograph suspicious objects, environments, and anomalies

  • Capture visual evidence that supports (or contradicts) official records

  • Decide what is worth documenting and what can be ignored

    What you choose to photograph directly affects your investigation.

A FIRST-PERSON INVESTIGATION GAME

store_data.about_the_game:
The Starry Battlefield descends, and every hero is poised for action. Facing the celestial mirror images from the stars, they integrate the combat styles of various schools to eradicate threats high above the cosmos.

Relic Road is a roguelike turn-based tower-climbing game centered around equipment and relic building. As players continue to explore, they can recruit various heroes to expand their team, obtain equipment from heroes, encounter different events, and strengthen their forces. Of course, Legacy Path welcomes every warrior to challenge the final boss at the start of the game.

Game Features:

1. Selectable climbing paths—each floor’s room routes are entirely determined by the player. Players can even challenge the final boss at the beginning.

2. A blend of card gameplay and turn-based combat. Beyond the heroes' turns, cards can assist in battles, often creating unexpected advantages. In certain situations, players can even become masters of card strategy.

3. Over 100 heroes, 300 pieces of equipment, 100 relics, and 100 cards to help players build a formidable lineup.

4. Mirror Images—heroes available to players will also appear as enemies in battles. Know yourself and your foe to triumph in every encounter.

5. Customizable turn-based maps, including terrain, enemies, and their equipment, all designable by players.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a game about a toy railway where engineering thinking meets economic challenges.

Your task is to build an efficient rail network with a limited set of pieces, launch trains, and deliver cargo where it’s needed.

In the economic mode, you’ll face resource shortages and tough strategic decisions: which cargo to deliver first, which route to take, whether to build new branches or rely on your existing lines.

In the sandbox, you can experiment freely: mix different track types, design routes, and decorate your railway world.

Levels introduce new conditions and challenges, encouraging you to find different ways to use the same set of parts.

And the command-sign system lets you create complex routes and junction logic, bringing your constructions to life.

Game features:

  • pixel-art visuals with a cozy toy-like charm;

  • over 10 types of track pieces: from straights and curves to switches and crossings;

  • dynamic train physics: weight-dependent movement, collisions, and derailments;

  • dozens of trains and wagons to collect and combine;

  • a flexible multi-window interface for observing events across the map;

  • diverse levels with unique objectives;

  • an economic mode with limited resources;

  • a sandbox mode for unrestricted building and playful collisions;

  • a command-sign system for train control;

  • automated movement through signs and custom routes for each train;

  • hidden secrets for the most curious players.

This is a game that encourages creativity while challenging your ingenuity.

Years ago, your father George—an undefeated MMA legend—disappeared after a brutal fight that shook the entire world of combat sports. Now, as you fight your way up from rookie to rising star, you’ll train under the wise and battle-scarred Master Lee, face ruthless opponents, and reconnect with Dana, the ambitious promoter who once guided your father’s career.   • Train across multiple disciplines, including Strength, Speed, Vitality, and Dexterity

  • Story-rich campaign filled with mystery, rivalries, branching choices, and emotional moments

  • Legacy-driven progression as you rise from underdog to champion, shaping your own path

store_data.about_the_game:
Fun Asymmetrical Party Game for Up to 5 Players!

Will the peasants survive the Lord’s hunt, or will he stop the revolt before it begins? Find, chase, and outsmart your opponents in this chaotic medieval party game!

Story

You are a medieval peasant, fed up with the Lord’s tyranny. Together with other peasants, you plan a secret nighttime revolt to finally win your freedom. But someone slipped up, and now the Lord is on the hunt. The revolt won’t start without its leaders - can you survive long enough to lead it?

How To Play

As The Lord

As the Lord, your goal is to find and eliminate Rebels hiding among your loyal Peasants.

Watch carefully for nervous behavior - Rebels might fart, slip, or try to run and jump away.

As a Rebel

As a Rebel, your goal is to survive and outsmart the Lord. Hide, run, and use animals and interactive objects to your advantage. Be careful - every noisy fart, slip, or encounter with dung and chickens could give you away!

Features

  • Exciting Hide-and-Seek Action: Play as the Lord hunting peasants, or as peasants trying to outsmart him.

  • Realistic Ragdoll Physics: Enjoy chaotic fights with hilarious ragdoll reactions.

  • Charming Stylized Graphics: A medieval world full of character and charm.

  • Play with Friends or Online: Invite your friends or find games online.

  • Lots of Interactive Objects: Hitch a ride on animals, dodge dung, and sneak past chickens without blowing your cover!

  • Endless Fun & Chaos: Laughter, tense moments, and unforgettable plays every round!

store_data.about_the_game:
As the last light of sunset fades and night begins to settle in, the player slowly walks through Hwaseong Temporary Palace from a first-person perspective, experiencing the space directly. The game contains no complex controls, combat, or puzzles—its structure consists solely of walking. This simplicity allows players to carefully observe their surroundings and absorb the atmosphere at their own pace. The architecture, ambient sounds, and shifting light of the real Hwaseong Palace have been recreated to naturally guide the player’s emotions as they move through the environment.

The core of the experience lies in time and atmosphere. The soft glow just before the sunset disappears, the gradual descent of evening darkness, and the unique blend between the two create a distinctive mood each time you play. Rather than relying on elaborate mechanics, the game focuses on subtle visual and auditory changes—shifts in color temperature, the length of shadows, the sound of wind brushing against structures—inviting players to experience each moment with heightened awareness. Because walking is the only interaction, the game’s flow is entirely shaped by how much the player looks around and which paths they choose to follow.

There are no guides, missions, or objectives within Hwaseong Temporary Palace. You are free to linger in one spot for as long as you wish or move on quickly without constraint. The first-person perspective amplifies the sense of scale, texture, and directional sound, making the walk feel like a genuine nighttime visit to the palace grounds. With intentionally minimal elements, the game encourages the player to interpret the space on their own, leading to a different emotional experience each time.

This title aims to create immersion solely through environment and perspective, without dramatic events or external stimulation. The quiet sound of footsteps, the faint echo of the distant city, and the rustling of leaves blend together subtly, while the shifting colors of the screen guide the tone of the experience. You can never fully predict what scenery will appear in the next moment, yet the transitions focus on calmness and contemplation rather than tension.

Warning: This game contains dark areas and occasional abrupt changes in brightness. Individuals with a history of photosensitive epilepsy or related conditions should consult a doctor before playing. If you experience dizziness, eye strain, or discomfort, stop playing immediately and rest. Maintaining an appropriate distance from your screen and playing in a sufficiently lit environment is recommended.

store_data.about_the_game:
你的老师突然消失，留下了巨大的遗产和迫近的危机。你做出的每一个选择，都将导向截然不同的未来——你可能会继承老师的衣钵，也可能亲手把衣钵砸碎。你的尝试越多，对世界、过去、以及对你身边重要的人的了解也更多。

从你最依赖的老师突然消失的那一刻起，你的人生被按下快进键。曾经你最依赖的人忽然离场，巨大的责任和时刻逼近的威胁落在你的肩上。但说实话，你不觉得这些有任何意义。你想知道自己到底是谁，你需要什么…… 你将自行抉择该去往何处。

【游戏特色与核心机制】

  • 多重选择与命运分支：玩家的每一次干涉，都将影响主角的命运，并将她的未来导向截然不同、甚至相互冲突的可能性。

  • 复杂的亲密关系网： 游戏包含关于许多关于亲密关系（包括但不限于亲情、友情、盟友、敌人以及其他的关系）的思考与描写。

  • 自我认同的探索： 这是一场寻找自我身份、定位自身价值的内心旅程。玩家的每一次干涉都将帮助主角坚定或推翻她的信念与个性。

  • 中二设定与幻想世界：故事发生在一个包含四个奇幻境界的架空世界中，每一个境界都有着截然不同的生态与文化。本游戏致力于传递给玩家幻想一个全新世界的趣味。

【内容警告】

本游戏包含写实的暴力、血腥描写；小众及悖德情感描述；以及对高度敏感的生理主题（生育过程、堕胎）的叙事呈现，可能不适合所有玩家。这些内容被限制在特定的可选故事线中，玩家可选择规避。请谨慎选择。

Gravity has no mercy, and neither do your friends.

In Hands Up, your bond with teammates is tethered by a ruthless physics engine.

You must learn to move as one, balance your momentum, and trust your friends because in this world, letting go means starting over.

Don't just climb, EVOLVE.

Discover hidden Rings scattered across the ascent to alter your physics and abilities.

From high jump boosts to magnetic grips, you can customize your playstyle on the fly.

Master your own unique setup, guide your friends with your discoveries, and rise together.

Express yourself without saying a word.

Dive into a massive library of hand animations and hilarious emotes.

Whether you want to point out danger, give a thumbs up, or taunt a falling friend, the stage is yours.

Customize your 4 slot emote wheel to chain reactions instantly. In Hands Up, style is just as important as survival.

Don't just parkour, perform.

Speak to coordinate, whisper to survive.

Utilizing immersive proximity voice chat, you must work together to ascend.

But be warned: the 'Hands' are listening. Shout for help or scream as you fall but know that in this echo chamber, noise gets you hunted.

  • Ruthless physics

  • Magic Rings (Hooks, Buffs, and Curses)

store_data.detailed_description:
Gravity has no mercy, and neither do your friends.

In Hands Up, your bond with teammates is tethered by a ruthless physics engine.

You must learn to move as one, balance your momentum, and trust your friends because in this world, letting go means starting over.

Don't just climb, EVOLVE.

Discover hidden Rings scattered across the ascent to alter your physics and abilities.

From high jump boosts to magnetic grips, you can customize your playstyle on the fly.

Master your own unique setup, guide your friends with your discoveries, and rise together.

Express yourself without saying a word.

Dive into a massive library of hand animations and hilarious emotes.

Whether you want to point out danger, give a thumbs up, or taunt a falling friend, the stage is yours.

Customize your 4 slot emote wheel to chain reactions instantly. In Hands Up, style is just as important as survival.

Don't just parkour, perform.

Speak to coordinate, whisper to survive.

Utilizing immersive proximity voice chat, you must work together to ascend.

But be warned: the 'Hands' are listening. Shout for help or scream as you fall but know that in this echo chamber, noise gets you hunted.

FEATURES

  • Platform with up to 4 friends

  • Proximity Voice Chat (Enemies can hear you)

  • Online Co-op & Single Player

  • Ruthless physics

  • Magic Rings (Hooks, Buffs, and Curses)

  • 4-Slot Emote Wheel

  • Hands

  • A very long fall
store_data.short_description: Escape a vertical nightmare with up to 4 friends using physics-based parkour. Equip Magic Rings to customize your climb. Don't let go, just keep your Hands Up.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gnomophobia is an unsettling escape-horror experience set in a themed forest split into distinct areas. You spawn with no direction except for scattered notes, each showing an image that reveals where the next clue is hidden. Following these notes is the only way to navigate the forest and find the way out.

But the forest is never safe.
Gnomes appear constantly, silently emerging around you. They freeze the moment you look at them—perfectly still, perfectly quiet. But the second you turn away, they rush toward you with unsettling speed. Every step you take, every clue you search for, every moment your back is turned gives them an opening.

Follow the clues.
Each note shows a simple image pointing to the next section of the forest. Study the picture, match it to your surroundings, and move to the area it represents. If you read the image right, you’ll find the next clue—and get one step closer to escaping.

Credits to schmoldt.art for the gnome.

store_data.about_the_game:
This work is a fan-made visual novel based on the Fate series, set in the fictional city of Newport, USA. It tells the story of a Holy Grail War where each participant is granted "two lives." When a Servant falls in battle, if their Master survives and still possesses Command Spells, they are given one final chance to summon the remaining Servant and continue the fight. This second Servant will be summoned under the same class as the previous one.

In the early stages of the game, players will observe the stories of multiple protagonists from an omniscient perspective, before choosing one of the seven Masters to embody. As that Master, they will strategize and fight to claim the Holy Grail.

The narrative styles, true motivations, and even gameplay mechanics differ significantly among the seven Masters:

- For Masters wholly dedicated to winning the Grail, their perspectives incorporate light strategic elements that challenge the player's intellect.

- For Masters unwillingly drawn into the war, their stories feature more moments of choice and branching paths shaped by the player's decisions.

- Some Masters join the Grail War with a secondary goal: to investigate the hidden orchestrator behind the ritual and thwart any potential阴谋. Their perspectives introduce elements of deduction and推理.

As you decide whose role to take on, I hope you will make a choice that truly resonates with you—who do you believe will emerge as the final victor, and who do you wish to see triumph in the end?

store_data.about_the_game:
Eternal night has fallen over the forest.
The trees have withered, the rivers have stilled, and only scattered embers of light remain.
You are a tiny firefly carrying the last sparks of hope.

Glide through a world where darkness devours life, collecting lost light sources to restore color and warmth to the woods. Each light you carry is a choice — and each choice reshapes the forest and the creatures that still cling to life.

Use three different auras of light to survive and to save others:

  • Blazing Red Light – Burn away lurking monsters and shadows that threaten the forest.

  • Calm Blue Light – Flow like water, speeding across dangerous swamps and unstable terrain.

  • Healing Green Light – Restore withered plants, heal wounded animals and rekindle fading life.

This is not a story about a chosen hero, but about a small, fragile glow that refuses to go out.
Every time you light a path, you push the night back by one more step.
Every time you change your light, you make a new decision of wisdom and courage.

Will you use your power to rush forward, to protect, or to heal?

Key Features

  • 🕯️ Light vs. Darkness – Explore a forest swallowed by eternal night, where every light source matters.

  • 🔴🔵🟢 Three-color Light System – Switch between red, blue and green auras to fight, traverse and heal.

  • 🧩 Gentle Puzzle Platforming – Combine simple platforming with environment-based puzzles instead of twitch-heavy precision.

  • 🐿️ Restore Life – Save injured animals, revive plants and gradually bring warmth back to the world.

  • 🌲 Atmospheric World – Hand-crafted levels with a focus on mood, lighting and quiet storytelling.

  • 💛 A Healing Journey – A short, emotional adventure about facing fear, making choices and becoming a small light for others.

In a world where the night never ends, even the smallest firefly can become the brightest hope.
May every little spark you kindle someday light the way home.

store_data.about_the_game:
☕ About the Game

Welcome to Coffee Coffin —
a traveling café that exists only in the whispers of wandering souls.

On this dim, misty road, the dead come to you carrying stories they never finished, regrets no one remembers, and obsessions buried too deep to fade.
As the Farewell Barista, your task is to listen, understand, and brew a cup of coffee that can finally let their soul rest.

🕯️ ✦ 7 Souls × 7 Deadly Sins × 7 Obsessions

Each visitor embodies a missing piece of a life:

Sloth, Wrath, Envy, Pride, Greed, Gluttony, Lust.

Their stories are short yet cutting, like small gothic fables.
Through fragmented memories and half-spoken confessions, you’ll piece together the struggles they never resolved in life.

🤖 ✦ AI-Generated, Living Dialogues

Every line of dialogue is generated by AI in real time.
Which means:

  • Every conversation is happening for the first time

  • Every farewell is one of a kind

  • Every soul responds differently to your questions and choices

You’re not “reading” a script.
You are truly talking to a soul.

☕ ✦ Guide Souls to Release Through Coffee Recipes

Once you understand their obsession, you must:

  • Choose the coffee beans (symbolizing scars of the past and their nature)

  • Adjust the flavors (reflecting the core emotions of their story)

  • Create a farewell coffee just for them

If you manage to grasp their true obsession,
the coffee you brew will guide them toward their final rest.

🖼️ ✦ A Distinct Gothic Illustration Style

Coffee Coffin uses a visual style of vintage paper texture × hand-drawn gothic linework —
something between gentle and eerie,
like a forgotten soul-portrait from another age.

Every object, every character, every frame of animation is filled with details and symbolism.

🌙 ✦ An Immersive Reflection on Seven Lives

You are not here to judge them.
You are here to stay, to listen,
and to help them finally say the one sentence they never dared to speak in life.

And when you send off the last wandering soul,
you may realize—

somewhere in their stories,
you caught a glimpse of your own.

store_data.about_the_game:
Synopsis

Rover Wilson had a pretty simple life; he went to school, learned about using the Elements, did his homework, and spent time with friends. Then one day a strange group of people appear near a mysterious monument. After the encounter, Rover's entire world as he knew it is about to get flipped upside down.

After being teleported away from his home, Rover finds himself in unfamiliar lands, stranded and alone. What begins as a simple search to find his friends and his way back home will become a quest to save the world. His life will be anything but simple from then on. 

About

Untold Story is a turn-based, party-based RPG with an emphasis on characters and story. Players will follow Rover Wilson on his journey, gaining new allies, completing quests, and learning the history of the world in the process. Manage your actions in battle well, and strategize the best approach to take down the fiercest of foes! 

Explore the world, meet the characters, complete their quests, earn rewards, and hear their stories!

  • Every single NPC is unique, with their own design, behavior, personality, and story! 

  • Almost 200 Quests to complete! From mandatory story quests, to a plethora of side stories that explore the characters and unravel the history of the world of Atomous. 

  • Friend Conversations explore inter party relationships and boost stats. Hidden Items are found throughout, and always present a visual cue to their location. Observe your surroundings, and be rewarded for it!

  • Hundreds of collectibles! From Friend Conversations, to Hidden Items, to books about the world itself. Find them all and get to 100%!

  • Nothing is missable! Every single quest and every single collectible can be obtained from the first opportunity all the way until the no going back point. Doing quests at different points in the story may even offer different dialogue as well! 

Many Monsters and fierce foes are abound as well. Master the combat and take down even the hardest of enemies!

  • Each character gets a single action per turn--the order they take those actions, and what they do, is up for you to decide! Strategize the best plan, and win!

  • Every action requires Energy, with more powerful skills requiring more Energy to preform. Characters naturally gain Energy each turn. Equipment can alter this gain, or change the Energy cost of skills. Find the perfect balance!

  • Every character has their own unique skill set. To exploiting weaknesses, inflicting statuses, and even changing the battle field, everyone has a use. Synergize with other party members and efficiently win each battle.

  • Unleash Decisive Skills at pivotal moments to change the tide of battle. Every character gets a unique skill, while several others can be taught to anyone at your choosing. 

  • Swap party members mid battle! Every turn you are free to switch the party however you like. Think carefully, once an action is taken, the party is locked for that turn!

There are three additional difficulty modes for players to enjoy:

Beginner Mode reduces damage taken & increases EXP earned.

Hard Mode limits the party max to 3 members [Opposed to 5], requiring more precise action management in battle.

Story Mode boosts the stats of all characters, reduces damage taken, grants regen, and doubles EXP earned, so players can focus more on the story, and less on the battles and combat.

store_data.about_the_game:
In this 3D third-person score-attack fighting & combat game, violent criminals keep breaking into your house, and it is your duty to defend yourself. Each passing wave reveals a more difficult set of enemies, as they are stronger, more numerous, and use deadlier weapons. 

You start off without any weapons, but the intruders of your home may use weapons in which you can then possess if you manage to defeat said intruder. 

Play as eight different characters, most of whom have an assistant to help fight. Seven different maps and two different sets of enemies, depending on which character you pick. 

Fight through infinite waves of home invaders, and obtain the highest score possible!

store_data.about_the_game:
In the middle of a remote island, with an old fishing rod in your hands and an ocean that looks endless all around you… this time, you’re not alone.

In this game, you try to survive on an island in the middle of the ocean with up to 4 players. A mysterious creature living on the island demands a certain amount of fish every day. If you can’t meet the daily quota by the end of the day, you lose. So every day is a race: find the right fish, catch them fast, protect what you caught, and deliver it.

While trying to complete the daily goal, you can also buy upgrades that make things easier. More efficient gear, better catching options, and faster progress as a team… because the creature’s demands may become more challenging over time.

And watch out: seagulls flying around the island can smell fish from afar. They might snatch your fish and fly away in an instant. Buy a scarecrow to protect your catch and keep the seagull threat under control.

Key Features

Co-op Gameplay Up to 4 Players
Fish together with your friends, split tasks, and complete the daily goal as a team.

Daily Fish Quota: Fail and You Lose
Collect and deliver what the creature wants before the day ends. If you fall short, the run is over.

Fishing From the Island
No boat: everything happens around the island. Find the most efficient spots and target the right fish.

Rod & Gear Upgrades
Catch better, earn more efficiency, and build stronger progression. The right upgrade choice can save the next day.

Seagulls & Scarecrow
Seagulls can steal your fish. Buy a scarecrow, protect your island, and don’t lose what you earned.

Short Loop, High Pressure, Satisfying Progression
Every day brings a new goal, new risks, and new decisions: catch → protect → deliver → upgrade → prepare for the next day.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build the Game. Control the Market. Replace the Human. 

The Conglomerate is is a journey through the history and monopolistic future of the gaming/corporate industry.

Start as a starving developer in a 1980s garage, developing games by hand to survive. Evolve into a corporate CEO managing a massive MMO studio. Finally, ascend to a ruthless industrialist, replacing human workers with AI and automation to achieve the Singularity.

Three eras. Three genres. One goal: Total Monopoly.

Note: This game is constantly evolving and becoming more refined with development work-in-progress. The description below reports on complete/active development progress.

Phase 1: The Garage (1980s)

Development Status: Complete (Refinements may come with updates)

Genre: Puzzle / Pipeline Defense

Survive the wild west of the 8-bit era. You aren't just filling progress bars; you are building the logic yourself.

  • Pipeline Coding: Connect Logic, Graphics, and Physics nodes on a 2D grid. Build efficient data pipelines while fighting off bugs and avoiding "spaghetti code."

  • The Flow State: Manage your physical needs. Drink coffee to boost coding speed, but beware the "jitters" that cause errors.

  • Dynamic History: Compete against real historical titles.

Phase 2: The Studio (1991–2010)

Development Status: Foundational (Needs refinement & balancing)

Genre: Management / City Builder

You've made your millions. Now, build your empire. Leave the garage behind for a sleek, isometric corporate office.

  • World Builder: Don't just make the game; design the map. Place quest hubs (towns), dungeons, and cities for your flagship MMORPG.

  • Server Management: Manage the physical infrastructure. Route cooling ducts and power cables to prevent your server racks from melting under player load.

  • The Banhammer: Police your community. Ban toxic players—but remember, today's banned troll might be tomorrow's rival CEO.

Phase 3: The Conglomerate (2011–Future)

Development Status: Work-In-Progress (Actively working to complete development of this phase)

Genre: Automation / Dystopian Strategy

Humans are inefficient. To dominate the global market, you must automate everything. The game shifts into a dark, neon-soaked logistics simulator.

  • The Human Pipeline: Build massive conveyor belt systems to route employees between dormitories and workstations. Optimize their output with chemical injections.

  • The Esports Rig: Own the league. Manufacture robotic players disguised as humans to crush the competition.

  • The Singularity: Research technologies to phase out human staff entirely. Achieve 100% market share and infinite efficiency.

Key Features

  • Visual Evolution: Watch the game's graphics evolve in real-time, from gritty 8-bit pixel art to clean corporate vector art, ending in a high-fidelity cyberpunk interface.

  • Diegetic UI: Read community feedback on sticky notes on your wall. Check your health in the reflection of your desk mirror.

  • AI-Driven Narrative: An internal logic engine generates dynamic community reactions, rival CEO threats, and social media storms based on your specific actions.

  • Procedural Audio: A reactive soundtrack that evolves with your company, shifting from chiptune waves to industrial techno as you grow.

Will you remain a creator, or will you become the machine?

store_data.about_the_game:
Full-Scale War in the European Theatre

Command historical divisions from D-Day to the Rhine in a hybrid operational-tactical wargame. A breakthrough 3D Pixel renderer simulates the entire campaign on a single seamless map. From high-level planning down to individual shell impacts, the world is fully procedural and permanently shaped by your actions.

Every decision leaves a mark. Every bullet matters.

Operational Layer – Division-Level Warfare in Full 3D

Establish front lines, logistics, and defenses across a massive hex-based model of Europe - the same terrain used for tactical battles.

Each campaign is shaped by interconnected systems:

  • Supply flows through depots, roads, fuel, and ammunition networks

  • Momentum, casualties, and reinforcement levels shift the front line

  • Dynamic weather alters mobility, visibility, and combat conditions

  • Strategic AI identifies weak points, executes offensives, and disrupts supply

  • Elevation, rivers, vegetation, and buildings all shape maneuver and defense

  • A command-point system rewards coordinated, efficient planning

When opposing divisions make contact, the game transitions into a real-time tactical engagement on fully-realized terrain at that exact location.

Tactical Layer – Command Down to the Platoon

Take direct control of infantry, armor, support weapons, and aircraft in intense, pausable real-time battles on procedurally generated maps that match the operational layer.

  • Voxel-based destruction: breach walls, level buildings, reshape defenses

  • Angle-based armor penetration and realistic ballistics

  • Suppression, morale, cover, and line-of-sight modeled in full 3D

  • Devastating artillery, mortars, and fully modeled air support

  • Precise orders with live path previews and full pause

  • Adaptive AI flanks, suppresses, and counterattacks

  • All terrain damage and casualties persist across the campaign

Units Forged in Battle

Your platoons evolve throughout the war, carrying experience, fatigue, and losses into each new engagement.

  • Gain experience and improved attributes

  • Earn commendations for standout actions

  • Accumulate fatigue, attrition, and reduced cohesion

  • Benefit from HQ support and stable supply

A battle-hardened company in 1945 fights nothing like the same unit on D-Day.

A Different Campaign Every Time

Procedural maps, dynamic enemy plans, authentic orders of battle, and countless alternate outcomes ensure no two playthroughs unfold the same way.

Key Features

  • Hybrid scale: division-level operations down to platoon-level tactics

  • Custom 3D Pixel renderer with one seamless, persistent world

  • Hex-based operational map covering Northern France and beyond

  • Real-time tactical battles with full pause and intuitive controls

  • Intelligent formations, convoy behavior, and pathing previews

  • Persistent voxel terrain destruction across the entire campaign

  • Deep logistics, dynamic weather, and command-point systems

  • Advanced AI at both operational and tactical levels

  • Detailed ballistics, suppression, cover, and morale modeling

  • Persistent experience, fatigue, and cohesion for all units

  • Dozens of historical units with possibility for alternate outcomes

store_data.about_the_game:
A nav-malfunction has dumped you and your crew in uncharted space. You decide to take refuge on a nearby planet. Instead of a rescue party, Head Office has a new directive: begin a full-scale harvest of the planet's mysterious, energy-dense organisms.

Sporbs is a relaxing and satisfying incremental game with a corporate mining twist. Hover your cursor to extract resources and synthesise fuel cells to explore previously inaccessible sectors and earn your ticket home. Just remember - machinery doesn't need sleep, and efficiency will be rewarded.

Simply hover you mouse over organisms to harvest resources from them. No clicking needed. No timers.

Features

  • Unique combo mode: When activated grants a multiplier to the resources harvested. Aim for higher value targets whilst in a combo to maximise your harvest - efficiency will be rewarded.

  • Skill Tree Progression: Spend your resources in a large skill tree with over 170 upgrades that will improve your extraction beams, influence organism spawn rates, unlock unique abilities, automate your harvesting and boost factory efficiency

  • The Fuel Factory: Deposit harvested Orbs and Spores to synthesise Fuel Cells. The factory can be automated and the efficiency improved with upgrades in the skill tree

  • Idle mechanics:  You can unlock idle harvesting, and factory automation, so, you can sit back and watch those numbers go up

  • Discover New Areas: Spend Fuel Cells to unlock new areas with higher organism densities and new organisms with unique abilities to harvest from and upgrade

  • Aesthetic & Atmosphere: Art, SFX and music made by me (No AI) :0

  • Steam Achievements: 20 Steam achievements to be completed

  • Music for Sporbs: A complete unique soundtrack for Sporbs is available (again, no AI used)

store_data.about_the_game:
Dreadmyst is a fantasy online MMO with tab-target combat and deep build customization. Combine abilities from multiple skill trees to craft unique playstyles, conquer dungeons and bosses for powerful gear, and prove your strength in competitive arenas through both PvE and PvP gameplay. 

Four playable classes

Paladin: Divine warriors devoted to honor and piety. They live to defend, protect and serve all believers. Can use Shields and Melee weapons.

Mage: Powerful arcane spellcasters born with magic in their blood who gradually learn to harness their innate abilities over time. Can use Staves and Wands.

Ranger: A wanderer in the wilds, their fierce independence makes them well suited to adventuring and mischief. Can use Bows and Daggers.

Cleric: Best known as healers, they are members of the divine faith who have the ability to cast priest spells from the gods they worship. Can use Shields, Staves and Maces.

Character Customization

Allocate points across core attributes like Strength, Agility, Willpower, Intelligence, and Courage to shape your playstyle. Each stat impacts combat effectiveness, weapon proficiency, and survival capabilities. Level up abilities for enhanced power.

Dungeons

Team up with three other players to tackle challenging dungeon content. Groups need one tank, one healer, and two DPS to succeed. Face deadly boss mechanics that require coordination and timing. Earn powerful loot and rare materials exclusive to these encounters. Higher difficulties offer better rewards but demand tighter execution. Or, run dungeons on your own. Face elite packs and mini-bosses while collecting loot in classic ARPG-style dungeon crawling action.

Arenas

Test your skills in competitive arena brackets. Quick matches where coordination and ability timing determine victory. Chain your crowd control perfectly and punish opponents' cooldowns to climb the ranks.

Combat That Feels Right

Crisp, responsive controls. Classes built around clear, powerful feedback. The kind of polish that just feels good to play. Dreadmyst was built with a custom C/C++ engine written in OpenGL. Gameplay is balanced through strength, not weakness. Every class is packed with abilities that feel good.

Truly Free

This game is non-profit in nature. There are no plans to introduce paid content or monetization.
