store_data.about_the_game:
Deliver magical essences across a living desert in this online co-op survival adventure for up to four players.

Play as wandering desert mages, working together to supply nomads, keep the oasis alive, and push back against a growing invasive market threatening the oasis.

The desert gives little… but it echoes back.

Follow melodies carried by the dunes, survive sudden sandstorms, and use memory, alchemy, and teamwork to complete dangerous deliveries and return home safely.

WORK TOGETHER

Success depends on coordination. Assign roles and survive together… or get lost together.

SURVIVE THE DESERT

The desert is unpredictable and extreme.

  • Navigate without reliable maps or weather forecasts

  • Endure scorching heat and sudden sandstorms

  • Use melodies and echo patterns to find nomads and your way home

KEEP THE OASIS ALIVE

Complete deliveries, support nomad communities, and resist the spread of the invasive market.

Every run helps keep the oasis alive.

FEATURES

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-op + Single Player

  • Delivery-based survival gameplay

  • Memory and melody-driven navigation

  • Proximity voice chat with goofy voice alteration

  • Alchemy crafting

  • Ghosts if you are unlucky enough

  • Melodies. Lots of melodies.

store_data.about_the_game:
Become Who You Were Meant to Be

Choose from 9 unique base classes, each offering a distinct combat identity. Evolve your playstyle even further with 18 specialized subclasses, each introducing new mechanics, abilities, and synergies. Master 15 unique weapons - from life-stealing scythes to boomerangs that strike twice - each with their own passives and attack patterns. Whether you're a precise swordsman, an explosive spellcaster, or an agile ranged fighter, every class delivers fresh ways to dominate the battlefield.  Play solo or in online co-op with a friend.

Level Up, Evolve, and Shape Your Build

Progress through each run by leveling up your character and gaining new strengths. Every 4 levels, select a powerful perk that dynamically alters your playstyle. Perks stack, synergize, and interact with your class and relics, ensuring endless build diversity and that no two runs ever feel the same.

Fight Across 6 Distinct Acts

Journey through a world torn apart by corruption, from eerie cemeteries to enchanted faerie forests, shadowed caves, fortified castles, and hidden criminal hideouts. Each act features its own enemies, hazards, events, and secrets, offering constant variety and challenge with every attempt.

Seek Legendary Treasures

Discover rare relics that dramatically reshape your abilities. Forge unstoppable synergies, break the rules of combat, and grow stronger with each new artifact you uncover as you press deeper into the darkness.

Grow Stronger with Permanent Upgrades

Between runs, spend gold to unlock persistent upgrades. Enhance your stats, open new strategic options, and expand your arsenal—ensuring steady progress even when defeat comes swiftly.

Face Terrifying Bosses

Challenge 23 uniquely crafted bosses, each featuring brutal attack patterns, relentless aggression, and no mercy for the unprepared. These encounters are the ultimate tests of your build, your execution, and your mastery of the game’s mechanics.


Dungeons are only the beginning. The Arena pits you against endless waves of enemies, pushing your build to its limits. Or take on the Hunt—dangerous expeditions where powerful Champions await. Slay them and claim legendary relics as your prize. Victory favors the bold.


A World Worth Fighting For

Sundered Soul: Chains of the Undying blends intense action, rewarding progression, and rich atmosphere into a roguelite experience designed for endless replayability. Forge your strength, conquer the darkness, and reclaim what was lost.  Etch your name into the Steam Leaderboards. 

Key Features:

  • 9 classes, 18 subclasses

  • 2 Player Online co-op 

  • 15 unique weapons with distinct passives

  • 23 Boss fights

  • 12  Miniboss fights

  • Perks with powerful synergies

  • Relic equipment and crafting system

  • Story mode across 6 acts

  • Arena mode with endless waves and mutators

  • Hunt mode with back to back elite bosses

  • Shattered Cycle difficulty scaling

  • Permanent upgrades between runs

  • Full controller support

  • Steam Cloud saves, leaderboards, achievements

  • Customizeable UI

store_data.about_the_game:
Legacy of Chaos Online is a revival of a legend and a long-awaited continuation of an unfinished story. Forget about the usual framework — this is not just a cooperative 3D Hack and Slash with Action-RPG elements, but a living legacy of a world where every hero is a bearer of ancient power, and you are the architect of their strength.

Here, you don't just level up your hero — you build their playstyle anew in every battle, where you choose 5 unique skills out of the 10 available for your character. Create the perfect tactical set to save the world, assemble a crazy combination for a friendly duel, or just experiment to surprise your friends and yourself. Your hero's legacy is not set in stone - it changes with your will and the challenges of chaos.

Key Features:

  • A legacy waiting to be discovered. Immerse yourself in a world with a deep but unfinished story. Your actions are the brush that will complete this saga.

  • Your build is your legend. Forget about predestination. Adapt to any threat! Choose 5 key skills out of 10 right in the middle of battle: create an impenetrable tank, a masterful control specialist, an explosive AoE fighter, or an unpredictable madman with skill synergies that no one has tried before. Every battle is a new interpretation of your hero.

  • The heart of the game is epic co-op. The core of your experience is teamwork in PvE against hordes of monsters and titanic bosses. Combine not only your roles, but also skill sets that you pick up on the fly, to find the perfect combinations to overcome any challenge.

  • Friendly Chaos: A PvP space for fun and experimentation. Where else can you test the most crazy build than in a battle with your friends? Face off against each other in special arenas where you can forget about meta builds. No rank pressure, just explosive creativity and a test of the most ridiculous and ingenious skill combinations. Surprise your opponent with something they never expected!

  • Heroes who bear the burden and glory. Choose your own legendary character, a descendant of great warriors. Each character has a unique arsenal of 10 skills, a story, and a progression tree, but how you assemble your team will define your unique playstyle.

  • Tactics, madness, and moment-by-moment inspiration. In PvE, it's not just about coordination but also about adapting your builds to suit your team's needs. In PvP, it's all about improvisation and creativity, where the player with the most innovative and effective skill combination will emerge victorious.

  • A world that remembers everything. Locations, enemies, and story twists are directly connected to the world's legacy. Experience its depth in serious cooperative campaigns and create a fun mess in its vastness through friendly duels.

It's a smooth and beautiful action game that requires cooperation and fun chaos, with spectacular ability effects, especially when you unleash them in a new sequence that you've perfectly curated.

Legacy of Chaos Online: Choose your hero, define your "five", and create a friendly commotion. Your legacy is in your hands and in your build.

store_data.about_the_game:
Christmas in the Backrooms shouldn’t exist… yet here you are.

You wake up lost in an endless maze of yellow walls and flickering lights — and someone (or something) wants you to celebrate. Santa has stolen the kids gifts and moved them into the Backrooms. Forty-two scattered gift boxes are the only way out. Collect them all, escape the nightmare, and try to survive long enough to beat your best time.

But you’re not alone down here.

Strange figures dressed for the holidays lurk in the dark. Some stalk you quietly. Some charge the moment they notice. And some… don’t follow the rules of reality at all.

Keep moving. Stay alert. Listen closely. The Backrooms never stop watching.

Features

  • 🏃 Fast-paced, time-trial survival horror

  • 🎁 42 gifts to find in one massive, labyrinth-like level

  • 🎅 Multiple disturbing enemies inspired by holiday cheer

  • 🔦 Tools to keep yourself alive… if you use them wisely

  • 😰 Traps, darkness, and constant dread around every corner

This year, Christmas hunts you!
Escape before the Backrooms make you disappear!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Scuba School, a management and exploration game set in a vibrant tropical archipelago. Start with a humble wooden hut by the water and build it into a world-famous scuba destination. Run expeditions, manage gear and safety, train clients, and explore mysterious reefs teeming with life.

Run Your Own Diving Club

Manage every aspect of a growing scuba center:

  • Train beginners into skilled divers

  • Buy, maintain, and upgrade boats

  • Expand your facilities with workshops, classrooms, air tanks, lounges, and gear shops

  • Hire staff to guide tours, fix equipment, and keep customers happy
    Grow your reputation to attract more advanced clients, special expeditions, and elite diving events.

Dive Into Living Underwater Worlds

Slip into the water and explore:

  • Coral reefs, kelp forests, caves, and deep-sea drop-offs

  • Exotic marine wildlife with unique behaviors

  • Hidden shipwrecks, artifacts, and treasure

  • Dynamic weather, currents, and visibility that transform every dive

Each expedition is a mix of beauty, risk, and discovery.

Master Equipment & Safety

Your clients trust you with their lives—so your decisions matter.
Monitor air levels, currents, depth limits, and underwater hazards. Invest in better wetsuits, tanks, regulators, cameras, and sonar. Prevent accidents, rescue divers when things get dicey, and run a professional operation that earns top ratings.

Grow From Shack to Scuba Empire

Turn your small coastal club into a global diving hotspot.
Complete contracts for universities, treasure hunters, wildlife researchers, and tourism boards. Unlock new regions, rare species, and challenging deep-sea missions that test your crew and your gear.

A Relaxing Yet Rewarding Simulator

Every day at your scuba club brings a new rhythm—calm mornings on the dock, frantic gear repairs before a tour, breathtaking underwater explorations, and the satisfaction of watching your community of divers grow.

Build, explore, teach, and discover.
The ocean is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your own little corner by the sea.

Fish Market is a cosy, first-person simulation game about running a small fish market. Buy fresh fish, prepare them by hand, transform them into delicious products like sushi, and slowly grow a calm, welcoming market filled with rare catches and happy customers.

There’s no rush — take your time, enjoy the process, and find satisfaction in the details.

Handle Fresh Fish by Hand

Every fish is prepared manually.

  • Cut, slice, and fillet fish using intuitive, tactile tools

  • Enjoy smooth, satisfying interactions inspired by real preparation

  • Improve efficiency and precision as you practice

From salmon fillets to delicate cuts, preparation is the heart of the experience.

Transform Fish into Products

Fresh fish becomes something special.

  • Turn raw fish into sushi, fillets, and other seafood products

  • Unlock new recipes and preparation methods

  • Arrange your products neatly for customers to browse

Care and craftsmanship lead to better quality and better rewards.

Collect Rare & Beautiful Fish

Discover and collect fish from around the world.

  • Common fish for daily sales, rare species for collectors

  • Unusual colors, sizes, and traits

  • Build a personal collection and display your favorites

Some fish are simply too beautiful to sell.

Build a Peaceful Fish Market

Create a space you enjoy working in.

  • Upgrade your stall with better tools and storage

  • Organize your workspace the way you like

  • Expand gradually as your market grows

Your market reflects your style: calm, efficient, and welcoming.

A Relaxing Daily Routine

Fish Market is designed to be played at your own pace.

  • No timers, no pressure

  • Gentle progression and soft atmosphere

  • A focus on routine, flow, and small improvements

Perfect for unwinding after a long day.

store_data.about_the_game:
DELIVER

Werehouse is a co-op haunted night shift where you and up to 3 other overworked elves package presents for Santa. If stocking the sleigh trucks an hour before Christmas wasn’t stressful enough, you’ll be fighting for your life against holiday monsters while you’re at it.

 

WORK (Together: Optional)

No instructions. All darkness. The werehouse’s magical layout changes form every shift, so finding that one box with the chairs, bananas, or shoes will be as much of a mystery as finding your co-workers when the lights go out on the final round.

 

FIGHT

Be prepared to throw both hands and candy to keep yourself alive. Hordes of monsters are always sneaking in, despite the constant health and safety complaints to Santa. Find holiday-themed weapons and power-ups, and clear a path for a successful shift. Or use your teammates as meat shields while you get the deliveries in on your own.

 

Features

  • Proximity chat

  • Procedural generation

  • Horrendous physics

  • Minimum wage

  • Overworked warehouse employee simulation

  • Lots of weapons and powerups

  • Online Co-Op

  • Elves

store_data.about_the_game:
It's 199X. While out in the woods, you find a strange camera that once belonged to a notable cryptozoologist. The footage within shows that he was successful in locating a few nearby cryptids, but the most recent entries - those that would help determine the fate of the cryptozoologist - are...

ENCRYPTID.

Encryptid is an FMV horror game inspired by iconic monster tamer titles from the mid 90s/00s featuring photography and real-world full-motion video recorded via the Gameboy Camera. Use this footage and all resources available to you to identify, locate, hunt and capture iconic cryptids across a variety of locations to discover what truly happened to your predecessor - and attempt to satiate your own cryptozoological obsession.

The game is an authentic throwback to an era of creature collecting games known for their simple yet evocative visuals, audio and many urban legends. It's designed to be played on both modern systems and the original Gameboy or any device capable of playing or emulating Gameboy titles. 

Do you like cryptids?

FEATURES

  • Creepy, authentic Gameboy inspired visuals and audio

  • Live-action footage filmed on 1998's most iconic digital camera

  • Capture cryptids and pit them against each other

  • Multiple endings to unlock

  • Cryptid horror inspired by urban myth both real and digital

  • It's actually a Gameboy game

  • Does not require $1000 of RAM to run

After arriving in AshCreek, you will move alongside others who have been pulled into this place. Brief alliances, unspoken dependencies, and fractures of trust will all be amplified with every choice you make.

In each story, you’ll progress through conversation, investigation, and careful judgment. Some decisions take effect instantly, while many others reveal their consequences only in later stories—shifting relationships, changing allegiances, and deciding who survives… and who doesn’t.

AshCreek makes no promise of salvation. What awaits you—release, continuation, or another kind of fall—remains unknown.

Only by moving forward can you uncover what AshCreek truly is.

store_data.about_the_game:
Guardian's Heart

Ten years after Jeh’oul’s fall, Vi bears the Guardian's Heart - her mother's sacrifice when she was young. Only she can stand against what rises now: Myougi, grieving daughter of the underworld, unleashes the manifestations of the Seven Deadly Sins to take back what she lost at any cost.

From the Avatar's holy seat, Vi descends to earth's fractured lands - divided tribes, ancient creatures, sunlit shores and deep grottos. Familiar paths twist into new dangers, revealing blooming fairy forests reclaimed from the Underworld's rot. Vi's allies emerge, old and new, each uncovering hidden truths about themselves.

They must use love to conquer: bonds tested by loss, mercy's price, the pull of forbidden power. But Myougi's desperation knows no bounds - she'll do anything for her mother's love, even if it shatters the realms as they all know it.

The Sequel: Fluid, Accessible, Transformable

Evolved from the Roah engine, Wings of Vi 2 delivers the tightest platforming yet - more accessible and fun for all, with optional difficulties of course.

  • Overworld Map: Level types: quest/story-heavy epics, short trials, movement showcases, combat gauntlets (w/ side quests), secrets hidden everywhere!

  • Fast, Fluid Combat: Strike while moving, mid-dash/flutter, chain every attack into seamless combos and juggle staggering foes like a god.

  • Spells & Talents: Almost MMO-style stack Holy Fire damage-over-time, bleed/return Celestial Spears, chain demons to your command. Haste/slow Favor of Time, Holy Light area of effects, chaining Lightning. Lots of things for min-max enjoyers.

  • Movement Options For Days: Double jump, fluttering, leaping slam, Divine Shield hovering, Holy Blast bounces. Responsive, intuitive - feels like cheating.

Solo-devving by Wings of Vi & Boshy creator.

store_data.about_the_game:
Scapnourn Camp Side

Return to a town marked by disaster and decay. Once an ordinary settlement, it now stands abandoned, shaped by tragedy and long-buried events. As you explore its streets and interiors, the remnants of past decisions and hidden truths slowly come to light, revealing a place that was never meant to be forgotten.

Ophelia Vanderlyn

Ophelia returns to the town searching for answers she cannot fully explain. As she explores its distorted streets and abandoned interiors, fragmented memories and unsettling encounters begin to surface. The town reflects her unstable perception of reality, forcing her to confront suppressed thoughts and a past she refuses to face. What begins as a search slowly turns into a deeply personal descent, where the line between reality and delusion grows increasingly unclear.

Gameplay

Experience a third-person psychological horror game that combines exploration, weapon-based combat, and puzzle-solving. Progress through interconnected environments by solving environmental, coded, and logic-based puzzles while using firearms to defend yourself against hostile threats. The game focuses on atmosphere, tension, and narrative-driven discovery as the world subtly shifts around you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Wangchuan Town: The Final Stop for Souls

Wangchuan is a border town in the Underworld, the very last station before reincarnation.

You play as AQi, a young woman with the gift of empathy who has just rage-quit her job in Heaven to return to her roots.

Your inheritance? "Wangchuan Pavilion," a centuries-old establishment left by your grandmother. You are now the glorious, newly appointed Meng Po (Lady of Forgetfulness).

But the Pavilion isn't empty.

"Wait, Grandma took in WHO?"

You’ll manage the shop alongside a mysterious hacker living in the basement and an enigmatic boy named Xiao Meng in the attic. Together, you will face the chaotic, hilarious, and heartwarming daily life of the Underworld.

Crisis in the Afterlife

The winds of "Cost-Cutting and Efficiency" have blown all the way to Wangchuan Town. Facing the threat of an automated reincarnation processing system, how will the traditional Lethe Bar survive?

"Lord Yan (King of Hell), why exactly are we doing this?"

"It's my ultimate solution to pass the upcoming inspections!"

Gameplay: The Soul Bartender

Lethe Bar doesn’t serve alcohol; we only serve Meng Po Soup.

As Meng Po, your family's hereditary empathy allows you to see the flow of emotions in your customers.

  • The Flavors of Life: Use your Emotion Compass to analyze the current state of a soul. Is it regret? Joy? Or lingering resentment?

  • Brewing Memories: Based on the customer's needs (or your own mischievous whims), mix ingredients to create a soup tailored just for them.

  • Watch the Pot: Be careful! Mixing conflicting emotions might cause the pot to explode—and earn you a harsh complaint.

Features

  • A Cozy Narrative: Experience a story filled with modern corporate satire wrapped in classic mythology.

  • Unique Customers: Meet a cast of quirky souls, each with their own "bittersweet" life stories.

  • Hangout System: Invite souls you are interested in for a date. Explore the fantastical sights of Wangchuan Town and create new memories before they forget them forever.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

Mortimer Sadbag and Moory the Pirate were hired to investigate strange disappearances in the remote mountain town of Cliffside. Journey with them on a humorous adventure to the once cozy town and beyond, trekking through dungeons and fighting monsters, to meet the foe responsible.

Characters

Mortimer is a businessman, author, and 'master negotiator' with years of experience working odd jobs, and Moory is a brutish pirate who's always drunk and looking for a fight. With the two together, every encounter becomes a question of negotiate or fight! Each boss comes with a choice to battle or come to some kind of agreement.

Mortimer is a summoner who can call ghosts to fight for him, and Moory is a pirate who drinks scrumpy to power up. Additionally, you will meet even more NPCs and optional party members with their own quirks.

Gameplay

Curse of the Ethereal Dragon is a linear JRPG with turn-based battles and plenty of overworld puzzles and action sequences.

There a four dungeons full of unique monsters, and treasure with powerful effects.

New skills are learned by equipping items instead of leveling up, allowing for freedom of choice and flexible roles of all your party members.

The full playtime can last 6 to 8 hours depending on play style.

Secrets are hidden around every corner for players willing to search for them.

Artwork

All of the sprites, character art, attack animations, and most of the music, is hand drawn.

Curse of the Ethereal Dragon is a linear JRPG with turn-based battles and plenty of overworld puzzles and action sequences.

There a four dungeons full of unique monsters, and treasure with powerful effects.

New skills are learned by equipping items instead of leveling up, allowing for freedom of choice and flexible roles of all your party members.

The full playtime can last 6 to 8 hours depending on play style.

Secrets are hidden around every corner for players willing to search for them.

Artwork

All of the sprites, character art, attack animations, and most of the music, is hand drawn.

Ø Game Introduction

"CyberGhitch" is a narrative-driven puzzle strategy game. It blends current events with internet culture, transforming pervasive online phenomena—such as reductive labeling, context-distorting meme misuse, misleading "science" trends, and the alienation of virtual relationships—into hilarious and bizarre stories. These are innovatively reimagined as "Digital Evil Spirits" within a cyber world. Players become "Cyber Exorcists" on a special mission to uncover the truth behind various online chaos, gradually revealing the nature of these digital evils through puzzles and adventures.

Ø Story Background

Set in the contemporary internet environment, the protagonist starts by debunking online rumors on a platform called "V-Blog" to complete a professor's assignment and gain followers. What begins as a routine academic task takes an unexpected turn during a standard investigation when they encounter "You," an exorcist trapped inside a CD. This sudden "cross-dimensional encounter" shatters the protagonist's mundane life, unleashing a series of bizarre events centered around "anomalies." Forced to team up as the "Cyber Ghostbusting Duo," they clumsily handle emerging supernatural troubles while digging deeper into the truths behind online chaos. Through a string of mysterious puzzles and adventures, they gradually uncover the essence of these "anomalies" and the secret behind "You's" confinement.

Use spiritual sight to perceive truths that are hard to express.

store_data.about_the_game:
Journey to the West: Idle RPG - Pure Offline Adventure

No complex operations required! Auto-battle through the Underworld, traverse the Dragon Palace, and retrieve the True Scriptures with full idle gameplay. Cultivate steadily across the Three Realms, choose from 8 original classes, raise divine gear and pets freely, and refine magical artifacts to break through realms—transform from a mortal to the Fighting Buddha! Experience the most laid-back idle grind while living out your passionate offline Journey to the West dream!

1. 8 Original Classes, 4 Core Roles Covered

Abandon classic MMO faction stereotypes and embrace a unique Journey to the West class system: Physical AoE, Magical AoE, Healer/Support, and Seal/Control. With clear role positioning and skills inspired by mythic lore, new players can start with brute force, while veterans can strategize for different idle scenarios.

2. Full Auto Idle Combat - Hands-Free Progression

Deeply optimized turn-based idle mechanics let your team fight automatically—level up and farm nonstop without manual input. Maximize idle efficiency: progress effortlessly during work breaks or fragmented time, no need to stay up late grinding.

3. Level-Less Equipment Crafting - Divine Gear Grows With You

Say goodbye to the "farm-discard-refarm" gear cycle! Your level 10 starter equipment can evolve into level 130 divine weapons. Unlock full crafting options: enhancement, refinement, socketing, and recasting—freely reforge attribute affixes. In an offline environment, your hardcrafted gear never becomes obsolete—witness every step of your divine gear's growth.

4. Free Pet Cultivation - Mythical Beasts for All

Three pet tiers: Common Pets, Mutated Spirit Beasts, and Ancient Divine Beasts—all obtainable through open collection methods. Every player can grind for divine beasts in offline mode. Stable skill slot unlocking ensures even common pets can rival divine beasts with smart skill combinations.

5. Pure Offline, Non-P2W Ecosystem - Grind for Everything

No online trading or paywalls—all gear, pets, artifacts, and cultivation resources are earned through idling. Save progress locally and via cloud sync for data security. No server shutdown risks—your cultivation journey is permanently preserved. Grind intensity matches sense of achievement!

6. Limitless Strategic Combinations - Unique Idle Builds

Customize your playstyle across 5 dimensions: class talents, gear affixes, cultivation paths, artifact synergies, and pet skills. Create builds like "Burst Damage," "Sustain," or "Control"—add strategic depth to idle gameplay. Every combination carves a unique Journey to the West path—no repetitive gameplay!

store_data.about_the_game:
Invocation is a First-Person Ghost Photography Simulator. Play as a paranormal investigator and explore dark, atmospheric locations where lost spirits still lurk in the shadows.

Sarah Winstead is killed in a car accident at a very young age, and awakens to find herself lost in dark labyrinth called the Otherside. Searching for a way back, Sarah encounters a powerful creature which promises to take her back to the world of the living, but at a price she will only come to know much later. Desperate, Sarah agrees, and is quickly revived. She awakens once again in a hospital bed, embraced by her parents who were assured by doctors that she would not survive.

Years later, Sarah has recovered from her car accident, but is still grappling with her near death experience. She believes that her brief escapade into the afterlife has awakened her ability to feel the presence of ghosts who wander amongst the living. She finds herself frequently disturbed by the many spirits who latch onto her, believing that she can somehow return them back to life.

Sarah moves with her family to Echo Canyon, a place where spirits pour out of a rift between the real world and the Otherside. The dark energy terrorizes the residents of Echo Canyon, many of whom are driven insane or killed under mysterious circumstances. 

Determined to find and seal the rifts to the Otherside, Sarah teams up with an amateur ghost hunter named Jacob. Jacob has long searched for the spirit of his deceased sister, Lily, but has yet to find even a trace her. Recognizing Sarah's potential as someone who can locate spirits, Jacob lends Sarah his ghost hunting equipment and guides her in tracking down the spirits coming from the Otherside.

The objective of this game is to take photographs of ghosts who hide in various rooms of the level. The ghosts can only be seen through the viewfinder of your camera. You will sometimes need to solve environmental puzzles in order to find ghosts. 

Many ghosts will become hostile when seen in the viewfinder, and will attempt to attack you. If you are attacked too many times, your sanity will be depleted and you will have to restart the case. You will have to watch your sanity levels, as well as your camera battery life.

You can find items scattered around the levels which will restore your sanity and battery life. Items found during cases can be sold/purchased in the store menu, and you can upgrade various stats in a separate upgrading menu.

This game features the following:

  • Immersive levels for the player to explore.

  • Paranormal cases to take on.

  • Various ghostly enemy types.

  • A ghost-hunting gameplay system with the following tools:

    • A camera to take photos of ghosts.

    • A radar for detecting the distance of the closest ghost.

    • A spirit box for listening to otherworldly messages from the static.

  • An inventory system and collectible items.

  • An item shop and a stat upgrade system.

  • A retro, PSX visual style.

  • Custom-made low poly 3D assets.

  • Atmospheric sound design.

  • A mysterious and compelling narrative.

store_data.about_the_game:
In a world where all the odds are stacked against you, adventure deeply into the unknown and find the core of the evil that emanates from a city built in the center of the ocean...

Note: This game is designed to be incredibly difficult at the higher difficulty levels. Proceed only if you are prepared to die, over and over and over again. 

  • Learn and master many techniques for traversal and combat - these techniques build on each other, and can be used in tandem to creatively overcome obstacles

  • Use your small, bullet-hell style hit-box for bullets, while your body is still vulnerable to larger objects

  • Overcome seemingly impossible challenges through trial, error, and pure grit

  • Many modes available - infinite mode, classic mode, arcade mode, as well as difficulty settings that feature complete redesigns and adjustments of levels

  • A training mode for practicing techniques and learning tricks

  • Enter a hand painted world with backgrounds done by a professional painter, with no usage of AI art

  • Explore over 30 levels across unique biomes, plus minigames and extra challenges

  • Find many secrets, allowing access to many unlockables and perhaps even hidden endings... 

  • Meet companions and venture together to the center of the ocean

Good luck!

store_data.about_the_game:
Bone Marrow 2 is a tactical 2D top-down puzzle game inspired by the mechanics of 2048. Instead of numbers, you combine survival resources: food increases health, weapons enhance attack, and armor increases defense.

By merging identical items, you create stronger versions and decide what to develop next. Your goal is to strategically combine resources and prepare your heroes for the upcoming night, where any mistake could cost them their lives.

It's not about armor or crests anymore. The hour has come for those whose power is born of the very nature of rage and magic. It's time for new heroes to take up what has become their continuation: a jagged staff that has absorbed the wrath of the earth; a taut bow singing the songs of the wind; a battered grimoire in which the souls of forgotten gods whisper. Their battle is not a battle pattern, but a ritual.

Everything happens in a tense rhythm of day and night. During the day, you can combine items on the field and collect ready-made supplies in your supplies. At night, when the world is frozen in terror, all you can do is desperately try to put the pieces together.

4243960.name: We Are So F*cked: The Last Critter Crew

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

All factories and facilities have long since fallen silent. A harsh, endless winter is closing in. In this post-apocalyptic world, you must lead a small expedition team into frozen ruins, searching for supplies and struggling to survive.

But be warned: the things roaming these abandoned facilities no longer behave as they once did. Some are familiar. Some are not. Whatever the catastrophe left behind, it is still waiting inside.

Day & Night Survival Loop

The game features a full day–night cycle. During the day, you choose target locations and dispatch expedition teams of 1–4 members to explore abandoned facilities in search of vital supplies.
Story progression, new locations, key items, and even new crew members are unlocked through these expeditions.

At night, you must carefully manage your resources to restore your team’s condition. Craft equipment, plan ahead, and prepare your crew to improve exploration efficiency and survival chances for the next day.

Expedition Command System

As the commander of the expedition, you issue real-time orders such as Move, Hide, Search, and Rescue to guide your team through unknown facilities.
Exploration unfolds in real-time within 3D environments, where dangerous creatures lurk in the shadows. Coordinate your crew effectively to strike a balance between search efficiency and survival.

Goals & Multiple Endings

The game features multiple endings.
Key objectives and items required to reach these endings are obtained through exploration, and most endings must be actively triggered by completing specific tasks.

Be warned: as in-game time progresses, the environment grows increasingly hostile. Fail to keep your crew alive before achieving an ending, and a bad ending awaits.

Features

  • A diverse expedition crew:
    Every member of your expedition has known for specific survival traits. Make the most of their strengths and help your team stay alive for as long as possible.

  • Real-time command & tactics system:
    Issue orders through the command panel and send up to four team members into facilities simultaneously for exploration.

  • Camp management:
    Use materials gathered during expeditions to craft gear, maintain your team’s condition, and prepare thoroughly for the next mission.

  • Environmental Survival Challenges:
    To enhance immersion and realism, certain scenarios require additional status management:

    • Underwater cave diving demands careful oxygen control

    • Snowfield exploration requires monitoring body temperature

Additional Game Modes

At launch, the game includes Story Mode only.
A Free Mode will be added later through a free update.

Estimated Playtime

Approximately 6–10 hours, depending on player strategy and decision-making.

4243990.name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Introduction

AFK to Your Heart's Content, Play for Endless Fun—this is our ultimate pursuit for idle AFK games.

About the Game

Deeply integrated with the classic features of dark fantasy games, this title delivers a rich gear-building experience.

Tailor-made for dark fantasy fans who are tired of intense mechanical operations, it lets you fully enjoy the fun of matching top-tier gear without tedious controls.

Important Note

This game is packed with loot-farming elements. A dazzling array of colorful gears and diverse affixes awaits you. Players who dislike this genre, please purchase with caution!

Game Background

On this planet, there once stood a mighty Old God who created all living beings.

However, one day, the Outer Gods descended upon the world, joined forces to defeat the Old God, and sealed him away.

They ruled the entire planet, reshaped the civilizations of its inhabitants, and then vanished without a trace.

As the heir to the Old God’s bloodline, you arrive alone at this sealed land, striving to help the Old God break free from the seal and reclaim his lost power.

Game Features

  • Idle Auto-BattleFull-auto real-time combat frees your hands completely—sit back and watch valuable loot fill your inventory effortlessly!

  • Six Unique ClassesEach class boasts an exclusive and one-of-a-kind skill system. Smartly combine skills to unleash devastating combat power.

  • Robust Gear SystemInheriting the essence of multiple dark fantasy games, gears of different rarities each serve a distinct purpose, enabling countless build possibilities.

  • Town Construction & UpgradeA variety of town buildings offer rich functional services. Customize upgrades at will to greatly enhance building efficiency.

  • Progressive Gameplay ModesFive adventure modes—Expedition, Exploration, Divine Tower, Alternate Dimension, and Finality—unfold in a layered progression, bringing diverse challenge experiences.

  • Single-Player Seasonal ChallengesEach season features unique new content with independent save files. You can embark on any seasonal journey at any time.

●GameOverview

Fear? What's wrong with that? Just punch it.

Evil spirits are gathering in the hospital. You visit with your disciple and purify the evil spirits with punches.

This action game sees players control a muscular onmyoji character from a POV perspective, attacking and defeating monsters with punches as they progress through the stages and story. As the stages progress, long-range attacks become available, reducing the need for intense viewpoint control and reducing the risk of motion sickness. Items that increase attack power, defense power, and stamina are placed on the stages, and by utilizing these, the game's difficulty can be eased. Even beginners can easily complete the game. While it does contain horror elements, there are no excessive depictions of being chased by monsters in a dark, confined space, and all monsters can be defeated by punching, so even those who aren't a fan of horror may be able to enjoy the content (individual results may vary).

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the life of Jesus like never before in True Christ, a unique simulation-adventure game that lets you experience the journey, challenges, and miracles of Christ in an immersive and family-friendly way. Explore detailed, historically inspired environments where every decision matters, manage essential resources like hunger, stamina, and health, and use simple tools to survive and interact with the world around you.

True Christ combines faith-based storytelling with engaging gameplay mechanics, offering a meaningful experience for players of all ages. Witness key moments from Jesus’ life, from humble beginnings to performing miracles, and feel the spiritual journey as you navigate challenges, care for your health, and use your skills to guide others along the path of compassion and faith.

Key Features:

  • Simulation and Resource Management: Monitor hunger, stamina, and health while interacting with your environment. Use simple tools to gather, build, and assist others, giving players a realistic sense of daily life in biblical times.

  • Faith-Based Adventure: Explore towns, countryside, and holy sites, experiencing the life of Christ in a respectful and inspiring way. Learn lessons of compassion, humility, and courage through immersive storytelling.

  • Interactive Environments: Collect items, use tools, and interact with NPCs to complete tasks and witness miracles unfold. Every action has a purpose in the journey of faith.

  • Family-Friendly Gameplay: Designed for players of all ages, with no explicit content, making it suitable for children, teens, and adults who want meaningful entertainment.

  • Cultural and Historical Accuracy: Experience environments, clothing, and traditions inspired by historical biblical accounts, providing an educational and immersive experience.

  • Spiritual Growth and Reflection: Beyond gameplay, True Christ encourages reflection on moral choices, kindness, and service, offering a unique blend of entertainment and spiritual enrichment.

Whether you are a Christian looking for an engaging way to explore the life of Jesus, or a player interested in story-driven simulation adventures, True Christ offers an unforgettable journey. Immerse yourself in faith, adventure, and historical storytelling. Experience the teachings of Jesus, live the miracles, and discover the lessons that have inspired millions around the world.

Join a meaningful adventure that combines simulation, exploration, and narrative. True Christ is more than a game—it is a spiritual journey where every choice, every action, and every moment matters. Perfect for families, educators, and anyone seeking a thoughtful and inspiring experience in gaming.

Play Your Way

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into this fantasy medieval battlefield where Tower Defense meets Real Time Strategy. Lead your units through a campaign as you control group of units, capture towers and push forward to bring down the enemy castle. Face different legions: Crusader, Orc, Undead, and Dynasty, each equips with their own special skill, new units, and a powerful dragon waiting at the end.

Unlock new units as you progress, enhance with upgrade tree, and promote units into stronger forms with unique titles that boost their stats. Use special legion skills at the right moment to turn the tide, with a mix of planning, grouping, marching and a little bit of luck!

BUILD YOUR ARMY

Lift the enemy's gate "little by little" to fight and gather gold from fallen foes.

Use gold wisely to train more soldiers and prepare your line of army.

TRAIN & ARRANGE

Each group of soldiers can be arranged on the bridge, positioning matter

Build your own team composition and strategy to find the odds against the dragon when the gate is fully opened.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pratfall is a game where you fall, dig, explode and rescue your dog! Navigate deadly caves solo or with friends in this chaotic co-op adventure. Team up with friends and watch your step on this journey full of traps, hazards, and the most deadly force of all: gravity. Will you jump into the unknown to rescue your dog?

RESCUE YOUR DOG

Wait, why is there even a construction site in this dog park? Your best friend fell down a hole and needs your help! Grab a helmet, a pickaxe, and some friends to head after your buddy.

DON'T FALL (TOO MUCH)

There’s a huge system of caves down there, and this rescue mission might be tougher than expected! Luckily, someone ordered a bunch of items that are scattered and buried all over the place. Find food to recover from injuries, use ziplines to cross crevasses, or create your own path with your pickaxe, drill, and magic beans. Don't forget to light the way with flares, it's dark down there!

GO DOWN TOGETHER

Turns out, it's not only you who is missing their best bud! All the dogs are gone! Watch out for your friends, catch them if they fall. Too clumsy to catch? Revive them if they're down. Or don't. Feed them weird stuff, toss them a bomb, and see what happens.

FEATURES

  • Online co-op for up to 4 friends or offline singleplayer (4 players tested, but more is possible, try it out!)

  • Voice proximity chat

  • Dogs

  • Every run is different with 3 procedurally generated biomes

  • Destructible terrain, interactive items, and explosive chaos

  • Cosmetics

  • Full key remapping and gamepad support

  • Fall damage is included

  • Mistakenly spelled as "Prattfall"

store_data.about_the_game:
The chain is stubborn. The fog is restless. The air smells like tar.

In the dream you wandered through the pines, and came upon a body, murdered and cold. So innocent and young. By your hand or another, makes no difference now.

The foghorns wake you, violent as ever. Another passenger, here to cross the lake.

Foghorns Drown is a psychological thriller where you play as a ferryman, bringing passengers across a foggy lake to a town drenched in mystery and folklore. The old ferryman has disappeared, and a murder has been committed. How to tell real from dream when the dead speak again?

Features:

  • Physics-based interactions to open doors, drag objects, and operate the crank of the ferry to pull it along a rusty old chain. The foghorns have little patience, the ferry must move.

  • A rich, detailed narrative told through environmental clues, dialogue with the townsfolk, and surreal visions woven into your experience. Look carefully, and listen well, for knowledge is a key for many locks.

  • Elements of psychological horror that escalate as truth begins to blur, and the strange old tales begin to reveal themselves to you. Something in the water demands its toll.

  • Who is the killer? Why did the old ferryman Disappear? Solve the mystery, before it's too late.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your handheld game is the only thing keeping you calm... but something feels wrong. The game seems to know you, its world mirrors your own. And as you play, something begins to move in your room. 

You are not alone.

The only way to survive is to keep playing.
Finish the levels of your turn-based game by fighting enemies and solving puzzles, but stay focused.

Look away for too long, and you might miss something you shouldn't.

At night, your room doesn't feel like yours anymore.
Observe and listen to what is taking place in your chamber. Pay attention to details and focus your gaze on what seems out of place.

Overcoming your fears will not be child's play.

Isn't the game you're playing more than that? Through its characters and events, it reflects a story you're trying to forget. Some actions even have an impact on reality, changing your odds of survival in your chamber.

It must be a coincidence... right?

  • 1 - 2 hour psychological horror experience

  • Unique dual gameplay: balance between the game and surviving in a room that's never safe

  • Unpredictable events that keep you on edge, never letting the fear fade

store_data.about_the_game:
Login

Login is a mystery × horror adventure game where you operate a PC screen to piece together files—images, videos, emails, memos, and various applications—uncovering the hidden story of the computer’s owner and drawing closer to the truth.
Enjoy the sensation of fear slowly building, little by little, through quiet PC interaction.

You Are the Perpetrator

In this game, you experience the story from the perspective of the “perpetrator” in a confinement case.
Deep within cold, sterile folders, unsettling footage and records lie quietly hidden—evidence that a woman is being held captive.

Who is she?
Why did you imprison her?
And why are you “trying to kill her”—?

All of the truth begins to move the moment you to this PC.
Open the files, follow the records, and when you finally reach the truth, what awaits is—an ending in which both your fate, and hers, are rewritten.
A mystery × horror adventure.

There are five endings, plus one secret ending.

movies.name: Eskadrila X - Rift Protocol - Gameplay Trailer

store_data.about_the_game:
Save Earth. Survive the invasion. Rewrite humanity’s fate.

Eskadrila X - Rift Protocol is our modern take on classic arcade shooters — fast, intense, and built for pure fun. You’ll pilot a high-speed recon ship through alien swarms in fully 3D environments, switching between dynamic chase and top-down views for the perfect mix of nostalgia and action.

The year is 2157. Humanity’s first deep-space mission turns into a desperate fight for survival when an alien signal lures our ships into a deadly trap. As Earth’s last surviving pilot, you must battle wave after wave of enemy ships, upgrade your weapons, and face massive boss encounters that test your skill and reflexes.

Your mission is simple - defend humanity, one alien wave at a time.

Gameplay

Eskadrila X - Rift Protocol combines the simplicity of classic arcade shooters with the depth of modern 3D action.

You control your ship’s movement left and right, dodging incoming fire and navigating through enemy formations, while using a targeting crosshair - controlled by your mouse or gamepad - to lock on and fire at alien ships.

Each encounter is fast-paced and skill-driven, challenging you to balance precision aiming, quick reflexes, and smart positioning. As you progress, you’ll earn resources to upgrade your weapons, shields, and special abilities, preparing for tougher waves and massive boss battles that push your piloting skills to the limit.

Whether you prefer the cinematic chase camera or the classic top-down view, every fight delivers that satisfying arcade rush - reimagined in full 3D.

Game Dynamics

Every victory makes you stronger.

As you clear enemy waves, you’ll earn upgrade points that can be spent to enhance your ship - boosting firepower, armor, and more. These upgrades don’t just make survival easier - they change how you play, letting you experiment with different builds and strategies as the alien threat intensifies.

The result is a constantly evolving gameplay experience where every level feels more powerful, faster, and more intense than the last.

Player Progress & Leaderboards

Track your progress as you play, unlock ship upgrades, and chase higher scores as you master each level. Your achievements and leaderboard rankings are tied to your Steam account, letting you compete with players around the world for the top spot.

Perfect your runs, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills as an elite pilot — every score counts, and every run is a chance to do better.

store_data.about_the_game:
— This is the final dream witnessed by Lumia, a lone warrior —

Lumia, a young girl who has survived a world torn apart by endless war,
is suddenly engulfed by a mysterious light during a mission
and falls into an unfamiliar world.

When she awakens, she finds a boy dressed in white standing before her—
and a colossal tower rising endlessly into the sky.

Guided by the boy, Lumia resolves to climb the tower
in order to return to her original world,
believing that hope awaits her at its summit.

■ About the Game

Lumia and the Eternal Tower is an action RPG brought to life
with beautifully crafted, fantastical pixel art.

The game features smooth, responsive controls and a satisfying sense of weight,
along with ever-changing gimmicks and stage structures
that evolve as you ascend the tower.

■ Key Features

  • A wide variety of combat styles through customizable weapons and modules

  • Procedurally changing stages and monsters with every run

  • A natural fusion of side-scrolling action and roguelike RPG mechanics

  • A dreamlike world that feels both nostalgic and mysterious

  • Dialogue events and short stories featuring memorable characters

Within the tower, what you encounter—
is it reality, or merely a dream?

As Lumia descends deeper into the tower,
the shape of a “wish” she herself does not yet realize
begins to take form.

What kind of view awaits you
at the very top of the tower?

This game is currently under development.
Content is subject to change through future updates.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Bartender Life Simulator" is a game where you take on the role of a bartender and owner of a small establishment.

Your uncle rented a small space for you and, with the words "Make a profit," left you to figure everything out on your own.

Think a bartender's main job is to mix delicious cocktails? Not here—your primary task is to listen to customers who don't mind taking advice from a stranger behind the bar. Be careful, though, because someone might actually follow your suggestions.

Still, don't forget about the cocktails. Purchase ingredients and mix drinks, steadily boosting your bar's reputation.

NEON TWIN-STICK • BULLET HELL ROGUELIKE

Mega Trons Survivors is a single-player survival action game built around fast loadout crafting, movement tech, and long-term progression. Choose your chassis, lock in a manual weapon, a starting auto weapon, a magic special, and a boost module, then push through handcrafted stages filled with enemy swarms, minibosses, stage bosses, hidden blueprints, treasure caches, and mastery challenges. Every run feeds back into permanent unlocks with ORE earned, soundtrack rewards, visual effects, and stronger future builds.

Full Game Features

  • 5 playable chassis with different stat profiles.

  • 4 full stages: Aurora Grove, Aperture Isles, Glacial Labyrinth, and Mech Foundry.

  • 23 selectable loadout pieces: 6 manual weapons, 11 auto weapons, 4 magic specials, and 2 boost modules.

  • 24 weapon evolutions that trigger when weapons hit Rank 10.

  • 14 unlockable treasure items and a slot-machine treasure cache system with rerolls, jackpots, and golden caches.

  • 19 amulets that expand the level-up pool.

  • 36 permanent upgrades for long-term progression.

  • 12 stage objectives across the campaign, plus medal clears, tier clears, rescue/escort content, blueprint hunts, and swarm trials.

  • 3 difficulties: Easy, Normal, Hard.

  • Tier I, II, and III clears for each stage.

  • 25 unlockable soundtrack tracks.

  • Unlockable visual FX filters.

  • 68 Steam achievements.

  • Steam leaderboards by stage, difficulty, and tier.

  • 3 player profiles and save-and-resume runs.

  • Full controller support with rumble.

  • 30 supported interface languages.

Steam Feature Flags To Use

  • Single-player

  • Full controller support

  • Steam Achievements

  • Steam Leaderboards

Mega Trons Survivors throws you into a Tron-style neon grid where swarms never stop spawning. Stack broken upgrades, melt thousands of robotic hordes, level up mid-fight, and clear side objectives in every glowing arena to push even deeper into the simulation.

WATCH GAMEPLAY TRAILER

ENEMIES ERASED

1,000S+

ROBOTIC SWARMS ON SCREEN EVERY RUN.

BUILD POWER

LAYER ABSURD SYNERGIES UNTIL THE GRID BREAKS.

SIDE OBJECTIVES

OPTIONAL MISSIONS THAT SUPERCHARGE EACH LEVEL.

CORE SYSTEMS

A neon grid built for ridiculous power fantasies.

Every run drops you into a remixed Mega Tron sector packed with robotic hordes, side missions, risk modifiers, and upgrade shrines. You're not just surviving—you're farming chaos for broken builds.

OVERPOWERED BUILDS

Stack broken upgrades

Combine ricochet beams, orbital drones, static mines, and dash barrages until the screen looks like a glitch in the simulation.

ENDLESS BULLET CURTAINS

True bullet hell density

Swarms don’t spawn in waves—they pour in. Dodge layered patterns, laser walls, and boss barrages that fill the grid with neon.

OBJECTIVE-DRIVEN CHAOS

Side missions & contracts

Escort data cores, purge Mega Tron nests, hack pylons, and race timers. Optional objectives crank up both the danger and the rewards.

COMBAT LOOP

Dash, shred, and deliberately break the balance.

  • ▹Twin-stick mastery: snappy movement and aiming tuned for gamepads and mouse + keyboard.

  • ▹Persistent meta: unlock new archetypes, starting weapons, blessings, and difficulty protocols that reshape runs.

  • ▹Sector micro-stories: each district hides lore fragments, corrupted nodes, and high-risk contracts that tempt you off the optimal path.

store_data.about_the_game:
[A Note from the Developer]

Hello, ClawBurst is a solo development project. I've always loved action games, but I often found that flashy action came with overly complex controls and punishing difficulty. I started developing this game with a simple question: 'Can we have spectacular action with just the right amount of challenge?'

This is my first time on Steam as a developer, not a gamer, so there may be some rough edges. However, I promise to take responsibility for the fun and quality of the game so that you can experience the same joy I felt while making it.

About This Game

ClawBurst is an action roguelite packed with unique personality, dazzling visual effects, and deeply satisfying combat.Combine flashy Rune Skills to wipe out screen-filling hordes of enemies, and evolve your weapons through three stages to survive against massive bosses.

Key Features

A Roster of Unique Characters

Don't let the cuteness fool you. Unleash the massive power hidden behind these unique heroes! Jump into the battlefield with your favorite character. Experience the thrill of breaking through monster waves with intuitive controls and weighty, impactful combat.

Spectacular Rune Skills

Collect and combine Rune Skills of various elements. From lightning storms to freezing blasts and raging fire, annihilate your enemies with effects that light up the entire screen. Find your own ultimate synergy to dominate the field.

3-Stage Weapon Evolution

The longer you fight, the stronger you become.

  • Growth & Change: Your weapons evolve through a total of 3 stages based on your combat experience.

  • Overwhelming Power: Upon reaching the final stage, weapons reveal a completely new look and unleash devastating destructive power.

Tension-Filled Boss Battles

This isn't just about survival. At the end of each stage, a boss armed with powerful patterns awaits you. Use every evolved weapon and rune skill in your arsenal to conquer the boss and claim your victory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Malo, a young man from the capital, never knew his father — a man who left for Karrodim just before he was born.
Driven by a longing for truth and adventure, he begins a journey across a world filled with mysteries, dangers, and secrets.

Explore a rich heroic-fantasy universe inspired by an original 650-page novel.

Meet memorable allies, travel through multiple continents and villages, and confront the threats lurking in the shadows of this vast world.

Be ready for:

  • A branching story where your decisions impact your character

  • A cast of endearing companions who may help you… or complicate your journey

  • Strategic turn-based combat with meaningful choices

  • Challenging bosses demanding smart tactics and careful planning

Side quests, leveling, gear, skills… everything you expect from a classic old-school RPG

Steam-deck support:

Several games have been played internally and by the community on Steam Deck, and no issues have been reported. The recommended controller configuration should work correctly.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everfall 2: Idle Dungeon RPG is here with some of the biggest dopamine you can find! Try out what could be one of the most fun games of 2026!

 Build Your Party - Customize Your Team!

Your squad features four characters of your choosing pick from 6 possible characters, each with many abilities, & build paths to choose from.

ENDGAME IS HUGE!

The fall is only the beginning. Endgame opens two major systems:

Vault Dungeons
Key-based, loot-heavy boss challenges with scaling rewards.

Rune Trials
High-difficulty boss fights where your build quality will be important.
Divine Arena
Incredible content that truly gives you the chance to become unbelievably strong. Everfall 2 will not be as easy on you.

The Pinnacle Boss
Beating the Pinnacle boss will truly be one of the hardest things to accomplish. Get your chance at UNIQUE WEAPONS! Beating this boss is like beating the game, Good Luck :)

Unique Zones with Target Farming!

  • Everfall: Enemies have +15% HP but deal -15% less damage. Prepare for longer battles.

  • Stoneforge: Enemies deal +15% more damage but have -15% less HP. Fast and deadly combat.

  • Umbral Depths: Face 2-5 additional enemies per room, but each enemy has -25% HP and -25% Attack. Survive the swarm.

 Loot, Stats, and Gear Progression!

Everfall 2 introduces NEW types of gear and UNIQUE Weapons from the NEW Pinnacle Boss! Starting from nothing to slowly equipping better level gear, rarities, keystones, runes, & pets has never felt better. From Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic, & even UNIQUE Weapons!

In Everfall 2, we focused a ton of work on proper balancing, while still allowing big numbers & TONS of ENDGAME CONTENT, while still keeping our journey to endgame extremely fun and satisfying.

The game expands into new systems, while still keeping many of the systems you all know in love.

store_data.about_the_game:
When the dastardly Demon King murders the old beloved monarch on the day of his wedding, what is a queen to do but raise a host of great heroes to take revenge and end his darkness once and for all?

Unfortunately, the Kingdom of Buxon has had it easy for too long, and, instead of heroes, possesses only an assortment of laggards, roustabouts and other low-level miscreants.

Fortunately, a new arrival may prove to be the kingdom's salvation. A sorcerous unicorn from far-away lands, famed for his powers of transformation.

They say an alchemist can transform lead into gold. Perhaps then, a sorcerer might be able transform bums into legends - and perhaps, have some fun in the process?

In this classic fantasy RPG, you will gather your party of less-than-heroic individuals, and travel with them from the streets of the Kingdom of Buxon, through dangerous and unexplored wilds, all the way to the Demon King's very ramparts.

Your four companions are your greatest weapon and resource - as you fight together, not only will they grow stronger, but you will also grow closer.

From this - and by the grace of Victor's own shape-changing abilities - they will take on new forms, worthy of heroes, and unlock entirely new abilities and be able to surmount greater challenges still.

A band of true companions, one worthy of song, must be as unique as it must be tightly-knit, after all.

store_data.about_the_game:
Set on the war-torn continent of Aragon, two alliances - the disciplined Sacred Order and the relentless Domination - battle for survival as an ancient Ice Dragon stirs in the frozen North.

Choose your faction, race, and class, then build your hero through a modern MMO combat system, evolving talents, personal Scars, meaningful crafting, and endlessly replayable Evershifting Dungeons.

KEY FEATURES:

Fast, modern MMO combat that rewards positioning, timing, and decision-making. Master active abilities, react to enemy patterns, and outplay your opponents rather than relying on rotations alone.

Shape your character with over 240 talents per class and permanent Scars that fundamentally alter your abilities and playstyle. Every choice matters, creating builds that feel personal, powerful, and distinct.

No two dungeon runs are the same. Dynamic layouts, shifting encounters, and changing modifiers ensure each run offers new challenges, strategies, and rewards.

Choose from unique races and unconventional classes, each grounded in the world’s lore and identity. Visual design, abilities, and narrative themes reinforce meaningful faction and character choice.

Test your skill in Arenas and 5v5 Battlegrounds with equalized gear. Victory is determined by teamwork, strategy, and mastery.

Craft, upgrade, and customize gear to complement your build and preferred playstyle. Progression supports experimentation, letting you refine your character as you grow stronger.

A fair monetization model focused on cosmetics and convenience only. Power is earned through gameplay, not purchases.

Scars of Honor is built for players who want freedom, challenge, and long-term character identity in a living MMORPG world.

Over the course of savage, replayable runs you’ll slay your way through an ever-evolving horde of demons, undead, vampires, and Hellgrowth abominations in visceral souls-inspired melee combat, culminating in brutal boss encounters with the fabled Dead Gods.

Whether you crusade alone or slay together in two-player co-op, the prophecy is yours to fulfill. So rise, violent one. And hail the Order of the Crimson Moon.

IMMERSE YOURSELF IN BRUTAL ELEGANCE

Save Gildenarch by venturing through every district and ward, each more hauntingly beautiful and hellish than the last. This is a world that remembers, reshapes, and pushes back, without demanding punishing repetition. 

 

BLOODSOAKED COMBAT

Fight demons, undead, vampires, and Hellgrowth abominations with adept seraphim vengeance and visceral executions unique to each enemy type. This is a game for those who thrive on improvisational and expressive combat.

 

CRUSADE ALONE OR SLAY TOGETHER

Your ally is your amplifier. Share lives, resurrect the fallen, and unlock synergies through optional co-op mode. Dynamic difficulty scaling and enemy composition ensures every mission feels fresh and personal.

 

HIGH RISK, HIGH REWARD MISSIONS

Every run is a ritual of transformation and resistance, with each triumph earning you new missions, modifiers, and skill achievements.

UNLEASH THE POWER OF ANGELIC TRANSFORMATION

Wreak holy havoc with evolving Nephilim powers that bestow temporary abilities and divinely devastating attacks.

FIND REPRIEVE IN REVERENT SPLENDOR

In between runs, return to the headquarters of the Church, your home base for permanent upgrades and NPC interactions. When ready, survey the city and plan your next mission via the War Table.

store_data.about_the_game:
DIVE INTO THE CO-OP MAYHEM

Why ruin someone's vacation alone when you can do it with friends? Grab your squad and split the duties: one person scans, one barks orders, and everyone else tries not to lose their minds.

DIG THROUGH WEIRD STUFF

Treat every suitcase like a loot box from a fever dream. You’ll find definitely-not-illegal things hidden in most unexpected places. It’s messy, it’s nosy, and it’s definetely glorious.

FLEX YOUR AIRPORT AUTHORITY

You’re the king of the metal detector, so start acting like it! Feel like confiscating a cactus? Do it. Want to deport a guy just because his passport photo is too smug? No problem. Your scanner, your rules.

FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS

Don’t overthink it. There is no need to make everything exceptional. Just follow simple instructions you’ve been given. Spot the banned stuff, stamp the papers, and keep the line moving.

FEATURES

  • Search passengers together with up to 4 players

  • An airport where you must ensure total security

  • Crowds of impatient passengers

  • Contraband in suitcases

  • A cute little dog

  • A stun gun

  • Name badges

  • The fate of vacations is in your hands

store_data.about_the_game:
Build, expand, and destroy. In this card strategy game, you're not just surviving — you're fighting a war. Collect poker combinations to develop the settlement, manage individual decks of Outposts to contain the threat, and use powerful artifacts. Your goal is to completely clear the map of monsters.

BUILD AN IMPREGNABLE FORTRESS

Forget about the boring shuffling of cards. Your settlement is a complex mechanism. To build a forge, a wall or a tower of magicians, you need to collect the perfect combination of cards in your hand. Plan your moves, discard the excess and look for synergies that will turn your village into an economic war machine.

MANAGE MULTI-DECKS

The main feature of the game is Outposts. These are not just buildings, but your strategic outposts on the edge of darkness.

Separate Decks: Each Outpost has its own mini-deck and mechanics.

Threat Deterrence: The more effective your outposts are, the lower the chance of a surprise monster attack on the capital.

Expansion: Competent management of several decks at the same time is the key to victory.

ADAPT OR DIE.

The world is cruel. You will face Disasters: droughts, epidemics and magical storms will test your defenses. But what doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Find and use Permanent Cards (Artifacts) — global bonuses that stay with you and change the rules of the game, allowing you to create unique builds for each party.

THE GOAL: TOTAL EXTERMINATION

In most games, you hide from monsters. Here you go for them. Your task is not to last N days, but to destroy the entire population of monsters.

Build up your military power, send troops on raids and clear the map sector by sector. But remember: if the monsters break through the Outpost line, your capital will fall.

store_data.about_the_game:
Travel to a tropical island where an old hotel awaits you, full of mysteries, problems, and temptations. You are the only man within hundreds of kilometers, and everyone will need your help.

Explore a small open world from a first-person perspective. Freely move around the island, visit the hotel, beach, lighthouse, and jungle, discover hidden paths, and unlock new ways to interact with characters.

This is active gameplay, not a visual novel. Repair the hotel, complete tasks for the female guests, make decisions, and take part in interactive scenes, including erotic mini-games.

Realistic characters and highly detailed environments create the atmosphere of a true resort adventure, where every action can lead to new events and intimate encounters.
